s.name: Film Release Timing
s.description: An independent film distributor and a neighborhood cinema chain are coordinating the timing of a new film. The distributor chooses an early or late release, while the cinema chain chooses a weekend or weekday screening slot.

s.name: Sawmill Kiln Booking
s.description: North Pine Sawmill and Cedar Ridge Sawmill are planning their seasonal kiln bookings with a regional kiln operator. Each sawmill must choose between Early Booking, which requests a firm slot in advance, and Flexible Booking, which leaves its timing adaptable.

s.name: Greenhouse Heat Sharing
s.description: Two neighboring growers share a small greenhouse and coordinate its heating schedule. Grower A chooses Early heat or Late heat, while Grower B chooses Early heat or Late heat.

s.name: Bakery Supply Orders
s.description: A neighborhood bakery chooses whether to place an Early Order or a Flexible Order for its flour supply. Its flour supplier chooses whether to prepare Reserve Flour or fulfill the request through Spot Flour purchasing.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: Two commercial beekeepers must each choose a winter siting location for their apiaries. Each beekeeper chooses between Sheltered Valley and Exposed Ridge for the placement of valuable overwintering colonies.

s.name: Yard Timetables
s.description: A local freight dispatcher and a neighboring short-line coordinator are arranging a small freight-rail handoff. The dispatcher chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot, while the coordinator chooses between Quick Handoff and Planned Handoff.

s.name: Dome Fine-Tuning
s.description: An astronomer and a dome technician share a short observatory dome-time slot. The astronomer chooses between Fine focus and Quick focus for setup, while the technician chooses between Slow slew and Fast slew for moving the dome.

s.name: Bog Rewetting Partnership
s.description: A peatland restoration trust is choosing between Block Ditches and Stage Rewetting for a season-long bog recovery project. A regional water utility is choosing between Fund Works and Delay Funding while coordinating its budget and water-management commitments.

s.name: Riverside Rope Ferry
s.description: A rope-ferry operator chooses between Solo Crew and Pair Crew for a day's service. A riverside market coordinator chooses between Early Shift and Late Shift for the crossing schedule.

s.name: Routine Downlink
s.description: A small satellite operator and a ground-station scheduler are coordinating one routine downlink window. The satellite operator chooses Early Window or Late Window, while the scheduler chooses Narrow Beam or Broad Beam for the station's pass.

s.name: Peatland Patchwork
s.description: A community peatland coordinator and a nearby smallholder are planning a modest peat-bog restoration patch. The coordinator chooses between Raised Bunds and Open Channels, while the smallholder chooses between Seasonal Grazing and Rest Year for the adjacent bog area.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A national conservation agency is planning high-stakes bat survey nights with a major cave-tour operator. The agency chooses between Peak survey and Off-peak survey, while the operator chooses between Reserve access and Public access.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Requests
s.description: A national herbarium and a botanical research institute are arranging a loan request for specimens needed for the coming field season. The herbarium chooses between Priority Review and Standard Review, while the institute chooses between a Broad Request and a Narrow Request.

s.name: Dye-House Scheduling
s.description: Two coordinators at neighboring textile workshops arrange their dyeing shifts at a shared dye house. Workshop A chooses between Early Shift and Late Shift, while Workshop B chooses between First Booking and Second Booking.

s.name: Shared Coppice Planning
s.description: Two neighboring coppice managers are planning the next cutting cycle for stands whose timber enters the same seasonal market. Each manager chooses between Short Cycle and Long Cycle.

s.name: Truffle Permit Accord
s.description: Two neighboring truffle estates are negotiating access to a highly valuable forest whose harvest matters greatly to both parties. Estate A chooses between Open Permits and Strict Permits, while Estate B chooses between Shared Permits and Exclusive Permits.

s.name: Lock-Keeper Shift Swap
s.description: Two neighboring lock-keepers are arranging a small shift swap for their shared canal stretch. Each chooses between an Early Swap, moving the handoff earlier in the day, and a Late Swap, moving it later.

s.name: Ice Rink Resurfacing
s.description: A rink manager and a local hockey club are coordinating an evening ice-rink resurfacing slot. The manager chooses between Deep Resurface and Quick Resurface, while the club chooses between Early Practice and Late Practice.

s.name: Stadium Concessions
s.description: A stadium operator and its concession partner must set their pricing posture for a season with significant budget and reputation consequences. The operator chooses between Premium Pricing and Fan Pricing, while the partner chooses between Premium Pricing and Fan Pricing.

s.name: Canal Lock Window
s.description: A water authority and a major freight consortium must schedule use of a strategic canal lock during a high-stakes shipping window. The authority chooses between releasing the lock early or late, while the consortium chooses between sending vessels through as a convoy or using staggered passage.

s.name: Lock-Keeper Shift Swap
s.description: Two lock-keepers are arranging coverage for an ordinary canal shift. Each chooses whether to keep the assigned shift or swap it with the other lock-keeper.

s.name: Pamphlet Digitisation
s.description: A small local archive's coordinator and a scanning technician are handling a batch of pamphlets. The coordinator chooses between Quick Capture and Careful Setup, while the technician chooses between Standard Scan and Gentle Scan.

s.name: Vineyard Irrigation
s.description: A vineyard manager chooses whether to irrigate a valuable block early or late in the growing season. A regional water cooperative chooses between reserving a dedicated supply for the block and offering flexible delivery during the season.

s.name: Clinic Triage
s.description: A small hospital's triage coordinator and ward charge nurse are arranging staffing for a routine shift. The coordinator chooses between Standard Coverage and Flexible Coverage, while the charge nurse chooses between Early Breaks and Late Breaks.

s.name: Silage Clamp Sharing
s.description: A dairy cooperative and a neighboring livestock cooperative are arranging access to one shared silage clamp during a high-stakes feeding season. Each chooses between Priority Loading, which sets its own loading window first, and Joint Scheduling, which coordinates loading windows with the other cooperative.

s.name: Small Hedge Repair
s.description: A smallholder and a local hedge-layer are arranging a minor hedge-laying contract. The smallholder chooses Narrow Scope, covering only the thinnest gaps, or Broad Scope, including a few borderline stretches; the hedge-layer chooses Early Visit, scheduling the work at the first convenient slot, or Late Visit, fitting it in after another nearby job.

s.name: Moorland Restoration
s.description: A local peatland trust chooses between Ditch Blocking and Patch Mowing for its part of a modest bog-restoration project. A nearby small farm cooperative chooses between Early Work and Late Work for scheduling its own restoration tasks.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations
s.description: A harbour authority is setting the season's pilot-rotation protocol for a busy port, choosing between Fixed Rotation and Flexible Rotation. The harbour pilot cooperative chooses between Early Handoff and Late Handoff for coordinating successive assignments.

s.name: Planetarium Show Slots
s.description: Two coordinators at neighboring planetariums are arranging a small shared astronomy evening. Each coordinator chooses whether their planetarium presents its show in an early slot or a late slot.

s.name: Kiln Delivery Timing
s.description: A small charcoal kiln operator and a nearby restaurant buyer are coordinating a routine delivery. The kiln operator chooses between “Early Burn” and “Late Burn,” while the buyer chooses between “Morning Pickup” and “Afternoon Pickup.”

s.name: Shared Greenhouse Heat
s.description: Two neighboring commercial greenhouses share a thermal-storage loop through a demanding growing season. The first operator chooses Hold Heat or Vent Heat for the loop, while the second chooses Draw Heat or Store Heat when scheduling the shared system.

s.name: Kiln Booking
s.description: Two major sawmills must choose how to book access to a shared industrial kiln for their harvest. Each mill is choosing between Prime Booking and Contingency Booking for this high-stakes processing schedule.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: At a small millpond, the miller and a downstream gardener coordinate a minor sluice adjustment. The miller chooses Open Early or Open Late, while the gardener chooses Request Early or Request Late.

s.name: Harbor Quota Talks
s.description: Two neighboring fishing cooperatives are negotiating how to manage their shared seasonal quota. The first cooperative chooses between Flexible Split and Fixed Split, while the second chooses between Open Forecast and Private Forecast for sharing catch estimates during the talks.

s.name: Rope Ferry Staffing
s.description: A county rope-ferry operator and a neighboring river authority must each set staffing for a heavily used ferry on which both communities depend. The operator chooses between Full Deck Crew and Lean Deck Crew, while the river authority chooses between Reserve Roster and Regular Roster.

s.name: Neighborhood Courier Bid
s.description: Two local courier companies, A and B, are bidding to serve a neighborhood delivery route. Each company chooses between a Fast Bid and a Lean Bid, representing the service package included in its proposal.

s.name: Shared Salt Pan
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan harvesters are making a fine adjustment to how they tend one small shared pan. Harvester A chooses either “Early skim” or “Late skim,” while Harvester B chooses either “Shallow rake” or “Deep rake.”

s.name: Quarry Window
s.description: A quarry operator schedules its main blasting work in either the Morning Blast or Evening Blast window. A haulage contractor serving the quarry chooses between Day Haul and Night Haul for moving the extracted stone.

s.name: Landmark Bell Commission
s.description: Two bell foundries, A and B, are involved in a high-stakes commission for a landmark bell. Foundry A chooses between Rush Casting and Measured Casting, while Foundry B chooses between Early Delivery and Deferred Delivery.

s.name: Morning Avalanche Roster
s.description: Two neighboring avalanche-patrol teams are making a small roster adjustment for a quiet morning. Team A chooses between an Early Sweep and a Late Sweep, while Team B chooses between a Ridge Check and a Trail Check.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: Two neighboring commercial orchard operators face a severe frost watch that could determine the survival of their harvests. Operator A chooses whether to Run Heaters or Delay Action, while Operator B chooses whether to Share Forecast or Withhold Forecast.

s.name: Marathon Detour
s.description: A municipal traffic coordinator chooses between Early Closure and Late Closure for a small marathon segment. The race organizer chooses between Main Route and Side Route for that segment.

s.name: Regional Emergency Triage
s.description: During a severe regional emergency, Hospital North and Hospital South must each choose how to staff their emergency-department triage operation. For either hospital, Full Surge Team means rostering extra clinicians for triage, while Lean Team means scheduling only the baseline triage staff.

s.name: Vineyard Irrigation
s.description: A vineyard manager and a regional water cooperative are coordinating irrigation for a high-value growing season. The manager chooses between Deep Irrigation and Measured Irrigation, while the cooperative chooses between Priority Release and Standard Release.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Windows
s.description: An upstream irrigation cooperative and a downstream water utility are arranging a routine weir maintenance window. The cooperative chooses Early Window or Late Window, while the utility chooses Weekday Window or Weekend Window.

s.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
s.description: Two small ferry operators share a lightly used crossing and are adjusting their next timetable slot. Each chooses either Keep Slot or Shift Slot for its own service.

s.name: Marsh Grazing Compact
s.description: A coastal land trust and a livestock cooperative are negotiating high-stakes grazing rights in a salt marsh. The land trust chooses between Grant Grazing and Hold Reserve, while the cooperative chooses between Accept Terms and Contest Terms.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Windows
s.description: A regional water authority and a downstream farmers’ cooperative are coordinating a weir’s seasonal maintenance window. The authority chooses between Early Closure and Late Closure, while the cooperative chooses between Release Flow and Hold Flow during the planned work period.

s.name: Seed Bank Exchange
s.description: Two neighboring community seed banks are arranging a small exchange of a local bean variety. Bank A chooses between “Small batch” and “Conditioned batch,” while Bank B chooses between “Early exchange” and “Delayed exchange” for the handoff.

s.name: Alpine Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain hut manager and a regional airlift coordinator are arranging a season-critical resupply. The manager chooses between Early Request and Late Request, while the coordinator chooses between Direct Flight and Staged Flight.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Crisis
s.description: A national herbarium is deciding whether to handle a high-stakes loan request with Insure Loan or Decline Loan. A conservation consortium is choosing whether to request Rare Specimens or Common Specimens from the herbarium.

s.name: Weekly Milk Pricing
s.description: Two nearby dairy co-ops are fine-tuning the posted price for a weekly farmers’ market delivery. Co-op A chooses between Keep Price and Trim Price, while Co-op B chooses between Keep Price and Raise Price.

s.name: Peat Bog Restoration
s.description: A small peat bog restoration project is coordinated by a landholder and a local volunteer group. The landholder chooses between Block Ditches and Leave Ditches, while the group chooses between Add Sphagnum and Monitor Only.

s.name: Shared Salt Pan
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan operators, Meridian Salt and Estuary Salt, must plan one season around a shared brine field. Meridian Salt chooses between Early Harvest and Late Harvest, while Estuary Salt chooses between Open Channels and Seal Channels.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Scheduling
s.description: Two neighboring seaweed cooperatives share a busy set of drying racks for the season. Cooperative A chooses either Dense Racks or Spaced Racks, while Cooperative B chooses either Early Turnover or Long Drying. Their scheduling teams make these choices before arranging the season’s rack plan.

s.name: Ringing Station Slots
s.description: At a small bird-ringing station, Ringer A chooses between the Early slot and the Late slot for a routine ringing session. Ringer B chooses between the Reserve slot and the Open slot for arranging the station's other session.

s.name: Seasonal Keg Deal
s.description: A small microbrewery and a neighborhood pub are arranging a seasonal keg distribution deal. The brewery chooses between Direct Delivery and Distributor Pickup, while the pub chooses between Featured Tap and Standard Tap.

s.name: Shared Clamp Season
s.description: Two neighboring dairy farms share a silage clamp for the season. Farm A chooses between Early Fill and Late Fill, while Farm B chooses between Reserve Space and Full Access for its storage plan.

s.name: Raptor Crop Defense
s.description: A large grain-growing consortium hires a licensed falconry contractor to protect its harvest from invasive birds and rodents. The consortium chooses between Full Coverage and Block Coverage, while the contractor chooses between Solo Falcon and Team Flight.

s.name: Orchard Pollination
s.description: A neighborhood orchard manager and a beekeeper are setting up a pollination contract for the coming season. The manager chooses either Scheduled Visits or Open Access, while the beekeeper chooses either Fixed Hives or Flexible Hives.

s.name: Eel Pass Check
s.description: A streamkeeper and a maintenance volunteer are making a small inspection plan for a local eel pass. The streamkeeper chooses between Routine Inspection and Close Inspection, while the volunteer chooses between Gate Check and Flow Check.

s.name: Charcoal Burn Scheduling
s.description: Two charcoal producers, North Ridge Charcoal and Riverbend Charcoal, must schedule major kiln burns around a critical dry-season shipping window. North Ridge Charcoal chooses Early burn or Late burn, while Riverbend Charcoal chooses Early burn or Late burn.

s.name: Vineyard Water Timing
s.description: Two neighboring vineyard managers share a reservoir during a demanding growing season. Each chooses whether to schedule their vineyard's irrigation for Early Release or Late Release.

s.name: Seasonal Letterpress Edition
s.description: A regional letterpress printer and a book publisher are planning a substantial seasonal edition. The printer chooses either Full Proofing, preparing extra press proofs before production, or Fast Run, moving quickly into the print run; the publisher chooses either Early Order, committing its edition plans sooner, or Late Order, waiting longer to commit.

s.name: Coppice Cycle Planning
s.description: A small woodland owner is choosing between a short rotation and a long rotation for the next coppice cutting cycle. A nearby biomass buyer is choosing between an early contract and a later contract for arranging its supply.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspections
s.description: A national river authority chooses between Full Inspection and Routine Inspection of a major eel pass. The dam consortium chooses between Permit Access and Restrict Access during the same high-stakes operating period.

s.name: Rink Resurfacing
s.description: A rink manager is choosing between Quick Resurface and Full Resurface for the ice. A skating-club coordinator is choosing between Early Booking and Late Booking for the club's next session.

s.name: Seed Bank Exchange
s.description: Two national seed banks are arranging a high-stakes exchange of drought-resistant crop samples. Bank A chooses between Open Exchange and Hold Back, while Bank B chooses between Share Samples and Retain Samples.

s.name: Moorland Renewal
s.description: A peatland restoration contractor chooses between Full Rewetting and Partial Rewetting for a bog restoration project. A regional conservation trust chooses between Release Grant and Hold Grant for the same season's work.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: A small orchardist chooses between Early Watch and Late Watch for checking the trees on a chilly night. A neighboring grower chooses between Open Cover and Leave Open for the light frost cloth.

s.name: Cheese Cave Ripening
s.description: A small cheesemaker chooses whether to turn a batch early or late during cave ripening. The cave manager chooses whether to open the ventilation or seal the cave for that period.

s.name: Seasonal Thatching Rotas
s.description: A heritage-roofing cooperative and a restoration contractor are scheduling crews for the same demanding thatching season, where timing affects their budgets and reputations. The cooperative chooses between a Steady Rota, keeping its crew assignments even, and a Surge Rota, concentrating labour during peak weeks; the contractor chooses between a Staggered Rota and a Peak Rota for its own thatching teams.

s.name: Wool Scouring Capacity
s.description: A regional wool cooperative and a major textile mill are making linked decisions about scarce wool-scouring capacity before a high-stakes processing season. The cooperative chooses between Reserve Capacity and Flexible Capacity, while the mill chooses between Early Booking and Spot Booking.

s.name: Mushroom Substrate Supply
s.description: A small mushroom grower chooses between Early pickup and Scheduled pickup for obtaining substrate from a local supplier. The supplier chooses between preparing a Fresh blend and a Recycled blend.

s.name: Small Cheese Cave
s.description: A cheesemaker and a cave keeper are tending a small batch of cheese during ripening. The cheesemaker chooses between Gentle Turn and Frequent Turn for handling the wheels, while the cave keeper chooses between Dry Air and Moist Air for a fine humidity adjustment.

s.name: Shared Salt Pans
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan cooperatives share a brine field for the coming harvest season. Cooperative A chooses Early Harvest or Late Harvest, while Cooperative B chooses Open Channels or Seal Channels.

s.name: Bell Commission
s.description: A master bell foundry and a cathedral consortium are coordinating a major bell commission. The foundry chooses between Standard Pour and Reinforced Pour, while the consortium chooses between Early Dedication and Deferred Dedication.

s.name: Shared Greenhouse Heat
s.description: Two neighboring allotment growers share a small greenhouse during a cool evening. Each chooses between holding warmth in the greenhouse and venting lightly.

s.name: Seasonal Vinyl Queue
s.description: An independent record label and a vinyl pressing plant are coordinating a substantial seasonal release through the plant's vinyl pressing queue. The label chooses between delivering an Early Master or a Late Master, while the plant chooses between assigning a Reserve Slot or a Flexible Slot.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A national polar agency and a major glacier-monitoring consortium must coordinate a high-stakes glacier survey flight campaign. The agency chooses between Early Flight, launching before the seasonal thaw, and Late Flight, launching afterward; the consortium chooses between Shared Corridor, using a jointly coordinated route, and Separate Corridor, using an independent route.

s.name: Turbine Fine-Tuning
s.description: At a small wind farm, the operator chooses between Gentle Tuning and Firm Tuning for a minor turbine adjustment. The maintenance technician chooses between a Short Check and a Full Check before carrying it out.

s.name: Clocktower Upkeep
s.description: The town clockkeeper chooses between Day Service and Night Service for routine clocktower upkeep. The nearby square's coordinator chooses between Keep Chimes and Mute Chimes while the work is scheduled.

s.name: Cable Ferry Timing
s.description: A ferryman is preparing a small cable ferry for a cyclist’s crossing. The ferryman chooses between Gentle pull and Firm pull, while the cyclist chooses between Board now and Wait briefly.

s.name: Mushroom Substrate Commitments
s.description: A commercial mushroom grower and its substrate supplier are setting terms for a high-stakes production cycle. The grower chooses Early Lock-in, committing its cultivation plan ahead of time, or Flexible Order, keeping its substrate request adjustable; the supplier chooses Dedicated Mix, reserving a tailored substrate batch for this grower, or Open Allocation, routing substrate capacity across orders.

s.name: Weekly Flour Order
s.description: A neighborhood bakery and a flour supplier are deciding how to handle the bakery’s next weekly flour order. The bakery chooses between Steady Order and Surge Order, while the supplier chooses between Reserve Stock and Spot Supply.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspections
s.description: A fisheries agency chooses how to inspect an eel pass: Routine Checks or Intensive Checks. A hydroelectric operator chooses whether to schedule the pass as Open Passage or Restricted Passage.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease
s.description: A regional oyster cooperative and a coastal land trust are negotiating control of a major oyster bed lease. The cooperative chooses between Long Lease and Short Lease, while the trust chooses between Restoration Clause and Production Clause.

s.name: Marsh Turnout
s.description: Two neighboring salt-marsh graziers are making a small seasonal adjustment to their shared grazing rights. The first chooses between Light Grazing and Full Grazing, while the second chooses between Early Turnout and Late Turnout.

s.name: Puppet Tour Booking
s.description: A touring puppet troupe is arranging a modest stop with a community arts venue. The troupe chooses between a Short Program and a Full Program, while the venue chooses between a Matinee Slot and an Evening Slot.

s.name: Cranberry Bog Flooding
s.description: Two neighboring cranberry growers must choose how to manage connected bogs during a severe flooding threat. Each grower independently chooses whether to open their levees and release water or hold the water back.

s.name: Ice Rink Resurfacing
s.description: A rink operations manager and a season event director are coordinating an important ice-hockey fixture. The manager chooses between Full Resurface and Quick Resurface, while the director chooses between Prime Slot and Late Slot for the game.

s.name: Orchard Pollination
s.description: A neighborhood orchard grower and a nearby beekeeper are setting a small pollination contract. The grower chooses between Basic coverage and Extra coverage, while the beekeeper chooses between Short rounds and Full rounds.

s.name: Dyeing Shift Coordination
s.description: A small textile mill and a clothing retailer coordinate a batch of fabric for dyeing. The mill chooses either Early Shift or Late Shift, while the retailer chooses either Standard Order or Rush Order.

s.name: Quota Negotiation
s.description: A small fishing cooperative and a nearby seafood distributor are arranging a modest seasonal quota deal. The cooperative chooses between Standard Quota and Flexible Quota, while the distributor chooses between Firm Contract and Open Contract.

s.name: Seasonal Cable Ferry
s.description: A cable-ferry operator and a regional transport office are coordinating a busy seasonal crossing. The operator chooses either Steady Crossing or Quick Crossing, while the office chooses either Open Window or Hold Window for the scheduled service.

s.name: Downlink Fine-Tuning
s.description: A small satellite-operations team is making a fine adjustment to a routine downlink window. The team chooses Early Trim or Late Trim, while the relay-station scheduler chooses First Slot or Second Slot.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A local mason submits either a Lean Bid or a Cushion Bid for repairing a homeowner’s stone wall. The homeowner chooses either Fast Approval or Review First for handling the bid.

s.name: Cathedral Bell Commission
s.description: A bell foundry is deciding how much bronze and finishing effort to commit to a high-stakes cathedral bell, choosing between Full Alloy and Lean Alloy. The cathedral patron is choosing between Rush Casting and Measured Casting for the commission's production schedule.

s.name: Truffle Permit Season
s.description: A regional truffle cooperative and a neighboring cooperative are setting policies for the coming truffle-foraging season. Each chooses between Shared Permits, which coordinate access across their grounds, and Restricted Permits, which limit permits to its own grounds.

s.name: Hedge Laying Contract
s.description: A landowner and a hedge-laying contractor are arranging a modest boundary restoration contract. The landowner chooses Early booking or Late booking, while the contractor chooses Careful laying or Quick laying.

s.name: Shared Downlink Window
s.description: Two small satellite teams share a scheduled ground-station downlink window. Team A chooses either “Early Handoff” or “Late Handoff” for its routine pass, while Team B chooses either “Low Offset” or “High Offset” to position its pass within the window.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: A lighthouse keeper and a regional relief coordinator are setting the season's relief schedule for a remote lighthouse. The keeper chooses “Early handoff” or “Late handoff,” while the coordinator chooses “Full crew” or “Lean crew.”

s.name: Neighborhood Route Bids
s.description: Two local courier companies are bidding to handle a small neighborhood delivery run. Each company chooses between a Tight Bid, allowing little slack in the proposed route, and a Loose Bid, allowing more slack for fine scheduling adjustments.

s.name: Evening Downlink Coordination
s.description: A small Earth-observation satellite operator chooses between the Early Window and Late Window for its routine downlink. A nearby ground-station coordinator chooses between a Shared Slot and a Reserved Slot for handling that evening's satellite downlink windows.

s.name: Orbital Downlink Coordination
s.description: A national space agency and a commercial satellite operator are coordinating a high-stakes satellite downlink window. The agency chooses between Priority Pass and Deferred Pass, while the operator chooses between Early Window and Late Window.

s.name: Scouring Season Capacity
s.description: A wool growers' cooperative and a downstream yarn mill are planning capacity for an important shearing season. The cooperative chooses between Contract Capacity and Spot Capacity for wool scouring, while the mill chooses between Early Booking and Late Booking for receiving the cleaned wool.

s.name: Lock-Keeper Shift Swaps
s.description: Two lock-keepers at the same canal station are arranging their upcoming duties. Each chooses between keeping the assigned shift and swapping it with the other lock-keeper.

s.name: Seasonal Kiln Contract
s.description: A pottery cooperative and an independent kiln operator are coordinating a high-value seasonal firing. The cooperative chooses Fast Firing or Slow Firing, while the operator chooses Early Loading or Late Loading for the kiln schedule.

s.name: Mirror Tune-Up
s.description: A small observatory's optics technician and observing coordinator are deciding how to handle a telescope mirror's recoating. The technician chooses between Fine Adjustment and Full Recoating, while the coordinator chooses between an Early Slot and a Late Slot.

s.name: Eel Pass Check
s.description: A town waterways coordinator and an eel-pass maintenance contractor are arranging a routine inspection. The coordinator chooses between “Inspect now” and “Inspect later,” while the contractor chooses between “Open access” and “Limit access” for the pass.

s.name: Telescope Mirror Recoating
s.description: An observatory and a telescope-optics contractor are planning a mirror recoating during the observing season. The observatory chooses between Full Recoat and Spot Recoat, while the contractor chooses between Standard Schedule and Accelerated Schedule.

s.name: Clocktower Maintenance
s.description: The municipal engineering office and the historic clockmaker’s guild must decide how to handle a failing central clocktower. The engineering office chooses between Full Rebuild and Patch Mechanism, while the clockmaker’s guild chooses between Close Tower and Keep Chiming.

s.name: Dome-Time Allocation
s.description: A national observatory and an international exoplanet consortium are negotiating access to a high-stakes observatory dome schedule. The observatory chooses between Deep Survey and Rapid Targeting, while the consortium chooses between Prime Slot and Reserve Slot.

s.name: Orchard Pollination
s.description: A small orchard grower and a nearby beekeeper are arranging a pollination contract for a few fruit trees. The grower chooses between a brief or full bee visit, while the beekeeper chooses whether to bring open or covered hives.

s.name: Greenhouse Heat Sharing
s.description: Two neighboring greenhouse growers share a small heat-exchange loop overnight. Grower A chooses between Low Heat and High Heat, while Grower B chooses between Low Draw and High Draw.

s.name: Seasonal Dune Fence Plan
s.description: A municipal dunes team chooses whether to place the barrier farther inland or nearer the beach edge, using Inland Fence or Seaward Fence. A beachfront property association chooses between Sparse Fencing and Dense Fencing for the same season-long dune-fence plan.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A saffron grower and a local harvest cooperative are arranging labour for a saffron harvest. The grower chooses Early Crew or Late Crew, while the cooperative chooses Full Crew or Split Crew.

s.name: Milk Season Pricing
s.description: A regional dairy cooperative and a large grocery chain are negotiating the pricing plan for the coming milk season. The cooperative chooses between Stable Price and Premium Push, while the chain chooses between Shelf Support and Price Cut.

s.name: Cottage Thatching Rotas
s.description: Two small thatching crews are coordinating a minor repair on one cottage roof. Crew A chooses between an Early rota and a Late rota, while Crew B chooses between a Staggered rota and a Shared rota.

s.name: Manor Thatching Rotas
s.description: Two estate stewards are coordinating thatching crews for major roofs whose condition will substantially affect their holdings. Each steward must choose whether to place its roof on an early rota or a late rota for the season.

s.name: Radio Telescope Allocation
s.description: A national observatory is planning how to allocate valuable radio telescope time for a season and must choose between Deep Survey and Rapid Survey. A partner research institute must choose between Joint Campaign and Independent Campaign for its own observing program.

s.name: Shared Greenhouse Heating
s.description: Two neighboring greenhouse operators share a small hot-water heating loop overnight. Operator A chooses between “Send Heat” toward the neighboring greenhouse and “Keep Heat” in their own greenhouse, while Operator B chooses between “Receive Heat” by opening its loop and “Close Loop” to isolate its greenhouse.

s.name: Shared Seaweed Rack
s.description: Two neighboring seaweed growers share a small drying rack. Grower A chooses between a Loose Layout and a Tight Layout for arranging the fronds, while Grower B chooses between an Early Turn and a Late Turn for rotating the rack.

s.name: Kelp Harvest Timing
s.description: Two major kelp farms share a high-stakes seasonal harvest market. The first farm chooses between Early Harvest and Full Growth, while the second farm chooses between Early Harvest and Full Growth.

s.name: Hedge Laying Contracts
s.description: A homeowner is choosing whether to schedule a hedge-laying contract for Early Laying or Late Laying. A local hedge contractor is choosing between offering a Firm Quote and a Flexible Quote.

s.name: Shared Quarry Windows
s.description: Two neighboring quarry operators, North Quarry and South Quarry, must each schedule a substantial blasting operation within the season. North Quarry chooses between Morning Window and Afternoon Window, while South Quarry makes the same choice for its own operation.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Capacity
s.description: Two large seaweed cooperatives must make linked decisions about a shared seaweed-drying rack complex. Cooperative A chooses Build Early or Build Late, while Cooperative B chooses Open Access or Hold Capacity for the same racks. Their decisions determine how the seaweed-drying operation is organized.

s.name: Clocktower Maintenance
s.description: A municipal clockkeeper and a clockworks contractor are arranging routine maintenance for the town clocktower. The clockkeeper chooses Day Service or Night Service, while the contractor chooses Full Crew or Small Crew.

s.name: Channel Dredging Schedule
s.description: A port authority chooses whether to schedule its major channel-dredging work in an Early Window or a Late Window. A shipping consortium chooses whether to concentrate vessel movements in Peak Loading or use Spread Loading during the season.

s.name: Bog Water Tuning
s.description: Two neighboring peat bog restoration volunteers are making a small water-level adjustment in one shared patch. The first volunteer chooses between Light rewetting and Deep rewetting, while the second chooses between Narrow bund and Broad bund.

s.name: Local Taproom Delivery
s.description: A small neighborhood microbrewery is choosing whether to deliver its weekly keg to a nearby bottle shop on Tuesday or Friday. The bottle shop is choosing whether to place the keg on its regular shelf or on an endcap.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A city traffic agency is deciding whether to impose an Early Closure or a Late Closure for roads along a major marathon route. The marathon organizer is choosing between a Full Detour and a Phased Detour for managing traffic around the course.

s.name: Clocktower Restoration
s.description: The city’s heritage authority and a specialist clockmaker must decide how to carry out urgent maintenance on a landmark clocktower. The authority chooses between Full Overhaul and Patch Repairs, while the clockmaker chooses between Day Closure and Night Access.

s.name: Shared Archive Digitisation
s.description: A town archive chooses between Batch Scanning and Careful Scanning for a modest digitisation project. Its library partner chooses between Basic Metadata and Rich Metadata for the digital catalogue.

s.name: Seasonal Ferry Slots
s.description: Two ferry operators share a busy crossing and are setting their timetable slots for the coming season. Each operator must choose either an early slot or a late slot for its scheduled sailing.

s.name: Archive Digitisation
s.description: A small archive's scanning technician chooses between Even Lighting and Edge Lighting for a batch of fragile pamphlets. Its cataloguing assistant chooses between Brief Notes and Expanded Notes for the accompanying records.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring dairy farms share a silage clamp. Farm A chooses between Early Cover and Late Cover, while Farm B chooses between Full Cleanup and Quick Cleanup.

s.name: Seasonal Quota Talks
s.description: The North Fleet and the Coastal Cooperative are negotiating their seasonal fishing quota arrangement. The North Fleet chooses whether to land its catch early or delay landing, while the Coastal Cooperative chooses whether to share quota access or keep quota separate.

s.name: Marsh Gate Timing
s.description: Two neighboring salt-marsh graziers are making a small adjustment to one shared grazing arrangement. The first grazier chooses Early grazing or Late grazing, while the second chooses Narrow gate or Wide gate for the access gate.

s.name: Hospital Triage Staffing
s.description: The emergency-department charge nurse chooses between Core Triage and Surge Triage for the shift. The observation-unit coordinator chooses between Shared Intake and Separate Intake for handling incoming triage cases.

s.name: Shared Wall Repair
s.description: A neighborhood property manager and a masonry contractor are arranging a modest repair to a shared stone wall. The property manager chooses between “Basic repair” and “Full repair,” while the contractor chooses between “Standard bid” and “Flexible bid.”

s.name: Kelp Harvest Contract
s.description: A kelp farm manager and a regional processing buyer are arranging one important harvest contract. The farm manager chooses Early Harvest or Late Harvest, while the buyer chooses Spot Purchase or Season Contract.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: A dairy cooperative and a neighboring cattle farm must coordinate access to their shared silage clamp during harvest. The cooperative chooses Cooperative Slot or Farm Slot, while the cattle farm chooses Early Filling or Late Filling.

s.name: Boundary Hedge Contracts
s.description: Two neighboring smallholders, Rowan and Briar, are arranging separate hedge-laying contracts for one shared boundary. Each chooses between a Firm Slot and a Flexible Slot for their contract.

s.name: Lift-Grooming Schedule
s.description: A ski resort's grooming manager and an independent lift-grooming contractor are coordinating preparation for the ski season. The manager chooses between Full Grooming, covering all lift-served routes, and Targeted Grooming, concentrating work on selected routes; the contractor chooses between an Early Shift and a Late Shift for carrying out the work.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Scheduling
s.description: A river district schedules a routine weir maintenance window, choosing between a Weekday Window and a Weekend Window. A nearby irrigation cooperative plans its water use by choosing either a Daytime Draw or an Evening Draw.

s.name: Puppet Tour Timing
s.description: A small puppet theatre director is planning a touring performance and chooses between Early Setup and Late Setup. The receiving venue coordinator chooses between Compact Program and Full Program for the visit.

s.name: Bakery Supply Orders
s.description: A neighborhood bakery and its flour supplier are deciding how to handle the next routine supply order. The bakery chooses Early Order or Last-Minute Order, while the supplier chooses Reserve Stock or Spot Fulfill.

s.name: Cheese Cave Ripening
s.description: An affineur and a wholesale buyer are coordinating the ripening plan for a season’s cave-aged cheese. The affineur chooses between Slow Ripening and Fast Ripening, while the buyer chooses between Strict Cooling and Flexible Cooling for the cave schedule and purchasing plan.

s.name: Flagship Mirror Recoat
s.description: A national observatory and a specialist coating contractor are arranging the recoating of a flagship telescope mirror. The observatory chooses between Full Recoat, stripping and replacing the entire reflective layer, and Patch Recoat, treating selected areas; the contractor chooses between Rush Schedule and Careful Schedule for the operation.

s.name: Archive Workflow
s.description: An archive manager and a digitisation vendor are preparing a small collection for online access. The archive manager chooses between Metadata First and Images First, while the vendor chooses between Standard Capture and Careful Capture.

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queue
s.description: A record label is scheduling a major seasonal release with a vinyl pressing plant. The label chooses between Early Master and Late Master, while the plant chooses between Rush Queue and Standard Queue.

s.name: Branch-Line Timing
s.description: A local freight dispatcher chooses whether a short train uses an Early Slot or a Late Slot through a branch-line junction. A nearby yard coordinator chooses between keeping a Steady Pace and arranging a Quick Turn for the connecting freight.

s.name: Turbine Service Scheduling
s.description: A tidal-turbine operator chooses between Early Service and Deferred Service for a routine maintenance visit. A servicing contractor chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew for that visit.

s.name: Overnight Corduroy
s.description: At a busy ski resort, the grooming supervisor and lift-operations manager must coordinate the next major grooming window, with the decision important for the season’s budget and guest reputation. The supervisor chooses between Full Groom and Selective Groom, while the manager chooses between Early Lift and Later Lift.

s.name: Thatching Crew Rotas
s.description: Two small thatching crews are coordinating work on neighboring cottage roofs. The first crew lead chooses between a Compact Rota and a Split Rota, while the second crew lead chooses between an Early Start and a Late Start.

s.name: Radio Telescope Allocation
s.description: A national radio observatory and an international research consortium are deciding how to use a scarce radio telescope window. The observatory chooses between Deep Survey, reserving the window for a long observation, and Rapid Scan, dividing it among shorter scans; the consortium chooses between Protected Band, requesting an exclusive frequency band, and Shared Band, coordinating use of a band with other observations.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: An upstream miller and a downstream grower share a millpond sluice. The miller chooses Open Early or Open Late, while the grower chooses Request Early or Request Late for the water release.

s.name: Mushroom Substrate Contract
s.description: A commercial mushroom grower is arranging substrate for an important growing season and must choose between Reserve Substrate and Spot Purchase. The substrate supplier must choose between Priority Allocation and Flexible Allocation for the grower's order.

s.name: Small Library Order
s.description: A small public library and a local book distributor are arranging a minor acquisitions order. The library chooses between Trim List and Keep List, while the distributor chooses between Standard Pack and Flexible Pack.

s.name: City Hive Siting
s.description: A community-garden coordinator and a local beekeeping cooperative are deciding how to place a shared urban hive. The coordinator chooses Roof Garden or Courtyard, while the cooperative chooses Café Block or Library Block as the nearby public site.

s.name: Critical Canal Window
s.description: A canal authority and a major grain carrier are scheduling passage through a lock during a critical shipping window. The authority chooses between Priority Release and Staged Release, while the carrier chooses between Early Convoy and Delayed Convoy.

s.name: Bell Tuning
s.description: A small bell foundry's caster chooses between Fine Pour and Steady Pour for a bell's final casting adjustment. The workshop tuner chooses between Light Tapping and Firm Tapping while checking the bell's tone.

s.name: Twin Film Releases
s.description: Two small film distributors are scheduling the local releases of their respective films. Each chooses between Opening Week and Second Week.

s.name: Channel Dredging Schedule
s.description: A port authority and a dredging contractor are coordinating a major seasonal channel-clearing project. The authority chooses Early Window or Late Window for the permitted dredging period, while the contractor chooses Day Shift or Night Shift for its work schedule.

s.name: Small Letterpress Run
s.description: A small letterpress shop's typesetter chooses between Light Impression and Firm Impression for a short print run. The press operator chooses between Fresh Packing and Reused Packing before the same run.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: A commercial beekeeper and a neighboring commercial beekeeper are deciding where to place their overwintering apiaries before winter. Each must choose between Sheltered Grove and Windward Ridge for its colonies.

s.name: Regional Triage Coverage
s.description: The emergency-care directors of two neighboring hospitals are coordinating staffing for a demanding winter season. Hospital A chooses between a Rapid Team and a Lean Team for its triage desk, while Hospital B chooses between a Surge Team and a Core Team for its own triage desk.

s.name: Hedge-Laying Contract
s.description: A homeowner and a local hedge-laying contractor are arranging a modest boundary-hedge job. The homeowner chooses Spring contract or Autumn contract, while the contractor chooses Fixed crew or Flexible crew.

s.name: Small Vinyl Reissue
s.description: A small record label and a neighborhood vinyl plant are coordinating a modest reissue. The label chooses Early Queue or Late Queue for its project, while the plant chooses Short Run or Long Run for the pressing queue.

s.name: Roastery Sourcing Contract
s.description: A national coffee roastery and a coffee-growing cooperative are choosing terms for a high-stakes sourcing arrangement. The roastery chooses between Premium Contract, a committed long-term purchase, and Spot Contract, a seasonal purchase; the cooperative chooses between Priority Supply, reserving beans for the roastery, and Open Market, offering beans to buyers generally.

s.name: Antique Restoration Bids
s.description: Two antique-restoration studios are submitting sealed bids for a prestigious restoration commission. Each studio must choose either a Lean bid, covering a narrower scope of work, or a Premium bid, covering a more extensive restoration plan.

s.name: Shared Dune Fence
s.description: A homeowner and a neighboring beach café are coordinating a dune fence along their shared stretch of sand. The homeowner chooses between an Inland Fence and a Dune-Edge Fence for their section, while the café chooses between Open Access and Full Barrier for its adjoining section.

s.name: Offshore Turbine Maintenance
s.description: A national grid operator and a turbine manufacturer are coordinating maintenance at a major offshore wind farm. The grid operator chooses between Planned Shutdown and Emergency Repair, while the turbine manufacturer chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew.

s.name: Cottage Thatching Rotas
s.description: Two nearby thatching crews are assigned separate shifts on the same small cottage, and each foreperson chooses between Early start and Late start. The choice is a minor adjustment to the crews’ daily rota.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: A national lighthouse authority and a contracted maritime operator are arranging a relief handoff at a critical offshore lighthouse. The authority chooses between Early Relief and Late Relief, while the operator chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew for the shift.

s.name: Bog Edge Tuning
s.description: A peatland volunteer and a nearby land steward are making a small restoration adjustment at one shared bog edge. The volunteer chooses between Gentle raking and Leave cover, while the steward chooses between Shallow ditch and Keep water.

s.name: Quay Quota Talks
s.description: Two neighboring fishing cooperatives are negotiating a shared seasonal quota. Cooperative A chooses between Moderate Quota and High Quota for its requested catch, while Cooperative B chooses between Support Cap and Push Expansion in the negotiation.

s.name: Alpine Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain hut warden chooses between an Early Convoy and a Late Convoy for the season's resupply. A regional air-cargo pilot chooses between a Full Load and a Light Load for that operation, with the decision carrying substantial seasonal and budgetary stakes.

s.name: Peatland Recovery Pact
s.description: A national peatland agency and a major bogland owner are deciding how to handle a large peat bog restoration project. The agency chooses between Full Restoration and Pilot Restoration, while the owner chooses between Join Program and Stay Independent.

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queue
s.description: A boutique record label and a vinyl pressing plant are coordinating a high-profile seasonal release amid a crowded pressing queue. The label chooses between Rush Pressing and Standard Pressing, while the plant chooses between Priority Slot and Shared Slot for handling the project.

s.name: Clocktower Renewal
s.description: The municipal heritage office and an independent clockworks contractor must prepare a landmark clocktower whose reliable operation matters to the whole city. The office chooses between Full Restoration and Patch Repairs, while the contractor chooses between Day Shift and Night Shift for carrying out the work.

s.name: Tidal Lease Lines
s.description: Two neighboring oyster growers are making a small adjustment to their adjacent bed leases. Each chooses between Keep Boundary and Nudge Boundary, meaning leaving the shared lease line as recorded or requesting a slight shift before renewal.

s.name: Shared Seaweed Racks
s.description: Two neighboring seaweed growers share a small shoreline area for drying racks. Grower A chooses between Dense Racks and Spaced Racks, while Grower B chooses between Early Cover and Open Racks.

s.name: Kelp Harvest Window
s.description: Two neighboring kelp farms, North Shoal Kelp and South Shoal Kelp, are planning their main seasonal harvest. North Shoal chooses between Early Harvest and Late Harvest, while South Shoal independently chooses between Early Harvest and Late Harvest.

s.name: Cable Ferry Crossing
s.description: At a small cable-ferry crossing, the ferry operator chooses between Hold Cable and Ease Cable. A dock attendant coordinating the crossing chooses between Signal Early and Signal Late.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A quarry operator chooses between Dawn Blast and Night Blast, while a regional rail operator chooses between Clear Line and Divert Trains for the same high-stakes window. The choices set the quarry's blasting schedule and the rail service plan for a major freight corridor.

s.name: Village Truffle Permits
s.description: A local truffle forager chooses between applying for an Early Permit or a Late Permit. A nearby woodland cooperative chooses between issuing a Broad Permit or a Narrow Permit for the same season.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspection
s.description: A regional river authority and an eel-pass operator are preparing inspections before the migration season. The authority chooses between Spot Checks and Full Audits, while the operator chooses between Prompt Access and Limited Access for inspectors.

s.name: Championship Concessions
s.description: A stadium concession operator and the stadium owner are setting the concession plan for a championship event, with stakes large enough to materially affect both organizations. The operator chooses between Premium Menu and Value Menu, while the owner chooses between Revenue Share and Flat Fee.

s.name: Shared Greenhouse Heat
s.description: Two neighboring growers share a small greenhouse and coordinate its heating. Each grower chooses between Gentle heating and Full heating for their side of the shared space.

s.name: Silage Clamp Sharing
s.description: Two neighboring livestock farmers share a silage clamp for storing feed. Farmer A chooses between Compact Feed and Leave Buffer, while Farmer B chooses between Book First and Book Later for arranging their use of the clamp.

s.name: Archive Digitisation Plan
s.description: A regional archive is choosing between Batch Scanning and Curated Scanning for a major digitisation season. Its digitisation contractor is choosing between Open Workflow and Staged Workflow for coordinating the project.

s.name: Sawmill Kiln Booking
s.description: North Fork Timber and Cedar Ridge Lumber are booking access to a shared industrial kiln for high-value lumber orders. Each sawmill chooses either Early Slot, committing to an early kiln reservation, or Flexible Slot, keeping its kiln booking adaptable.

s.name: Local Beer Run
s.description: Two small microbreweries are coordinating a shared neighborhood distribution run. Brewery A chooses between Steady Dispatch and Adjusted Dispatch, while Brewery B chooses between Morning Drop and Later Drop.

s.name: Freight Rail Scheduling
s.description: A regional freight carrier chooses between Early Departure and Later Departure for a routine shipment. A rail-network dispatcher chooses between Priority Slot and Regular Slot when assigning the train's timetable.

s.name: Kelp Harvest Contract
s.description: A kelp farm operator and a local processing cooperative are setting terms for one harvest season. The farm chooses between Early Harvest and Full Growth, while the cooperative chooses between Standard Intake and Flexible Intake.

s.name: Deep-Sky Allocation
s.description: Two international radio-astronomy consortia are negotiating access to a radio telescope for a major deep-space observation campaign. Each consortium must choose either Priority Window, reserving tightly coordinated observing time, or Flexible Window, allowing its schedule to adapt around the other consortium's request.

s.name: Wind-Farm Maintenance
s.description: A wind-farm operator chooses between Routine service and Deep overhaul for a set of turbines. An independent maintenance contractor chooses between a Standard crew and a Flexible crew for the same job.

s.name: Lantern Relief
s.description: At a small lighthouse, the outgoing keeper and incoming keeper are coordinating a routine relief shift. The outgoing keeper chooses between an early or late handoff, while the incoming keeper chooses between preparing a full log or a brief log.

s.name: Radio Telescope Scheduling
s.description: A national radio observatory and a university consortium are shaping the schedule for a high-stakes observing season. The observatory chooses Long Campaign, reserving telescope time for one extended target, or Short Campaign, dividing time among briefer targets; the consortium chooses Joint Proposal, coordinating its request with the observatory, or Solo Proposal, submitting its own independent request.

s.name: Tidal Tune-Up
s.description: A tidal-turbine technician chooses between Blade Check and Sensor Tune for a small service visit. A maintenance coordinator chooses between Early Visit and Later Visit for scheduling that visit.

s.name: Seasonal Cable Ferry
s.description: A regional cable-ferry operator and a timber cooperative are coordinating crossings during the peak harvest season. The operator chooses either Early Loading or Staggered Loading, while the cooperative chooses either Reserved Slot or Flexible Slot.

s.name: Flagship Mirror Recoat
s.description: A major observatory and a specialized optics contractor are deciding how a flagship telescope's mirror will be recoated. The observatory chooses between Full Recoat and Spot Recoat, while the contractor chooses between Rush Schedule and Careful Schedule.

s.name: Planetarium Scheduling
s.description: A neighborhood planetarium is coordinating a small show with a visiting astronomy club. The planetarium chooses between an early or late setup, while the club chooses between a weeknight or weekend show slot.

s.name: Planetarium Show Slots
s.description: A planetarium director and a local astronomy-club coordinator are arranging the season's featured show slots. The director chooses between "Prime slot" and "Late slot," while the coordinator chooses between "Weekend slot" and "Weeknight slot."

s.name: Turbine Service Window
s.description: A wind-farm operator and a maintenance contractor are coordinating work on a turbine. The operator chooses between Routine service and Full overhaul, while the contractor chooses between a Day visit and a Night visit.

s.name: Routine Downlink
s.description: A small satellite's flight team and a receiving station coordinate one routine downlink window. The flight team chooses between an Early Pass and a Late Pass, while the station chooses between Wide Watch and Narrow Watch for its antenna schedule.

s.name: Bakery Supply Orders
s.description: A large bakery group and a flour mill are coordinating a high-stakes supply order. The bakery chooses between a Rush Order and a Planned Order, while the mill chooses between Reserve Flour and Spot Allocation for that order.

s.name: Small-Batch Rinsing
s.description: At a small textile mill, the first dyeing shift chooses between a Gentle Rinse and an Extra Rinse for its batch. The second dyeing shift chooses between an Early Rinse and a Late Rinse when handling its batch.

s.name: Neighborhood Route Bids
s.description: Two neighborhood courier firms are bidding to handle the same recurring delivery route. Courier A chooses between a “Priority Bid,” promising faster service, and a “Regular Bid,” offering standard service; Courier B makes the same choice for its bid.

s.name: Osier Harvest Timing
s.description: An osier grower and a basket-weaving cooperative are coordinating the cutting and collection of a commercially important bed. The grower chooses between Early cutting and Late cutting, while the cooperative chooses between Prompt collection and Delayed collection.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A quarry operator and a regional rail authority must coordinate a high-stakes blasting schedule near an active rail corridor. The quarry chooses Dawn Window or Night Window for the blast. The rail authority chooses Clear Line or Hold Line for train operations during the selected window.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Timing
s.description: Two neighboring saffron growers are arranging a small harvest team's workday. Grower A chooses Early picking or Late picking, while Grower B chooses Shared crew or Separate crew.

s.name: Flagship Beer Launch
s.description: A fast-growing microbrewery and a major beverage distributor are deciding how to launch a flagship beer under a large distribution contract. The brewery chooses between Exclusive Batch, reserving the beer for this distributor, and Open Allocation, allowing multiple channels; the distributor chooses between National Rollout, taking the beer across its network, and Regional Rollout, limiting the launch to selected markets.

s.name: Mirror Recoating Schedule
s.description: An observatory is arranging a routine telescope-mirror recoating job with a specialist recoating shop. The observatory chooses between Early coating and Late coating, while the shop chooses between Standard polish and Extra polish.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Tour
s.description: A touring puppet company and a regional arts festival are planning a season together. The company chooses between Full Tour and Short Tour, while the festival chooses between Prime Slots and Off-Peak Slots for the performances.

s.name: Canal Shift Roster
s.description: Two lock-keepers at a busy canal are arranging a season-critical duty roster. Lock-keeper A chooses between Keep Shift, retaining the assigned duty, and Request Swap, asking to trade it; Lock-keeper B chooses between Honor Roster, leaving the roster in place, and Rearrange Coverage, changing the coverage plan.

s.name: Weekly Bean Order
s.description: A neighborhood coffee roaster and a café manager are arranging the café's weekly bean order. The roaster chooses between Single Origin and House Blend, while the café manager chooses between Early Order and Late Order.

s.name: Wind Farm Bat Nights
s.description: A regional wildlife agency and a wind-power consortium are coordinating bat survey nights before a major turbine project proceeds. The agency chooses between Extended Survey and Rapid Survey, while the consortium chooses between Night Shutdown and Night Operation during the survey period.

s.name: Seasonal Freight Slots
s.description: A freight railway chooses between Early Dispatch and Late Dispatch for a season of high-demand cargo movements. A connecting railway chooses between Priority Routing and Flexible Routing for the same service window.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A small quarry's foreman and a nearby quarry's foreman each choose a blasting window for a routine trimming job. Each is choosing between an Early window and a Late window while coordinating around the other's schedule.

s.name: Shared Canal Lock
s.description: Two nearby canal operators are arranging their routine barge schedules at a shared canal lock. Operator A chooses Early Passage or Late Passage for its barge, while Operator B chooses Reserve Lock or Yield Lock for how its booking handles the lock.

s.name: Kelp Harvest Contract
s.description: A kelp farm manager and a regional kelp processor are coordinating one season’s harvest. The farm manager chooses Early Harvest or Late Harvest, while the processor chooses Spot Purchase or Season Contract for the crop.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contracts
s.description: A large orchard company is arranging a high-stakes harvest and chooses between Early Harvest and Full Harvest. A national juice processor chooses between Premium Contract and Spot Contract for purchasing the crop.

s.name: Rink Resurfacing
s.description: A small ice rink manager chooses between a Light Pass and a Deep Pass for a routine resurfacing. The rink technician chooses between an Early Cut and a Late Cut while fine-tuning the same resurfacing job.

s.name: Shared Seaweed Racks
s.description: Mara and Jo are neighboring seaweed growers who use nearby drying racks. Mara chooses either High Rack or Low Rack for her seaweed, while Jo chooses either Wind Cover or Shade Cover for his.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Tour
s.description: A touring puppet theatre company is arranging a season-long run with a regional festival. The company chooses Full Cast or Lean Cast, while the festival chooses Prime Slot or Late Slot for the engagement.

s.name: Salt Pan Harvesting
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan workers are making a small routine harvest from the same pan. The first chooses between a Shallow scrape and a Deep scrape, while the second chooses between an Early rake and a Late rake.

s.name: Blockbuster Release Clash
s.description: Two major film studios are deciding when to release their flagship movies in a high-stakes season. Each studio must choose either Holiday Release or Spring Release for its film.

s.name: Shared Kiln Scheduling
s.description: A neighborhood pottery studio and a local tile maker share a modest electric kiln for routine batches. The studio chooses Early firing or Late firing, while the tile maker chooses Short cooldown or Long cooldown for its kiln schedule.

s.name: Orchard Pollination Contract
s.description: A national seed producer and a commercial orchard consortium are negotiating a high-stakes pollination contract for the coming growing season. The seed producer chooses between Dedicated Hives and Shared Hives, while the orchard consortium chooses between Early Booking and Flexible Booking.

s.name: Seasonal Route Bids
s.description: Two regional courier companies, A and B, are bidding for a substantial seasonal delivery route. Each company chooses between an Aggressive Bid, offering a lean price and tight schedule, and a Premium Bid, allowing more room for service capacity and contingencies.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A saffron grower is deciding whether to arrange harvest labour through Early Hiring or Late Hiring. A seasonal labour cooperative chooses between offering a Flexible Crew or a Fixed Crew arrangement for the harvest.

s.name: Oyster Bed Leases
s.description: Two oyster companies, Northwater and Seagrass, are competing in a high-stakes lease round for the same oyster bed. Northwater chooses either Aggressive Bid or Reserved Bid, while Seagrass independently chooses either Aggressive Bid or Reserved Bid.

s.name: Seed Bank Exchange
s.description: Two national seed banks are negotiating an exchange before a severe crop threat makes their stored varieties critically important. Each bank must choose whether to release part of its reserve to the exchange or hold its reserve back.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: Before a demanding winter weekend, a regional avalanche patrol coordinator and a neighboring resort’s patrol chief plan coverage for a shared mountain corridor. The coordinator chooses between an Expanded Roster and a Core Roster, while the chief chooses between a Dawn Patrol and a Staggered Patrol.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Adjustments
s.description: Two neighboring seaweed growers share a small drying area. Grower A chooses between Close Spacing and Open Spacing for their rack, while Grower B chooses between Early Turning and Late Turning for theirs. They are making fine adjustments to how the racks are arranged and tended that day.

s.name: Salt Pan Season
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan operators are planning the season’s main harvest. The first operator chooses between Early Harvest and Late Harvest, while the second chooses between Open Channels and Hold Channels for managing brine movement across the pans.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: A national avalanche center and a major mountain resort are coordinating rosters for a dangerous winter weekend. The avalanche center chooses between Full Patrol and Lean Patrol, while the resort chooses between Early Closure and Open Longer.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A homeowner and a mason are arranging a bid for repairing an old stone wall. The homeowner chooses between Detailed Bid and Quick Bid, while the mason chooses between Firm Schedule and Flexible Schedule.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations
s.description: Two harbour pilot coordinators are arranging the handoffs for a small set of routine vessel movements. The first coordinator chooses Early Rotation or Late Rotation, while the second chooses Tight Spacing or Wide Spacing between successive pilot assignments.

s.name: Dyeing Shift Coordination
s.description: A major textile mill and its contracted dye supplier are coordinating a high-volume dyeing shift. The mill chooses between Early release and Late release for the fabric batch, while the supplier chooses between Standard bath and Intensive bath for the dye run.

s.name: Herbarium Loan
s.description: A national herbarium and a university field team are arranging a loan of rare specimens for an upcoming research season. The herbarium chooses between Standard Release and Deferred Release, while the field team chooses between Immediate Request and Flexible Request.

s.name: Eel Pass Check
s.description: A small stream steward and a fisheries technician are checking an eel pass at a local weir. The steward chooses whether to fine-tune the passage slots or leave them as they are, while the technician chooses between a brief check and a full check.

s.name: Puppet Tour Booking
s.description: A small puppet theatre company and a host-venue coordinator are planning one stop on a modest tour. The company chooses between Town Circuit and Village Circuit, while the coordinator chooses between Advance Slot and Last-Minute Slot.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: A seasonal lighthouse keeper and a coastal relief coordinator must set the next relief shift at an isolated lighthouse. The keeper chooses between Early Handover and Late Handover, while the coordinator chooses between Boat Relief and Helicopter Relief.

s.name: Marsh Grazing Rights
s.description: A coastal land trust chooses between restoring the salt marsh or leasing grazing rights, while a cattle cooperative chooses whether to schedule its herd's access early or late in the season. Their choices govern a high-stakes grazing arrangement affecting the marsh and the cooperative's herd operations.

s.name: Quiet Sky Session
s.description: Two observing teams share a small radio telescope time slot. Team A chooses Early Tuning or Late Tuning for its setup, while Team B chooses Narrow Band or Wide Band for its setup.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: Two neighboring orchard managers are coordinating an overnight frost watch for their adjoining fruit trees. Each manager chooses between Active Watch, meaning personally checking the orchard during the night, and Remote Watch, meaning monitoring it from home with a remote alert system.

s.name: Tent-Pole Release
s.description: A major film studio and a global streaming platform are coordinating the release timing of a tent-pole film. The studio must choose between Wide Release and Staggered Release, while the platform chooses between Opening Weekend and Holiday Window.

s.name: Ski-Lift Grooming
s.description: A small ski area’s lift operator chooses between a light grooming pass and a deeper pass on the access slope. A nearby trail crew chooses whether to make its pass early or late in the routine.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A small saffron grower is planning when to pick, choosing Early Picking or Late Picking. A nearby saffron grower is arranging harvest labour and chooses Shared Crew or Separate Crew.

s.name: Radio Telescope Allocation
s.description: A national observatory and an international astronomy consortium are deciding how to use a scarce, high-stakes block of radio telescope time. The observatory chooses between Deep Survey and Rapid Follow-up, while the consortium chooses between Joint Campaign and Reserved Targets.

s.name: Freight Rail Scheduling
s.description: A regional rail dispatcher and a connecting freight carrier are arranging an everyday freight movement. The dispatcher chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot, while the carrier chooses between Fast Handoff and Flexible Handoff.

s.name: Foundry Season
s.description: A bell foundry manager is choosing how to organize a major bell casting: a Single Pour or a Staged Pour. A cathedral committee is choosing whether to request a Rush Order or a Seasonal Order for an important installation.

s.name: Continental Freight Corridor
s.description: A national rail carrier and a port consortium must schedule a strategically important freight corridor. The rail carrier chooses between Priority Dispatch and Balanced Dispatch, while the port consortium chooses between Early Loading and Flexible Loading.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: Two neighboring orchard keepers coordinate a small overnight frost watch. One chooses between “Check early” and “Check late,” while the other chooses between “Cover rows” and “Leave open.”

s.name: Herbarium Loan Scheduling
s.description: A regional herbarium curator and a visiting botanist are arranging an ordinary specimen loan. The curator chooses Full loan, sending the requested set, or Limited loan, sending a smaller set; the botanist chooses Standard schedule or Flexible schedule for handling the request.

s.name: Seasonal Quota Talks
s.description: Two regional fishing cooperatives are negotiating quotas for the coming fishing season, with each decision affecting its seasonal catch and standing with regulators. Cooperative A chooses between Reduce Quota and Hold Quota, while Cooperative B chooses between Accept Quota and Challenge Quota.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contracts
s.description: An orchard cooperative and a juice processor are arranging a substantial harvest-season contract. The cooperative chooses between Early Contract and Spot Market, while the processor chooses between Firm Booking and Flexible Buy.

s.name: Winter Hive Siting
s.description: Two neighboring beekeepers are making a fine winter-siting adjustment for their apiaries. Beekeeper A chooses between Windbreak Edge and Orchard Edge, while Beekeeper B chooses between North Pad and South Pad for its hives.

s.name: Sawmill Kiln Booking
s.description: A small sawmill manager is choosing between Early reserve and As-needed for booking kiln space. A nearby kiln operator is choosing between a Standard slot and a Flexible slot for the sawmill's lumber.

s.name: Osier Bed Harvest
s.description: Two neighboring commercial osier growers, A and B, must each choose when to cut their beds for the season. Each chooses either Early cutting or Late cutting, with both decisions shaping a harvest on which their livelihoods depend.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A national glaciology institute and a commercial satellite operator coordinate a season of glacier survey flights. The institute chooses between Early Flights and Late Flights, while the operator chooses between High Coverage and Targeted Coverage.

s.name: Coffee Sourcing Contract
s.description: A nationwide coffee roaster and a coffee-growing cooperative are deciding a high-stakes annual sourcing arrangement. The roaster chooses between Direct Contract, which commits it to the cooperative, and Spot Buying, while the cooperative chooses between Guaranteed Supply and Flexible Allocation for distributing its beans.

s.name: Kelp Harvest Timing
s.description: Two neighboring kelp-farm cooperatives are coordinating a high-stakes harvest season. Cooperative A chooses between Early Harvest and Late Harvest, while Cooperative B chooses between Early Harvest and Late Harvest.

s.name: Shared Telescope Session
s.description: A small university astronomy team and a nearby community observatory are arranging one shared radio-telescope session. The astronomy team chooses either Broad Survey or Focused Target, while the observatory chooses Early Window or Late Window for its observing request.

s.name: Coppice Harvest Planning
s.description: A managed woodland owner and a biomass contractor are planning a coppice harvest for the coming season. The owner chooses Short cycle or Long cycle, while the contractor chooses Early booking or Late booking.

s.name: Antique Finish Quotes
s.description: Two independent antique restorers are preparing bids for a small adjustment to the finish on a side table. Each chooses between a Careful Quote, allowing room for fine handwork, and a Lean Quote, keeping the proposed work narrowly priced.

s.name: Orchard Pollination Contract
s.description: A commercial orchard cooperative is negotiating a pollination contract with a regional beekeeper for the coming growing season. The cooperative chooses between Standard Placement and Expanded Placement, while the beekeeper chooses between Basic Service and Priority Service.

s.name: Canal Shift Swap
s.description: Two lock-keepers are assigned to cover shifts at a vital canal lock. Each chooses whether to keep the assigned shift or swap it with the other lock-keeper.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: Two neighboring beekeepers are arranging where to site their hives for winter. Beekeeper A chooses between Orchard Edge and Garden Shed, while Beekeeper B chooses between Creek Meadow and Field Margin.

s.name: Thatching Crew Rotas
s.description: A regional thatching contractor and a heritage-roof cooperative are arranging work for the coming season. The contractor chooses between a steady crew rota and a surge rota, while the cooperative chooses between early booking and late booking for its thatching projects.

s.name: Hedge Laying Agreement
s.description: A local hedge layer and a homeowner are arranging a small hedge-laying contract. The hedge layer chooses between Light Laying and Firm Laying, while the homeowner chooses between Early Access and Late Access for the work.

s.name: Weekend Release Window
s.description: A small film distributor and an independent cinema are coordinating the release timing for a weekend film. The distributor chooses between Early Release and Late Release, while the cinema chooses between Friday Screening and Sunday Screening.

s.name: Shared Osier Bed
s.description: Riverbend Osier Cooperative and Fenbank Willow Works depend on a shared osier bed whose harvest will materially affect both organizations. Riverbend chooses between Early cutting and Late cutting, while Fenbank chooses between Reserve cutting and Full cutting.

s.name: Bell Foundry Commission
s.description: A master bell foundry is choosing between a Rapid pour and a Refined pour for an important seasonal commission. The cathedral committee commissioning the bells is choosing between Standard alloy and Resonant alloy for the casting.

s.name: Brewery Distribution Deal
s.description: A major microbrewery is deciding whether to pursue a National Launch or a Regional Rollout for its next flagship release. A large beverage distributor is choosing between Premium Placement and a Volume Contract for handling the brewery's distribution.

s.name: Seasonal Dyeing Run
s.description: A textile mill and its finishing partner are coordinating a seasonal dyeing contract. The mill chooses between the Early Shift and Late Shift, while the finishing partner chooses between the Full Batch and Split Batch.

s.name: Reindeer Herding Routes
