s.description: Two neighborhood coffee roasteries are arranging bean supplies for their next everyday house blend. Roastery A and Roastery B each choose between sourcing through Direct Trade or buying a Broker Lot.

s.name: Seasonal Kiln Scheduling
s.description: A charcoal cooperative is deciding whether to run its season's major kiln batch in an Early Burn or a Late Burn. A commercial buyer is arranging its contracted collection window and must choose Early Pickup or Late Pickup.

s.name: Wind-Farm Maintenance
s.description: A wind-farm operator and a maintenance contractor are planning turbine work for an important production season. The operator chooses between Routine Service and Deep Overhaul, while the contractor chooses between Standard Crew and Rapid Crew.

s.name: Truffle Foraging Permits
s.description: The county woodland council is deciding whether to issue Broad Access or Limited Access permits for the coming truffle season. A commercial truffle cooperative is deciding whether to Apply Early or Apply Late for those permits.

s.name: Harvest Press Booking
s.description: A large orchard cooperative and a cider processor are arranging a high-stakes harvest-season cider press booking. The cooperative chooses Early Booking or Flexible Booking, while the processor chooses Reserve Slot or Open Slot to determine how the press schedule is arranged.

s.name: Small Vinyl Pressing
s.description: A small record label chooses between sending an Early Master or a Later Master for its next vinyl pressing. A neighborhood pressing plant chooses between a Tight Queue and a Flexible Queue for fitting the job into its ordinary schedule.

s.name: Lock-Keeper Shift Swap
s.description: Mira, a canal lock-keeper, chooses between “Swap Early,” taking the other shift sooner, and “Keep Shift,” working her assigned slot. Jon, the other lock-keeper, chooses between “Swap Early,” offering the handoff sooner, and “Keep Shift,” staying with his assigned slot.

s.name: Kiln Firing Season
s.description: A regional pottery studio and a ceramic tile maker are planning a high-stakes kiln-firing season. The studio chooses between Steady Ramp and Aggressive Ramp, while the tile maker chooses between Early Firing and Late Firing.

s.name: Stadium Concessions
s.description: Two concession vendors at the same stadium each choose between Premium Price and Value Price for a featured snack during the game. Each vendor makes its pricing choice for its own stand while the other vendor makes the same kind of choice for the neighboring stand.

s.name: Roastery Blend Tuning
s.description: A small coffee roastery and a nearby café are arranging a routine bean-sourcing agreement. The roastery chooses between Single Origin and House Blend, while the café chooses between Weekly Order and Flexible Order.

s.name: Bat Survey Night
s.description: One volunteer conducting a small bat survey chooses between an Early Sweep and a Late Sweep. A second volunteer chooses between a Quiet Route and an Echo Route for the same evening’s transect.

s.name: Shared Dune Fences
s.description: A coastal restoration manager and a shorefront resort operator face a dune fence placement decision for the same beach. The manager chooses Landward Fence or Seaward Fence, while the operator chooses Align Fences or Offset Fences.

s.name: Type-Specimen Loan
s.description: A national herbarium seeks a loan of a unique type specimen from a holding herbarium for a high-stakes scientific decision. The requesting herbarium chooses between Urgent Request and Routine Request, while the holding herbarium chooses between Approve Loan and Retain Specimen.

s.name: Shared Kiln Schedule
s.description: A small charcoal cooperative and a neighboring charcoal maker coordinate their weekly kiln schedules. Each chooses between a Daytime Burn and an Overnight Burn for the next batch.

s.name: Urban Beehive Siting
s.description: A neighborhood beekeeper cooperative chooses between Rooftop Cluster and Park Edge for its seasonal hives. The city pollinator office chooses between Support Hives and Limit Hives as its urban siting policy.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A county heritage trust and a specialist masonry firm are negotiating a high-stakes contract to repair a centuries-old stone wall. The trust chooses between Open Tender, inviting a competitive repair bid, and Direct Award, commissioning the firm directly; the firm chooses between Full Restoration, covering traditional stonework and mortar, and Minimal Repair, covering essential stabilization.

s.name: Seed Sample Exchange
s.description: Two neighboring seed banks are arranging a small exchange of a local seed variety. Bank A chooses between a Standard sample and a Fine-tuned sample, while Bank B chooses between an Early packet and a Matched packet for the exchange.

s.name: Co-op Milk Pricing
s.description: A dairy co-op chooses whether to set a Member Price or a Spot Price for its milk shipments. A neighborhood grocer chooses whether to use a Steady Markup or a Promo Markup when pricing that milk for shoppers.

s.name: Seasonal Reindeer Routes
s.description: Two neighboring reindeer-herding cooperatives are planning routes for an important seasonal migration. Cooperative A chooses between the Valley Route and Ridge Route, while Cooperative B chooses between an Early Crossing and a Late Crossing for its herd.

s.name: Kelp Harvest Timing
s.description: Two neighboring kelp farmers are planning an ordinary harvest. Farmer A chooses between Early harvest and Late harvest, while Farmer B chooses between Early harvest and Late harvest.

s.name: Winter Hut Resupply
s.description: A remote mountain hut operator is preparing the hut’s lifeline before a severe winter and chooses between Early Lift, sending supplies by helicopter before winter, and Trail Cache, staging supplies along the approach trail. A regional logistics coordinator chooses between Full Shipment and Lean Shipment for the quantity and scope of the resupply operation.

s.name: Puppet Tour Scheduling
s.description: A traveling puppet troupe is arranging a modest weekend tour with a town's community-arts coordinator. The troupe chooses between Full Cast and Small Cast, while the coordinator chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot for the performance.

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queue
s.description: A neighborhood pressing shop’s coordinator chooses between Early Queue and Late Queue for a small batch’s test pressing. An indie label’s scheduler chooses between Short Run and Long Run for that batch’s place in the vinyl pressing queue.

s.name: Archive Digitisation Partnership
s.description: A national archive is planning a major digitisation season and must choose between Full Scan and Selective Scan. A scholarly publisher coordinating rights and distribution must choose between Open Release and Curated Release for the same collection.

s.name: Truffle Grove Concession
s.description: Two major truffle estates are deciding how to share a high-value woodland concession. Estate A chooses between a Broad Permit and a Narrow Permit for its foraging area, while Estate B chooses between an Early Permit and a Late Permit for its foraging period.

s.name: Triage Capacity Plan
s.description: A regional hospital chooses between Surge staffing and Baseline staffing for a demanding triage period. A neighboring ambulance service chooses between Early diversion and Open intake while coordinating patient arrivals and protecting its seasonal budget and reputation.

s.name: Canal Lock Scheduling
s.description: An upstream canal operator and a downstream canal operator are coordinating the day’s lock schedule. The upstream operator chooses between Steady Release and Surge Release, while the downstream operator chooses between Morning Lock and Afternoon Lock.

s.name: Neighborhood Letterpress Run
s.description: A small publisher is scheduling a letterpress print run for a neighborhood booklet, while an independent printer is choosing the paper stock for the job. The publisher chooses between Early Run and Late Run, and the printer chooses between Standard Stock and Premium Stock.

s.name: Marsh Gate Adjustment
s.description: Two neighboring salt-marsh graziers are making a small seasonal adjustment to how they share one grazing patch. Grazer A chooses between Light grazing and Full rest, while Grazer B chooses between a Narrow gate and a Wide gate for access to the patch.

s.name: Charcoal Burn Scheduling
s.description: A regional charcoal kiln operator and a seasonal timber buyer are coordinating a substantial production run. The kiln operator chooses between Early Burn and Late Burn, while the buyer chooses between Firm Order and Flexible Order.

s.name: Kelp Raft Harvest
s.description: Two neighboring kelp farmers are arranging a small shared-raft harvest. Farmer A chooses between Gentle Trim and Full Trim, while Farmer B chooses between Early Pull and Later Pull.

s.name: Orchard Falconry
s.description: An orchard manager chooses whether to arrange the falcon's release early or late in the workday. A local falconer chooses between flying a wide circuit over the orchard or a short circuit near the main fields.

s.name: Migration Station Allocation
s.description: A national bird-migration research consortium and a regional conservation authority are negotiating access to a season-critical bird ringing station. The consortium chooses between “Dawn Survey” and “Dusk Survey,” while the authority chooses between “Joint Release,” opening slots for shared use, and “Protected Hold,” reserving them under the station plan.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: For a demanding lighthouse season, the regional lighthouse authority chooses between an Early Relief and a Late Relief for its outgoing keeper team. The contracted incoming crew chooses between a Full Handover and a Brief Handover while scheduling the changeover.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: Two polar research agencies are planning aircraft surveys over a glacier whose measurements will shape a major ice-sheet assessment. Agency A chooses between Central Transect and Perimeter Transect, while Agency B chooses between Synchronized Flight and Independent Flight.

s.name: Marsh Grazing Schedule
s.description: A local salt-marsh steward and a neighboring smallholder are arranging access to a shared grazing patch for an ordinary week. The steward chooses between Fixed allotment and Flexible allotment, while the smallholder chooses between Early grazing and Late grazing.

s.name: Kelp Harvest Timing
s.description: Two kelp-farm cooperatives share a high-value offshore growing zone and must independently choose when to harvest. Each cooperative can select Early Harvest before a volatile ocean-current window or Late Harvest after it.

s.name: Adjacent Oyster Leases
s.description: Two neighboring oyster growers are arranging leases for adjacent beds. Each grower chooses between renewing an existing bed lease or requesting an expanded lease that includes additional bed area.

s.name: Substrate Season Contract
s.description: A gourmet mushroom farm and a substrate supplier are planning a season in which dependable substrate supply matters to both businesses. The farm chooses between Spot Order and Reserve Contract, while the supplier chooses between Flexible Mix and Fixed Batch.

s.name: Orchard Pollination Contract
s.description: A small orchardist chooses whether a pollination contract offers Early Access or Late Access to the blossoms. A local beekeeper chooses between a Nearby Route and an Extended Route for making the contracted visit.

s.name: Reindeer Migration Routes
s.description: Two reindeer-herding cooperatives must plan their herds' passage through a crucial seasonal grazing region. The first cooperative chooses between Coastal Route and Inland Route, while the second chooses between Ridge Route and Valley Route.

s.name: Salt Marsh Grazing Rights
s.description: Two neighboring salt-marsh grazing cooperatives are arranging access for the coming season. The first cooperative chooses between Early grazing and Late grazing, while the second chooses between Shared access and Reserved access.

s.name: High-Stakes Kiln Run
s.description: Two major ceramics manufacturers are coordinating schedules for a high-stakes kiln firing. Manufacturer A chooses between Rapid Firing and Gentle Firing, while Manufacturer B independently chooses between Rapid Firing and Gentle Firing.

s.name: Neighborhood Hive Siting
s.description: A city garden coordinator and a nearby building cooperative are planning where to place small beehive installations in the same neighborhood. The coordinator chooses Street Garden or Courtyard Plot, while the cooperative chooses Rooftop Hive or Lot Hive.

s.name: Planetarium Premiere
s.description: A regional planetarium and a touring science production are arranging the season's marquee show. The planetarium chooses Prime Slot or Late Slot, while the production chooses Full Dome or Compact Set.

s.name: Kiln Allocation
s.description: Two large charcoal producers share a regional supply network and must set their kiln schedules for the coming production cycle. Producer A chooses between Early Burn and Late Burn, while Producer B chooses between Steady Burn and Surge Burn.

s.name: Creek Ferry Timing
s.description: A small cable-ferry operator chooses between Steady pull and Gentle pull for an ordinary crossing. A waiting cyclist chooses between Board promptly and Board later while preparing to cross.

s.name: Competing Film Releases
s.description: Two rival film studios, Northstar Pictures and Lantern Films, are planning releases whose performance will shape their seasonal slates and reputations. Northstar chooses between a Peak Season release and an Off Season release, while Lantern Films makes the same timing choice for its film.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease
s.description: An oyster grower and a neighboring seafood processor are negotiating access to a valuable oyster bed for the coming season. The grower chooses either “Short Lease,” granting access for one season, or “Long Lease,” committing access across multiple seasons; the processor makes the same choice for its lease arrangement.

s.name: Ringing Station Slots
s.description: A local bird-ringing team chooses either Early Slot, reserving the first available station period, or Backup Slot, holding a later period. A visiting bird club chooses either Fixed Slot, committing to a specified period, or Flexible Slot, allowing its period to shift.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: A regional mill operator and a downstream farming cooperative must coordinate a high-stakes millpond drawdown before a major storm. The mill operator chooses Early release or Late release for its sluice, while the cooperative chooses Early intake or Late intake for its canal gates.

s.name: Port Dredging Windows
s.description: A port authority and a dredging contractor are arranging a seasonal channel-maintenance operation. The port authority chooses between an Early Window and a Late Window, while the contractor chooses between a Full Crew and a Split Crew.

s.name: Cable Ferry Crossing
s.description: At a small cable ferry, the ferryman chooses between Steady Pull and Soft Pull for the next crossing. A pedestrian passenger chooses between Board Now and Wait Briefly while the ferry is being prepared.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flight
s.description: A regional glacier survey team and a small helicopter operator plan one survey flight. The survey team chooses between Dawn launch and Midday launch, while the operator chooses between Full crew and Lean crew.

s.name: Raptor Crop Defense
s.description: A regional farming cooperative and a licensed falconry team are coordinating a high-stakes pest-control operation to protect the cooperative’s crops. The cooperative chooses between Full deployment and Limited deployment, while the falconry team chooses between Immediate release and Reserve birds.

s.name: Stone Wall Bids
s.description: Two local masons are preparing bids for a small stone wall repair. Each chooses between submitting a Detailed Bid, with a careful work outline, and a Brief Bid, with a short estimate.

s.name: Orchard Pollination Contract
s.description: A berry grower and a local beekeeper are arranging a pollination contract for the growing season. The grower chooses either Early Access or Peak Access for the hive visits, while the beekeeper chooses either Flexible Route or Reserved Route for scheduling the hives. The options describe when visits are arranged and how firmly the hives are reserved for this contract.

s.name: Substrate Partnership
s.description: A large mushroom grower is arranging a season-critical substrate supply with a major substrate producer. The grower chooses between Reserve Supply and Spot Supply, while the producer chooses between Premium Mix and Standard Mix for the arrangement.

s.name: Mirror Fine-Tuning
s.description: A small observatory’s mirror technician chooses between Light trim and Careful trim of a newly recoated telescope mirror. The coating specialist chooses between Edge tuning and Center tuning for the final fine adjustment.

s.name: Rope Ferry Staffing
s.description: Two neighboring rope-ferry operators are planning staffing for the next morning's shared crossing. Each chooses between a Regular crew and a Relief crew for its own ferry.

s.name: Tundra Herding Routes
s.description: Two neighboring reindeer herders are planning routes for moving their herds across shared tundra pasture. One chooses between Creek Route and Ridge Route, while the other chooses between Moss Route and Lake Route.

s.name: Archive Acquisition
s.description: The National Library and the University Library are deciding how to pursue a high-stakes acquisition of a nationally significant archive. The National Library chooses between Exclusive purchase and Joint acquisition, while the University Library chooses between Shared purchase and Independent bid.

s.name: Seasonal Seed Exchange
s.description: The National Seed Archive is deciding between Priority Release and Standard Release for a seed bank exchange. A regional seed cooperative must choose Early Exchange or Deferred Exchange for its request during the growing season.

s.name: Puppet Tour Circuit
s.description: A puppet theatre company is planning a touring season and must choose between Full Tour and Selective Tour. A regional theatre circuit is arranging the engagements and must choose between Prime Slots and Late Slots.

s.name: Stadium Concessions
s.description: The north and south concession stands at a stadium each choose a game-day pricing plan. The north stand chooses between Regular Pricing and Value Pricing, while the south stand chooses between Regular Pricing and Value Pricing.

s.name: Vineyard Water Allocation
s.description: A major vineyard cooperative and a regional water authority are making linked irrigation decisions during a critical growing season. The cooperative chooses between Full Release, sending stored water to its vines, and Reserve Storage, while the authority chooses between Open Canal and Restrict Flow for the vineyard network.

s.name: Hut Resupply Timing
s.description: A mountain hut keeper and a volunteer resupply coordinator are arranging a small delivery. The keeper chooses between Compact Load and Spread Load, while the coordinator chooses between Early Drop and Late Drop.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: A lighthouse keeper and the keeper taking the next relief shift coordinate their handover. The first keeper chooses between Early Relief and Late Relief, while the incoming keeper chooses between Radio Check and Direct Handoff.
actorB: the keeper taking the next relief shift

s.name: Harvest Sourcing
s.description: A specialty coffee roastery and a regional green-coffee importer are arranging sourcing for the coming harvest season. The roastery chooses Direct Trade or Brokered Lots, while the importer chooses Premium Lots or Flexible Lots.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A small saffron grower and a seasonal harvest worker are preparing one ordinary picking session. The grower chooses between Gentle Pacing and Quick Pacing, while the worker chooses between Careful Sorting and Fast Sorting for handling the blossoms.

s.name: Planetarium Premiere Slots
s.description: A national observatory and a private planetarium consortium each must place its flagship space show in one of two nationally coordinated premiere slots. Their choices determine access to a globally broadcast launch-night audience and the associated exhibition rights.

s.name: Cottage Thatching Rotas
s.description: The Northside thatching crew and the Meadow thatching crew are arranging rotas for nearby cottage jobs. Northside chooses either Early Rota or Late Rota, and Meadow chooses either Early Rota or Late Rota.

s.name: Silage Clamp Sharing
s.description: A dairy cooperative and a neighboring cattle farm are arranging access to a shared silage clamp for harvest. The cooperative chooses Priority Loading or Shared Loading, while the cattle farm chooses Early Booking or Flexible Booking.

s.name: Vineyard Watering
s.description: Two neighboring small-vineyard growers share a short irrigation channel. Grower A chooses Early watering or Late watering for a fine adjustment, while Grower B chooses Morning release or Evening release for the channel flow.

s.name: Tundra Route Planning
s.description: Two neighboring reindeer herders are planning routes for a routine morning movement through shared tundra. Herder A chooses between Ridge Route and Valley Route, while Herder B chooses between North Loop and Lakeside Loop.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A saffron cooperative chooses between Early Mobilization, reserving harvest labour before the flowers open, and Late Mobilization, arranging workers closer to picking time. A seasonal labour team chooses between Full Crew and Limited Crew for the cooperative's harvest.

s.name: Charcoal Burn Scheduling
s.description: Two small charcoal makers are coordinating the schedule for separate batches in nearby kilns. The first chooses between Steady Burn and Late Trim, while the second chooses between Early Vent and Late Vent.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: Two keepers at neighboring lighthouses are arranging their next relief shifts. Keeper A chooses between Early Relief and Late Relief, while Keeper B chooses between Regular Relief and Delayed Relief.

s.name: Osier Bed Schedule
s.description: Two neighboring osier growers are planning a season whose harvest matters to an important contract, and each must choose a cutting schedule for their osier bed. Grower A chooses Early cutting or Late cutting, while Grower B chooses Early cutting or Late cutting.

s.name: Scouring Capacity Pact
s.description: Two major wool cooperatives are arranging access to scarce scouring capacity before a region-wide shearing season. Each cooperative chooses either Reserve Slots, committing capacity for its contracted fleeces, or Open Market, leaving its capacity to be arranged through the spot market.

s.name: Thatching Crew Rotas
s.description: Two small thatching crews are planning their next routine workday in the same village. The first crew chooses an Early Rota or a Late Rota, and the second crew independently chooses an Early Rota or a Late Rota.

s.name: Seasonal Substrate Allocation
s.description: A commercial mushroom farm and its substrate supplier are arranging the farm's seasonal substrate supply. The farm chooses between Reserve Substrate and Spot Purchase, while the supplier chooses between Priority Contract and Open Sale.

s.name: Regional Brewery Rollout
s.description: A craft microbrewery and a national beverage distributor are negotiating a high-stakes regional rollout. The brewery chooses Direct Launch, selling through multiple wholesalers, or Distributor Exclusive, granting the distributor sole regional rights. The distributor chooses Shelf Push, a coordinated retail-placement campaign, or Standard Listing, its routine listing process.

s.name: Cider Press Bookings
s.description: A community cider-press operator and a nearby cider maker are arranging a shared pressing appointment. The operator chooses whether to hold a slot, while the cider maker chooses whether to book now or book later.

s.name: Marsh Grazing Schedule
s.description: Two neighboring livestock cooperatives share valuable salt-marsh grazing rights for the season. The first cooperative chooses between Rotational grazing and Full-season grazing, while the second chooses between Early release and Late release of its herd onto the marsh.

s.name: Mushroom Substrate Contract
s.description: A high-volume mushroom grower is arranging a major substrate supply contract and must choose between Spot Purchase and Reserve Batch. The substrate supplier must choose between Standard Mix and Priority Mix for the contract.

s.name: Salt Pan Season
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan cooperatives are deciding how to manage a valuable harvest season. Cooperative A chooses between Early Harvest, collecting salt sooner, and Deep Brine, leaving brine longer; Cooperative B chooses between Shared Pumping, coordinating water removal, and Independent Pumping, operating its pumps separately.

s.name: Clocktower Tuning
s.description: A clockkeeper and a tower caretaker are making a small routine adjustment to an ordinary clocktower. The clockkeeper chooses between Gentle adjustment and Firm adjustment, while the caretaker chooses between Early check and Late check.

s.name: Antique Restoration Bids
s.description: An antique restoration firm and a regional museum are negotiating a substantial restoration contract with important budget and reputation implications. The firm chooses either Conservative Bid or Ambitious Bid, while the museum chooses either Open Tender or Preferred Vendor.

s.name: City Hive Siting
s.description: A neighborhood beekeeper and a community-garden coordinator are deciding how to site a shared urban beehive. The beekeeper chooses Courtyard Hive or Roof Hive, while the coordinator chooses Garden Plot or Alley Terrace.

s.name: Vinyl Release Queue
s.description: A major record label and a vinyl pressing plant are coordinating a high-stakes worldwide release. The label chooses between an Early Master and a Revised Master, while the plant chooses between a Rush Queue and a Standard Queue.

s.name: Local Milk Pricing
s.description: Two nearby dairy co-ops are setting prices for a routine local milk collection contract. Co-op A chooses between Small Discount and Standard Price, while Co-op B chooses between Small Discount and Standard Price.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: Lena and Omar are neighboring beekeepers deciding where to site their hives for winter. Lena chooses Sheltered Grove or Open Orchard, while Omar chooses Shared Yard or Separate Yard.

s.name: Seasonal Charcoal Contract
s.description: A charcoal producer and a wholesale buyer are planning the producer’s main kiln schedule for the season. The producer chooses Early Burn or Late Burn, while the buyer chooses Firm Contract or Flexible Contract for the season’s supply.

s.name: Stadium Snack Prices
s.description: Two neighboring concession stands at a small stadium are adjusting prices for the same routine game-day snack. The first stand's manager chooses between Usual Price and Small Discount, while the second stand's manager makes the same choice for its own stand.

s.name: Turbine Maintenance Timing
s.description: A wind-farm operator is deciding whether to schedule a Routine Visit or Defer Visit for a modest turbine maintenance job. A maintenance contractor is choosing between Crew Ready and Crew Delayed for the same job.

s.name: Silage Clamp Sharing
s.description: Two neighboring smallholdings share a silage clamp for a small routine job. The first farmer chooses between Early covering and Delayed covering, while the second chooses between Light smoothing and Thorough smoothing.

s.name: Eel Pass Audit
s.description: A regional fisheries office and a dam operator are preparing an inspection of an eel pass before the migration season. The fisheries office chooses between Full Inspection and Paper Review, while the dam operator chooses between Open Access and Restricted Access for the inspection.

s.name: Flood Ferry Staffing
s.description: A regional ferry authority and a contracted ferry operator must set staffing for a heavily used rope ferry during a dangerous flood season. The authority chooses Full Crew or Lean Crew, while the operator chooses Two Shifts or Single Shift.

s.name: Antique Restoration Bids
s.description: A neighborhood antique dealer is seeking a restoration bid for a modest cabinet, and a nearby restoration shop is preparing its proposal. The shop chooses between Basic Bid and Full Bid, while the dealer chooses between Local Award and Open Solicitation.

s.name: Migration Station Access
s.description: A national bird census agency and a conservation consortium are allocating access to a vital bird-ringing station during migration season. The agency chooses between Peak-week slot and Late-season slot, while the consortium chooses between Shared release and Reserved release.

s.name: Shared Greenhouse Heat
s.description: Two neighboring commercial greenhouse growers are connected to a shared heating loop during an important growing season. Grower A and Grower B each choose either Full heat draw, requesting the loop’s higher scheduled heat allocation, or Reduced heat draw, requesting the lower scheduled allocation.

s.name: Shared Dredging Window
s.description: A port authority chooses whether to schedule routine dredging in the Day Window or Night Window. A nearby terminal operator chooses whether to Align Berths with that window or Keep Schedule.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Planning
s.description: A seaweed cooperative chooses how to prepare its drying racks for the coming harvest season: Open racks or Covered racks. A nearby seaweed processor chooses how to arrange rack access: Shared schedule or Private schedule.

s.name: Small Port Dredging
s.description: A port authority is choosing between an Early window and a Late window for a small dredging job. A ferry operator is choosing between a Morning reroute and a Regular route during the scheduling process.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: A tidal-energy operator and an offshore maintenance contractor are coordinating servicing for a major tidal turbine array. The operator chooses between Early Overhaul and Deferred Overhaul, while the contractor chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew for the service window.

s.name: Coppice Cycle Planning
s.description: A small woodland owner and a neighboring coppice manager are planning their next cutting cycles. The woodland owner chooses between Short Cycle and Long Cycle, while the neighboring manager chooses between Early Cutting and Late Cutting.

s.name: Small Hedge Job
s.description: A small landowner and a local hedge-layer are arranging a minor hedge-laying contract. The landowner chooses Early booking or Flexible booking, while the hedge-layer chooses Careful trim or Quick trim for the job.

s.name: Seasonal Cheese Release
s.description: An affineur and a regional cheese cooperative are setting the ripening plan for a high-profile seasonal cheese release. The affineur chooses between Slow maturation and Rapid maturation, while the cooperative chooses between Limited airflow and Open airflow in the cheese cave.

s.name: Reindeer Migration Routes
s.description: Two neighboring reindeer-herding cooperatives are planning a high-stakes seasonal migration across shared grazing land. Cooperative A chooses Valley Passage or Ridge Passage, while Cooperative B chooses Tundra Passage or River Passage.

s.name: New-Title Acquisition
s.description: A community librarian and a regional publisher are arranging a modest new-title acquisition. The librarian chooses between Advance Order and Hold Request, while the publisher chooses between Bundle Offer and Single Title.

s.name: Vineyard Falconry Contract
s.description: A vineyard cooperative is arranging seasonal falconry pest control with a licensed falconer. The cooperative chooses between Broad Coverage and Targeted Coverage, while the falconer chooses between Early Deployment and Late Deployment.

s.name: Small Kiln Firing
s.description: A ceramicist chooses between Gentle ramp and Quick ramp for a small batch of pottery. The kiln operator chooses between Early hold and Late hold for when to pause the firing.

s.name: Cheese Cave Ripening
s.description: Two major cheesemakers are deciding how to manage a high-value cheese cave during a critical aging season. Alpine Crown chooses between “Slow Ripening” and “Rapid Ripening,” while Valley Reserve chooses between “Shared Cave” and “Sealed Cave.” Each choice sets part of the cave’s ripening program.

s.name: Thatching Crew Rotas
s.description: Two neighboring thatching crews are arranging rotas for a shared village repair job. Crew A chooses an Early Rota or Late Rota, while Crew B makes the same choice for its own team.

s.name: Canal Shift Exchange
s.description: During the peak boating season, two lock-keepers at adjoining canal stations must settle a shift exchange that matters to the season’s staffing plan and their professional standing. The first lock-keeper chooses either “Swap Early” or “Keep Early,” while the second chooses either “Swap Late” or “Keep Late.”

s.name: Rink Resurfacing Schedule
s.description: A community ice-rink manager is choosing between Quick Resurface and Thorough Resurface for the rink. The local skating-program coordinator is choosing between Early Session and Late Session for the next scheduled activity.

s.name: Seasonal Ferry Slots
s.description: Two ferry operators are assigning their sailings on a shared seasonal route. Each operator chooses between an Off-Peak Slot and a Prime Slot for its timetable.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contracts
s.description: A regional orchard cooperative chooses between Early Harvest and Late Harvest for its crop contract. A national produce buyer chooses between Premium Contract and Flexible Contract for the same high-stakes harvest season.

s.name: Lift-Run Grooming
s.description: A grooming lead and a lift-side coordinator are making a small routine adjustment to the snow surface near one ski lift. The grooming lead chooses between Fine comb and Deep comb, while the coordinator chooses between Early pass and Late pass.

s.name: Release Window
s.description: A film studio and its distribution partner are planning the release of a major film. The studio chooses between Festival Premiere and Wide Release, while the distributor chooses between Holiday Slot and Spring Slot.

s.name: Substrate Batch
s.description: A small mushroom grower chooses between Standard Mix and Adjusted Mix for a routine batch. A local substrate supplier chooses between Fresh Blend and Stored Blend for that same batch.

s.name: Quay Pilot Rotations
s.description: Two neighbouring harbour pilot teams, East Quay Pilots and West Quay Pilots, are planning the next day's routine vessel assignments. East Quay chooses Fixed rotation or Swap rotation, while West Quay chooses Fixed rotation or Swap rotation; each choice describes whether that team's pilots stay in the planned sequence or exchange places during the rotation.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A bat-conservation consortium and a cave-network operator must coordinate a major bat survey night. The consortium chooses between Rapid Census and Full Census, while the operator chooses between Open Access and Restricted Access.

s.name: Shared Kiln Scheduling
s.description: A neighborhood pottery studio and an independent ceramicist share a community kiln. The studio chooses between Quick Firing and Gentle Firing, while the ceramicist chooses between Early Loading and Late Loading.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Timing
s.description: Two neighboring seaweed growers share a small set of drying racks. Each chooses between Early Drying and Late Drying for that day's seaweed, arranging their work around the available rack space and breeze.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations
s.description: A harbour pilot cooperative and a container line are planning pilot rotations for an important shipping season. The cooperative chooses either "Steady Rotation" or "Flexible Rotation," while the line chooses either "Early Booking" or "Late Booking" when assigning pilot shifts.

s.name: Dome-Time Tuning
s.description: A small observatory's scheduler and telescope technician coordinate a shared dome-time session. The scheduler chooses Early focus or Late focus, while the technician chooses Fine tune or Quick align for the session.

s.name: Mission Premiere Slots
s.description: A national planetarium and an international space agency are coordinating a planetarium show slot for a once-in-a-generation space-mission premiere. The planetarium chooses between Prime Slot and Late Slot, while the agency chooses between Joint Premiere and Exclusive Premiere.

s.name: Harvest Sourcing
s.description: A regional coffee roastery and a grower cooperative are deciding how to structure their sourcing arrangement for the coming harvest. The roastery chooses either “Long Contract” or “Spot Purchase,” while the cooperative chooses either “Quality Sort” or “Volume Push.”

s.name: Apple Harvest Contract
s.description: An orchard grower and a local juice processor are arranging a modest apple harvest contract. The grower chooses between Early Pickup and Flexible Pickup, while the processor chooses between Firm Price and Market Price.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Requests
s.description: A university herbarium curator decides whether to offer a Standard Loan or a Priority Loan for a valuable seasonal specimen set. A botanical research team requesting the loan chooses between Prompt Return and Extended Study for its use of the specimens.

s.name: Small Sawmill Kiln Booking
s.description: A small sawmill manager chooses between an Early booking and a Flexible booking for a modest batch of boards. A nearby kiln operator chooses between a Morning slot and an Afternoon slot for that booking.

s.name: Coppice Timing
s.description: Two neighboring small woodland owners are planning the next coppice cutting cycle for their adjoining plots. The first owner chooses between Short cycle and Long cycle, while the second chooses between Early cut and Delayed cut.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A quarry operator and a haulage contractor are coordinating a substantial production week. The quarry operator chooses between Dawn blasting and Dusk blasting, while the contractor chooses between Early hauling and Late hauling.

s.name: Shared Kiln Scheduling
s.description: A small ceramics workshop and a community kiln operator are coordinating routine mug batches in a shared kiln. The workshop chooses between Early Firing and Late Firing, while the operator chooses between Day Schedule and Night Schedule.

s.name: Invitation Proof
s.description: A small letterpress printer and a paper stockist are preparing a tiny run of invitations. The printer chooses Light Inking or Firm Inking, while the stockist chooses Soft Stock or Stiff Stock.

s.name: Shared Kiln Booking
s.description: Two nearby sawmills are arranging access to a shared kiln for their next lumber batches. Sawmill A chooses between Advance Booking and Flexible Booking, while Sawmill B chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot.

s.name: Osier Contract Timing
s.description: Two neighboring commercial osier growers, Willowmere Farm and Fenbank Cooperative, are bidding jointly for a major basket-fiber contract. Each chooses Early Cut, harvesting its osier bed before the main season, or Late Cut, leaving the bed standing longer.

s.name: Rope Ferry Shift
s.description: A ferryman and a dock attendant are making a fine staffing adjustment for a small rope ferry's ordinary crossing. The ferryman chooses between "Assisted pull" and "Solo pull," while the dock attendant chooses between "Rope assist" and "Shore signal."

s.name: Routine Mirror Recoat
s.description: A small observatory is arranging a routine telescope mirror recoating with a maintenance contractor. The observatory chooses between Full Recoat and Spot Recoat, while the contractor chooses between Careful Cure and Rapid Cure.

s.name: Dome-Time Scheduling
s.description: Two research teams are applying for dome time at the same observatory during an important observing season. Team A chooses between an Early Run and a Late Run, while Team B makes the same choice for its own observing program. Their selections are used to arrange the shared dome schedule, with consequences for each program's season and reputation.

s.name: Emergency Triage Surge
s.description: During a severe emergency-department surge, the triage director chooses between Full Triage, assigning senior clinicians to initial assessment, and Rapid Triage, using a streamlined assessment protocol. The hospital operations chief chooses between Surge Staffing, calling in reserve staff, and Lean Staffing, keeping the regular staffing plan.

s.name: Small Library Order
s.description: A branch acquisitions librarian and a local bookseller are arranging a small supplemental order for the library. The librarian chooses between Hold Order and Add Title, while the bookseller chooses between Regular Delivery and Combined Delivery.

s.name: Mirror Recoating Contract
s.description: A major observatory and a specialized telescope-coating contractor are deciding how to handle a high-stakes recoating of the observatory's primary mirror. The observatory chooses between Full Recoat and Spot Recoat, while the contractor chooses between Rush Schedule and Careful Schedule.

s.name: City Beehive Siting
s.description: A small-city beekeeper chooses whether to place a hive cluster on a building roof or in a sheltered courtyard. A nearby residents’ association chooses a welcome plan or a caution plan for the proposed urban beehive site.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A bat-monitoring contractor and a cave-network manager must coordinate a season of survey nights. The contractor chooses Full-night survey or Short survey, while the manager chooses Open access or Restricted access for the survey sites.

s.name: Dairy Co-op Contract
s.description: A regional dairy co-op and a supermarket chain are negotiating a seasonal milk contract. The co-op chooses either Premium Quote or Volume Quote, while the chain chooses either Shelf Push or Standard Listing for the contract.

s.name: Garden Hedge Contract
s.description: A homeowner and a hedge-laying contractor are arranging a modest garden contract. The homeowner chooses between Clear access and Restricted access, while the contractor chooses between Standard crew and Shared crew.

s.name: Archive Digitisation Release
s.description: A national archive and a scholarly consortium are coordinating a high-stakes digitisation project. The archive chooses between Full Scan and Selective Scan, while the consortium chooses between Open Release and Restricted Release.

s.name: Kelp Farm Harvesting
s.description: Two neighboring kelp farmers are arranging a routine harvest for their small farms. The first farmer chooses between Light Trim and Deep Trim, while the second chooses between Early Cut and Late Cut.

s.name: Orchard Pollination Contract
s.description: A regional orchard cooperative and a commercial beekeeper are negotiating a pollination contract for the coming growing season. The cooperative chooses between Early Coverage and Peak Coverage, while the beekeeper chooses between Dedicated Hives and Shared Hives.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contract
s.description: A regional orchard cooperative and a national juice company are negotiating a high-stakes harvest contract. The cooperative chooses between Spot harvest and Staged harvest, while the juice company chooses between Firm purchase and Flexible purchase.

s.name: Dome-Time Alignment
s.description: A telescope operator and a calibration technician are coordinating a small observatory dome-time slot. The operator chooses between Quick Focus and Careful Focus, while the technician chooses between Early Tweak and Late Tweak for a minor alignment adjustment. Their choices determine how they use the shared slot.

s.name: Oyster Bed Leases
s.description: Two neighboring oyster growers, Avery and Bay, are arranging leases for adjacent oyster beds for the coming season. Each chooses between a short lease and a long lease for their own bed.

s.name: Port Dredging Windows
s.description: A port authority and a major shipping consortium are coordinating a high-stakes channel-dredging project. The authority chooses an Early Window or Late Window for its dredging work, while the consortium chooses an Early Window or Late Window for its vessel-scheduling commitment.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring farms share a silage clamp for storing forage during the season. Each farm chooses between making a firm booking and keeping a flexible booking for its use of the clamp.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: The upstream miller chooses whether to open the millpond sluice early or late in the day. A downstream farmer independently chooses whether to release water from a connecting channel early or late.

s.name: Clocktower Tune-Up
s.description: A clocktower caretaker is arranging a small maintenance visit for the tower mechanism. The caretaker chooses between Fine Tuning and Quick Check, while the clock committee chooses between Keep Schedule and Shift Visit for the appointment.

s.name: Dairy Contract Pricing
s.description: Two major dairy cooperatives, Northvale Dairy Co-op and Valley Crest Dairy Co-op, are setting prices for a high-stakes milk supply contract. Northvale chooses between Hold Price and Cut Price, while Valley Crest independently chooses between Hold Price and Cut Price.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Review
s.description: A local herbarium curator requests a pressed specimen loan from a neighboring herbarium. The requester chooses between Standard Request and Detailed Request, while the lending curator chooses between Routine Review and Extra Review.

s.name: Community Seed Exchange
s.description: Two neighboring community seed banks are arranging a seasonal seed exchange. The first bank chooses between Early exchange and Late exchange, while the second chooses between Local varieties and Regional varieties.

s.name: Dome Time Allocation
s.description: An observatory director and a visiting survey consortium are coordinating access to the observatory dome for an important observing season. The director chooses between Early Run and Late Run, while the consortium chooses between Dark-Night Slot and Backup Slot.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A saffron estate manager must choose between Early harvest and Late harvest for a high-stakes flowering season. A regional labour cooperative must choose between Commit crews and Hold crews for the same harvest.

s.name: Routine Downlink
s.description: A small Earth-observation satellite operator and a ground station are coordinating one routine downlink window. The satellite operator chooses between “Nominal Window” and “Shifted Window,” while the ground station chooses between “Early Pass” and “Late Pass.”

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A homeowner and a local mason are arranging repairs for an aging stone wall. The homeowner chooses between a Basic repair and a Full repair, while the mason chooses between a Firm quote and a Flexible quote.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: An orchard manager and a neighboring growers’ cooperative coordinate a frost watch before a consequential night for the orchard. The manager chooses between Early Wake-Up and Late Wake-Up, while the cooperative chooses between Deploy Fans and Hold Fans.

s.name: Vinyl Release Queue
s.description: A major record label is choosing between Early Master, sending the final audio to the pressing plant sooner, and Late Master, holding it for additional revisions. The pressing plant is choosing between Rush Queue, placing the release in its expedited production line, and Standard Queue, placing it in the regular production line for this high-stakes vinyl release.

s.name: Telescope Scheduling
s.description: Two radio astronomy teams are preparing observing proposals for a heavily oversubscribed telescope season. Team A and Team B must each choose between requesting a focused campaign and requesting flexible observing windows.

s.name: Shared Wool Scouring
s.description: Two small wool workshops share a local wool-scouring service with limited daily capacity. Each workshop chooses between keeping a regular booking and making a fine adjustment to its booking.

s.name: Orchard Falconry
s.description: A small orchard keeper and a falconer coordinate an ordinary pest-control outing. The orchard keeper chooses between Perch Release and Glide Release, while the falconer chooses between Broad Circuit and Tight Circuit.

s.name: Cheese Cave Contract
s.description: A cheesemaker decides whether to keep a valuable batch in the cheese cave for Deep Ripening or send it out under Early Release. A major buyer chooses between a Firm Order and a Flexible Order for that batch, shaping a high-stakes cheese sale.

s.name: Urban Beehive Siting
s.description: A city parks coordinator and a neighborhood beekeepers’ cooperative are planning where to place a small urban hive installation. The coordinator chooses between Library Roof and Transit Plaza, while the cooperative chooses between Market Roof and Courtyard Garden.

s.name: Silage Clamp Sharing
s.description: Two neighboring dairy farms share one silage clamp during harvest, and the timing of access affects their winter feed preparations. Farm A and Farm B each choose between Early loading and Late loading for their use of the clamp.

s.name: Planetarium Show Slots
s.description: Northstar Planetarium and Riverside Planetarium are each assigning a major seasonal show to one of two available planetarium show slots. Northstar chooses between Prime slot and Late slot, while Riverside independently chooses between Prime slot and Late slot.

s.name: Mirror Recoating
s.description: A national observatory and a specialist coating firm are planning a telescope mirror recoating before the next observing season. The observatory chooses Full Recoat or Patch Recoat, while the firm chooses an Early Slot or Late Slot for the work.

s.name: Puppet Tour Booking
s.description: A small puppet troupe and a neighborhood arts center are arranging one stop on a tour. The troupe chooses between Weekday Tour and Weekend Tour, while the center chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot.

s.name: Cider Press Bookings
s.description: Two neighboring orchard owners are making small bookings at the same cider press for one ordinary pressing day. Orchard A chooses between Morning Slot and Afternoon Slot, and Orchard B makes the same choice.

s.name: Hedge-Laying Contract
s.description: A homeowner and a hedge-laying contractor are arranging an ordinary garden-boundary job. The homeowner chooses between Full Scope and Trimmed Scope, while the contractor chooses between Detailed Plan and Quick Plan.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A specialist masonry contractor submits a bid for repairing a strategically important stone wall, choosing between Full Rebuild and Targeted Patch. The wall's owner chooses between Award Bid and Reopen Bidding for the repair contract.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A glacier survey pilot is choosing between a Steady Pass and an Offset Pass over a small crevasse field. A field glaciologist coordinating the flight is choosing between an Early Turn and a Late Turn.

s.name: Bell Foundry Casting
s.description: A bell foundry is preparing a major commission, while a cathedral consortium chooses how to schedule the casting. The foundry selects either Standard Pour or Reinforced Pour, and the consortium selects either Immediate Casting or Patient Casting, with the contract affecting both the season's budget and the foundry's reputation.

s.name: Dune Fence Adjustment
s.description: Two neighboring dune caretakers are making a small adjustment to their sections of a shared sand fence. Each caretaker chooses between placing their section nearer the footpath or nearer the dune grass.

s.name: Dune Fence Placement
s.description: A coastal council and a resort operator are each deciding where to place a major dune fence. Each must choose between a Seaward Fence near the beach and a Landward Fence farther inland.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief
s.description: Two lighthouse keepers coordinate the relief schedule for neighboring stations. Keeper A chooses Early Relief or Late Relief, while Keeper B chooses Short Handoff or Long Handoff for the shift arrangement.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: A millpond operator and a downstream farming cooperative must each choose when to schedule a major sluice opening. The operator chooses between Early Release and Late Release, while the cooperative likewise chooses between Early Release and Late Release.

s.name: Peatland Recovery Pact
s.description: A peatland restoration trust and an energy consortium jointly decide how a large peat bog will be managed. The trust chooses between Rewet Early, beginning water-control work now, and Phase Restoration, staging that work over time; the consortium chooses between Fund Rewetting, providing project support, and Delay Funding, postponing its support.

s.name: Small Kiln Run
s.description: A potter and a kiln technician are planning a small ordinary firing. The potter chooses between Steady Ramp and Quick Ramp, while the technician chooses between Early Cooling and Late Cooling.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: A millpond keeper chooses between Open Early and Open Late for the day's sluice schedule. A downstream miller chooses between Request Release and Hold Water while planning the mill's water use.

s.name: Tournament Ice Scheduling
s.description: A professional ice rink's operations manager is choosing between Full Resurface and Quick Resurface before an important tournament. A visiting team's coach is choosing between Early Practice and Late Practice for the team's scheduled time on the rink.

s.name: Small Salt Pan
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan operators are making a small routine adjustment to their harvest work. Operator A chooses between Early Skimming and Late Skimming, while Operator B chooses between Light Raking and Deep Raking.

s.name: Moorland Recovery
s.description: A regional peatland trust and a downstream water utility must choose policies during a major peat-bog restoration project. The trust chooses Full Rewetting or Limited Rewetting, while the utility chooses Support Restoration or Protect Withdrawals. Support Restoration means coordinating utility operations with the restoration plan; Protect Withdrawals means maintaining existing water-access priorities.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: Two quarry operators sharing a constrained blasting corridor must each schedule a major blast in either an Early Window or a Late Window. Their choices determine how the season's extraction work is coordinated around the shared corridor.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Terms
s.description: A university herbarium curator and a visiting botanist are arranging a specimen loan. The curator chooses between a Standard loan and a Restricted loan, while the botanist chooses between Accept terms and Request changes.

s.name: Observatory Allocation
s.description: Two major radio-astronomy teams are deciding how to use a scarce, high-stakes allocation of radio telescope time. Team A chooses between Deep Survey and Rapid Survey, while Team B chooses between Shared Block and Priority Block.

s.name: Cranberry Bog Flooding
s.description: Two neighboring cranberry growers are making a fine adjustment to water levels in their small bogs. Each chooses between Light Flooding and Deep Flooding for the next routine flooding period.

s.name: Dome-Time Allocation
s.description: A national observatory and a guest research team are settling a high-stakes dome-time plan for the coming observing season. The observatory chooses Long Exposure or Short Exposure, while the research team chooses Prime Hours or Off-Peak.

s.name: National Courier Contract
s.description: Two major courier firms, A and B, are bidding for a national delivery route whose award would materially affect both companies. Each firm must choose between a Priority Bid, built around premium routing commitments, and an Economy Bid, built around leaner route commitments.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: At a small coastal lighthouse, the outgoing keeper and the incoming keeper are arranging a routine relief shift. The outgoing keeper chooses Early Handoff or Late Handoff, while the incoming keeper chooses Quiet Handoff or Checked Handoff.

s.name: Ski-Lift Grooming
s.description: A ski-area manager chooses whether the lift runs receive grooming before the day ends or during the overnight shift. A grooming-crew coordinator chooses between a full pass and a light pass for the scheduled work.

s.name: Salt Marsh Grazing Rights
s.description: A cattle cooperative is choosing whether to schedule its marsh grazing season early or late. A coastal land authority is choosing between issuing a standard permit and issuing a conditional permit for those grazing rights.

s.name: Cheese Cave Adjustments
s.description: An affineur and a small dairy manager share a cheese cave for a modest batch during ripening. The affineur chooses between Gentle turning and Frequent turning, while the dairy manager chooses between Dry cloth and Damp cloth for routine cave adjustments.

s.name: Cranberry Bog Flooding
s.description: Two cranberry growers, A and B, are deciding how to manage flooding in their adjoining bogs during a critical growing season. Each chooses between Early Flooding, releasing water into the bog now, and Delayed Flooding, holding the water back for later.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: North Ridge and Pine Crest are two ski areas arranging avalanche patrol rosters for an important winter season. North Ridge chooses between Early Sweep and Late Sweep, while Pine Crest chooses between Shared Shift and Solo Shift.

s.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
s.description: Two neighboring ferry operators are placing one daily sailing on a shared timetable. Operator A chooses Early slot or Late slot, while Operator B chooses First slot or Second slot for its sailing.

s.name: Salt-Marsh Rotation
s.description: Two neighboring graziers share a small salt-marsh pasture. The first chooses between Light grazing and Full grazing, while the second chooses between Early rotation and Late rotation for moving animals between nearby sections.

s.name: Downlink Fine-Tuning
s.description: A small satellite operations team chooses between an Early Start and a Late Start for a routine downlink window. A ground-station scheduler chooses between Narrow Pointing and Wide Pointing for the same window.

s.name: Clocktower Service Plan
s.description: The municipal clockmaker chooses between Full Overhaul and Routine Tuning for the historic clocktower before the major festival season. The city events director chooses between Daytime Closure and Night Work for when the maintenance is carried out, with the decision affecting the season's schedule, budget, and public reputation.

s.name: Shared Osier Bed
s.description: Two commercial osier growers, A and B, jointly manage a valuable osier bed for the coming harvest season. Each must choose between Early cutting and Late cutting for their assigned cutting work.

s.name: Observatory Dome Time
s.description: Two major observatories are assigned the same rare dome-time opportunity, with important scientific programs depending on the schedule. The first observatory chooses between Long Campaign and Rapid Survey, while the second chooses between Prime Window and Backup Window.

s.name: Weekly Bean Blend
s.description: A neighborhood coffee roaster chooses Direct Blend, arranging beans through a regular small supplier, or Spot Blend, adjusting the week's blend from available lots. A nearby café manager chooses Early Order, confirming the order before roasting, or Late Order, confirming it after the roast plan is set.

s.name: Orchard Falconry
s.description: A small orchard grower and a local falconer coordinate a routine falconry pest-control visit. The grower chooses between Open Rows and Covered Rows, while the falconer chooses between Short Flight and Long Flight.

s.name: Seasonal Beer Distribution
s.description: A regional microbrewery and a wholesale distributor are coordinating distribution for a seasonal beer release. The brewery chooses between Direct Allocation and Broad Allocation, while the distributor chooses between Featured Placement and Routine Placement for the beer.

s.name: Bat Survey Night
s.description: A volunteer ecologist and a park caretaker are coordinating a bat survey night. The ecologist chooses between Mobile Detectors and Fixed Detectors, while the caretaker chooses between Lights Off and Dim Lights.

s.name: Quarry Window Coordination
s.description: A major quarry operator and an adjacent tunnel contractor must coordinate around two permitted quarry-blasting windows, with major production and infrastructure stakes. The quarry chooses Early Blast or Late Blast, while the contractor chooses Early Window or Late Window for its nearby excavation work.

s.name: Orbital Downlink Allocation
s.description: A national weather agency and a disaster-response network must allocate a satellite's downlink window for high-stakes transmissions. The weather agency chooses between Early Window and Late Window, while the response network chooses between Priority Relay and Routine Relay.

s.name: Canal Shift Exchange
s.description: The upstream and downstream lock-keepers must coordinate coverage during the canal's busiest seasonal shipping period. Each decides whether to keep the assigned shift or arrange a swap with a qualified relief keeper.

s.name: Satellite Downlink Windows
s.description: A small earth-observation team and a regional satellite operator are coordinating a satellite downlink window. The team chooses Early Pass or Late Pass, while the operator chooses Standard Slot or Flexible Slot.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: An upstream mill operator and a downstream mill operator are setting the sluice schedule for a seasonal millpond. The upstream operator chooses Early Release or Late Release, while the downstream operator chooses Morning Draw or Evening Draw.

s.name: Major Beer Release
s.description: A microbrewery and its distribution partner are planning a major beer release. The brewery chooses between Large Batch and Limited Batch, while the distributor chooses between Chain Rollout and Independent Rollout.

s.name: Kiln Batch Scheduling
s.description: A small pottery studio and a local clay supplier are coordinating a kiln batch. The studio chooses between Staged Firing and Rapid Firing, while the supplier chooses between Standard Delivery and Flexible Delivery.

s.name: Clocktower Maintenance
s.description: A city heritage trust and a specialist clockmaker are coordinating a major clocktower maintenance project. The trust chooses between Full Overhaul and Patchwork Repair, while the clockmaker chooses between Day Shutdown and Night Shutdown for the work schedule.

s.name: Charcoal Burn Scheduling
s.description: A small charcoal maker and a neighboring charcoal maker are scheduling one ordinary kiln burn each. The first maker chooses between Dawn Burn and Dusk Burn, while the neighbor chooses between Dawn Burn and Dusk Burn.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: An upstream millpond keeper and a downstream market gardener coordinate around the daily sluice schedule. The keeper chooses Open early or Open late, while the gardener chooses Irrigate early or Irrigate late.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: A ski resort's patrol director and a neighboring mountain rescue coordinator are setting their avalanche patrol rosters for the winter season. The patrol director chooses between Dawn Roster and Split Roster, while the rescue coordinator chooses between Full Coverage and Relay Coverage.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Window
s.description: An upstream river authority and a downstream hydroelectric operator must coordinate a major weir maintenance window. The authority chooses between Early closure and Late closure, while the operator chooses between Rapid drawdown and Staged drawdown.

s.name: Stadium Concessions
s.description: A stadium operator chooses between Premium pricing and Value pricing for a game day. A concession company chooses between a Bundle menu and an Item menu for the same event.

s.name: Antique Restoration Bids
s.description: Two independent antique restorers are preparing bids for a small ordinary restoration job involving a fine adjustment to an old cabinet. Restorer A chooses between Light Adjustment and Full Adjustment, while Restorer B chooses between Early Bid and Late Bid.

s.name: Mirror Recoating
s.description: An observatory consortium must decide how extensively to recoat a telescope mirror before an important observing season. Its coating contractor chooses between a Rush Schedule and a Standard Schedule, while the consortium chooses Full Recoat or Patch Recoat.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Tour
s.description: A touring puppet theatre company chooses whether to travel with a small cast or a full cast for a stop on its tour. The hosting community arts coordinator chooses whether to schedule the performance in a matinee slot or an evening slot.

s.name: Scouring Capacity Commitments
s.description: Two wool processors are planning their seasonal use of a shared wool-scouring facility. Processor A chooses between Reserve Capacity and Spot Capacity, while Processor B chooses between Early Booking and Late Booking.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A city marathon organizer chooses between Full Closure and Rolling Closure for the race route. A regional hospital network chooses between reserving an Ambulance Corridor and using Shared Roads for emergency access during the event.

s.name: Substrate Tuning
s.description: A small mushroom grower chooses between Fine Blend and Standard Blend for the next substrate order. A nearby substrate supplier chooses between Moist Batch and Dry Batch for preparing that order.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: A migratory beekeeper and a land steward are planning where the hives will spend winter. The beekeeper chooses between Sheltered Grove and Exposed Field, while the steward chooses between Shared Ground and Reserved Ground.

s.name: Puppet Tour Broadcast
s.description: A puppet theatre company and a national arts broadcaster are arranging a major touring production. The company chooses between Full Tour and Selective Tour, while the broadcaster chooses between National Push and Regional Push.

s.name: Ice Rink Resurfacing
s.description: An ice-rink manager and a local hockey league coordinator are planning a routine resurfacing break between scheduled sessions. The manager chooses either Quick Resurface or Full Resurface, while the coordinator chooses either Early Slot or Late Slot for the next booking.

s.name: Library Puppet Tour
s.description: A traveling puppet troupe and a neighborhood library are arranging a small touring show. The troupe chooses either Compact Set, bringing a pared-down stage, or Full Set, bringing its usual small props; the library chooses either Quiet Slot, a calmer afternoon booking, or Busy Slot, a more active community-hour booking.

s.name: Vineyard Watering Plan
s.description: A vineyard manager is choosing between Deep Irrigation and Light Irrigation for the season. A neighboring vineyard manager is choosing between Early Release and Late Release of shared irrigation water.

s.name: Cider Press Bookings
s.description: Two major cider producers, A and B, must each book one slot at a shared regional cider press for their harvest. Each chooses either Peak Slot or Off-Peak Slot, with the booking determining when that producer's apples are processed.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: Two neighboring orchard growers coordinate a frost watch for one chilly night. Grower A chooses either Early Watch, beginning before dusk, or Regular Watch, beginning at the usual time; Grower B chooses either Shared Watch, taking a joint shift, or Solo Watch, monitoring their own trees.

s.name: Scouring Capacity Commitments
s.description: Two large wool cooperatives, A and B, are making their seasonal commitments at a regionally critical wool-scouring facility. Each chooses either Reserve Capacity, securing a larger share of the facility’s operating commitment, or Release Capacity, leaving that capacity unreserved.

s.name: Seasonal Ferry Slots
s.description: North Channel Ferries and Island Link Ferries are assigning services to a shared ferry timetable for the coming season, with the decision carrying substantial revenue and reputation stakes. North Channel Ferries chooses between “Early Slot” and “Late Slot,” while Island Link Ferries chooses between “Peak Slot” and “Off-Peak Slot.”

s.name: Small Radio Telescope Session
s.description: Two small radio-astronomy teams are coordinating a shared radio telescope session. Team A chooses between Fine Tuning, centering its receiver on a narrow band, and Broad Tuning, covering a wider band; Team B chooses between an Early Slot and a Late Slot for its observation.

s.name: Canal Lock Scheduling
s.description: An upstream growers’ cooperative and a downstream canal-tour operator are coordinating use of a shared canal lock on a routine workday. The cooperative chooses either First Passage or Second Passage for its barge, while the operator chooses either Early Opening or Late Opening for the lock’s public schedule.

s.name: Dune Fence Placement
s.description: A coastal council and a beachfront resort are coordinating dune-fence placement before a major tourist season. The council chooses Seaward Fence or Inland Fence, while the resort chooses Low Fence or High Fence for its adjoining stretch.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A national glacier institute plans a survey flight and chooses between an Early Traverse and a Late Traverse. A neighboring polar research consortium chooses whether to designate an Open Corridor or a Reserved Corridor for the flight.

s.name: Cave-Ripening Plan
s.description: A small creamery's cheesemaker and cave manager are deciding how to handle a batch during ripening. The cheesemaker chooses between Early Turning and Late Turning, while the cave manager chooses between Open Vents and Closed Vents.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: Two neighboring orchard keepers are arranging a small frost watch for adjoining rows of trees. Keeper A chooses either “Early Watch” or “Late Watch,” while Keeper B chooses either “Open Vents” or “Closed Vents” for the night’s orchard routine.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contract
s.description: An orchard owner and a regional juice processor are negotiating a substantial harvest contract for the coming season. The owner chooses between Early Harvest, which sets an earlier picking schedule, and Late Harvest, which sets a later schedule; the processor chooses between Firm Purchase, a firm volume commitment, and Flexible Purchase, a more adjustable commitment.

s.name: Small Archive Digitisation
s.description: A local archive and a digitisation contractor are preparing a small batch of records. The archive chooses between Careful Scan and Quick Scan, while the contractor chooses between Light Metadata and Full Metadata.

s.name: Vineyard Watering Schedule
s.description: Two neighboring vineyard managers coordinate irrigation from the same local canal. Manager A chooses between Early watering and Late watering, while Manager B chooses between Morning release and Evening release.

s.name: Championship Lift Grooming
s.description: A mountain resort and the regional lift operator are jointly planning maintenance for a ski-lift corridor before championship week. Each chooses either Full grooming or Limited grooming.

s.name: Pamphlet Scanning
s.description: A small archive is digitising a routine batch of fragile pamphlets. The archive coordinator chooses between Wide Margins and Tight Margins for the scans, while the digitisation technician chooses between Soft Lamp and Bright Lamp.

s.name: Salt Pan Harvest Accord
s.description: Two neighboring salt cooperatives share a major evaporation basin whose harvest timing affects their seasonal operations. Each cooperative chooses between Early Skimming, removing salt sooner, and Deep Harvest, waiting for a fuller harvest before clearing its section.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Scheduling
s.description: Two seaweed enterprises face a high-stakes harvest-season decision involving the same drying racks. Enterprise A chooses Rapid Drying or Careful Drying, while Enterprise B chooses Early Loading or Delayed Loading.

s.name: Seasonal Kiln Contract
s.description: A ceramics studio must set a firing schedule for a high-profile season, choosing between Gentle firing and Rapid firing. Its kiln contractor chooses between Early ramp and Late ramp for the same production run.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Window
s.description: A regional water authority and a downstream hydroelectric operator must coordinate maintenance at a major river weir. The authority chooses an Early Window or Late Window, while the operator chooses Clear Flow or Hold Flow for its release schedule.

s.name: Neighborhood Route Bid
s.description: Two small courier firms are bidding for the same neighborhood delivery route. Each firm chooses between a Tight bid, allowing little schedule slack, and a Cushion bid, building in extra time for minor delays.

s.name: Reindeer Route Planning
s.description: Two neighboring reindeer herders are planning routes through shared seasonal grazing ground. Herder A chooses Ridge Route or Valley Route, while Herder B chooses Birch Crossing or Lakeside Crossing.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Scheduling
s.description: Two large seaweed cooperatives share a crucial set of drying racks during a high-stakes harvest season. Cooperative A chooses between Early loading and Late loading, while Cooperative B chooses between Open racks and Reserve racks.

s.name: Hut Resupply Timing
s.description: The caretaker of a small mountain hut chooses between Early restock and Late restock for a routine resupply adjustment. A local carrier chooses between Steady carry and Flexible carry for the same trip.
