s.name: Lift-Run Grooming
s.description: At a small ski resort, the trail manager chooses between Night Grooming and Dawn Grooming for the lift-served runs. The lift-crew supervisor chooses between a Full Pass and a Targeted Pass for the same grooming work.

s.name: Clocktower Maintenance
s.description: The municipal clockkeeper and the town events director are coordinating maintenance before a major festival season. The clockkeeper chooses between Full Overhaul and Basic Service, while the events director chooses between Keep Chimes and Silence Chimes during the maintenance period.

s.name: Neighborhood Marathon Closures
s.description: A neighborhood marathon organizer chooses between Early Closure and Late Closure for a small course segment. The city traffic coordinator chooses between Arrow Detour and Volunteer Crossing signs.

s.name: Ice Rink Resurfacing
s.description: A rink manager is choosing between a Full Resurface and a Spot Resurface for the ice. A local skating club is choosing between scheduling Early Practice and scheduling Late Practice around the resurfacing work.

s.name: Planetarium Scheduling
s.description: A regional planetarium and a visiting astronomy foundation are coordinating their seasonal shows. The planetarium chooses Prime Launch or Late Launch for its featured program, while the foundation chooses Peak Slot or Off-Peak Slot for its presentation in the shared planetarium schedule.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Allocation
s.description: Two seaweed cooperatives must coordinate the use of a shared bank of drying racks during a critical harvest season. Each cooperative chooses Priority Loading, putting its own wet seaweed onto the racks first, or Shared Loading, allocating rack space jointly with the other cooperative.

s.name: Freight Slot Tuning
s.description: A local freight dispatcher chooses whether a small goods train uses an Early Slot or a Late Slot. A nearby yard coordinator chooses between a Steady Handoff and a Quick Handoff for fine-tuning the train’s routine transfer.

s.name: Truffle Foraging Permits
s.description: Two neighboring truffle cooperatives are planning their permits for the coming foraging season. Each cooperative must choose between issuing Open Permits, allowing broader access to its grounds, and issuing Limited Permits, restricting access through a tighter permit policy.

s.name: Truffle Permit Allocation
s.description: Two neighboring small truffle-foraging crews are applying for permits in the same seasonal allocation. Crew A chooses either North permit or South permit, and Crew B makes the same choice.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A national polar agency and an international air-survey consortium are planning flights over a rapidly changing glacier whose measurements will guide downstream flood warnings. The agency chooses Early Flight or Late Flight, while the consortium chooses High Route or Low Route.

s.name: Eel Pass Tune-Up
s.description: At a small eel pass, an upstream field technician and a downstream habitat volunteer coordinate a routine inspection. The technician chooses Quick check or Fine check, while the volunteer chooses Morning round or Afternoon round.

s.name: Heritage Letterpress Edition
s.description: A major publisher and a specialty paper mill are coordinating a high-stakes letterpress edition. The publisher chooses between Rush Printing and Staged Printing, while the mill chooses between Priority Stock and Shared Stock for the run.

s.name: Wool Scouring Schedule
s.description: A regional wool cooperative and a nearby wool-scouring mill are planning their seasonal arrangements. The cooperative chooses between Reserve Capacity and Spot Booking for its lots, while the mill chooses between Open Shift and Tight Shift for its scouring schedule.

s.name: Winter Hive Siting
s.description: Two neighboring beekeepers, Mira and Sol, are choosing winter sites for their small apiaries. Mira chooses North Hedge or South Shed, while Sol chooses East Fence or West Meadow.

s.name: Mountain Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain-hut warden and a local supply carrier are arranging the hut’s next resupply. The warden chooses between Early order and Late order, while the carrier chooses between Direct haul and Shared haul.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease
s.description: An oyster cooperative and a neighboring oyster company are negotiating a seasonal lease for an oyster bed. The cooperative chooses Shared Lease, meaning joint use, or Exclusive Lease, meaning sole control; the company chooses Standard Terms or Expansion Terms, meaning ordinary or broader seasonal access.

s.name: Small Kiln Timing
s.description: Two neighboring charcoal burners are coordinating a small shared kiln. Burner A chooses an early or late burn start, while Burner B chooses a short or long pause before adding the next small batch of wood.

s.name: Flood Ferry Staffing
s.description: A county river authority and a ferry contractor must staff a rope ferry carrying evacuation supplies during a major flood. The authority chooses “Full Crew” or “Lean Crew,” while the contractor chooses “Reserve Crew” or “On-Call Crew” for its own staffing plan.

s.name: Peatland Restoration
s.description: A community peatland volunteer group and a nearby farm tenant are coordinating work on a modest restoration patch. The volunteer group chooses either Block Ditches or Stage Work, while the tenant chooses either Keep Track or Close Track.

s.name: Seed Bank Exchange
s.description: A national seed bank and a regional seed bank are arranging a major exchange of climate-resilient crop samples. The national bank chooses between Share Samples and Hold Samples, while the regional bank chooses between Open Exchange and Restrict Exchange.

s.name: Canal Shift Roster
s.description: Two lock-keepers, one assigned to the upstream lock and one to the downstream lock, are planning staffing for a demanding canal season. Each chooses whether to keep their assigned roster or swap shifts with the other lock-keeper.

s.name: Library Acquisitions
s.description: A public library acquisitions coordinator chooses between New Releases and Local History for a routine purchasing round. A regional bookseller chooses between Standard Terms and Bundle Offer for the same order.

s.name: Yard Handoff
s.description: A local freight dispatcher is choosing between the Early Slot and Late Slot for a short handoff through a shared yard. A neighboring freight-line coordinator is choosing between Steady Pace and Quick Pace for that same handoff.

s.name: Seasonal Letterpress Edition
s.description: An independent publisher and a letterpress studio are planning a seasonal limited-edition release. The publisher chooses either Full Edition or Proof Run for its print run, while the studio chooses either Priority Slot or Deferred Slot for how it schedules that run.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations
s.description: A national port authority and a major shipping consortium must coordinate harbour-pilot rotations during a high-stakes overhaul. The authority chooses between Steady Rotation and Rapid Rotation, while the consortium chooses between Fixed Windows and Flexible Windows for assigning pilot shifts.

s.name: Seed Bank Exchange
s.description: Two neighboring seed banks are arranging a small exchange of routine seed samples. The first bank chooses between Fresh Sample and Stored Sample, while the second chooses between Prompt Exchange and Deferred Exchange.

s.name: Vineyard Reservoir
s.description: Two neighboring vineyard operators share a reservoir during a severe heatwave. The upstream operator chooses Early Irrigation or Late Irrigation, while the downstream operator chooses Release Water or Hold Water.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Tuning
s.description: Two neighboring seaweed growers are drying small batches on adjacent racks. Grower A chooses between Looser Spacing and Tighter Spacing, while Grower B chooses between Lower Cover and Raised Cover.

s.name: Seasonal Reindeer Routes
s.description: Two neighboring reindeer herders are coordinating seasonal routes across shared grazing country, with each trying to protect the season’s herd condition and their standing with local land stewards. Herder A chooses between Ridge Route and Valley Route, while Herder B chooses between Early Crossing and Late Crossing.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: The keeper at Gull Point and the keeper at Lantern Reef are arranging relief coverage for an upcoming week. Each keeper chooses between an Early relief shift and a Late relief shift.

s.name: Dome-Time Allocation
s.description: Two observatory teams must choose how to use a shared dome-time assignment. Team A chooses between Early block and Late block, while Team B chooses between Coordinated run and Independent run.

s.name: Archive Digitisation
s.description: An archivist and a cataloguing volunteer are preparing a small archive digitisation batch. The archivist chooses between Batch Scan and Page Check, while the volunteer chooses between Quick Index and Full Index.

s.name: Orchard Falconry
s.description: A small-orchard manager and a local falconer coordinate routine pest control. The manager chooses between Short Release and Long Release for the hawk's service window, while the falconer chooses Low Flight or High Flight for the hunting pattern.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A national ice agency must choose between Full Survey and Limited Survey for a hazardous glacier-flight campaign. A hydropower consortium deciding how to handle the campaign chooses between Open Data and Private Data.

s.name: Freight Interchange Timing
s.description: A regional freight operator and a connecting rail operator are arranging a routine interchange between their networks. The freight operator chooses between Early dispatch and Late dispatch, while the connecting operator chooses between Early slot and Late slot.

s.name: Seed Bank Exchange
s.description: Two regional seed banks are arranging an exchange of drought-resistant seed before the planting season. Bank A chooses Early Release or Reserved Release, while Bank B chooses Broad Package or Targeted Package for the exchange.

s.name: Clocktower Restoration
s.description: A municipal heritage trust and a specialist clockworks contractor must maintain a nationally important clocktower whose continued operation matters to the surrounding city. The trust chooses between Full Overhaul and Targeted Repair, while the contractor chooses between Day Crew and Night Crew.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: Two coordinators are arranging rosters for neighboring avalanche patrol teams after a small overnight snowfall. Coordinator A chooses either “Early Sweep” or “Late Sweep,” while Coordinator B chooses either “Early Sweep” or “Late Sweep” for their own team.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contracts
s.description: A small orchard owner and a local juice maker are arranging an orchard harvest contract. The orchard owner chooses between Early Picking and Full Ripeness, while the juice maker chooses between Firm Price and Flexible Price.

s.name: Dairy Co-op Contract
s.description: A regional dairy co-op and a national food processor are negotiating a contract that will shape the co-op's production plans and the processor's long-term milk supply. The co-op chooses between Premium Quote and Volume Quote, while the processor chooses between Stable Contract and Discount Push.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Windows
s.description: A river authority and a downstream irrigation cooperative are setting a maintenance schedule for a shared weir before the coming irrigation season. The authority chooses between Early Closure and Late Closure, while the cooperative chooses between Brief Closure and Extended Closure.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A small saffron grower and a seasonal labour cooperative are arranging a harvest day. The grower chooses between Local Hiring and Agency Hiring, while the cooperative chooses between Dawn Start and Later Start.

s.name: Seasonal Rail Corridor
s.description: Two freight rail operators are coordinating service on a heavily booked seasonal corridor. Operator A chooses between Night Dispatch and Day Dispatch, while Operator B chooses between Priority Slots and Flexible Slots for its trains.

s.name: Memorial Bell Casting
s.description: Two major bell foundries are preparing casts for a landmark memorial-bell commission with very large stakes. Foundry A chooses either Early Pour or Late Pour, while Foundry B independently chooses either Early Pour or Late Pour.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: Two avalanche patrol leads are arranging ordinary rosters for neighboring sections of a small ski area. The morning lead chooses either Early Sweep or Late Sweep for the routine check, while the afternoon lead chooses either Early Sweep or Late Sweep for the follow-up roster.

s.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
s.description: Two neighboring ferry operators are arranging their daily timetable slots for a shared route. Operator A chooses between the Early Slot and Late Slot, while Operator B chooses between the First Slot and Second Slot.

s.name: Seasonal Letterpress Run
s.description: A regional publisher and a letterpress studio are coordinating a substantial seasonal print run. The publisher chooses Rush Edition or Standard Edition, while the studio chooses Premium Stock or Economy Stock.

s.name: Thatching Crew Rotas
s.description: Two foremen are arranging rotas for neighboring thatching crews on a small repair job. The first foreman chooses between Early Shift and Late Shift, while the second chooses between Full Crew and Split Crew.

s.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
s.description: Two neighboring ferry operators are setting their daily timetable slots. Each operator chooses either a Morning Slot or a Midday Slot for its service.

s.name: Alpine Lift Operations
s.description: A major ski resort operator chooses between Full Grooming and Minimal Grooming for its lift-served terrain. A mountain safety authority chooses between Open Lifts and Close Lifts during the same high-stakes operating window.

s.name: Stone Wall Bids
s.description: Two masonry firms are bidding for a substantial contract to repair an old stone boundary wall before the next building season. Each firm chooses between a Full survey bid, with a comprehensive assessment and repair plan, and a Lean survey bid, with a quicker assessment and narrower plan.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: Two neighboring avalanche patrol coordinators are arranging small rosters for an ordinary mountain morning. The first coordinator chooses between an Early Sweep and a Late Sweep, while the second chooses between a Full Roster and a Lean Roster.

s.name: Full-Dome Release
s.description: A national planetarium consortium and a space-media foundation are arranging a high-stakes nationwide run of a new full-dome show. The consortium chooses Prime Slots or Late Slots for its release plan, while the foundation chooses Joint Booking or Solo Booking for its distribution plan.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: A regional beekeeper cooperative is choosing a winter apiary site between Sheltered Orchard and Windward Ridge. A commercial pollination firm is making its own siting choice between Valley Lease and Upland Lease for the same winter season.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: A small orchard grower chooses between Light Watch and Close Watch for an overnight frost watch. A neighboring grower chooses between Early Check and Late Check for the same watch.

s.name: Shared Lift Grooming
s.description: Two neighboring ski resorts share responsibility for grooming the runs served by a busy lift. Resort A’s grooming chief chooses Night Grooming or Dawn Grooming, while Resort B’s grooming chief chooses Full Grooming or Spot Grooming; these mean preparing the assigned runs overnight or just before opening, and grooming all assigned runs or selected trouble spots.

s.name: Craft Beer Distribution
s.description: A rapidly growing microbrewery and a regional beverage distributor are deciding how to handle a major new distribution agreement. The brewery chooses between Rush Launch and Measured Launch, while the distributor chooses between Wide Rollout and Selective Rollout.

s.name: Coppice Rotation
s.description: A small woodland owner and a neighboring coppice manager are coordinating cutting cycles for nearby coppice plots. The owner chooses between Short cycle and Long cycle, while the manager chooses between Early cut and Late cut.

s.name: Bell Foundry Scheduling
s.description: A small bell foundry manager chooses between Early Pour and Late Pour for a parish bell batch. The parish events coordinator chooses between Standard Order and Revised Order for the bell's specifications.

s.name: Season Showcase
s.description: A university planetarium and a municipal planetarium are planning one marquee show each for the season's shared evening calendar. The university chooses between a Prime launch or a Late rerun, while the municipal planetarium chooses between a Dome feature or an Archive feature.

s.name: Local Beer Distribution
s.description: A small microbrewery chooses between Direct Delivery and Distributor Deal for supplying a neighborhood distributor. The distributor chooses between Featured Placement and Standard Placement for the brewery's beer.

s.name: Orchard Pollination
s.description: A small orchard grower and a local beekeeper are arranging a pollination contract for a few trees. The grower chooses between Early Visit and Late Visit, while the beekeeper chooses between Short Stay and Long Stay.

s.name: Seasonal Kiln Booking
s.description: A regional sawmill and a kiln operator are arranging a seasonal kiln booking. The sawmill chooses Standard batch or Priority batch, while the kiln operator chooses Early slot or Late slot.

s.name: Archive Digitisation
s.description: A local archive team is choosing between Batch Scanning and Careful Scanning for a digitisation project. A community history group is choosing between Open Access and Curated Access for sharing the resulting digital files.

s.name: Ice Rink Resurfacing
s.description: An arena manager is choosing between Full Resurface and Quick Resurface before a high-stakes hockey event. The event coordinator is choosing between Early Practice and Late Practice for the teams using the rink.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Allocation
s.description: A seaweed cooperative and a coastal food company must decide how to use shared drying racks during a high-stakes harvest season. The cooperative chooses Early Loading or Staggered Loading, while the company chooses Reserve Racks or Open Racks.

s.name: Puppet Tour Timing
s.description: A small puppet troupe and a neighborhood theatre are coordinating one stop on a touring show. The troupe chooses between Short Set and Full Set, while the theatre chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot for the booking.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring dairy farmers are sharing a silage clamp for storing silage. Farmer A chooses between Early loading and Late loading, and Farmer B independently chooses between Early loading and Late loading.

s.name: Seasonal Freight Routing
s.description: A freight rail operator is choosing between Priority Dispatch and Steady Dispatch for a seasonally important shipment program. A rail-network coordinator is choosing whether to assign a Peak Slot or an Off-Peak Slot to that program.

s.name: Clocktower Fine-Tuning
s.description: A volunteer clockkeeper and a town timekeeper are making a small adjustment to an old clocktower. The clockkeeper chooses between Pendulum Check and Gear Check, while the timekeeper chooses between Pause Chime and Keep Chime.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: Two glacier-monitoring teams are planning flights to collect seasonal ice data, with the survey results affecting their field-season budget and scientific reputation. Team A chooses between a Low Transect and a High Transect, while Team B chooses between a Morning Flight and an Afternoon Flight.

s.name: Marsh Grazing Adjustments
s.description: Two neighboring smallholders share salt marsh grazing rights for a modest seasonal adjustment. The first chooses between Light grazing and Full grazing, while the second chooses between Early access and Late access.

s.name: Championship Ice Renewal
s.description: A rink operator preparing the ice for a high-stakes championship chooses between Full Resurface and Rapid Resurface. The championship organizer chooses between Early Schedule and Late Schedule for the resurfacing window.

s.name: Orchard Pollination
s.description: A regional orchard cooperative and a beekeeping firm are negotiating a pollination contract for the coming growing season. The cooperative chooses between Standard Acreage and Expanded Acreage, while the beekeeping firm chooses between Fixed Schedule and Flexible Schedule.

s.name: Cranberry Bog Flooding
s.description: An upstream cranberry grower and a neighboring bog manager are planning a routine flooding day. The grower chooses between “Early Release” and “Delayed Release,” while the neighbor chooses between “Open Ditch” and “Keep Ditch.”

s.name: Short Ferry Crossing
s.description: A small cable-ferry operator and a passenger are coordinating a short crossing. The operator chooses Taut Cable or Gentle Cable, while the passenger chooses Board Now or Wait Dock.

s.name: The Truffle Grove Permit
s.description: A regional grove trust is choosing whether the truffle-foraging permit will allow Open Harvest or Conserve Grove. A commercial truffle cooperative is choosing between a Quiet Bid and a Premium Bid for the high-stakes permit.

s.name: Brewery Distribution
s.description: A neighborhood microbrewery is deciding whether to use a Local rollout or a Regional rollout for its next batch. Its independent distributor is deciding between Priority placement and Standard placement for the same batch.

s.name: Vineyard Water Schedule
s.description: Two neighboring vineyard managers share a reservoir before an important growing season. Manager A chooses between Early irrigation and Late irrigation for the vines, while Manager B chooses between Peak release and Off-peak release for releasing the shared water supply.

s.name: Osier Bed Trimming
s.description: A small osier grower and a nearby basket maker are planning how to handle one shared bed of willow. The grower chooses between Selective Cut and Full Cut, while the basket maker chooses between Early Cut and Late Cut.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A saffron grower chooses between Early Picking and Late Picking for the harvest. A local harvest-crew coordinator chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew for staffing the picking days.

s.name: Seasonal Bell Commission
s.description: A bell foundry is planning a substantial seasonal casting, while a church consortium is arranging its commission. The foundry chooses between Thick Casting and Lean Casting, and the consortium chooses between Early Order and Late Order.

s.name: Shoal Quota Talks
s.description: Two neighboring fishing cooperatives are negotiating a major annual quota for their shared shoal. The North Shoal Cooperative chooses between Expand Quota and Conserve Quota, while the South Shoal Cooperative chooses between Accept Quota and Challenge Quota.

s.name: Planetarium Show Slots
s.description: A regional planetarium and a touring astronomy producer are planning the season's featured show. The planetarium chooses between a Prime Launch and a Late Run, while the producer chooses between an Exclusive Premiere and a Shared Premiere.

s.name: Kiln Burn Timing
s.description: Two neighboring charcoal makers, A and B, are scheduling a routine kiln burn. Each chooses between a Morning Burn and an Evening Burn for the next batch.

s.name: Small Film Release
s.description: A small cinema is choosing whether to hold a film's first screening early or later in its run. A local distributor is choosing between a Thursday slot and a weekend slot for the release.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A regional wildlife authority and a bat-research team are making decisions for a high-stakes bat survey night. The authority chooses between Restrict Access and Allow Access, while the research team chooses between Survey Tonight and Survey Later.

s.name: Charcoal Kiln Scheduling
s.description: A small charcoal cooperative and a neighborhood restaurant are coordinating a kiln run. The cooperative chooses either Early Burn or Late Burn, while the restaurant chooses either Flexible Pickup or Fixed Pickup.

s.name: Wind-Farm Maintenance
s.description: A wind-farm operator chooses between Scheduled Overhaul and Reactive Repairs for the coming service window. An independent maintenance contractor chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew to organize that work before the next production season.

s.name: Small Hedge Repair
s.description: A village allotment owner and a local hedge layer are arranging a small repair contract. The owner chooses between Light Lay and Deep Lay, while the hedge layer chooses between Quick Finish and Careful Finish.

s.name: Bell Order Timing
s.description: A neighborhood bell foundry's caster and a local parish buyer are coordinating a modest bell order. The caster chooses Early Casting or Late Casting, while the buyer chooses Full Bell or Split Batch for the order.

s.name: Eel Pass Coordination
s.description: A fisheries authority and a dam operator are coordinating inspections of an eel pass during an important migration season. The authority chooses between Full inspection and Rapid inspection, while the operator chooses between Scheduled opening and Conditional opening.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: Two saffron estates must choose how to secure labour for a single high-stakes harvest season. Estate A chooses between Early Hiring and Late Hiring, while Estate B chooses between Steady Crew and Expanded Crew.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotation
s.description: Two harbour pilots are arranging a routine rotation for a small dock. Pilot A chooses between an Early handoff and a Late handoff, while Pilot B chooses between a Short overlap and a Long overlap for the changeover.

s.name: Sawmill Kiln Booking
s.description: A regional sawmill is choosing between Early Booking and Flexible Booking for its seasonal kiln needs. The kiln operator is choosing between Reserve Capacity and Open Scheduling for that booking.

s.name: Regional Triage Surge
s.description: Two neighboring hospitals, Northside and Lakeside, are coordinating during a major regional emergency. Northside chooses between Surge Staffing and Routine Staffing for its triage unit, while Lakeside chooses between Open Overflow and Limit Intake for incoming patients.

s.name: Oyster Bed Leases
s.description: A small oyster grower and a neighboring leaseholder are deciding how to manage adjacent oyster-bed leases for the coming season. The grower chooses Renew Lease or Move Beds, while the neighboring leaseholder chooses Share Channel or Hold Channel.

s.name: Wind-Farm Maintenance
s.description: A wind-farm operator is scheduling seasonal maintenance and must choose between Full overhaul and Routine servicing. A turbine-parts contractor serving the same maintenance window must choose between Rush delivery and Standard delivery.

s.name: Flour Supply Contract
s.description: A large bakery chain is arranging a major flour supply order with a regional milling cooperative before a high-volume baking season. The chain chooses between Spot Order and Reserved Contract, while the cooperative chooses between Flexible Terms and Firm Terms.

s.name: Charcoal Batch Timing
s.description: A small charcoal maker chooses between Short Burn and Long Burn for a batch. A nearby market stall chooses between Early Pickup and Late Pickup for collecting the charcoal.

s.name: Championship Concessions
s.description: Two concession operators at a championship stadium set their pricing policies for the event. The first operator chooses between Premium Pricing and Value Pricing, while the second operator chooses between Premium Pricing and Value Pricing.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Setup
s.description: Two neighboring seaweed growers are drying small batches on adjacent racks in a shared yard. Grower A chooses between Tight spacing and Wide spacing for the rack slats, while Grower B chooses between Cloth cover and Open rack for the rack surface.

s.name: Community Archive Digitisation
s.description: A municipal archive manager and a local history group are planning a modest batch of archive digitisation. The manager chooses Scan First, beginning with image capture, or Catalog First, organizing metadata before scanning; the group chooses Broad Selection, nominating a varied set of ordinary records, or Rare Materials, nominating a smaller set of unusual holdings.

s.name: Mountain Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain hut association chooses between Bulk Lift and Staged Lift for its seasonal resupply plan. A mountain air-cargo operator chooses between Fixed Route and Flexible Route for serving the hut.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Tour
s.description: A touring puppet company is planning a season with a regional theatre presenter. The company chooses Full Tour or Limited Tour, while the presenter chooses Prime Dates or Off Dates for the performances.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A local glacier survey team is choosing between a Dawn Launch and a Midday Launch for its flight. A neighboring survey team is choosing between a North Route and a South Route for its own glacier survey flight.

s.name: Shared Kiln Booking
s.description: North Ridge Sawmill and Cedar Falls Sawmill each have a high-stakes timber batch awaiting processing in a shared industrial kiln. North Ridge chooses either “First Slot” or “Second Slot,” while Cedar Falls independently chooses either “First Slot” or “Second Slot” for its batch.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: The North and South trail coordinators are arranging the next ordinary avalanche-patrol roster. Each coordinator chooses between an Early Roster and a Late Roster for their patrol team.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Adjustments
s.description: Two workers at a small seaweed-drying shed are making fine adjustments to one shared rack. Worker A chooses between Turn Slats and Leave Slats, while Worker B chooses between Raise Cover and Lower Cover.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: The North Head lighthouse crew and the South Shoal lighthouse crew are arranging relief coverage for a demanding season. Each crew chooses between an Early Relief shift and a Late Relief shift for its station.

s.name: Orbital Downlink Coordination
s.description: A deep-space agency and a commercial satellite operator are coordinating a mission-critical satellite downlink window. The agency chooses Early Window or Late Window, while the operator chooses Reserve Window or Release Window.

s.name: Season Ice Plan
s.description: A municipal ice-rink manager chooses between Full Resurface and Patch Repair for the season's main sheet. s.name: Championship Ice Rink
s.description: A rink operator preparing for a championship must choose between Full Resurface and Patch Repair for the ice. The championship organizer must choose between Early Closure and Late Closure of the rink for resurfacing work.
