s.name: Saffron Harvest Crew
s.description: A small saffron grower is choosing between Early Picking and Late Picking for the harvest. A nearby harvest crew coordinator is choosing between Full Crew and Split Crew for the same saffron fields.

s.name: Vineyard Drip Timing
s.description: Two neighboring small-vineyard growers share a narrow irrigation channel. Each chooses between Early watering and Late watering for a fine adjustment to the day's drip schedule.

s.name: Shared Osier Bed
s.description: Two commercial osier growers share rights to a valuable bed whose harvest will determine their next contract season. Grower A chooses between Early Cut and Late Cut, while Grower B chooses between Selective Cut and Full Cut.

s.name: Bat Survey Night
s.description: A town ecology coordinator and a volunteer bat-survey team are planning one bat survey night. The coordinator chooses Early night or Late night for the session, while the team chooses Woodland loop or Riverside loop as its route.

s.name: Osier Cutting Schedule
s.description: An osier-bed manager and a basketry buyer are coordinating one important seasonal cutting contract. The manager chooses between Early cutting and Late cutting, while the buyer chooses between Early intake and Late intake for the harvested osier.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: At a small shared millpond, an upstream mill operator and a downstream mill operator each choose when to make a minor sluice adjustment. The upstream operator chooses between “Early adjustment” and “Late adjustment,” while the downstream operator makes the same timing choice.

s.name: Heritage Roof Rota
s.description: A thatching contractor and the owner of a historic estate are setting the rota for a high-stakes restoration of its thatched roofs. The contractor chooses between Rotating Crews and Fixed Crew, while the owner chooses between Open Sections and Staged Sections for the worksite.
actorB: the owner of a historic estate

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A university glacier-survey crew and a local helicopter operator are coordinating a modest day's flight over a monitored glacier. The crew chooses Early Flight or Late Flight, while the operator chooses Direct Route or Staged Route.

s.name: Winter Triage Plans
s.description: For a high-demand winter season, Hospital A’s emergency department chooses between Extra triage and Standard triage staffing. Hospital B’s emergency department chooses between Float team and Fixed team staffing for its seasonal plan.

s.name: Floodway Ferry Plan
s.description: A cable-ferry operator and a regional emergency coordinator must plan a high-stakes river crossing during flood response. The operator chooses either “Day crossing” or “Night crossing,” while the coordinator chooses either “Medical convoy” or “Supply convoy.”

s.name: Cable Ferry Timing
s.description: A small cable-ferry operator chooses between Steady pull and Gentle pull for the next crossing. A waiting cyclist chooses between Board early and Board late while preparing to cross.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A quarry manager chooses between an Early blast and a Late blast for the day's work. A nearby road crew coordinator chooses between Open detour and Hold traffic while arranging the road schedule.

s.name: Seasonal Ferry Schedule
s.description: A regional ferry operator and a port authority are setting timetable slots for a seasonal route. The operator chooses Early sailing or Late sailing, while the authority chooses Protected slot or Shared slot for that route.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: A tidal-turbine operator chooses between Routine Service and Deferred Service for a modest maintenance job. A maintenance contractor chooses between an Early Visit and a Later Visit to schedule the work.

s.name: High Pass Resupply
s.description: A mountain hut association plans its seasonal resupply by choosing between Early Order and Late Order. A mountain freight cooperative chooses between Direct Drop and Staged Haul for delivering the supplies to the hut.

s.name: Marsh Grazing Timing
s.description: Two neighboring salt-marsh graziers are coordinating a small shared grazing right. Each chooses either Early grazing or Late grazing for a routine seasonal visit.

s.name: Woodland Truffle Permits
s.description: Two neighboring truffle foragers are arranging access permits for the same woodland. Forager A chooses between an Early Permit and a Late Permit, while Forager B chooses between a Shared Permit and a Reserved Permit.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: A trail steward and a nearby hut coordinator are arranging small avalanche-patrol rosters for a quiet stretch of trail. The steward chooses between an Early sweep and a Late sweep, while the coordinator chooses between a Dawn check and a Midday check.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A saffron cooperative and a major spice buyer are arranging labour for a high-stakes harvest season. The cooperative chooses between Hire Crews and Use Locals, while the buyer chooses between Fund Labour and Settle Later.

s.name: River Cable Ferry
s.description: At a small river cable ferry, the operator chooses between a Gentle Pull and a Quick Pull for the crossing. A waiting driver chooses between Board Now and Board Later.

s.name: Seasonal Channel Dredging
s.description: A port authority chooses an Early window or a Late window for the season's channel dredging. The dredging contractor chooses Accept window or Request shift for that proposed schedule.

s.name: Blockbuster Release Window
s.description: A major film studio and a global streaming platform are deciding the release timing for a heavily financed blockbuster. The studio chooses Wide Release or Delayed Release, while the platform chooses Festival Launch or Holiday Launch.

s.name: Quiet Scan Setup
s.description: An archive curator and a digitisation technician are preparing a small batch of fragile pamphlets for scanning. The curator chooses between Loose Crop and Tight Crop, while the technician chooses between Soft Light and Even Light.

s.name: Rink Resurfacing
s.description: A neighborhood ice-rink manager is choosing between Quick Resurface and Full Resurface for the rink. A local skating club is choosing between a Morning Session and an Evening Session for its practice booking.

s.name: Seasonal Wool Scouring
s.description: A wool growers' cooperative is arranging access to a regional wool-scouring mill for the coming season. The cooperative chooses Early Booking or Spot Booking, while the mill chooses Expand Capacity or Hold Capacity.

s.name: Dome Time Tuning
s.description: During a small observatory's dome time, the night observer chooses between Focus Check and Tracking Check for a fine adjustment. The dome operator chooses between Shutter Trim and Pointing Trim for the same routine setup.

s.name: Cranberry Bog Flooding
s.description: Two neighboring cranberry growers share a canal during a routine bog-flooding period. Each chooses whether to flood their own bog now or flood it later.

s.name: Masterpiece Restoration Contract
s.description: A national museum and a specialist restoration firm are negotiating a high-stakes contract for the treatment of a priceless antique. The museum chooses between a Strict Scope, fixing detailed conservation requirements, and a Flexible Scope, allowing broader professional discretion; the firm chooses between a Low Bid and a Premium Bid.

s.name: Orchard Pollination
s.description: A community orchard manager and a beekeeper are arranging a small pollination contract. The orchard manager chooses Standard hives or Extra hives, while the beekeeper chooses Early visits or Late visits.

s.name: Radio Telescope Scheduling
s.description: Two small astronomy teams share a radio telescope for a routine observation night. Team A chooses either “Short Session” or “Long Session” for its request, while Team B chooses either “Early Slot” or “Late Slot” for its request.

s.name: Seasonal Route Bidding
s.description: Two courier companies are bidding to serve a high-volume regional delivery route for the coming season. Company A chooses either Express Bid or Flexible Bid, while Company B chooses either Peak Bid or Outer Bid as its route-bidding plan.

s.name: Stormwatch Relief
s.description: During a severe-weather relief window at a remote lighthouse, the regional lighthouse service (A) chooses between an Early Relief and a Late Relief shift. A contracted relief crew (B) chooses between a Full Handoff and a Staggered Handoff for taking over the lighthouse watch.

s.name: Oyster Lease Adjustment
s.description: Two neighboring oyster growers are making a routine, fine adjustment to the edges of their small bed leases. The first grower chooses between a Tight Boundary and a Loose Boundary, while the second chooses whether to use Early Marking or Late Marking for the revised lease line.

s.name: Creek Ferry Shifts
s.description: Two operators run neighboring rope ferries and are arranging staffing for the afternoon. Each chooses between “Regular Only,” using the usual ferryman alone, and “Add Relief,” scheduling an extra deckhand.

s.name: Wind-Farm Maintenance
s.description: A wind-farm operator chooses between an Early overhaul and a Deferred overhaul for a turbine cluster. A maintenance contractor chooses between a Crew surge and Normal crew for the same service window, as the parties plan the farm’s seasonal maintenance budget.

s.name: Clocktower Restoration
s.description: A city heritage trust and the municipal power utility must decide how to maintain a landmark clocktower whose condition affects a major civic district. The trust chooses between Full Restoration and Patch Repairs, while the utility chooses between Grid Isolation and Live Service.

s.name: Saffron Picking Day
s.description: Two neighboring saffron growers, A and B, are planning a small harvest day for their plots. Each chooses between Early Picking and Late Picking for the labor they can arrange.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A saffron grower and a seasonal labor cooperative are negotiating labor arrangements for the coming saffron harvest. The grower chooses Early Hiring or Late Hiring, while the cooperative chooses Crew Reserve or Crew Release.

s.name: Routine Library Order
s.description: A small neighborhood library is making a fine adjustment to a routine acquisitions order. The library chooses between Regular Edition and Large-Print Edition, while its local distributor chooses between Shelf Bundle and Single Shipment.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Scheduling
s.description: Two large seaweed cooperatives must schedule their harvest on the same set of drying racks. Cooperative A chooses between Early loading and Staggered loading, while Cooperative B chooses between Priority booking and Shared booking. The rack plan affects a harvest of major importance to both cooperatives.

s.name: Marsh Grazing Schedule
s.description: Two neighboring smallholders are arranging their ordinary seasonal rights to graze livestock on a shared salt marsh. Each chooses whether to use the marsh in Spring Grazing or Fall Grazing.

s.name: Salt Pan Season
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan cooperatives, Dune Flats and White Basin, are planning their shared evaporation season. Dune Flats chooses between Early Harvest and Extended Ponds, while White Basin chooses between Shared Brine and Separate Brine.

s.name: Dyeing Season Contract
s.description: A large textile mill and a global apparel brand are arranging a high-stakes dyeing season. The mill chooses between Rapid Dyeing and Batch Dyeing, while the brand chooses between Committed Orders and Flexible Orders.

s.name: Seed Lot Exchange
s.description: Two neighboring seed banks are arranging a small exchange to fine-tune seed lots for an ordinary planting trial. Bank A chooses either Catalog Update, meaning it checks and adjusts the exchange list, or Quick Dispatch, meaning it sends its packet promptly; Bank B chooses either Fresh Packet, meaning it sends a newly packed sample, or Reserve Packet, meaning it sends a sample from its reserve stock.

s.name: Rink Resurfacing Coordination
s.description: At a neighborhood ice rink, the rink manager chooses between Quick Resurface and Full Resurface for the next maintenance session. The resurfacing contractor chooses between an Early Shift and a Late Shift for carrying out the work.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: A coastal lighthouse authority and a relief contractor are coordinating a high-stakes handover at an isolated lighthouse. The authority chooses between Early Relief and Late Relief, while the contractor chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew for the relief shift.

s.name: Seasonal Kiln Contract
s.description: A regional ceramics cooperative and a high-end tile studio are scheduling a shared kiln firing before a major seasonal delivery. The cooperative chooses either Early Firing or Late Firing, while the tile studio chooses either Glaze Batch or Structural Batch for its kiln load.

s.name: Clocktower Fine-Tuning
s.description: A clocktower caretaker and a local horologist are coordinating a small maintenance visit. The caretaker chooses between Quick adjustment and Full adjustment, while the horologist chooses between Chime test and Gear test.

s.name: Seasonal Beer Rollout
s.description: A regional microbrewery and a specialty distributor are planning distribution for the brewery’s flagship seasonal beer. The brewery chooses Broad Release, sending the beer across many retail accounts, or Controlled Release, limiting it to selected outlets; the distributor chooses Chain Placement, emphasizing packaged-goods chains, or Taproom Focus, emphasizing independent bars and taprooms.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A marathon organizer chooses between Early Closure and Late Closure for a short neighborhood road. A city traffic coordinator chooses between Main Detour and Side Detour for nearby traffic.

s.name: Greenhouse Heat Sharing
s.description: Two neighboring commercial greenhouse growers are deciding how to manage a shared winter heat loop. Each chooses either “Release Heat,” sending available warmth into the shared loop, or “Hold Heat,” keeping its heating capacity for its own greenhouse.

s.name: Small Bog Workday
s.description: A small peatland landowner and a local conservation group are arranging a modest bog-restoration workday. The landowner chooses either “Plug Ditches” or “Trim Vegetation,” while the group chooses either “Volunteer Day” or “Private Crew.”

s.name: Canal Shift Swap
s.description: Two lock-keepers at neighboring canal locks are arranging a small schedule adjustment for an upcoming shift. Each chooses whether to keep the assigned shift or swap it with the other lock-keeper.

s.name: Coppice Cycle Coordination
s.description: Two neighboring coppice managers, Rowan Estate and Vale Cooperative, are choosing how to time their next harvest. Rowan chooses between “Short Cycle” and “Long Cycle,” while Vale chooses between “Early Cut” and “Late Cut” for its own coppice plots.

s.name: Shared Pressing Queue
s.description: Label A and Label B are small record labels booking slots at the same vinyl pressing plant. Each label chooses either “Rush Slot” or “Standard Slot” for an upcoming release.

s.name: Weekly Milk Pricing
s.description: Two small dairy co-ops serving the same local shops each choose a pricing adjustment for a routine weekly milk-list update. “Hold Price” means keeping the current list price, while “Trim Price” means making a small downward adjustment.

s.name: Masterwork Restoration Bid
s.description: A restoration studio chooses between submitting a Lean Restoration bid or a Full Restoration bid for a priceless antique. The antique's owner chooses between Award Contract and Invite Rivals for the commission, with the decision carrying major financial and cultural stakes.

s.name: Radio Telescope Scheduling
s.description: Two university radio astronomy teams share a community radio telescope's weekly schedule. Team A chooses between Deep Scan and Broad Scan, while Team B chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot.

s.name: House Blend Sourcing
s.description: A neighborhood coffee roaster and a small café are fine-tuning the sourcing plan for next week’s house blend. The roaster chooses between a Standard Lot and a Split Lot, while the café chooses between a Regular Window and a Flexible Window for receiving the coffee.

s.name: Bakery Supply Order
s.description: A neighborhood bakery and a flour mill are arranging a routine bread-supply order. The bakery chooses Early order or Late order, while the mill chooses Reserve stock or Spot supply.

s.name: Clocktower Maintenance
s.description: A clocktower engineer and a municipal budget officer are planning maintenance for the town’s landmark tower before the busy season. The engineer chooses between Full Overhaul and Patch Repairs, while the budget officer chooses between Release Budget and Hold Budget.

s.name: Clocktower Maintenance
s.description: A municipal clock authority and a specialist clockworks contractor must decide how to handle maintenance of a landmark clocktower. The authority chooses between Immediate overhaul and Deferred overhaul, while the contractor chooses between Keep chimes and Stop chimes during the maintenance decision.

s.name: Small Scouring Plans
s.description: A small wool mill and a nearby wool cooperative are planning a minor adjustment to their wool-scouring capacity for the next batch. Each chooses between keeping its current schedule and adding a little capacity.

s.name: Evening Triage Staffing
s.description: Two nearby community hospitals are planning staffing for a routine evening triage shift. Hospital A chooses between Float Nurses, who can move between intake points, and Fixed Triage, while Hospital B chooses between a Shared Pool and a Triage Desk assigned to intake.

s.name: Thatching Crew Rotas
s.description: A lead thatching crew and a partner thatching crew are planning rotas for a season of substantial roof-restoration work. The lead crew chooses an Early rota or a Reserve rota, while the partner crew chooses a Joint rota or an Independent rota for coordinating its work.

s.name: Salt-Marsh Grazing Rights
s.description: A cattle cooperative and a coastal land trust are deciding the future of grazing rights on a valuable salt-marsh parcel. The cooperative chooses between Early Grazing and Deferred Grazing, while the trust chooses between Grant Lease and Reserve Marsh.

s.name: City Hive Siting
s.description: A neighborhood association and a city garden coordinator are planning an urban beehive site. The association chooses between Rooftop Apiary and Courtyard Apiary, while the coordinator chooses between Community Lot and Greenway Edge.

s.name: Harvest Freight Window
s.description: A national freight railroad and a grain-export terminal are setting the schedule for a high-stakes harvest shipment. The railroad chooses between Priority Dispatch and Flexible Dispatch, while the terminal chooses between Early Loading and Staggered Loading.

s.name: Dome Time Adjustment
s.description: An observatory technician chooses between Fine Focus and Quick Setup for a small dome-time session. A visiting astronomer chooses between requesting an Early Slot and requesting a Late Slot.

s.name: Replacement Bell
s.description: A small bell foundry and a town clock committee are arranging a replacement bell. The foundry chooses either Traditional Casting or Rapid Casting, while the committee chooses either Early Pickup or Flexible Pickup.

s.name: Seasonal Planetarium Slots
s.description: Northstar Planetarium and Meridian Planetarium are planning their headline shows for the coming season. Northstar chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot, while Meridian chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot.

s.name: Truffle Permit Season
s.description: A regional land agency and a commercial truffle cooperative are setting the terms for a high-stakes truffle-foraging season. The agency chooses between Strict Permit and Open Permit, while the cooperative chooses between Early Foraging and Late Foraging.

s.name: Triage Shift Adjustment
s.description: The triage charge nurse chooses between Core Cover, keeping the usual triage assignment, and Flex Cover, shifting a float nurse into triage. The float-pool coordinator chooses between Early Roster, scheduling that float earlier, and Late Roster, scheduling the float later.

s.name: Cider Press Bookings
s.description: An orchard cooperative and a neighborhood cider mill are arranging the cooperative’s seasonal cider-press booking. The cooperative chooses between an Early slot and a Late slot, while the mill chooses between Reserve capacity and Open capacity.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: A tidal-energy operator chooses between Scheduled Service and Deferred Service for a turbine cluster. A marine maintenance contractor chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew for the same servicing window, with the decision affecting the season’s budget and reputation.

s.name: Offshore Turbine Maintenance
s.description: A wind-farm operator and a regional grid coordinator are planning a major turbine-maintenance window. The operator chooses Planned outage or Emergency repairs, while the coordinator chooses Reserve power or No reserve.

s.name: City Hive Placement
s.description: A community garden coordinator and a nearby rooftop beekeeper are making small adjustments to where their urban beehives will sit. The coordinator chooses between Street Edge and Garden Edge, while the beekeeper chooses between Low Roof and High Roof.

s.name: Bakery Supply Orders
s.description: A neighborhood bakery and a flour supplier are coordinating a routine flour order. The bakery chooses Early order or Flexible order, while the supplier chooses Reserve stock or Spot shipment.

s.name: Antique Restoration Bids
s.description: Two competing antique-restoration houses are bidding for the commission to restore a prominent heirloom. Each house chooses between a Conservation Bid, centered on minimal intervention, and a Revival Bid, proposing a more extensive restoration.

s.name: Rink Resurfacing Tweak
s.description: A small ice rink manager chooses between a Shallow Cut and a Deep Cut for the next resurfacing. The rink technician chooses between a Cooler Finish and a Warmer Finish for the same routine job.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations
s.description: A harbour authority and a pilot cooperative must set the rotation plan for a high-stakes shipping season. The authority chooses Fixed Rotation, keeping pilot assignments on a preset cycle, or Flexible Rotation, changing assignments as traffic shifts; the cooperative chooses Standard Rotation, using its ordinary roster sequence, or Surge Rotation, concentrating available pilots on scheduled arrivals.

s.name: Peatland Recovery Plan
s.description: A peatland restoration trust and a neighboring landowner are planning one season of work on a damaged peat bog. The trust chooses between Block drains and Stage works, while the landowner chooses between Grant access and Restrict access to the restoration site.

s.name: Yard Slot Timing
s.description: A local freight dispatcher chooses whether to assign a small freight train an Early Slot or a Late Slot. A nearby yard coordinator chooses between a Steady Pace and a Quick Pace for handling the train.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: Two commercial beekeepers, North Apiary and South Apiary, must choose winter sites for their hives. North Apiary chooses between Sheltered Ridge and Valley Orchard, while South Apiary chooses between Frostbank Meadow and Sunny Orchard.

s.name: Telescope Mirror Recoating
s.description: A small observatory is choosing between Quick Recoat and Careful Recoat for its telescope mirror. The recoating shop is choosing between an Early Slot and a Late Slot for the work.

s.name: Seasonal Fabric Run
s.description: A textile mill’s color director chooses between Deep Vat and Measured Vat for a seasonal fabric run. Its dye-house partner chooses between Early Shift and Late Shift for the same run.

s.name: Continental Freight Corridor
s.description: A national freight railroad is choosing between Express Routing and Deferred Routing for a high-stakes cross-country cargo movement. A major port authority is choosing between Night Slot and Day Slot for the train's terminal access.

s.name: Radio Telescope Scheduling
s.description: Two astronomy teams are submitting observing plans for a heavily scheduled radio telescope season. Team A chooses between a Deep Survey, which reserves long observing blocks, and a Rapid Survey, which uses shorter visits; Team B chooses between a Pulsar Campaign and Galaxy Mapping.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contract
s.description: An orchard grower and a nearby packing cooperative are arranging a modest harvest contract for the season. The grower chooses between Early Commitment and Flexible Commitment, while the cooperative chooses between Fixed Pickup and Flexible Pickup.

s.name: Neighborhood Courier Bids
s.description: Two neighborhood courier firms are bidding to coordinate a shared delivery run. Firm A chooses between the Early Route and Late Route, while Firm B chooses between using a Compact Van and a Cargo Bike for its assigned deliveries.

s.name: Orchard Pollination
s.description: An orchard grower and a local beekeeper are arranging a small pollination contract for one row of trees. The grower chooses Early Visit or Late Visit, while the beekeeper chooses Fixed Hives or Roving Hives.

s.name: Tanker Pilot Rotation
s.description: Two harbour pilot cooperatives are coordinating the rotation for a major tanker movement through the port. North Channel chooses between Priority Rotation and Deferred Rotation for its pilots, while South Channel chooses between Priority Rotation and Deferred Rotation for its own pilots.

s.name: Vineyard Water Allocation
s.description: A vineyard cooperative must choose between Deep Irrigation and Reserve Irrigation for its vines during a critical growing period. The regional water authority chooses between Release Water and Hold Water for the same allocation decision.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease Adjustment
s.description: Two neighboring oyster growers are making a small adjustment to a shared oyster-bed lease. Grower A chooses a narrow or wide buffer around the beds, while Grower B chooses an early or late lease renewal.

s.name: Bell Commission
s.description: A bell foundry and a cathedral project steward are coordinating a major bell commission. The foundry manager chooses between Rush Casting and Careful Casting, while the steward chooses between Early Approval and Late Approval for the casting plan.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: A millpond sluice keeper chooses whether to Open Early or Open Late, while a nearby mill operator chooses whether to Run Early or Run Late. Their choices set the timing for the day's ordinary water release and mill operations.

s.name: Substrate Contract
s.description: Two large mushroom growers, Northvale Farms and Cedar Ring, are choosing how to arrange their substrate supply for the coming production cycle. Northvale Farms chooses between Reserve Early and Reserve Late, while Cedar Ring chooses between Lock Supply and Flexible Order.

s.name: Orchard Pollination Contract
s.description: An orchard cooperative and a commercial beekeeper are negotiating a pollination contract for an important growing season. The cooperative chooses Early Contract or Flexible Contract, while the beekeeper chooses Full Placement or Limited Placement.

s.name: Neighborhood Beer Route
s.description: A neighborhood microbrewery and a local bottle shop are arranging a distribution agreement. The brewery chooses between Direct Delivery, bringing the beer to the shop itself, and Regional Distributor, using a wholesaler; the shop chooses between Regular Shelf placement and Tap Feature placement.

s.name: Salt Pan Timing
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan workers share a small evaporation pond. Worker A chooses Early raking or Late raking for the salt crust, while Worker B chooses Open channel or Narrow channel for the connecting brine gate.

s.name: Truffle Permit Season
s.description: Alba Grove and Black Oak are neighboring truffle estates planning their seasonal foraging permits. Each estate chooses between Open Access, issuing permits broadly, and Limited Access, restricting permits to a small vetted group.

s.name: Turbine Fine-Tuning
s.description: A wind-farm technician chooses whether to fine-tune a turbine's blade alignment or leave it as-is. The site operator chooses whether to schedule a brief pause for the adjustment or keep the turbine running.

s.name: Neighborhood Letterpress Run
s.description: A neighborhood letterpress shop and a local author are coordinating an everyday print run. The shop chooses Quick Setup or Careful Setup, while the author chooses Standard Stock or Premium Stock for the job.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Tour
s.description: A celebrated puppet theatre company is deciding between mounting a full tour and taking a regional run. A national arts broadcaster is deciding whether to schedule the production in a prime broadcast slot or a late broadcast slot, with the choices forming a high-stakes touring and distribution deal.

s.name: Season Quota Talks
s.description: A fishing cooperative and a regional fisheries council are negotiating the season's quota. The cooperative chooses between Early Agreement and Hold Out, while the council chooses between Flexible Quota and Firm Quota.

s.name: Seaweed Drying Racks
s.description: Two neighboring seaweed growers are tending small drying racks on the same shore. One chooses whether to turn the racks, while the other chooses whether to raise or lower the protective cloth.

s.name: Championship Concessions
s.description: Two concession operators run neighboring stands during a championship game, with both facing a commercially important pricing decision. Each operator chooses between Premium pricing and Value pricing for its stadium menu. The contracts and crowd demand make the decision consequential for both businesses.

s.name: Seasonal Kiln Run
s.description: A regional tile studio and a ceramics cooperative are planning a substantial seasonal production run in a shared kiln. The tile studio chooses either Fast Ramp or Slow Ramp, while the cooperative chooses either Early Unload or Late Unload for the run.

s.name: Oyster Bed Leases
s.description: Two oyster growers in a small coastal cooperative are arranging leases for neighboring beds. Grower A chooses between a rotating lease and a fixed lease, while Grower B chooses between a shared channel and a private channel.

s.name: Seed Share Exchange
s.description: A community seed bank and a neighborhood gardening cooperative are arranging an everyday exchange of saved vegetable seeds. The seed bank chooses between Small Batch and Full Batch, while the cooperative chooses between Early Pickup and Flexible Pickup.

s.name: Vineyard Water Allocation
s.description: A vineyard manager chooses between Measured Irrigation and Full Irrigation for the growing season. A regional water cooperative chooses between Priority Release and Deferred Release for the vineyard's water allocation.

s.name: Wool Scouring Capacity
s.description: Two major wool processors are preparing for the region’s main harvest and must choose how to handle their scouring capacity. Each processor chooses between expanding its available capacity or holding its current capacity for the season.

s.name: Routine Telescope Session
s.description: A small radio observatory and a partner research team share a routine radio-telescope session. The observatory chooses between Short Scan and Long Scan, while the partner chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: At a shared millpond, the upstream miller chooses between Early Release and Late Release for opening the sluice, while the downstream miller chooses between Early Intake and Late Intake for admitting water to the millrace. These are their two timing choices for an ordinary day of water management.

s.name: Seasonal Thatching Rotas
s.description: A lead thatching crew and a property cooperative are coordinating their seasonal work rotas for a major group of roof repairs. Each chooses between an Early Rota and a Late Rota for scheduling its thatching teams.

s.name: Vineyard Water Allocation
s.description: Two vineyard owners jointly depend on a shared reservoir during a heat-sensitive growing season. Owner A chooses between Deep Irrigation and Water Reserve, while owner B chooses between Early Release and Hold Water.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring dairy farmers share a silage clamp during harvest. Each chooses either Reserve Early, meaning committing to a storage slot in advance, or Keep Flexible, meaning leaving their clamp use open until later.

s.name: Seasonal Kiln Firing
s.description: A regional ceramics studio and a contract kiln operator are coordinating a season's high-value stoneware firing. The studio chooses between Standard Ramp and Accelerated Ramp, while the kiln operator chooses between Early Venting and Sealed Hold.

s.name: Tundra Route Coordination
s.description: Two reindeer-herding cooperatives plan routes for a high-stakes seasonal migration across shared tundra. Cooperative A chooses between Valley Route and Ridge Route, while Cooperative B chooses between Early Passage and Late Passage.

s.name: Herbarium Loan
s.description: A requesting herbarium is arranging a small loan of pressed specimens from a lending herbarium. The lending herbarium chooses between Standard packet and Extra padding, while the requesting herbarium chooses between Flexible dates and Fixed dates.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A glaciology institute is coordinating a season of glacier survey flights with an aviation contractor. The institute chooses Early Flights or Late Flights for when to conduct the surveys, while the contractor chooses Broad Coverage or Reserve Capacity for how to allocate flight capacity.

s.name: Cheese Cave Contract
s.description: A cheesemaking cooperative and a specialty-food distributor are arranging a very large cheese-cave batch. The cooperative chooses Long Ripening or Quick Ripening, while the distributor chooses Reserve Purchase or Spot Purchase.

s.name: Regional Rail Timetable
s.description: Two neighboring freight rail operators are setting departure windows for trains sharing a busy regional corridor. Each operator chooses either an Early Slot or a Late Slot for its daily service, balancing the timetable with the other operator's choice.

s.name: Shared Quarry Windows
s.description: Two quarry companies are coordinating blasting windows around a shared haul road during a busy extraction season. Quarry North chooses Morning blast or Late blast, while Quarry South chooses Morning blast or Late blast.

s.name: Clocktower Maintenance
s.description: A city council and an independent clockmaker must jointly decide the maintenance plan for a clocktower central to the city's emergency timekeeping. The council chooses between Full Overhaul and Patch Repairs, while the clockmaker chooses between Night Shutdown and Live Operation.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Request
s.description: A small local herbarium and a nearby university herbarium are arranging a loan of a few plant specimens. The local herbarium chooses between Quick Review and Careful Review, while the university herbarium chooses between Standard List and Revised List for the request.

s.name: Bakery Supply Orders
s.description: A neighborhood bakery is arranging its weekly flour order with a local supplier. The bakery chooses between Bulk Order and Small Order, while the supplier chooses between Priority Delivery and Standard Delivery.

s.name: Orchard Pollination Contract
s.description: A regional orchard company and a managed-bee cooperative are negotiating a pollination contract for the coming fruit season. The orchard chooses between Early Placement and Late Placement, while the cooperative chooses between Full Coverage and Limited Coverage.

s.name: Orbital Downlink Coordination
s.description: Two satellite operators are coordinating a critical downlink window for mission data with major operational consequences. Operator A chooses Early Handoff or Late Handoff for transferring its data, while Operator B chooses Shared Window or Exclusive Window for scheduling access to the downlink channel.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Tuning
s.description: A maintenance technician and a tidal-site scheduler are coordinating a small service visit for one tidal turbine. The technician chooses Standard tune or Fine tune, while the scheduler chooses Early window or Late window for the service work.

s.name: Harvest Corridor Scheduling
s.description: A regional freight railroad and a large agricultural shipper are planning service on a crowded corridor for the coming harvest season. The railroad chooses between Priority Slots and Flexible Slots, while the shipper chooses between Early Dispatch and Late Dispatch.

s.name: Urban Apiary Siting
s.description: A city redevelopment authority and an urban beekeepers' cooperative are planning a major rooftop apiary. The authority chooses between Civic Rooftop and River Terrace, while the cooperative chooses between Dense Hives and Sparse Hives.

s.name: Ski-Lift Grooming
s.description: Two neighboring ski-lift operators coordinate grooming on a shared beginner slope. The first operator chooses Full Grooming or Light Grooming, while the second chooses Early Grooming or Late Grooming for its grooming shift.

s.name: Routine Downlink
s.description: A small satellite operations team chooses between Early Trim and Late Trim for a routine downlink window. The ground-station scheduler chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot for receiving it.

s.name: Orchard Falconry Plan
s.description: A falconer and an orchard cooperative manager are planning a season of pest control using trained falcons. The falconer chooses between Broad Release and Targeted Release, while the manager chooses between Open Corridors and Protected Plots.

s.name: Mirror Recoating Adjustment
s.description: An observatory technician and a telescope-coating technician are preparing a small mirror for recoating. The observatory technician chooses between Fine polish and Quick polish, while the coating technician chooses between Thin coat and Standard coat.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contract
s.description: An orchard cooperative and a regional juice processor are negotiating a harvest contract for the coming season. The cooperative chooses between Early Contract and Late Contract, while the processor chooses between Firm Volume and Flexible Volume.

s.name: Dairy Co-op Pricing
s.description: Two nearby dairy co-ops are setting prices for their everyday milk cartons. Each co-op chooses between Steady Price and Promo Price for the coming sales period.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Tour
s.description: A major puppet theatre company and a national arts presenter are arranging a high-stakes touring season. The company chooses between Full Tour and Short Tour, while the presenter chooses between Prime Slots and Late Slots.

s.name: Creekside Bat Count
s.description: A park volunteer and a local naturalist are coordinating a small bat survey night. The volunteer chooses between “Early sweep” and “Late sweep,” while the naturalist chooses between “Quiet route” and “Open route.”

s.name: Oyster Bed Leases
s.description: A coastal oyster cooperative is choosing between Early Renewal and Seasonal Renewal for a valuable bed lease. A regional seafood distributor is choosing between Premium Contract and Flexible Contract for purchasing the cooperative’s harvest.

s.name: Osier Bed Cutting
s.description: Two neighboring osier-bed growers are choosing how closely to cut their own beds during a routine trimming round. Each grower must choose either Light cut or Close cut.

s.name: Archive Digitisation
s.description: A small historical archive is coordinating a routine digitisation job with a scanning vendor. The archive chooses between Scan Onsite and Ship Boxes, while the vendor chooses between Rush Queue and Careful Queue.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A quarry operator and a rail carrier coordinate blasting windows for stone deliveries. The quarry operator chooses Early blasting or Late blasting, while the rail carrier chooses Day routing or Night routing for the trains serving the quarry.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: A millpond authority and a downstream irrigation cooperative must coordinate a high-stakes water release. The authority chooses between Early Release and Late Release, while the cooperative chooses between Early Draw and Late Draw for its intake schedule.

s.name: Stadium Concessions
s.description: A stadium operator and its concessionaire are setting prices for an upcoming game. The operator chooses between Combo Deals and Separate Items for how concessions are sold, while the concessionaire chooses between Premium Prices and Value Prices.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contracts
s.description: A large orchard owner is arranging a harvest contract with a juice processor. The orchard owner chooses between Early Contract and Spot Delivery, while the processor chooses between Firm Pickup and Flexible Pickup.

s.name: Antique Restoration Bids
s.description: An antique collector and a restoration workshop are arranging a bid for an everyday restoration job. The collector chooses between Full Restoration and Light Restoration, while the workshop chooses between Firm Quote and Flexible Quote.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspection
s.description: A local waterway caretaker and a volunteer coordinator are arranging a routine inspection of a small eel pass. The caretaker chooses between “Quick check” and “Careful check,” while the coordinator chooses between “Morning visit” and “Afternoon visit.”

s.name: Seed Reserve Exchange
s.description: A regional seed bank is deciding whether to Release Reserve or Hold Reserve during a proposed exchange with a neighboring seed bank. The neighboring seed bank is deciding whether to Match Exchange or Decline Exchange.

s.name: Silage Clamp Sharing
s.description: Two neighboring dairy cooperatives must manage a shared silage clamp during a harvest when feed storage is crucial. Each cooperative chooses either Open Access, making its available clamp space usable by the other, or Reserve Capacity, holding that space back for its own use.

s.name: Garden Wall Bids
s.description: A local mason is preparing a bid for a small garden-stone wall and chooses between Spot Repair and Joint Reset. The homeowner considers the bid and chooses between Morning Reply and Evening Reply.

s.name: Cranberry Bog Flooding
s.description: A cranberry grower chooses between Open Gates and Hold Gates for a shared bog channel. A neighboring cranberry grower chooses between Flood Now and Wait for the same channel.

s.name: Clocktower Restoration
s.description: A city clock conservator is planning maintenance for a prominent clocktower and must choose between Routine overhaul and Full restoration. The tower’s civic sponsor must choose between Public ceremony and Quiet closure while the work is arranged.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Service Window
s.description: A tidal-energy operator and a specialist maintenance contractor must coordinate servicing a critical tidal turbine. The operator chooses between Full Overhaul and Quick Service, while the contractor chooses between Release Access and Hold Access for the turbine's maintenance window.

s.name: Canal Lock Schedule
s.description: An allotment gardener and a small-boat keeper are arranging the schedule for a nearby canal lock. The gardener chooses First Slot or Second Slot, while the boat keeper chooses Open Early or Open Late.

s.name: Shared Kiln Schedule
s.description: Two small charcoal makers share a neighborhood kiln and each must choose a schedule for its next batch. Each maker can select a daytime burn or a nighttime burn.

s.name: Shared Seaweed Racks
s.description: Two major seaweed producers must use a shared set of coastal drying racks during a high-stakes harvest season. Each producer chooses either Early Loading or Late Loading for its harvest.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: A commercial orchard manager chooses between Deploy heaters and Skip heaters for an overnight frost watch. A neighboring orchard cooperative chooses between Night patrol, sending crews through the orchard overnight, and Remote watch, monitoring sensors from its dispatch room.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A volunteer bat surveyor chooses whether to begin a small evening transect at Dusk Start or Moonrise Start. A second surveyor chooses whether to use Quiet Playback or Brief Playback while setting up the same bat survey night.

s.name: Orchard Falconry
s.description: An orchard grower and a local falconer coordinate a modest pest-control visit. The grower chooses Request patrol or Skip patrol, while the falconer chooses Fly hawk or Keep hawk.

s.name: Substrate Season Contracts
s.description: A commercial mushroom farm and a regional mushroom-substrate supplier are planning a high-stakes growing season. The farm chooses between Bulk Contract and Spot Purchase, while the supplier chooses between Reserve Capacity and Open Market.

s.name: Lifeline Rope Ferry
s.description: A regional ferry authority and a ferry cooperative are setting staffing for a rope ferry that serves an isolated community and carries high-stakes traffic. The authority chooses between Full crew and Lean crew, while the cooperative chooses between Fixed roster and Relief roster.

s.name: Canal Shift Swap
s.description: Two lock-keepers are arranging a shift swap for the next canal rota. Each chooses whether to take the Early Shift or the Late Shift.

s.name: Peatland Restoration Pact
s.description: A national peatland agency and a downstream water utility are coordinating a high-stakes peat bog restoration project. The agency chooses between Rewet Early and Phase Works, while the utility chooses between Fund Works and Protect Intake.

s.name: Weekly Milk Contract
s.description: A small dairy co-op and a nearby creamery are adjusting a routine weekly milk contract. The co-op chooses either “Hold Rate” or “Trim Rate” for its producer payment, while the creamery chooses either “Hold Offer” or “Trim Offer” for its purchase price.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspections
s.description: A river trust chooses between Scheduled Checks and Spot Checks for eel pass inspections. A fisheries cooperative chooses between Shared Records and Private Records for documenting those inspections.

s.name: Critical Courier Routes
s.description: Two major courier firms are bidding for a high-stakes contract to carry time-sensitive medical shipments between distant distribution hubs. Each firm chooses between a Direct Bid, promising dedicated route capacity, and a Relay Bid, proposing transfers through its regional network.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Coordination
s.description: An upstream water authority and a downstream canal operator are arranging a substantial weir repair before the next operating season. The authority chooses a Spring Window or Autumn Window for the work, while the canal operator chooses Full Flow or Reduced Flow during that maintenance window.

s.name: Ski-Lift Grooming
s.description: A ski resort's trail crew chooses between Early Grooming and Late Grooming for a lift-served slope. The lift operations manager chooses between Full Lift Service and Limited Lift Service for the same period.

s.name: Hut Resupply Timing
s.description: A mountain hut warden and a local carrier are coordinating a small resupply. The warden chooses between Early Request and Late Request, while the carrier chooses between Morning Carry and Afternoon Carry.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Tour
s.description: A touring puppet troupe and a regional theatre festival are arranging the troupe’s upcoming season. The troupe chooses Full Tour or Short Tour, while the festival chooses Prime Slot or Off-Season.

s.name: Reindeer Range Routes
s.description: Two reindeer-herding cooperatives are planning a high-stakes seasonal migration across neighboring grazing territory. Cooperative A must choose between Coastal Route and Valley Route, while Cooperative B must choose between Northern Route and Mountain Route.

s.name: Triage Shift Tuning
s.description: A charge nurse and a hospital staffing coordinator are making a small adjustment to one ordinary triage shift. The charge nurse chooses between Steady coverage and Flexible coverage, while the coordinator chooses between Early adjustment and Late adjustment.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: Two commercial beekeepers are choosing winter apiary sites for the coming season. Beekeeper A chooses between Orchard Edge and River Meadow, while Beekeeper B chooses between Windbreak Grove and Open Bench for placing their colonies.

s.name: Woodland Truffle Permit
s.description: A village land steward and a small truffle forager are coordinating access to a nearby woodland patch. The steward chooses Early Permit or Late Permit, while the forager chooses Early Search or Late Search.

s.name: Kiln Burn Scheduling
s.description: Two neighboring charcoal makers are scheduling their next kiln burn. Each chooses between an Early Burn and a Late Burn for their own kiln.

s.name: Milk Contract Pricing
s.description: A regional dairy co-op and a supermarket chain are setting terms for a season-long milk contract. The co-op chooses Stable Price or Flexible Price, while the supermarket chooses Premium Price or Discount Price for the milk on its shelves.

s.name: Weekly Flour Order
s.description: A neighborhood bakery and its flour wholesaler are arranging a routine weekly supply order. The bakery chooses Early Order or Last-Minute Order, while the wholesaler chooses Reserve Stock or Open Allocation.

s.name: Ferry Channel Timing
s.description: A small port maintenance office schedules a dredging job in either the Early Window or Late Window. A nearby ferry operator chooses either Shift Sailings or Keep Sailings for its timetable during that window.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Crews
s.description: A saffron cooperative and a seasonal harvest contractor are arranging labour for the coming saffron harvest. The cooperative chooses between Early Hiring and Flexible Hiring, while the contractor chooses between Local Crew and Traveling Crew.

s.name: Orchard Falconry
s.description: A small orchard keeper and a local falconer coordinate a brief visit to discourage pests from a few fruit trees. The keeper chooses between Mark target and Skip marking, while the falconer chooses between Low pass and High pass.

s.name: Seasonal Taproom Release
s.description: A regional microbrewery and its distribution partner are planning a season-defining release of a new beer. The brewery chooses between Early Release and Staggered Release, while the distributor chooses between Broad Rollout and Curated Rollout.

s.name: Puppet Tour Contract
s.description: A major puppet theatre company and a national arts network are negotiating a high-stakes touring contract. The company chooses between Full Tour and Limited Tour, while the network chooses between Early Booking and Late Booking for the performances.

s.name: Port Dredging Windows
s.description: A port authority schedules a channel-dredging project in an Early Window or a Late Window. A dredging contractor chooses a Full Crew or a Split Crew for the selected port dredging window.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Timing
s.description: A small herbarium curator is preparing a routine specimen loan for a neighboring collection. The curator chooses between Prompt Packing and Careful Packing, while the borrowing collection chooses between Quick Return and Flexible Return.

s.name: Freight Yard Timing
s.description: A small freight-yard dispatcher and a nearby customer each make a scheduling choice for one routine transfer. The dispatcher chooses between “Early Slot” and “Late Slot,” while the customer chooses between “Hold Consist” and “Release Consist” for its cars.

s.name: Small Library Order
s.description: A public library and an independent book distributor are arranging a modest batch of new books. The library chooses Popular Titles or Local Authors, while the distributor chooses Early Shipment or Bundled Shipment.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: The marathon organizer chooses between Full Closure and Staged Closure for the race route. The transit authority chooses between Early Detours and Late Detours for rerouting buses and traffic during the high-stakes marathon.

s.name: Shared Kelp Raft
s.description: Two neighboring kelp farmers tend adjacent lines on the same small raft. Each chooses between an Early trim during the routine check and a Late trim at the next check.

s.name: Archive Digitisation Plan
s.description: A public archive director and a specialist digitisation contractor are setting the plan for a substantial season of archive digitisation. The director chooses between Pilot Batch and Full Rollout, while the contractor chooses between Conservative Specs and Rapid Specs.

s.name: Kelp Harvest Timing
s.description: Two neighboring kelp farms are planning their harvest for the same season. Farm A chooses between Early Harvest and Delayed Harvest, while Farm B chooses between Early Harvest and Delayed Harvest.

s.description: Meridian Records and Northstar Music are preparing flagship albums at a vinyl pressing plant, where queue decisions carry major consequences for each company's release. Meridian chooses between “Rush Pressing” and “Standard Queue,” while Northstar independently chooses between “Rush Pressing” and “Standard Queue.”

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: Two avalanche patrol leads are adjusting a small daily roster. The first chooses between an Early Sweep and a Late Sweep, while the second assigns the team to a Ridge Route or a Tree Route.

s.name: Osier Bed Cutting
s.description: Two neighboring osier growers are planning when to cut their beds for the next basket-making season. Each grower chooses between Early cutting and Late cutting.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspections
s.description: A regional fisheries office and a hydroelectric operator are setting the inspection plan for an eel pass during an important migration season. The office chooses between Routine Inspection and Thorough Inspection, while the operator chooses between Open Passage and Managed Passage.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contracts
s.description: A small orchard owner and a nearby juice cooperative are arranging a modest harvest contract. The orchard owner chooses between Early pickup and Late pickup, while the cooperative chooses between a Flexible slot and a Fixed slot for receiving the fruit.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspections
s.description: A river steward and a local eel fisher are deciding how to handle an everyday inspection of an eel pass. The steward chooses between Routine Check and Detailed Check, while the fisher chooses between Guide Eels and Leave Passage.

s.name: Freight Timetable Adjustment
s.description: A small freight-rail dispatcher and a neighboring yard coordinator are choosing how to handle a minor timetable adjustment. The dispatcher can use a Flexible Slot or a Fixed Slot, while the coordinator can keep the Current Order or Shift Departure.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: At a major millpond, the upstream mill operator chooses between Early Release and Late Release, while the downstream water manager chooses between Early Opening and Late Opening of the receiving sluice. Their choices set the timing of water movement through the millpond system.

s.name: Orchard Pollination
s.description: A local beekeeper and a small orchard owner are arranging a pollination contract. The beekeeper chooses either Standard Hives or Flexible Visits, while the orchard owner chooses either Early Booking or Last-Minute Booking.

s.name: Seasonal Textile Dyeing
s.description: A textile mill manager chooses between Standard Dyeing, using a fixed recipe, and Flexible Dyeing, allowing the seasonal production shift to adjust its process. An independent apparel-brand buyer chooses between Early Commitment to the run and a Revised Order for the same dyed textiles.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: At a major tidal array, the grid operator chooses between Rapid Service and Scheduled Service for a turbine intervention. The maintenance contractor chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew for the same intervention.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: Two neighboring beekeepers are deciding where to site their hives for winter. Beekeeper A chooses between Sheltered Grove and Field Edge, while Beekeeper B chooses between North Meadow and South Meadow.

s.name: Lift-Grooming Plan
s.description: A ski resort and an independent lift-operations crew are planning grooming for a demanding ski season. The resort chooses between Night Grooming and Morning Grooming, while the crew chooses between Full Pass and Targeted Pass.

s.name: Alpine Lift Opening
s.description: A major ski area and the regional lift authority must coordinate the opening of a high-alpine lift after a severe overnight storm. The resort operator chooses Full Grooming or Light Grooming, while the authority chooses Early Opening or Delayed Opening.

s.name: Local Taproom Distribution
s.description: A small microbrewery is deciding whether to Release Early or Hold Batch for a new seasonal beer. Its neighborhood distributor is choosing between Wide Placement and Selective Placement for the beer in local shops and taprooms.

s.name: Stadium Concession Pricing
s.description: For an upcoming season, two concession operators serving the same stadium are deciding how to position their prices. Operator A chooses either Value pricing or Premium pricing, while Operator B chooses either Value pricing or Premium pricing.

s.name: Island Ferry Timetable
s.description: Two ferry operators are setting a high-stakes timetable for a vital island route. Operator A chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot, while Operator B chooses between Peak Slot and Off-Peak Slot for its own sailing.

s.name: Triage Shift Planning
s.description: A charge nurse and an on-call physician are coordinating staffing for a small hospital triage unit. The nurse chooses between Early Huddle and Routine Handoff, while the physician chooses between Extra Float and Usual Coverage.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Service
s.description: A tidal-turbine operator and a maintenance contractor are arranging a routine service call. The operator chooses either Routine Visit or Deferred Visit, while the contractor chooses either Full Crew or Compact Crew.

s.name: Dyeing Shift Contract
s.description: A textile mill chooses whether a seasonal fabric batch runs on the Night Shift or Day Shift. The apparel brand commissioning the batch chooses between Rush Approval and Standard Approval for the dyeing schedule.

s.name: Clocktower Maintenance
s.description: The Heritage Trust and the Municipal Works Authority must choose plans for maintaining a high-stakes city clocktower. The Trust chooses between Full Overhaul and Patch Repairs, while the Authority chooses between Night Closure and Open Continuously.

s.name: Tundra Route Adjustment
s.description: Two neighboring reindeer herding teams are making a small route adjustment for an ordinary day's crossing. Team A chooses between Ridge Loop and Valley Bend, while Team B chooses between Early Spur and Late Spur.

s.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
s.description: Two ferry operators serving the same local route are arranging their routine timetable slots. Each operator chooses between a Morning Slot and an Afternoon Slot for its sailing.

s.name: Quiet-Sky Scheduling
s.description: Two small research teams are sharing a radio telescope for a routine observation. The first team chooses between Brief Calibration and Full Calibration, while the second chooses between Low Band and High Band for its setup.

s.name: Seasonal Rope Ferry
s.description: A rope-ferry cooperative and a regional transit office are planning staffing for a heavily used river crossing during the sailing season. The cooperative chooses either Full Crew or Lean Crew, while the transit office chooses either Dedicated Relief or Shared Relief for its side of the operation.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: A coastal lighthouse authority and a contracted relief operator must coordinate staffing at a lighthouse guarding a heavily used shipping route. The authority chooses between Early Relief and Full Watch, while the operator chooses between Day Handoff and Night Handoff.

s.name: Seasonal Vinyl Release
s.description: A record label is planning a high-profile seasonal release with a vinyl pressing plant. The label chooses Early Pressing or Late Pressing for its masters, while the plant chooses Rush Queue or Standard Queue for the job’s place in its pressing schedule.

s.name: Regional Brewery Launch
s.description: A craft microbrewery is arranging a high-stakes regional distribution launch with a national distributor. The brewery chooses between Exclusive Launch, granting the distributor sole channel rights, and Open Launch, using multiple distributors; the distributor chooses between Premium Rollout, committing its top retail and logistics network, and Basic Rollout, using a standard distribution plan.

s.name: Canal Lock Scheduling
s.description: Two neighboring canal operators share a lock during a busy afternoon. Operator A chooses an Early Slot or Late Slot for its barge queue, while Operator B makes the same choice for its own queue.

s.name: Parish Bell Casting
s.description: A small bell foundry and a parish committee are arranging a routine bell casting. The foundry chooses Early Pour or Late Pour for the mold, while the committee chooses Firm Order or Flexible Order for its requested casting date.

s.name: Seasonal Lock Schedule
s.description: A canal authority and a freight consortium are coordinating lock usage during a high-volume shipping season. The authority chooses between Early Slots and Late Slots, while the consortium chooses between Steady Convoys and Surge Convoys.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations
s.description: A harbour pilot coordinator and the evening pilot each choose how to handle a small adjustment in the pilot rotation. The coordinator chooses an early or late handoff, while the pilot chooses a tight or loose rotation around that handoff.

s.name: Charcoal Burn Scheduling
s.description: Two neighboring charcoal producers are competing to supply a citywide emergency fuel contract. Each producer chooses whether to schedule its kiln run in the Early Burn window or the Late Burn window.

s.name: Seasonal Ferry Slots
s.description: Two ferry operators are choosing timetable slots for a busy seasonal route. Each operator must select either the Early Slot or the Late Slot for its main crossing schedule.

s.name: Antique Restoration Bids
s.description: An antique dealer and a local restoration studio are setting terms for restoring a modestly valuable antique. The dealer chooses between a Firm Bid and a Flexible Bid, while the studio chooses between Full Treatment and Light Treatment.

s.name: Quota Season Deal
s.description: A coastal fishing cooperative and a major seafood buyer are negotiating access to a shared fishing quota for the coming season, with the agreement affecting both parties' livelihoods and supply commitments. The cooperative chooses between Release Quota and Reserve Quota, while the buyer chooses between Early Contract and Late Contract.

s.name: Neighborhood Hive Siting
s.description: A community-garden coordinator and a nearby beekeeper are choosing sites for their urban beehives. The coordinator is deciding between Garden Roof and Park Edge, while the beekeeper is deciding between Library Roof and Market Roof.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Windows
s.description: An upstream weir keeper and a downstream weir keeper are coordinating a small maintenance adjustment. The upstream keeper chooses an Early Window or a Late Window, while the downstream keeper chooses a Short Closure or a Long Closure.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: During a saffron harvest, a grower chooses between Early Picking and Late Picking. A seasonal labour coordinator chooses between Full Crew and Small Crew for the picking work.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspections
s.description: A river fisheries authority is choosing how to inspect an eel pass at a major hydroelectric facility. The facility operator is choosing whether to repair the pass immediately or defer repairs while the inspection program proceeds.

s.name: Dye-Bath Adjustment
s.description: A small textile workshop is coordinating two adjacent dyeing shifts. The dyeing lead chooses either Quick Rinse or Careful Rinse for the batch, while the finishing lead chooses either Cool Bath or Warm Bath for the next bath.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations
s.description: A harbour pilot cooperative and a port scheduling office are planning the next day's pilot rotations. The cooperative chooses between Fixed Rotation and Flexible Rotation, while the scheduling office chooses between Early Slots and Late Slots.

s.name: Seasonal Port Dredging
s.description: A port authority and a dredging contractor are planning the port's seasonal channel work. The authority chooses between Early Window and Late Window, while the contractor chooses between Full Fleet and Staged Fleet for its work plan.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A quarry operator and a regional power utility are coordinating a blast near a major transmission corridor. The quarry operator chooses either Early Window or Late Window, while the utility chooses either Grid Ready or Grid Reroute for handling the corridor during that period.

s.name: City Hive Siting
s.description: A community-garden coordinator and a nearby rooftop beekeeper are choosing locations for a small urban beehive. The coordinator chooses between Garden Edge and Courtyard Corner, while the beekeeper chooses between Roof Ledge and Roof Garden.

s.name: Linked Salt Pans
s.description: At the start of a valuable harvest season, two salt-pan operators must set plans for the same linked evaporation system. Operator A chooses between “Rapid drainage,” sending brine onward sooner, and “Held brine,” retaining it longer; Operator B chooses between “Early harvest,” collecting crystals sooner, and “Late harvest,” waiting longer.

s.name: Raptor Crop Defense
s.description: A national grain cooperative chooses between Falcon Deployment and Conventional Control for protecting its harvest from destructive pests. A neighboring land trust chooses between Joint Coordination and Separate Operation for its own falconry pest-control effort.

s.name: Small Film Release
s.description: A small film distributor chooses between a weekday launch and a weekend launch for a modest local release. A neighborhood cinema chooses between an early screening slot and a late screening slot for the same film.

s.name: Turbine Service Visit
s.description: A wind-farm operator and a maintenance contractor are arranging a routine turbine service visit. The operator chooses Day Shift or Night Shift, while the contractor chooses Full Crew or Small Crew for the visit.

s.name: Mirror Recoating
s.description: An observatory is preparing a major telescope mirror for the next observing season, while a specialized coating firm is planning the recoating work. The observatory chooses between Full recoating and Patch recoating, and the firm chooses between Rush schedule and Careful schedule.

s.name: Premiere Calendar
s.description: Two major film studios are choosing when to release their flagship films: during the holiday season or in the spring. Each studio must commit to one release window while the other studio makes its own timing decision.

s.name: Small-Batch Firing
s.description: A studio potter chooses between Gentle Ramp and Quick Ramp for a small batch’s firing schedule. The kiln keeper chooses between Early Vent and Late Vent while making a fine adjustment to the same firing.

s.name: Peat Bog Restoration

s.name: Eel Pass Scheduling
s.description: A river authority inspector chooses between Full Checks and Spot Checks for an eel pass. A small dam operator chooses between Day Opening and Night Opening for the pass.

s.name: Raptor Crop Protection

s.name: Small Bell Tuning
s.description: A bell founder is preparing a small ordinary bell and chooses between a Thicker casting and a Thinner casting. A tuning specialist then chooses between Gentle filing and Firm filing to make the final adjustment.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A quarry operator chooses between Morning Window and Evening Window for a scheduled blast. A regional rail dispatcher chooses between Clear Track and Hold Traffic for trains near the quarry.

s.name: Tundra Herd Routes
s.description: Two large reindeer-herding cooperatives must coordinate their seasonal routes across the same tundra corridor. The first cooperative chooses between Valley Route and Ridge Route, while the second chooses between Early Crossing and Late Crossing for moving its herd through the corridor.

s.name: Clocktower Chime

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contracts

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations

s.name: Seasonal Rope Ferry
s.description: A rope-ferry operator and the county transport office are setting staffing plans for a high-demand crossing season. The operator chooses Full Crew or Lean Crew, while the office chooses Expanded Roster or Basic Roster for the service.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows

s.name: Dyeing Shift Timetable
s.description: Two large textile mills are scheduling shifts for a high-volume dyeing run. Mill A chooses between Early Shift and Late Shift, while Mill B independently chooses between Early Shift and Late Shift.

s.name: Town Archive Partnership
