s.name: National Archive Digitisation
s.description: A national archive and a preservation foundation are coordinating the digitisation of a vast, irreplaceable collection. The archive chooses between Full Scan and Selective Scan, while the foundation chooses between Open Release and Restricted Release for the resulting digital records.

s.name: Freight Rail Timetable
s.description: A freight railroad is planning its seasonal dispatch pattern, choosing between Peak Dispatch and Off-Peak Dispatch. A regional rail network coordinator is choosing between Reserve Capacity and Shared Capacity for the railroad's schedule.

s.name: Neighborhood Taproom Delivery
s.description: A small microbrewery and a nearby bottle shop are arranging a modest weekly delivery. The brewery chooses between Standard Drop and Flexible Drop, while the shop chooses between Shelf Space and Counter Space.

s.name: Seasonal Letterpress Edition
s.description: A small publisher is preparing a letterpress edition important to its seasonal catalogue, while a specialist print workshop decides how to allocate press time. The publisher chooses between Rush Run and Staged Run; the workshop chooses between Shared Press and Dedicated Slot.

s.name: Peatland Restoration
s.description: A peatland restoration trust and a neighboring farm cooperative are coordinating work on a season-long bog restoration project. The trust chooses between Block Ditches and Leave Channels, while the cooperative chooses between Raise Weirs and Keep Drains.

s.name: Cosmic Premiere Slots
s.description: A national planetarium network and a major space-media company are each deciding when to place a high-stakes new show in their flagship planetarium slot. The network chooses between Dawn Premiere and Night Premiere, while the company chooses between Dawn Premiere and Night Premiere.

s.name: Dome Season Booking
s.description: A regional planetarium director and a touring astronomy production company are arranging the season's featured show engagement. The planetarium chooses between Prime Weekend and Midweek Run, while the company chooses between Full Dome and Touring Cut.

s.name: Ringing Station Slots
s.description: Two coordinators from nearby bird-ringing teams are arranging access to the station. The first coordinator chooses whether to Book Dawn or Book Midmorning, while the second chooses whether to Join Dawn or Join Midmorning.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: Two coordinators for neighboring avalanche patrols are setting the next day's small roster. Each chooses between a Dawn Roster and a Midday Roster for their patrol team.

s.name: Cider Press Scheduling
s.description: A family orchard cooperative and a regional cidermaker are arranging access to the same cider press for an important harvest season. The cooperative chooses between Peak Booking and Flexible Booking, while the cidermaker chooses between Early Reservation and Last-Minute Booking.

s.name: Ringing Station Booking
s.description: A volunteer bird-ringing team is arranging one day's use of a bird-ringing station and chooses between a Dawn slot and a Midday slot. The station coordinator handles the same booking by choosing either Confirm slot or Reassign slot. Both are coordinating an ordinary station day.

s.name: Championship Ice Rink
s.description: A municipal ice-rink operator and a professional hockey league must coordinate a championship venue. The operator chooses between Full Resurface and Quick Resurface, while the league chooses between Early Booking and Late Booking.

s.name: Clocktower Maintenance
s.description: The town clock committee chooses between Routine Service and Full Overhaul for the clocktower mechanism. The nearby shop association chooses between Open Access and Night Closure while the maintenance is scheduled.

s.name: Peat Plug Adjustment
s.description: A small peat-bog restoration crew is adjusting water-holding plugs in one patch of bog. The crew chooses between Fine Bunding, a close adjustment of the plugs, and Coarse Bunding, a broader adjustment; a nearby landholder chooses between Early Flow, releasing water sooner, and Late Flow, releasing it later.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contracts
s.description: A regional orchard cooperative and a juice processor are arranging a substantial seasonal harvest contract. The cooperative chooses Early Commitment or Spot Sale, while the processor chooses Fixed Purchase or Flexible Purchase.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: Two large saffron producers, A and B, are preparing for the same high-stakes harvest season. Each must choose whether to secure seasonal saffron pickers early or wait and hire closer to the harvest.

s.name: Shared Greenhouse
s.description: Two neighboring gardeners share a small greenhouse heating loop. The first gardener chooses between Steady Heat and Night Setback for one bench, while the second gardener makes the same choice for another bench.

s.name: Shared Cider Press
s.description: North Orchard Cooperative and Valley Orchard Cooperative are arranging their seasonal bookings at the same cider press. Each cooperative must choose between a Peak Slot and an Off-Peak Slot for its pressing schedule.

s.name: Cottage Thatching Rotas
s.description: Two thatching crews are arranging rotas for a run of small cottage repairs. Crew A chooses an Early rota or Late rota, while Crew B chooses a Shared rota or Separate rota for its team.

s.name: Championship Concessions
s.description: A stadium operator and its concession partner must set prices for a sold-out championship final, where the decision has major financial consequences for both parties. The operator chooses Premium Pricing or Fan Pricing, while the concession partner independently chooses Premium Pricing or Fan Pricing.

s.name: Corner-Café Delivery
s.description: A small microbrewery and a nearby café distributor are arranging one ordinary weekly delivery. The brewery chooses between Keg Drop and Can Drop, while the distributor chooses between Morning Route and Afternoon Route.

s.name: Eel Pass Check
s.description: A local river officer and an eel-pass operator coordinate a routine inspection. The officer chooses either Full Inspection or Quick Inspection, while the operator chooses either Open Gate or Hold Gate during the visit.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Tour
s.description: A puppet theatre company planning a season-long tour chooses between Full Tour and Limited Tour. A regional arts festival chooses between Prime Slot and Flexible Slot for hosting the company's production, with both decisions setting the tour's contract and schedule.

s.name: Tidewindow Pilots
s.description: A port authority and a shipping consortium are planning harbour pilot rotations for a heavily loaded fleet during a critical tide window. The authority chooses between Fixed Rotation, assigning pilots in a preset order, and Flexible Rotation, reallocating them as ships arrive. The consortium chooses between Early Dispatch and Staggered Dispatch for sending ships into the harbour.

s.name: Satellite Downlink Scheduling
s.description: Two small-satellite operators are scheduling routine transmissions through available satellite downlink windows. Operator A chooses between Early Window and Late Window, while Operator B chooses between Primary Slot and Backup Slot.

s.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
s.description: Two small ferry operators are adjusting departures on the same local route. Operator A chooses either Early Slot or Late Slot, while Operator B chooses either Morning Slot or Midday Slot.

s.name: Orchard Pollination
s.description: An orchard cooperative is arranging pollination for an important growing season and must choose between Reserve Hives and Expand Hives. A regional beekeeper cooperative is choosing between Standard Contract and Flexible Contract for the same pollination agreement.

s.name: Small Quota Adjustment
s.description: Two neighboring small fishing boats are negotiating a fine adjustment to a shared local fishing quota for the next trip. Boat A chooses Hold Quota or Shift Quota, while Boat B chooses Keep Schedule or Move Schedule to indicate how it handles the adjustment.

s.name: Canal Lock Scheduling
s.description: Two neighboring canal operators are coordinating use of the same lock. The upstream operator chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot, while the downstream operator independently chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot.

s.name: Seasonal Freight Corridor
s.description: A regional freight carrier is planning its seasonal rail schedule, while a port terminal operator is setting its slot policy. The carrier chooses either “Night departures” or “Day departures,” and the operator chooses either “Priority slots” or “Flexible slots” for the same freight corridor.

s.name: Taproom Route
s.description: A small microbrewery is deciding whether to send a modest delivery through its regular route or make a direct drop at a nearby café. The café is deciding whether to give the delivery its standard shelf spot or a rotating feature shelf spot.

s.name: National Puppet Tour
s.description: A touring puppet theatre company, A, is choosing between Full Circuit and Regional Circuit for a high-stakes season. A national venue consortium, B, is choosing between Prime Booking and Flexible Booking as it sets the tour's contract terms.

s.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
s.description: Two major ferry operators are assigning their flagship sailings within a heavily contested timetable. Each operator chooses between the Peak Slot and the Reserve Slot for its service, with the decision affecting access to a strategically vital sailing window.

s.name: Orchard Pollination
s.description: A small orchard grower arranges a pollination contract with a local beekeeper who also serves other farms. The grower chooses between Full Contract and Basic Contract, while the beekeeper chooses between assigning hives to the Orchard Route or an Alternate Route.

s.name: Small Film Release
s.description: A small film distributor and a neighborhood cinema are coordinating the timing of a modest film release. The distributor chooses between an Early Release and a Late Release, while the cinema chooses between a Prime Slot and an Off-Peak slot.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: Two lighthouse keepers are arranging a small relief shift at a coastal light. Keeper A chooses an early or late handoff, while Keeper B chooses whether to keep the lamp steady or make a fine trim during the changeover.

s.name: Radio Telescope Allocation
s.description: Two radio-astronomy teams are seeking a season's allocation on a shared radio telescope. Team A chooses between Long Tracks, which schedules extended observing sessions, and Short Cadence, which schedules many brief sessions; Team B chooses between Quiet Hours, which requests low-interference periods, and Prime Hours, which requests the most sought-after observing periods.

s.name: Urban Beehive Siting
s.description: A neighborhood gardener and a local beekeeper are arranging a small urban beehive siting decision. The gardener chooses Courtyard Edge or Roof Corner, while the beekeeper chooses Morning Access or Evening Access.

s.name: Seasonal Flour Contract
s.description: A regional bakery and a flour mill are arranging a substantial seasonal supply contract. The bakery chooses between Early Order and Late Order, while the mill chooses between Reserve Flour and Spot Flour for the contract.

s.name: Island Ferry Slots
s.description: A regional ferry operator and a nearby island café are coordinating ferry timetable slots. The operator is committing its main service schedule, while the café is adjusting its opening window around the ferry, and each chooses between an early or late slot.

s.name: Almond Pollination Contract
s.description: A regional almond grower and a commercial beekeeper are negotiating a high-stakes pollination contract for the coming bloom. The grower chooses either Full Coverage or Limited Coverage, while the beekeeper chooses either Dedicated Hives or Shared Hives.

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queues
s.description: A small record label is scheduling its next vinyl pressing run and chooses between a Standard Run and a Rush Run. The pressing plant chooses whether to place the job in its Day Queue or Night Queue.

s.name: Seed Packet Timing
s.description: Two neighboring community seed banks are arranging a small exchange of heritage seeds. Bank A chooses whether to send its packet early or late, and Bank B makes the same choice for its packet.

s.name: Coastal Quota Talks
s.description: Bayview Cooperative and Seagrass Cooperative are negotiating how to divide a modest shared fishing quota. Bayview chooses either Flexible Split, adjusting its proposed share during the discussion, or Firm Cap, keeping its proposed share fixed; Seagrass makes the same choice for its side.

s.name: Bakery Supply Orders
s.description: A regional bakery chain must choose between Spot Purchase and Annual Contract for its flour supply. A major mill is choosing between Premium Flour and Budget Flour for the same high-stakes supply arrangement.

s.name: Orchard Falconry
s.description: A small orchard owner and a local falconer are coordinating a brief falconry visit to discourage everyday pests. The owner chooses whether to release the hawk or hold it, while the falconer chooses an early flight or a late flight.

s.name: Seasonal Tap Route
s.description: Cedar Peak Brewery and a regional beverage distributor are deciding how to handle a major seasonal release. The brewery chooses between Direct Delivery and Distributor Contract, while the distributor chooses between Priority Placement and Standard Placement.

s.name: Urban Beehive Siting
s.description: A city planning authority is deciding whether to designate rooftops or courtyards for a major urban beehive installation. A commercial beekeeper is choosing between placing a full colony at the site or splitting the operation across smaller colony units.

s.name: Allotment Falconry
s.description: Two neighboring allotment keepers are arranging small falconry pest-control visits for their plots. Keeper A chooses between Short Flights and Perch Waiting, while Keeper B chooses between Morning Release and Afternoon Release.

s.name: Greenhouse Heat Sharing
s.description: Two neighboring greenhouse operators share a heating network during a financially important cold season. Operator A chooses between Open valve and Close valve, while Operator B chooses between Draw heat and Conserve heat.

s.name: Satellite Downlink Windows
s.description: A university satellite team and a small weather-satellite operator are coordinating routine satellite downlink windows. The satellite team chooses either Direct Pass or Buffered Pass, while the weather-satellite operator chooses either Shared Window or Separate Window.

s.name: Mountain Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain hut manager chooses between Pack Light and Pack Extra for the next resupply load. A local courier chooses between an Early Ascent and a Late Ascent to deliver it.

s.name: Bell Tuning
s.description: A small bell foundry is making a routine adjustment to a new bell casting. The casting lead chooses between Narrow vent and Wide vent, while the finishing lead chooses between Quick cool and Slow cool.

s.name: Critical Lock Shift
s.description: Two senior lock-keepers must decide how to cover an assigned shift during a critical canal water-management window. Each independently chooses either to keep the shift or swap it with a trained relief partner.

s.name: Cheese Cave Ripening
s.description: An affineur and a farmhouse dairy are coordinating the ripening of a season's prized cheese in a shared cave. The affineur chooses either Early Release or Deep Ripening, while the dairy chooses either Open Vents or Sealed Vents.

s.name: Kelp Patch Trimming
s.description: Two neighboring kelp farmers are making a small harvesting adjustment before the next tide. Each chooses between a Light trim and a Full trim for their assigned patch.

s.name: Coastal Quota Talks
s.description: Two neighboring fishing cooperatives are negotiating a modest seasonal quota arrangement. Cooperative A chooses between Flexible Quota and Firm Quota, while Cooperative B chooses between Joint Landing and Separate Landing.

s.name: Orchard Falconry
s.description: A falconer tending a small orchard chooses between Brief Patrol and Thorough Patrol for routine pest control. A neighboring falconer chooses between Open Perch and Covered Perch for where their bird waits between passes.

s.name: Rink Touch-Up
s.description: At a small community ice rink, the rink manager chooses whether the routine resurfacing pass emphasizes the edges or the center. The resurfacing technician chooses between using a light water pass and a fresh water pass.

s.name: Cave-Ripened Batch
s.description: A small cheesemaker and a neighborhood grocer are coordinating a shared batch in a cheese cave. The cheesemaker chooses Early Release or Longer Ripening for the batch, while the grocer chooses Standard Pickup or Delayed Pickup for collection timing.

s.name: Falconry Crop Defense
s.description: A high-value grain estate is arranging falconry pest control and must choose between Full Coverage and Targeted Coverage. A licensed falconry contractor must choose between Solo Flights and Team Flights for the deployment.

s.name: Migration Window Slots
s.description: A national bird observatory and a continental bird-conservation consortium are coordinating scarce bird-ringing station access during a decisive migration window. The observatory chooses between Early Slots and Late Slots, while the consortium chooses between Core Slots and Reserve Slots for its field team.

s.name: Shared Fishing Quota
s.description: Two small fishing cooperatives are negotiating access to a shared seasonal fishing area. Cooperative A chooses either Joint Proposal or Separate Proposal for its quota request, while Cooperative B makes the same choice for its request.

s.name: Indie Film Release
s.description: A small film distributor and a neighborhood cinema are planning the release of an independent movie. The distributor chooses Festival Week or Regular Week, while the cinema chooses Matinee Launch or Evening Launch.

s.name: Peatland Restoration
s.description: A local peatland trust is deciding whether to leave existing drainage ditches open or block them during a small bog-restoration project. A nearby farm cooperative is choosing between arranging field access early or arranging it late around the project.

s.name: Routine Lift Grooming
s.description: A ski-lift grooming supervisor and a lift operator coordinate a small adjustment on an ordinary ski run. The supervisor chooses Standard Pass or Fine-Tune, while the operator chooses Early Run or Late Run for the grooming schedule.

s.name: River Cable Crossing
s.description: A national freight carrier with a major cable-ferry contract chooses between Full Service and Reduced Service for the crossing. A county traffic office responsible for a smaller local route chooses between Peak Dispatch and Off-Peak Dispatch for vehicles using the ferry.

s.name: Apple Harvest Contract
s.description: A small orchard grower and a nearby cider maker are arranging a modest apple-harvest contract. The grower chooses Early Harvest or Late Harvest, while the cider maker chooses Firm Pickup or Flexible Pickup for the contract.

s.name: Dairy Contract
s.description: A regional dairy co-op and a national milk processor are negotiating a high-stakes seasonal supply agreement. The co-op chooses between Premium Price and Base Price, while the processor chooses between Expand Intake and Cap Intake.

s.name: Flour Capacity Deal
s.description: A national bakery chain and a flour mill are arranging a high-volume bakery supply order. The bakery chooses between a Spot Order and a Contract Order, while the mill chooses between Reserved Capacity and Open Allocation.

s.name: Archive Scan Settings
s.description: A small local archive's curator chooses between Gentle Cleanup and Detailed Cleanup for a digitisation batch. The scanning technician chooses between Quick Scan and Careful Scan while preparing the same batch.

s.name: Quarry Trim Windows
s.description: Two small quarry crews, North Bench and South Bench, each schedule a routine trim blast in one of two nearby windows. North Bench chooses Early blast or Late blast, while South Bench makes the same choice for its own work.

s.name: High-Stakes Herbarium Loan
s.description: A national herbarium and a biotech consortium are negotiating access to a rare type specimen central to a major crop-resilience program. The herbarium chooses between Grant Loan and Retain Specimen, while the consortium chooses between Publish Data and Restrict Data.

s.name: Critical Route Contract
s.description: Two major courier firms, A and B, are bidding for a high-stakes route contract whose award and service obligations materially affect both companies. Each firm chooses between a Premium bid, committing more resources to the route, and a Lean bid, offering a lower-cost route plan.

s.name: Flour Delivery Timing
s.description: A small bakery chooses whether to place its flour order early or late. Its nearby mill chooses whether to hold a small reserve or release stock for the bakery's routine order.

s.name: Seasonal Color Run
s.description: A seasonal textile mill manager chooses between Batch Dyeing, which consolidates color work into a single shift, and Staged Dyeing, which spreads it across several shifts. An apparel brand's sourcing director chooses between Early Booking, reserving dyehouse capacity ahead of the season, and Late Booking, placing orders closer to production.

s.name: Shared Quota Adjustment
s.description: Two neighboring small fishing cooperatives are negotiating a fine adjustment to their shared seasonal catch quota. Each cooperative chooses between making a small cut and keeping its current quota.

s.name: Shared Kiln Booking
s.description: Two small sawmills share a local drying kiln for a routine batch of boards. Each operator chooses either an early booking or a late booking for this batch.

s.name: Imperial Portrait Restoration
s.description: Two major restoration houses are bidding for the contract to restore a newly authenticated imperial portrait. Meridian Atelier chooses between a Conservative Bid and a Premium Bid, while Vellum Works chooses between a Basic Bid and a Comprehensive Bid.

s.name: Blockbuster Release Window
s.description: A major film studio is deciding whether to launch its film with a wide opening or use a staggered opening. A global streaming platform is deciding whether to place the film in a holiday slot or an off-peak slot, with the release choice carrying major financial consequences for both parties.

s.name: Canal Shift Swap
s.description: Two lock-keepers overseeing a major canal each face a critical operating shift. Each chooses between keeping the assigned shift and swapping it with the other lock-keeper.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Terms
s.description: A national herbarium and a university herbarium are arranging a specimen loan important to the coming research season and both institutions’ reputations. The national herbarium chooses between Full Loan and Selected Loan, while the university herbarium chooses between Rapid Return and Extended Return.

s.name: Championship Ice Resurfacing
s.description: A championship ice-rink operator must choose between Overnight Cure and Rapid Patch for resurfacing the main rink. The resurfacing contractor must choose between Premium Compound and Standard Compound for the same job.

s.name: Substrate Contract
s.description: A commercial mushroom grower is arranging substrate for an important growing season and must choose between Early Order and Late Order. Its substrate supplier must choose between Reserve Stock and Spot Release for handling that order.

s.name: Bird-Ringing Station Slots
s.description: A local conservation group and a visiting bird survey team are arranging access to a shared bird-ringing station. The conservation group chooses the Dawn Slot or Noon Slot, while the survey team chooses the Weekday Slot or Weekend Slot.

s.name: Small Trail Grooming
s.description: A ski-lift grooming lead chooses either Light Grooming or Fine Grooming for a small trail. The lift attendant chooses either Early Opening or Later Opening for that same trail, coordinating routine adjustments to the morning schedule.

s.name: Canal Shift Swap
s.description: Two lock-keepers on a busy canal must coordinate their assignments for the season’s shipping schedule. Each independently chooses either Keep Shift, meaning retain the assigned watch, or Swap Shift, meaning exchange watch times with the other lock-keeper.

s.name: Courier Route Bids
s.description: Two local courier firms, A and B, are bidding on a recurring neighborhood delivery route. Each firm chooses between a Standard Bid and a Rush Bid for the route.

s.name: Dairy Co-op Pricing
s.description: Two nearby dairy cooperatives are setting prices for next week's ordinary milk deliveries. Each cooperative chooses between Steady Price and Discount Price for its own customers.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A small quarry manager chooses whether to schedule a routine blast in the Morning Window or the Late Window. A neighboring stone hauler chooses whether to make its small pickup run during Morning Deliveries or Late Deliveries.

s.name: Bell Tuning
s.description: A small bell foundry's caster is choosing between Fine Alloy and Standard Alloy for a routine bell. The workshop tuner is choosing between Early Pour and Late Pour to set the casting schedule.

s.name: Ringing Station Schedule
s.description: A university bird-ringing team and a conservation charity are arranging access to the same bird-ringing station. Each organization chooses between the Dawn Slot and the Later Slot for its seasonal ringing session, with the scheduling decision carrying consequences for its field program and reputation.

s.name: Turbine Service Window
s.description: A tidal-energy operator and an offshore servicing consortium are planning a tidal-turbine servicing campaign. The operator chooses Full Overhaul or Minimal Service, while the consortium chooses Shared Window or Exclusive Window for access to the turbines.

s.name: Seasonal Route Bids
s.description: Two regional courier companies are bidding for a demanding seasonal delivery route that could affect their annual reputation and contract portfolio. Northline chooses either Premium Bid or Lean Bid, while SwiftParcel chooses either Premium Bid or Lean Bid, with each option representing the service-price package it submits.

s.name: Morning Lift Grooming
s.description: A ski-area grooming supervisor prepares a small patch beneath one lift and chooses between Fine Groom and Quick Groom. A lift attendant coordinating that lift’s opening check chooses between Early Check and Later Check; the supervisor is responsible for the patch, while the attendant handles only the nearby check.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A small glacier-research team and a regional aviation coordinator are arranging a routine survey flight. The research team chooses between Full Transect and Short Transect, while the coordinator chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot.

s.name: Bakery Supply Orders
s.description: A regional bakery chain with a season-defining production schedule places a flour order with a smaller specialty mill whose annual budget depends on this contract. The bakery chooses between a Large Batch and a Small Batch, while the mill chooses between Priority Dispatch and Routine Dispatch.

s.name: Quarry Blast Scheduling
s.description: A quarry operator and a regional freight authority must coordinate a high-stakes blast near a major transport corridor. The operator chooses a Day Window or Night Window, while the authority chooses Clear Corridor or Hold Corridor.

s.name: Morning Lift Prep
s.description: A ski-lift grooming supervisor chooses between Early Grooming, finishing trail work before dawn, and Late Grooming, completing it closer to opening. A mountain-operations scheduler chooses between Broad Opening, preparing many lifts for service together, and Staggered Opening, bringing lifts online in sequence.

s.name: Salt-Marsh Grazing Rights
s.description: Two neighboring livestock cooperatives share salt-marsh grazing rights for the coming season. Each cooperative chooses between Spring Access, sending its herd onto the marsh earlier, and Deferred Access, holding its herd back for later grazing. Their choices determine how the shared grazing schedule is arranged.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A city traffic office is choosing between an Early Closure and a Late Closure for roads along a marathon route. A nearby delivery cooperative is choosing between Morning Dispatch and Afternoon Dispatch while scheduling its local deliveries around the race.

s.name: Harvest Falconry Plans
s.description: A vineyard manager and a neighboring orchard manager each choose a falconry pest-control plan for the coming harvest season. The vineyard manager chooses between Release Falcons and Hold Falcons, while the orchard manager chooses between Shared Patrol and Solo Patrol.

s.name: Ringing Station Slots
s.description: Two volunteer bird-ringing teams, A and B, are coordinating use of a local ringing station. Team A chooses either the Dawn slot or the Later slot, while Team B chooses either the Net circuit or the Single net arrangement.

s.name: High-Stakes Herbarium Loan
s.description: A national herbarium is deciding how to handle a request to loan a rare plant specimen to a pharmaceutical consortium whose research could affect a major crop. The herbarium chooses Rapid Loan or Archive Hold, while the consortium chooses Fund Safeguards or Withhold Support.

s.name: Bell Commission
s.description: A bell foundry and a cathedral restoration committee are negotiating a major bell commission. The foundry chooses between Traditional Alloy and Rapid Pour, while the committee chooses between Full Specification and Flexible Specification.

s.name: Stadium Snack Pricing
s.description: At a small stadium, two neighboring concession stands each set the price posture for a routine game. Stand A chooses Regular Price or Small Discount, while Stand B chooses Regular Price or Small Discount for a comparable snack.

s.name: Urban Hive Network
s.description: The city apiary authority is choosing whether to place a citywide beehive network on Civic Rooftops or Railway Lots. A commercial beekeepers' cooperative is choosing between a Dense Cluster and Scattered Hives layout for that network.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Handling
s.description: A small herbarium is preparing a routine specimen loan for a neighboring botanical archive. The herbarium chooses between Tight Packing and Loose Packing, while the archive chooses between Quick Review and Detailed Review.

s.name: Small Cinema Release
s.description: A small film distributor and a neighborhood cinema are coordinating a film's release timing. The distributor chooses between “Early release” and “Later release,” while the cinema chooses between “Weekday slot” and “Weekend slot.”

s.name: Sawmill Kiln Booking
s.description: A sawmill manager and an independent kiln operator are arranging a seasonal kiln booking. The sawmill manager chooses between Early Booking and Flexible Booking, while the kiln operator chooses between Peak Slot and Off-Peak Slot.

s.name: Storm-Day Lift Grooming
s.description: After a major storm, a mountain resort and its lift-operations contractor face a high-stakes ski-day decision. The resort chooses between Full Grooming and Minimal Grooming, while the contractor chooses between Early Opening and Delayed Opening for the lifts.

s.name: Ice Rink Resurfacing
s.description: An arena operations manager is deciding between a Full Resurface and a Quick Resurface before an important hockey game. A league scheduler is deciding between an Early Faceoff and a Late Faceoff for the same event.

s.name: Canal Shift Swap
s.description: A canal lock-keeper whose weekly rota is difficult to rearrange is arranging a shift swap with a nearby lock-keeper who has more flexibility. The first chooses between Take early shift and Keep late shift, while the second chooses between Swap promptly and Wait for confirmation.

s.name: Sawmill Kiln Booking
s.description: A large sawmill is arranging kiln access for a valuable timber shipment and must choose between Early Booking and Flexible Booking. The kiln operator must choose between Reserve Capacity and Open Capacity for that booking period.

s.name: Mushroom Substrate Supply
s.description: A small gourmet mushroom grower is arranging its next substrate order with a local substrate supplier. The grower chooses Fresh Batch or Stored Batch, while the supplier chooses Priority Delivery or Standard Delivery.

s.name: Seasonal Milk Pricing
s.description: A dairy cooperative and a supermarket chain are setting their pricing plans for the coming milk season. The cooperative chooses between Stable Contract and Discount Push, while the supermarket chain chooses between Premium Shelf and Promotion Drive.

s.name: Summit Lift Grooming
s.description: A ski resort’s operations manager and its grooming contractor are coordinating preparation for a high-profile lift corridor that matters to the season’s budget and reputation. The manager chooses Full Grooming or Selective Grooming, while the contractor chooses Early Crew or Late Crew for the grooming schedule.

s.name: Offshore Wind Maintenance
s.description: A national grid operator and a wind-farm owner are coordinating a major offshore wind farm during a critical maintenance window. The grid operator chooses between Dispatch Now and Hold Dispatch, while the owner chooses between Full Overhaul and Minimal Service.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: The north-slope avalanche patrol coordinator and the neighboring south-slope coordinator each set a day's roster. The first chooses either Dawn Sweep or Midday Sweep for its team, while the second chooses either Ridge Sweep or Valley Sweep for its team.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Tour
s.description: A touring puppet theatre company and a regional arts festival are arranging an engagement for the coming season. The theatre chooses between Full Cast and Lean Cast, while the festival chooses between Prime Slot and Late Slot for the performances.

s.name: Orbital Downlink Scheduling
s.description: A satellite mission's operations team must choose between Early Downlink and Late Downlink for a valuable pass. The ground-station operator must choose between Reserved Window and Shared Window for that same pass.

s.name: Harvest Lock Timetable
s.description: An upstream grain cooperative and a regional canal authority must schedule a heavily used lock before the harvest shipping season. The cooperative chooses Early Convoy or Late Convoy, while the authority chooses Priority Slot or Regular Slot for the lock timetable.

s.name: Bell Rim Tuning
s.description: A small bell foundry is making a routine fine adjustment to one bell. The caster chooses between Narrow gate and Broad gate for the pour, while the finisher chooses between Light filing and Firm filing for the rim.

s.name: Peat Bog Restoration
s.description: A regional conservation trust is planning a peat bog restoration project and must choose between Rapid Rewetting and Phased Rewetting. A specialist restoration contractor must choose between Block Ditches and Build Sluices for carrying out the work.

s.name: River Lifeline
s.description: A cable-ferry operator serving a flooded river chooses between the Flood Window and the Later Tide for a crossing. A regional emergency coordinator chooses whether to send an Ambulance Convoy or a Fuel Convoy across the cable ferry.

s.name: Lock-Keeper Shift Swaps
s.description: Two neighboring canal lock-keepers, Mira and Leon, are arranging one day's roster. Mira chooses Keep Shift or Swap Shift, and Leon makes the same choice; Keep Shift means staying on the assigned shift, while Swap Shift means requesting an exchange with the other keeper.

s.name: Mountain Hut Resupply

s.description: A marathon organizer is deciding between Full Closure and Staged Closure for a major race route. The city transit authority is deciding between Early Detour and Late Detour while coordinating service around that route. These are the two scheduling decisions for the event.

s.name: Pocket Garden Hive
s.description: A pocket-garden coordinator and a nearby beekeeper are making a small decision about where and when to accommodate an urban beehive. The coordinator chooses Garden Edge or Roof Corner, while the beekeeper chooses Morning Visits or Evening Visits.

s.name: Stadium Concessions
s.description: The stadium's main concession operator and a prominent in-stadium rival are setting prices for the season's concessions. Each chooses between Premium Pricing and Value Pricing for its stands.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A regional bat-monitoring team and a wind-farm operator coordinate a season of bat survey nights. The team chooses between Early Survey and Late Survey, while the operator chooses between Full Access and Restricted Access for each night. Together, these choices establish the field protocol for the surveys.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A city marathon organizer, responsible for the race route, chooses between Full Closure and Partial Closure. A neighborhood bus operator handling a limited local route chooses between Early Reroute and Normal Routing.

s.name: Kelp Harvest Timing
s.description: Two kelp-farm operators must decide how to time a high-stakes harvest from adjoining beds during the same season. Each chooses between Early Harvest and Late Harvest.

s.name: Bell Commission Scheduling
s.description: A bell foundry is arranging a major commission whose timing will affect its season, budget, and reputation. The foundry chooses between Expedited Casting and Scheduled Casting, while the commissioning cathedral consortium chooses between Single Delivery and Phased Delivery.

s.name: Flagship Beer Launch
s.description: A microbrewery and a major distributor are negotiating a high-stakes launch for the brewery’s flagship beer. The brewery chooses between Limited Release and Full Rollout, while the distributor chooses between Exclusive Launch and Shared Launch.

s.name: Harvest Contract
s.description: A national coffee roastery and a major coffee-growing cooperative are negotiating a high-stakes sourcing arrangement for the next harvest. The roastery chooses between Long Contract and Spot Buying, while the cooperative chooses between Premium Lots and Volume Lots.

s.name: Triage Shift Balance
s.description: Two neighboring hospital units each have a charge nurse deciding how to make a small adjustment to triage staffing for one shift. Each nurse chooses either Keep Roster or Shift Float coverage.

s.name: Indie Film Scheduling
s.description: A small film distributor and a neighborhood cinema are coordinating the release timing for an upcoming movie. The distributor chooses Weekend Release or Midweek Release, while the cinema chooses Prime Slot or Off-Peak Slot.

s.name: Shared Kiln Commission
s.description: A tile studio and a pottery studio share a kiln while preparing a seasonal commission. Each studio chooses between Rapid Firing and Gentle Firing for its pieces.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A conservation consultancy and a protected-area manager are planning a season of bat survey nights. The consultancy chooses between Full Transect and Short Transect, while the manager chooses between Open Roost and Delayed Roost access.

s.name: Commemorative Letterpress Run
s.description: A major publisher and an independent letterpress printer are coordinating a high-stakes commemorative print run. The publisher chooses between Release Plates and Revise Plates, while the printer chooses between Run Edition and Hold Press.

s.name: Antique Restoration Bids
s.description: An antique restoration studio is preparing a bid for a museum curator's substantial restoration project, choosing between Conservative Bid and Ambitious Bid. The curator is choosing between Quick Award and Extended Review for handling the submitted bid.

s.name: Library Acquisitions
s.description: A community library's acquisitions manager is choosing whether to order a widely requested core title or a specialized niche title. The publisher's representative is choosing between offering the regular list price or a bundle offer for the library's order.

s.name: Shared Dome Session
s.description: A graduate observer and a visiting astronomy club are arranging shared observatory dome time for an evening session. The graduate observer chooses between an early slot and a late slot, while the club chooses between a narrow-field setup and a wide-field setup.

s.name: Wool Scouring Capacity
s.description: A regional wool growers' cooperative is arranging scouring capacity for the coming shearing season, while a commercial scouring mill is setting its booking policy. The cooperative chooses between Reserve Capacity and Spot Capacity, and the mill chooses between Early Booking and Late Booking.

s.name: Seasonal Rope Ferry
s.description: A rope-ferry operator chooses between Full crew and Lean crew for the coming season. A river authority chooses between Peak schedule and Steady schedule for the service plan, with the decision carrying significant seasonal budget and reputation stakes.

s.name: Migration Slot Exchange
s.description: The managers of Northbank and Reedmere bird-ringing stations are arranging access to valuable migration-season ringing slots. Northbank chooses between the Early Slot and Late Slot, while Reedmere chooses between the Dawn Block and Dusk Block.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: Two neighboring lighthouse stations are managed by seasonal relief coordinators planning the coming changeover. Each coordinator chooses between Early relief and Late relief for the shift schedule.

s.name: Seasonal Weir Repairs
s.description: A regional water authority and a downstream farming cooperative must coordinate a weir maintenance window before the irrigation season. The authority chooses either Early closure or Late closure, while the cooperative chooses either Reroute water or Keep channels.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: One glacier survey pilot chooses between a Close pass and a Wide pass for a routine flight, while a second survey pilot chooses between an Early pass and a Late pass. These are the flight-path and timing options available during the same small survey window.

s.name: Local Keg Delivery
s.description: A small microbrewery chooses between a Short Run and a Full Run for its next local keg delivery. A neighborhood distributor chooses between a Shared Route and a Solo Route for handling that delivery.

s.name: Mushroom Substrate Supply
s.description: A small mushroom grower and a nearby substrate supplier coordinate a routine substrate order. The grower chooses Early Order, meaning a request before the growing cycle, or Spot Order, meaning a request when needed. The supplier chooses Reserve Batch, meaning holding substrate for the grower, or Release Batch, meaning offering it through ordinary sales.

s.name: Branch Shelf Refresh
s.description: A branch librarian and a neighborhood bookseller are arranging a modest refresh of the branch's shelves. The librarian chooses between Core titles and Niche titles, while the bookseller chooses between Small order and Quick order for the books being discussed.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: Two caretakers of a small orchard are arranging its overnight frost watch. The first caretaker chooses when to begin checking the trees, while the second chooses whether the shared alert should use a low or high frost threshold.

s.name: Almond Bloom Contract
s.description: A national almond cooperative and a commercial apiary are signing a high-stakes pollination contract for the bloom season. The cooperative chooses between Full Coverage and Limited Coverage, while the apiary chooses between Dedicated Hives and Flexible Allocation.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: An orchard manager and a local weather-service coordinator are preparing a high-value fruit season for overnight frost. The manager chooses between Deploy heaters and Cover rows, while the coordinator chooses between Night patrol and Remote alerts.

s.name: Small Library Order
s.description: A neighborhood library's acquisitions librarian chooses between Add Title, putting a modestly requested book into the next order, and Hold Title, leaving it for a later review. A nearby branch coordinator chooses between Standard Order, using the usual delivery arrangement, and Adjusted Order, making a small change to that arrangement.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: A regional avalanche office and a major ski resort must coordinate their rosters during a dangerous storm cycle. The avalanche office chooses Full Patrol or Lean Patrol, while the resort chooses Open Terrain or Close Terrain.

s.name: Seasonal Cheese Cave
s.description: An affineur and a cheese-cave owner are responsible for a seasonal batch of wheels in a working ripening cave. The affineur chooses Slow Ripening or Fast Ripening, while the cave owner chooses Open Vents or Seal Cave for that batch.

s.name: Allotment Falcon Flights
s.description: Two neighboring allotment growers arrange falconry flights to control pests around their plots. Each grower chooses between a Morning Release and an Evening Release for their trained falcon.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A quarry operator and a nearby road manager coordinate a daily quarry blasting window. The quarry operator chooses Early window or Late window, while the road manager chooses Clear road or Hold traffic.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A specialist masonry contractor and a regional heritage trust are making decisions about a major stone wall repair project. The contractor chooses between Full Rebuild and Targeted Repair, while the trust chooses between Premium Contract and Lean Contract for the work.

s.name: Brewery Distribution Plan
s.description: A regional microbrewery and its distribution partner are setting a route-to-market plan for the coming season. The brewery chooses between Regional Rollout and Taproom Focus, while the distributor chooses between Priority Placement and Standard Placement.

s.name: Letterpress Card Order
s.description: A small letterpress printer is coordinating a seasonal card order with a neighborhood stationery shop. The printer chooses between a Rush run and an Extended run, while the shop chooses between a Feature cards promotion and a Quiet listing.

s.name: Seasonal Flour Orders
s.description: A regional bakery is preparing its flour orders for a high-stakes baking season and must choose between a Routine Order and a Reserve Order. Its flour mill must choose between Priority Supply and Flexible Supply for serving that bakery.

s.name: Seasonal Hedge Contract
s.description: A rural estate manager and a hedge-laying contractor are setting a substantial seasonal contract. The estate manager chooses Full Scope or Reduced Scope for the work, while the contractor chooses Fixed Price or Review Price for the contract.

s.name: Triage Shift Handoff
s.description: At a small hospital’s evening triage desk, the charge nurse for intake and the charge nurse for observation coordinate a minor staffing adjustment. The intake nurse chooses Standard roster or Flex roster for the desk, while the observation nurse chooses Early float or Late float for when a cross-trained aide joins triage.

s.name: Letterpress Run
s.description: A neighborhood print shop and a small publisher are arranging a letterpress edition together. The print shop chooses between Full Run and Short Run, while the publisher chooses between Premium Stock and Standard Stock.

s.name: Dome Calibration
s.description: A visiting astronomer and the observatory dome operator share a small observing session. The astronomer chooses between Fine focus and Broad scan, while the operator chooses between Early slew and Late slew.

s.name: Rope Ferry Staffing
s.description: A rope-ferry operator chooses between staffing the crossing with a Full Crew or a Lean Crew. A dock attendant chooses between taking the Early Shift or the Late Shift to coordinate the ferry service.

s.name: Kiln Season
s.description: A lumber sawmill and a commercial kiln operator are arranging a season's drying schedule. The sawmill chooses between Early Booking and Flexible Booking, while the kiln operator chooses between Reserved Slot and Spot Scheduling.

s.name: Turbine Maintenance
s.description: A wind-farm operator schedules either Routine servicing or Full overhaul for a high-value turbine fleet. The maintenance contractor assigns either a Rapid crew or a Staged crew to carry out the season’s work.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotation
s.description: Two harbour pilots are arranging their rotation for an ordinary shift. Pilot A chooses either Early Handover or Late Handover, while Pilot B chooses either Early Relief or Late Relief.

s.name: Shared Quota Talks
s.description: Two major fishing cooperatives are negotiating access to a shared fishing ground whose quota decision will shape their seasons. Blue Current Cooperative chooses between Strict Quota and Flexible Quota, while Deepwater Cooperative chooses between Accept Terms and Seek Revision.

s.name: Urban Beehive Siting
s.description: A city housing authority chooses between Central Roof and Perimeter Roof for a major urban beehive zone. A commercial beekeeper chooses between Concentrated Hives and Spread Hives for the same project.

s.name: Blockbuster Release Window
s.description: Two major film studios are planning competing blockbuster releases, with the timing decisions carrying enormous financial stakes. Studio A chooses between a Summer Premiere and a Winter Premiere, while Studio B independently chooses between a Summer Premiere and a Winter Premiere.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A quarry operator and a rail consortium must coordinate a high-stakes quarry blasting schedule. The quarry operator chooses between Early window and Late window, while the rail consortium chooses between Clear track and Run trains.

s.name: Neighborhood Marathon Crossing
s.description: A municipal marathon coordinator chooses between Early closure and Late closure for a small residential crossing. A nearby shop manager, responsible for one storefront rather than the wider route, chooses between Detour notice and Standard notice.

s.name: Canal Lock Scheduling
s.description: A grain-export consortium and a container carrier must coordinate use of a major canal lock during a high-stakes seasonal delivery window. The consortium chooses either Priority Passage or Staggered Passage, while the carrier chooses either Reserve Window or Open Window for its lock schedule.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contracts
s.description: A national juice processor and an orchard cooperative are negotiating a high-stakes harvest contract. The processor chooses Fixed Contract or Spot Contract, while the cooperative chooses Early Harvest or Late Harvest for the season.

s.name: Puppet Tour Engagement
s.description: A touring puppet theatre company and a national arts presenter are planning a high-stakes season. The company chooses between Full Circuit and Local Run, while the presenter chooses between Prime Residency and Offseason Residency.

s.name: Bakery Flour Restock
s.description: A neighborhood bakery is coordinating a routine flour restock with its nearby supplier. The bakery chooses between Usual Batch and Small Top-Up, while the supplier chooses between First Route and Second Route.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: A tidal-energy utility and a marine service contractor are coordinating a major offshore turbine servicing campaign. The utility chooses between Full Overhaul and Limited Service, while the contractor chooses between Large Crew and Small Crew.

s.name: Alpine Morning Plan
s.description: A ski resort's grooming manager chooses between Night Grooming and Dawn Grooming for a major run, while its lift-operations director chooses between Early Opening and Delayed Opening for the same morning. Their decisions concern how an important weekend will be prepared and launched.

s.name: Charcoal Burn Scheduling
s.description: Two major charcoal producers, A and B, are scheduling kiln runs for a high-stakes regional charcoal supply contract. Each producer chooses between Early Burn and Late Burn for its production schedule.

s.name: Peat Bog Fine-Tuning
s.description: At a small peat bog restoration plot, a volunteer crew chooses whether to Trim hummocks or Leave hummocks as a fine surface adjustment. A neighboring caretaker chooses whether to Nudge sluice or Hold sluice as a small water-level adjustment.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease Planning
s.description: A small oyster grower is deciding whether to renew a current bed lease or shift to another plot. The local oyster cooperative is choosing between shared access terms and separate access terms for the leased beds.

s.name: Planetarium Show Slots
s.description: A small planetarium's scheduler chooses between an Early Start and a Late Start for an evening show. The visiting presenter chooses between a Short Gap and a Long Gap for the changeover before the presentation.

s.name: Bird-Ringing Schedule
s.description: Two regional bird-ringing station coordinators are arranging their teams' use of a shared season of station slots. Each coordinator chooses between Early Slots and Late Slots for the station's fieldwork schedule, with the decision carrying meaningful consequences for the season's budget and reputation.

s.name: Urban Beehive Siting
s.description: A city planning office chooses between Rooftop Apiary and Ground Apiary for a citywide beehive program. A beekeepers’ cooperative chooses between Central Cluster and Distributed Cluster for arranging the colonies. Together, they are setting the plan for a high-stakes urban pollination network.

s.name: Eel Pass Review
s.description: A river authority and a hydroelectric operator are making a seasonal decision about an eel pass. The authority chooses Thorough Inspection or Quick Inspection, while the operator chooses Schedule Passage or Hold Passage.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: A tidal-energy operator is deciding whether to schedule turbine work early in the season or defer it, while a marine servicing contractor chooses between sending a full crew or a lean crew. Their choices shape the season’s maintenance budget and the operator’s reliability reputation.

s.name: Dyeing Shift Coordination
s.description: A large textile mill and a global clothing brand are coordinating a high-volume dyeing contract. The mill chooses between the Early Shift and Late Shift for its dye vats, while the brand chooses between Morning Pickup and Evening Pickup for receiving the finished fabric.

s.name: Eel Pass Check
s.description: A streamkeeper and a county ecology officer coordinate a small inspection of an eel pass. The streamkeeper chooses between Routine Check and Close Check, while the officer chooses between Morning Visit and Later Visit.

s.name: Weekday Release Slots
s.description: Two small independent film distributors are arranging weekday releases at the same neighborhood cinema. Each chooses between an early weekday screening and a later weekday screening for its film.

s.name: Salt Marsh Grazing Rights
s.description: Two neighboring livestock cooperatives are arranging access to a valuable salt marsh for the coming grazing season. Cooperative A chooses between Early Grazing and Deferred Grazing, while Cooperative B chooses between Shared Access and Reserved Access.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: The upstream millpond keeper chooses between Early Release and Late Release for a routine sluice adjustment. The downstream millpond keeper chooses between Early Intake and Late Intake to coordinate the pond’s water flow.

s.name: Cranberry Bog Flooding
s.description: A cranberry grower chooses between Early Flood and Delayed Flood for a commercial bog. A neighboring water-district manager chooses between Release Water and Hold Water during the same season’s flood-management planning.

s.name: Neighboring Cranberry Bogs
s.description: Two neighboring cranberry growers are making a fine adjustment to flooding in their small bogs. Grower A chooses between Light Flood and Full Flood, while Grower B chooses between Early Flood and Late Flood.

s.name: Port Dredging Windows
s.description: A port authority chooses whether to schedule a major channel-dredging project in the spring window or the autumn window. A dredging consortium independently chooses which window to commit its equipment and crews to.

s.name: Cheese Cave Ripening
s.description: A cheesemaker chooses between Turn cheeses and Leave cheeses for a small batch in a cheese cave. A cave manager chooses between Open vent and Keep vent during the same fine ripening adjustment.

s.name: Bakery Supply Orders
s.description: A national bakery company is arranging a high-stakes flour order with a regional milling cooperative before a major production cycle. The bakery chooses between Rush Order and Planned Order, while the cooperative chooses between Reserve Capacity and Spot Supply.

s.name: Archive Digitisation
s.description: A national archive and a major preservation foundation are coordinating the digitisation of an irreplaceable historical collection. The archive chooses between Full Scan and Selective Scan, while the foundation chooses between Open Release and Restricted Release for the digital collection.

s.name: Seasonal Milk Pricing
s.description: A dairy cooperative and a regional milk processor are negotiating pricing terms for the coming season. The co-op chooses Premium price or Volume price, while the processor chooses Premium contract or Discount contract.

s.name: Reindeer Route Planning
s.description: Two nearby reindeer herders are planning routes for a routine seasonal move. Herder A chooses between Ridge Trail and Valley Trail, while Herder B chooses between Lakeside Trail and Birch Trail.

s.name: Bog Water Plan
s.description: A volunteer peatland crew chooses between installing Peat Dams and adding Sphagnum Planting to a small restoration plot. A nearby landholder chooses between Hold Water and Release Water for the plot's shared drainage channel.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring dairy farms, Farm A and Farm B, are planning their shared silage clamp for the coming season. Farm A chooses between Early Filling, loading its silage at the start of harvest, and Staged Filling, loading it in later batches; Farm B chooses between Reserved Space, setting aside a fixed portion before harvest, and Flexible Space, adjusting its portion during harvest.

s.name: Marathon Road Timing
s.description: A neighborhood marathon organizer and a city traffic coordinator are arranging a small stretch of marathon road closure. The organizer chooses between Early Closure and Late Closure, while the coordinator chooses between Advance Signs and Corner Signs.

s.name: Coffee Bean Contract
s.description: A neighborhood coffee roastery and a small café are arranging a weekly bean-sourcing contract. The roastery chooses between Direct Trade and Broker Lot, while the café chooses between Local Blend and Imported Blend.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations
s.description: A harbour pilot association and a major shipping line are planning pilot rotations for the coming busy season. The association chooses between Early Rotation and Late Rotation, while the shipping line chooses between Joint Roster and Separate Roster.

s.name: Archive Digitisation Contract
s.description: A university archive director is choosing how to commit the season’s digitisation budget: Batch Scanning or Pilot Scanning. A preservation contractor is choosing whether to promise Rapid Delivery or schedule a Quality Review process for the archive’s collections.

s.name: Bird-Ringing Slots
s.description: At a small bird-ringing station, Team A chooses between the Dawn Slot and the Late Slot, while Team B chooses between the Reed Hide and the Meadow Hide. Their choices represent which station slot each team books for its routine ringing session.

s.name: Seasonal Letterpress Edition
s.description: A small art publisher is preparing a high-stakes seasonal letterpress edition and must choose between Rush Printing and Proof First. Its letterpress printer must choose between Premium Stock and Economy Stock for the run.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A saffron cooperative is choosing between Early Crews, which assembles harvest labour at the start of the picking season, and Staggered Crews, which schedules labour in successive waves. A seasonal labour contractor is choosing between Reserve Workers, which holds workers available for the harvest, and Flexible Roster, which reallocates workers as scheduling needs change.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: Two commercial orchard operators face a severe overnight frost watch with major harvest stakes. Operator A chooses between Run Heaters and Cover Rows, while Operator B chooses between Share Crews and Hold Crews.

s.name: Mirror Fine-Tuning
s.description: A small observatory’s optician and recoating technician are preparing one telescope mirror. The optician chooses between Light Polish and Full Recoat, while the technician chooses between Thin Layer and Thick Layer for the recoating adjustment.

s.name: Orchard Hawk Patrol
s.description: An orchard manager and a local falconer coordinate a routine falconry visit for pest control. The manager chooses whether to open the orchard roost, while the falconer chooses whether to fly a circuit over the orchard or skip the circuit.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A quarry manager chooses an Early window or Late window for a routine blast. A nearby road coordinator chooses Open traffic or Reroute traffic during that period.

s.name: Cable Ferry Crossing
s.description: A cable-ferry operator and an approaching driver must decide how to handle a routine crossing. The operator chooses between “Hold Position” and “Release Cable,” while the driver chooses between “Board Now” and “Wait Ashore.”

s.name: Turbine Fine-Tuning
s.description: At a small wind farm, the maintenance technician chooses between Fine Tune and Leave Settings for a turbine. The site scheduler chooses between Short Check and Routine Check for the same maintenance visit.

s.name: Planetarium Premiere Slots
s.description: A national space agency and an international planetarium consortium each control a flagship show in a planetarium season with consequences for their public reach and future funding. The agency chooses either Friday Premiere or Sunday Premiere, while the consortium chooses either Friday Premiere or Sunday Premiere.

s.name: Corridor Scheduling
s.description: A national freight railroad chooses between Peak Priority and Steady Dispatch for assigning locomotives and crews across a congested corridor. A national rail-network coordinator chooses between Slot Protection and Flexible Slots for allocating scarce track windows, with both decisions shaping the corridor's high-stakes schedule.

s.name: Osier Bed Contract
s.description: An osier grower and a basketmaker's cooperative are arranging the season's osier-bed cutting. The grower chooses Early cutting or Late cutting, while the cooperative chooses Firm contract or Flexible contract.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A heritage trust and a masonry contractor are preparing a season-critical repair of a long stone boundary wall. The trust chooses between Strict scope and Flexible scope for the work brief, while the contractor chooses between Detailed bid and Lean bid for its proposal.

s.name: Saffron Picking Shift
s.description: A small saffron grower and a nearby harvest coordinator are arranging one day's picking work. The grower chooses between Careful Picking and Quick Picking, while the coordinator chooses between Morning Crew and Afternoon Crew.

s.name: Stone Wall Bids
s.description: Two local stone masons, Mason A and Mason B, are bidding to repair the same small stone wall. Each independently chooses between a Lean Estimate, with minimal contingency in the bid, and a Detailed Estimate, with more preparation and contingency included.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: During an overnight frost watch, orchard manager A chooses between Run Heaters and Hold Heaters, while orchard manager B chooses between Send Crews and Reserve Crews. Their decisions set the operating plan for a commercially important orchard season.

s.name: Local Beer Placement
s.description: A neighborhood microbrewery is deciding how to distribute a weekly batch, while a local bottle-shop chain chooses how to list the beer. The brewery can use Direct Delivery or Distributor Route, and the chain can choose Shelf Feature or Standard Listing.

s.name: Cable Ferry Crossing
s.description: At a small cable ferry, the ferry operator chooses between Keep Cable Taut and Ease Cable while a waiting motorist chooses between Join Queue and Wait Ashore. Their choices describe how this everyday crossing is managed.

s.name: Archive Digitisation Pact
s.description: A national archive and a preservation consortium are negotiating the digitisation of a nationally significant collection. The archive must choose between Full Scan and Selective Scan, while the consortium chooses between Open License and Restricted License for the resulting digital collection.

s.name: Hedge-Laying Terms
s.description: A small estate steward and a local hedge layer are setting terms for a minor hedge-laying contract. The steward chooses Early laying or Late laying for the work window, and the hedge layer chooses Full weave or Light weave for how tightly the hedge is woven.

s.name: Canal Lock Coordination
s.description: Two regional freight operators share a canal lock during a season when reliable scheduling matters to their contracted deliveries and reputations. The first operator chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot, while the second chooses between Batch Passage and Staggered Passage for arranging its vessels.

s.name: Shared Greenhouse Heat
s.description: Mira, who runs one greenhouse, and Leon, who runs a neighboring greenhouse, share a small district-heating loop. For the morning cycle, each chooses between Full draw and Conserve heat.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring dairy farmers are arranging how to share a silage clamp for the next filling. Farmer A chooses between Compact First and Fill Quickly, while Farmer B chooses between Reserve Space and Fill Quickly.

s.name: Puppet Tour Deal
s.description: A puppet theatre company and a major arts festival are arranging a tour. The company chooses between Full Production and Lean Production, while the festival chooses between Prime Slot and Off-Season Slot.

s.name: Rare Collection Acquisition
s.description: A national library and a major university consortium are negotiating the acquisition of a rare collection with consequences for both institutions. The library chooses between Immediate Purchase and Joint License, while the consortium chooses between Open Bid and Coordinated Bid.

s.name: Winter Hive Siting
s.description: Two neighboring beekeepers are arranging their hives for winter in a small apiary. Beekeeper A chooses between “Sunny edge” and “Windbreak side,” while Beekeeper B chooses between “Dry corner” and “Sheltered nook” for the position of their hive.

s.name: Garden Wall Repair
s.description: A homeowner and a local mason are discussing a small repair to a garden stone wall. The homeowner chooses either Narrow patch or Full patch, while the mason chooses either Firm bid or Flexible bid.

s.name: Shared Lift Grooming
s.description: Two rival ski resorts coordinate grooming for a major shared ski-lift route, with each resort's decision carrying serious consequences for its winter operation. Resort A chooses between "Overnight Grooming" and "Deferred Grooming," while Resort B independently chooses between "Overnight Grooming" and "Deferred Grooming."

s.name: Cider Press Bookings
s.description: Two nearby orchard owners are arranging bookings at the same small cider press. Each chooses either an early slot or a late slot for their pressing appointment.

s.name: Coppice Cutting Cycles
s.description: Two regional woodland cooperatives manage adjoining coppice forests. Each chooses between a Short Cycle and a Long Cycle for its cutting schedule.

s.name: Planetarium Show Slots
s.description: A planetarium programming coordinator and a visiting astronomy club organizer are arranging an evening show. The coordinator chooses between Prime Slot and Late Slot, while the organizer chooses between Publicity Push and Quiet Listing for the event.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A regional glacier survey team and a local aviation cooperative are planning one routine survey flight. The survey team chooses Early Flight or Late Flight, while the aviation cooperative chooses Shared Route or Separate Route.

s.name: North Shoal Quota Talks
s.description: The North Shoal Cooperative and the South Shoal Cooperative are negotiating a seasonal fishing quota, with the agreement carrying major consequences for both communities. North Shoal chooses between a Flexible quota and a Firm quota, while South Shoal chooses between a Shared package and a Separate package.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: Two neighboring beekeepers are making a fine adjustment to where their small hives will sit for winter. Beekeeper A and Beekeeper B each choose between the windbreak side and the sunny wall of the shared apiary.

s.name: Seasonal Letterpress Run
s.description: A heritage publisher and a contract letterpress studio are coordinating a substantial seasonal print run. The publisher chooses Full Edition or Short Edition for the order, while the studio chooses Overtime Run or Regular Run for production.

s.name: Surge Triage Staffing
s.description: A hospital emergency-department leadership team chooses between Expanded Triage and Standard Triage for a demanding seasonal period. The hospital’s ward-management team chooses between Add Ward Staff and Hold Ward Staff while coordinating the same triage plan.

s.name: Coppice Rotation Plans
s.description: A community woodland manager and a regional biomass buyer are planning the next coppice harvest cycle. The woodland manager chooses Short Cycle or Long Cycle, while the buyer chooses Rapid Intake or Deferred Intake for its purchasing schedule.

s.name: Neighborhood Route Bids
s.description: Two local courier companies are submitting bids for a recurring neighborhood delivery route. Each company chooses between a Base Bid, which covers the route on its regular schedule, and a Flex Bid, which includes adjustable pickup timing.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A regional bat-monitoring team chooses between an Early Survey and a Late Survey for a crucial season of fieldwork. The roost site's operating trust chooses between Open Access and Limited Access for the same survey night, with the decisions affecting its budget and reputation.

s.name: Rope Ferry Shift
s.description: A ferryman and a dock assistant are covering a small rope ferry for a quiet crossing. The ferryman chooses between “Steady Pull” and “Light Pull,” while the assistant chooses between “Rope Watch” and “Landing Watch” for the shift.

s.name: Urban Apiary Siting
s.description: A city council and a commercial beekeeping cooperative are making a high-stakes decision about where and how a major urban apiary will operate. The council chooses Rooftop Lease or Park Parcel, while the cooperative chooses Dense Hives or Spread Hives.

s.name: Canal Lock Shift Swap
s.description: At a small canal lock, the regular keeper, who fits this duty around a fixed second job, and an occasional relief keeper arrange one shift swap. The regular keeper chooses Keep roster or Swap shift; the relief keeper chooses Take swap or Keep shift.

s.name: Seasonal Milk Contract
s.description: A dairy co-op and a supermarket chain are setting terms for a seasonal milk contract. The co-op chooses Premium Price or Volume Price, while the supermarket chooses High Markup or Low Markup for the same contract.

s.name: Small Print Run
s.description: A local letterpress printer chooses between Fine Adjustment and Quick Setup for a small print run. A nearby shop chooses between Morning Delivery and Flexible Delivery for receiving the finished cards.

s.name: Wool Scouring Bookings
s.description: Two small wool processors use the same regional wool-scouring service during an ordinary season. Each chooses between reserving scouring capacity in advance or relying on spot bookings as wool arrives.

s.name: Library Acquisitions
s.description: A small public library is choosing between ordering a Core List of established titles and ordering New Releases for its shelves. Its book distributor is choosing between a Single Shipment of the order and a Staged Shipment delivered in batches.

s.name: Roastery-Café Release
s.description: A small coffee roastery is deciding whether to secure a single-origin lot or a blended lot for its next release. A partner café is deciding whether to feature that coffee prominently or keep it on its routine menu.

s.name: Dyeing Shift Timing
s.description: A small textile dyeing workshop has a dyer choosing between Short Rinse and Long Rinse for a batch. The shift coordinator chooses between Early Shift and Late Shift for handling that same batch.

s.name: Dome Scheduling
s.description: A visiting astronomer chooses between requesting an Early Slot or a Late Slot for an evening at the observatory dome. The observatory coordinator chooses whether to Open Dome access or Reserve Dome time for setup and maintenance.

s.name: Tidepool Quota Talks
s.description: Two neighboring small-boat fishing cooperatives are negotiating a fine adjustment to a shared local quota for the next tide. Each cooperative chooses either Hold Quota or Trim Quota.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspections
s.description: A regional water authority and a hydropower operator are deciding how to manage inspections of a newly built eel pass at a major dam. The authority chooses between Full audit and Desk review, while the operator chooses between Continuous flow and Scheduled flow.

s.name: Rink Resurfacing
s.description: A small ice rink's manager chooses between a Fine Pass and a Standard Pass for the resurfacing machine. The rink technician chooses between a Cooler Finish and a Warmer Finish for the ice surface.

s.name: Bird-Ringing Station Slots
s.description: At a community bird-ringing station, the North Marsh team and the Riverside team are arranging their visits for a shared morning schedule. North Marsh chooses Early slot or Late slot, while Riverside chooses Early slot or Late slot.

s.name: The Failing Estate Wall
s.description: A heritage foundation and a specialist masonry firm are making decisions on a high-stakes contract to repair a failing stone boundary wall. The foundation chooses between Full Repair and Targeted Repair as the required scope, while the firm chooses between Firm Bid and Contingent Bid, meaning a fixed price or a bid conditional on what the wall reveals.

s.name: Dye-Bath Adjustments
s.description: A small textile workshop is fine-tuning a dyeing shift for a routine fabric batch. The dye operator chooses between Slightly Cooler and Slightly Warmer, while the finishing lead chooses between Shorter Soak and Longer Soak.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: At a small bat survey, one volunteer chooses whether to make an Early Sweep or a Late Sweep, while a second volunteer chooses a Quiet Route or an Open Route for the same night. The first choice sets the survey timing, and the second sets how the route is handled.

s.name: Ringing Station Slots
s.description: Two volunteer teams share a small bird-ringing station and each must choose one of two nearby slots for a brief ringing session. Team A chooses between the Reedbed Slot and the Hedgerow Slot, while Team B makes the same choice for its session.

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queue
s.description: A small record label and a local pressing plant are scheduling a vinyl release. The label chooses Early Master or Late Master for sending its approved audio, while the plant chooses Rush Queue or Regular Queue for placing the job in its production schedule.

s.name: Salt Marsh Grazing Rights
s.description: A coastal land trust and a cattle cooperative are deciding how to allocate rights over a highly valuable salt marsh. The trust chooses between Lease grazing and Reserve marsh, while the cooperative chooses between Seasonal grazing and Year-round grazing.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A glaciology team must choose between an Early Launch and a Late Launch for its season's glacier survey flights. A regional aviation coordinator must choose between assigning a Clear Corridor and using Shared Airspace for those flights.

s.name: Wool Scouring Schedule
s.description: Two nearby wool farms, A and B, are arranging access to a shared wool-scouring service for their next clip. Each chooses either Reserve Capacity, booking a regular processing slot in advance, or Use Overflow, relying on unreserved processing space.

s.name: Seasonal Coffee Sourcing
s.description: A regional coffee roastery is choosing how to source beans for its next major seasonal release: Direct Contract or Spot Purchase. A specialty importer is choosing whether to offer a Premium Lot or a Flexible Lot for that release.

s.name: Continental Rail Timetable
s.description: A national freight railroad and a major inland distribution network are setting the timetable for a heavily used freight corridor. The railroad chooses between Priority Trains, which reserve faster scheduled movements, and Flexible Trains, which allow broader dispatch timing; the distribution network chooses between Day Windows and Night Windows for receiving those trains.

s.name: Critical Lock Coverage
s.description: A canal lock-keeper and a neighboring lock-keeper must arrange coverage for a critical lock during a severe water-management period. Each chooses between Keep Shift, retaining the assigned duty, and Swap Shift, exchanging the duty with the other keeper.

s.name: Reindeer Herding Routes
s.description: Two neighboring reindeer herding cooperatives are planning routes for a seasonally important migration. Cooperative A must choose between Ridge Route and Valley Route, while Cooperative B must choose between North Pass and Lakeside Pass.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease
s.description: A coastal oyster cooperative and a commercial shellfish company are negotiating a high-stakes lease for a valuable oyster bed. The cooperative chooses between Long Lease and Short Lease, while the company chooses between Premium Bid and Basic Bid.

s.name: Orchard Pickup Terms
