s.description: A small orchard grower and a local juicing cooperative are setting a harvest contract. The grower chooses between Early Pickup and Flexible Pickup, while the cooperative chooses between Firm Schedule and Adjust Schedule.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A conservation ecologist and a wind-farm operator must coordinate a high-stakes bat survey night. The ecologist chooses between a Full Survey and a Brief Survey, while the operator chooses between Stop Turbines and Run Turbines.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A small quarry operator whose workday centers on one blast chooses between a Morning Window and an Afternoon Window. A local hauler making one pickup chooses between a Morning Pickup and an Afternoon Pickup.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Windows
s.description: A regional irrigation coordinator schedules the weir's maintenance for either the Early Window or the Late Window. A grower beside the weir chooses either Reduce Flow or Keep Flow during that window; the coordinator oversees water service for the district, while the grower runs one small farm.

s.name: Seasonal Flour Order
s.description: A regional bakery and its flour supplier are finalizing a high-volume seasonal supply order. The bakery chooses between Premium Blend and Standard Blend, while the supplier chooses between Firm Contract and Flexible Contract.

s.name: Seed Exchange Terms
s.description: A regional seed bank and a partner seed bank are arranging an exchange before the next planting season. The first chooses between Curated Set and Broad Set for the seeds it offers, while the second chooses between Open Terms and Tight Terms for the exchange agreement.

s.name: Hut Resupply Timing
s.description: A mountain hut caretaker and a local porter are coordinating a small resupply run. The caretaker chooses between Leave Stock and Carry In, while the porter chooses between Early Trip and Late Trip.

s.name: Shared Scouring Schedule
s.description: Northfield Wool Co-op and Moorland Wool Co-op send fleeces to the same regional wool-scouring plant. Each chooses between Reserve Capacity, booking a processing slot ahead of shearing, and Spot Booking, arranging a slot later through the plant’s open schedule.

s.name: Observatory Mirror Recoat
s.description: A national observatory and its mirror-coating contractor are planning the recoating of a flagship telescope mirror before the next observing season. The observatory chooses Full Recoat or Patch Recoat, while the contractor chooses Rush Schedule or Careful Schedule.

s.name: Clocktower Maintenance
s.description: A city conservator chooses between Routine Overhaul and Limited Servicing for a landmark clocktower, while an independent clockworks contractor chooses between Day Crew and Night Crew for the same maintenance season. Their decisions shape a maintenance plan during a season when the tower’s reliability, budget, and public reputation matter.

s.name: Clocktower Maintenance
s.description: A municipal clocktower caretaker chooses between Full Overhaul and Routine Tune for the tower’s next maintenance cycle. An independent clockmaker chooses between an On-Site Visit and Remote Advice while coordinating with the caretaker.

s.name: Triage Handoff
s.description: At a small community hospital, the day-shift charge nurse and evening-shift charge nurse coordinate triage staffing for a lightly busy handoff. The day-shift nurse chooses between “Core coverage” and “Float coverage,” while the evening-shift nurse makes the same choice for the incoming shift.

s.name: Small-Port Dredging
s.description: A small port's maintenance foreperson and a nearby ferry dispatcher are coordinating a minor dredging job. The foreperson chooses between the Dawn Window and Dusk Window, while the dispatcher chooses between a Ferry Pause and continued Ferry Service; the foreperson is responsible for the dredging schedule, while the dispatcher coordinates only one nearby ferry's timetable.

s.name: Seasonal Port Dredging
s.description: A port authority is scheduling a major channel dredging project, while a shipping consortium is planning its seasonal traffic window. The port authority chooses between Early Dredging and Late Dredging, and the consortium chooses between Peak Sailing and Off-Peak Sailing.

s.name: Migration Window Allocation
s.description: The Alpine Raptor Institute and the Marshland Migration Consortium each choose between the Dawn slot and the Dusk slot at a scarce bird-ringing station. The booking controls access to a season-critical migration window, with major conservation programs depending on the resulting field access.

s.name: Stadium Concession Pricing
s.description: For a season with major budget and reputation stakes, the stadium concessionaire chooses between Premium Pricing and Fan Pricing. Venue management independently chooses between Revenue Share and Attendance Push.

s.name: Orchard Pollination Contract
s.description: A multinational fruit grower and a commercial beekeeper are negotiating a high-stakes pollination contract for the grower's flowering season. The grower chooses between Full Coverage and Basic Coverage, while the beekeeper chooses between Fixed Apiaries and Mobile Apiaries.

s.name: Bell Foundry Tuning
s.description: A small bell foundry's caster chooses between Fine adjustment and Standard adjustment for an ordinary bell. The local bell tuner independently chooses between Quick tuning and Patient tuning before the bell is finished.

s.name: Shared Vineyard Canal
s.description: Two neighboring vineyard managers share a small irrigation canal during an ordinary growing season. Manager A chooses when to irrigate their vines, while Manager B chooses whether to release water into the shared canal or hold it back.

s.name: Dredging Schedule
s.description: A port authority and a terminal cooperative are coordinating a routine port dredging window. The authority chooses an early or late dredging window, while the cooperative chooses whether to schedule its berthing for the early or late period.

s.name: Seasonal Kiln Contract
s.description: A boutique ceramics studio and a restoration-tile manufacturer are coordinating kiln firing schedules for a high-value seasonal order. The studio chooses between "Steady firing" and "Rush firing," while the manufacturer chooses between "Early firing" and "Late firing".

s.name: Season-Opening Shows
s.description: The directors of Northstar Planetarium and Orbit Hall are coordinating their featured shows for a season-opening astronomy festival. Each director chooses whether to schedule the planetarium's show in the Early slot or the Late slot.

s.name: The Painted Cabinet
s.description: A restoration studio is preparing a bid to restore a valuable painted cabinet, choosing between Lean Bid and Full Bid. The cabinet’s museum owner is choosing between Quick Award and Detailed Review for handling the restoration proposals.

s.name: Seasonal Flour Orders
s.description: A regional bakery and a specialty flour distributor are arranging a substantial seasonal supply order. The bakery chooses between Reserve Flour and Spot Buy, while the distributor chooses between Bulk Contract and Late Order.

s.name: Stadium Snack Pricing
s.description: Two neighboring concession operators at a stadium each set the price for a signature snack during a game. Each operator chooses between Value pricing and Premium pricing.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contract
s.description: An orchard grower and a local cider mill are arranging a modest harvest contract. The grower chooses between Early delivery and Late delivery, while the mill chooses between Fixed pickup and Flexible pickup.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A small masonry contractor and a neighborhood property manager are handling a bid for a minor stone wall repair. The contractor chooses between Fine Tuckpointing and Quick Patch, while the manager chooses between Quick Approval and Careful Review.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A small saffron grower and a nearby seasonal-labour coordinator are arranging picking for a modest harvest. The grower chooses Early Crew or Late Crew, meaning whether to schedule picking in the first or second available window; the coordinator chooses Full Roster or Short Roster, meaning whether to arrange the larger or smaller worker team.

s.name: Small Print Run
s.description: A neighborhood letterpress printer and a small-press editor are preparing a short print run. The printer chooses between Light Inking and Firm Inking, while the editor chooses between Quick Approval and Proof Check.

s.name: Dune Fence Placement
s.description: Two neighboring dune stewards each choose where to place a short section of sand fence. Each can choose Crest Placement or Setback Placement for their section.

s.name: Cheese Cave Ripening
s.description: A small cheesemaker chooses between Early Release and Extended Aging for a batch in a shared cheese cave. The cave manager chooses between Dry Venting and Humid Venting while the batch ripens.

s.name: Wool Scouring Capacity
s.description: A large wool cooperative chooses whether to book Reserve Capacity or use Spot Capacity at a small independent scouring mill. The mill chooses between an Overtime Shift and a Regular Shift.

s.name: Greenhouse Heat Sharing
s.description: Two neighboring greenhouse growers are deciding how to handle a cool evening with a shared heat line. Grower A chooses between “Open valve” and “Close valve,” while Grower B chooses between “Share heat” and “Keep heat.”

s.name: Canal Lock Timing
s.description: Two neighboring canal-lock operators are arranging the timing of a routine passage. The upstream operator chooses between Steady release and Quick release, while the downstream operator chooses between Hold schedule and Shift schedule.

s.name: Osier Bed Cutting
s.description: Two neighboring basket makers, A and B, are scheduling when to cut their sections of a shared osier bed. Each chooses between Early cutting and Late cutting for the season.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: Two neighboring orchard cooperatives face a high-stakes frost watch during a critical growing night. The first cooperative chooses between Active Heating and Passive Cover, while the second chooses between Night Watch and Stand Down.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: The keeper at Beacon North chooses Early Relief or Late Relief for the handoff. The keeper at Beacon South independently chooses Early Relief or Late Relief for the same relief window.

s.name: Dyehouse Shift Adjustments
s.description: Two supervisors at a small textile dyehouse are coordinating a routine dyeing shift. The first supervisor chooses between Short Rinse and Full Rinse, while the second chooses between Cool Bath and Warm Bath for the same small batch.

s.name: Offshore Turbine Maintenance
s.description: An offshore wind-farm operator and a regional grid coordinator are making linked decisions during a major turbine-maintenance window. The operator chooses between Full overhaul and Patch repair, while the coordinator chooses between Hold reserve and Release reserve.

s.name: Seasonal Weir Maintenance
s.description: An upstream irrigation district and a downstream water authority are planning a substantial weir maintenance window before the irrigation season. The district chooses between Early Closure and Late Closure, while the authority chooses between Early Coordination and Late Coordination.

s.name: Championship Ice Rink
s.description: A major ice-rink operator is preparing the surface for a championship final and must choose between Full Resurface and Rapid Resurface. The championship organizer must choose between Early Final and Late Final for the event schedule.

s.name: Stadium Concession Pricing
s.description: Two concession vendors serving the same stadium choose their pricing approach for an upcoming match. Each vendor must choose between Regular Pricing and Premium Pricing for its menu.

s.name: Seasonal Vinyl Release
s.description: An independent record label is preparing a major seasonal release and must choose between sending its final master to the vinyl pressing queue early or late. The pressing plant must choose between reserving a dedicated queue slot for the release or scheduling it flexibly around other jobs.

s.name: Marsh Grazing Schedule
s.description: The North Inlet Cooperative and the South Inlet Cooperative share salt marsh grazing rights for the coming season. Each cooperative chooses between Early Rotation and Late Rotation for moving its herd through the marsh.

s.name: Salt Marsh Grazing
s.description: North Inlet Cooperative and South Inlet Cooperative are arranging their salt-marsh grazing rights for the coming season. North Inlet chooses between Early grazing and Late grazing, while South Inlet chooses between Early grazing and Late grazing.

s.name: Adjacent Oyster Leases
s.description: Two neighboring oyster growers are renewing small leases for adjacent beds. Grower A chooses between Narrow buffers and Wide buffers, while Grower B chooses between Early renewal and Late renewal for the lease paperwork.

s.name: Glacier Mapping Flight
s.description: A small glacier-survey crew is planning a flight over a marked stretch of ice. The crew chooses between Direct Transect, following the planned line, and Offset Transect, shifting slightly to one side; the flight coordinator chooses between Early Pass and Late Pass for the survey run.

s.name: Mirror Recoating
s.description: A major observatory is arranging the recoating of its primary telescope mirror and chooses between Premium Recoat and Basic Recoat. A specialist recoating contractor chooses between Rush Schedule and Normal Schedule for the same restoration project.

s.name: Coffee Supply Deal
s.description: A major coffee roastery and a highland coffee cooperative are negotiating a season-defining sourcing arrangement. The roastery chooses between Contract Reserve and Spot Purchase, while the cooperative chooses between Exclusive Lot and Open Sale.

s.name: Apple Harvest Contract
s.description: A small orchard grower and a neighborhood grocer are arranging an apple harvest contract. The grower chooses between Early Pickup and Flexible Pickup, while the grocer chooses between Firm Order and Spot Order.

s.name: Continental Freight Routing
s.description: A major freight rail operator must choose between Priority Dispatch and Flexible Dispatch for a high-stakes cross-border shipment program. A neighboring rail-network operator must choose between Reserved Slots and Open Slots for the same program.

s.name: Mushroom Substrate Supply
s.description: A commercial mushroom grower is arranging substrate for an important production season with a regional substrate supplier. The grower chooses Early Contract or Spot Purchase, while the supplier chooses Reserve Capacity or Flexible Allocation for handling the order.

s.name: Dune Fence Placement
s.description: A coastal council and a neighboring resort consortium must choose how to place protective fencing across a vulnerable dune system. The council chooses between Seaward Fence and Landward Fence, while the consortium chooses between Continuous Line and Segmented Line.

s.name: Thatching Crew Rotas
s.description: Two thatching contractors are planning crew rotas for a demanding roofing season, with their schedules affecting access to shared skilled workers and important client deadlines. Each contractor chooses either a Peak-first rota, concentrating crews early in the season, or an Even rota, spreading crews across the season.

s.name: Ridgeway Thatching Rota
s.description: A thatching cooperative is scheduling its crew for a major roof restoration, choosing between Full Crew and Split Crew. The estate restoration board is choosing between Early Rota and Late Rota for when its inspectors and supporting trades will be available.

s.name: Shared Kiln Contract
s.description: A spacecraft-components manufacturer and the owner of a shared industrial kiln must lock in a firing plan for a mission-critical ceramic batch. The manufacturer chooses Early Firing or Late Firing, while the kiln owner chooses Gentle Cycle or Rapid Cycle.
actorB: the owner of a shared industrial kiln

s.name: Truffle Permit Timing
s.description: Two neighboring truffle foragers are arranging small permits for visits to the same woodland patch. Forager A chooses between Early Visit and Late Visit, while Forager B chooses between Early Visit and Late Visit.

s.name: Saffron Picking Shift
s.description: Two neighboring saffron growers share a small harvest crew for one morning. Grower A chooses between Gentle Raking and Firm Raking, while Grower B chooses between Early Picking and Late Picking.

s.name: Orbital Downlink Coordination
s.description: A satellite operator and a ground-station consortium must coordinate a high-stakes satellite downlink window. The operator chooses between Early Pass and Late Pass, while the consortium chooses between North Station and South Station.

s.name: Kiln Slot Tuning
s.description: A small sawmill manager is booking one ordinary kiln run and chooses between the Morning Slot and Afternoon Slot. The kiln coordinator chooses between the Gentle Cycle and Quick Cycle for that booking.

s.name: Bell Tuning Cast
s.description: At a small bell foundry, the caster chooses between a slightly thicker or thinner bell lip for a routine casting. The kiln operator chooses between an earlier or later pour, making a fine adjustment to the same small batch.

s.name: Small-Run Pressing
s.description: A small record label and a neighborhood pressing plant are coordinating a modest vinyl pressing run. The label chooses between "Trim Master" and "Full Master," while the plant chooses between "Normal Queue" and "Flexible Queue."

s.name: Canal Lock Scheduling
s.description: A regional canal authority is scheduling lock operations for a major shipping season and must choose between Batch Release and Staggered Release of water and vessels. A downstream freight consortium must choose between sending a Rush Convoy through the locks or using a Spread Convoy schedule. The stakes are substantial because the schedule affects the parties' access to the canal during the season.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotation
s.description: Two harbour pilots are coordinating a small rotation at a local berth. Pilot A chooses between an Early Handoff and a Late Handoff, while Pilot B chooses between a Clockwise Swap and a Counterclockwise Swap.

s.name: Flagship Beer Distribution
s.description: A regional microbrewery and a national beverage distributor are negotiating the distribution plan for a flagship beer launch. The brewery must choose Direct Network or Distributor Deal, while the distributor must choose Premium Placement or Broad Rollout.

s.name: Film Release Timing
s.description: A local film studio chooses between an Early Release and a Weekend Release for its new film. A regional cinema chain chooses between a Friday Slot and a Midweek Slot for that film's booking.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: A large orchard owner chooses between Deploy heaters and Hold fire while preparing for a frost night. A regional frost-monitoring service chooses between Alert crews and Stand down as it coordinates the watch.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspection
s.description: A river authority and an eel-farming consortium are deciding how to handle inspections for a major eel pass. The authority chooses between Full inspection and Limited inspection, while the consortium chooses between Immediate opening and Delayed opening for the pass.

s.name: Seasonal Rope Ferry
s.description: A seasonal rope-ferry company is negotiating staffing for a busy crossing season with the river district that funds the service. The company chooses between Two Operators and Solo Operator, while the district chooses between Peak Coverage and Basic Coverage for the operating roster.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring small farms share one silage clamp. Farmer A chooses between Firm packing and Gentle packing, while Farmer B chooses between Early covering and Later covering for the shared clamp.

s.name: Substrate Fine-Tuning
s.description: A small mushroom grower chooses between Coarse Mix and Fine Mix for the day's substrate order. A nearby substrate supplier chooses between Moist Batch and Dry Batch as a minor adjustment to the same preparation.

s.name: Coppice Cycle Pact
s.description: Alder Estate and Birch Estate are the two owners of a large coppice woodland. Alder Estate chooses either Short cycle or Long cycle for its cutting plan, while Birch Estate independently chooses either Short cycle or Long cycle.

s.name: Hedge Restoration Contract
s.description: A national land trust and a regional hedge-laying contractor are negotiating a high-stakes contract to restore a major network of field boundaries. The land trust chooses between a phased contract and a full-season contract, while the contractor chooses between fixed-price terms and shared-risk terms.

s.name: Side-Table Restoration
s.description: An independent antique restorer and a neighborhood antiques shop are handling a modest repair of a worn side table. The restorer chooses between a Detailed bid, which lays out a fuller restoration plan, and a Lean bid, which proposes a simpler scope; the shop chooses between Award locally and Seek quotes from additional restorers.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspections
s.description: A river authority is choosing an inspection protocol for a major eel pass, while the pass operator chooses whether to Open passage or Hold passage during the review. The decision concerns the operation of a vital migration route with consequences for both parties.

s.name: Shared Downlink
s.description: A small Earth-observation team and a university ground station are coordinating use of a satellite's two available downlink windows. The team chooses Morning Pass or Evening Pass for its transmission, while the station chooses Morning Pass or Evening Pass for its own transmission.

s.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
s.description: Two small neighboring ferry operators are adjusting their daily timetable slots. North Ferry chooses either Early slot or Late slot, and South Ferry chooses either Early slot or Late slot.

s.name: Small-Port Dredging
s.description: A small port authority and its dredging contractor are coordinating a minor channel touch-up. The port authority chooses Early window or Late window for the work, while the contractor chooses Even pace or Concentrated pass for how to use that window.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A marathon organizer chooses either Full Closure or Rolling Closure for the race route. A city transit office chooses either Early Notice or Late Notice for communicating the road plan.

s.name: Triage Staffing
s.description: At a community hospital, the charge nurse and bed manager must set staffing for an ordinary busy shift. The charge nurse chooses between Full coverage and Lean coverage, while the bed manager chooses between Standard roster and Flex roster.

s.name: Orchard Pollination
s.description: A community orchard is arranging a seasonal pollination contract with a local beekeeper. The orchard chooses either Early booking or Flexible booking, while the beekeeper chooses either Shared hives or Reserved hives.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: Two neighboring orchard managers coordinate a frost watch for their nearby trees. The first manager chooses between Night watch and Dawn check, while the second chooses between Share alert and Keep schedule.

s.name: Seasonal Beer Distribution
s.description: A regional microbrewery is deciding whether to emphasize a seasonal beer through its own taprooms or pursue a wider retail rollout. Its independent distributor is choosing between premium placement in select stores and a broad release across its territory.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: A millpond caretaker and a downstream gardener are coordinating a small adjustment to the pond’s sluice timing. The caretaker chooses when to open the sluice, while the gardener chooses whether to request an earlier or later opening.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: An alpine research team and a nearby mapping cooperative are planning survey flights over the same glacier. The research team chooses between Early launch and Late launch, while the mapping cooperative chooses between Shared corridor and Separate corridor.

s.name: Scouring Capacity
s.description: Two major wool cooperatives are preparing for the coming shearing season and rely on regional scouring capacity to clean raw fleece. Each cooperative must choose whether to expand its reserved scouring capacity or hold its current reservation.

s.name: Seasonal Flour Contract
s.description: A regional bakery is arranging its flour supply for a high-demand baking season and must choose between an Early Order and a Late Order. Its flour supplier must choose between setting aside Reserve Flour and sourcing Spot Flour for the bakery.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Timing
s.description: Two commercial seaweed growers share a set of drying racks for their contracted seasonal harvest. Each grower chooses between Early loading, placing seaweed on the racks at the first available tide window, and Late loading, holding it for the later window.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shift
s.description: A lighthouse keeper and a relief coordinator are arranging a lighthouse relief shift. The keeper chooses Early Handoff or Late Handoff, while the coordinator chooses Launch Boat or Hold Boat.

s.name: Dune Fence Line
s.description: A regional shoreline authority and a coastal resort consortium must each choose where to place a dune fence along adjoining stretches of a heavily developed beach. Each can select a Seaward Fence line near the beach or a Landward Fence line farther inland.

s.name: Stadium Snack Prices
s.description: At a small stadium, two neighboring concession stands are adjusting prices for the same game. Each stand manager chooses between Regular Price and Slight Discount for a familiar snack menu.

s.name: Planetarium Season Slots
s.description: The planetarium director chooses between “Prime slot” and “Late slot” for the flagship show, while the festival coordinator chooses between “Weekend slot” and “Weeknight slot” for the visiting program. They are coordinating the season’s prominent planetarium show schedule.

s.name: Wool Scouring Capacity
s.description: A large export wool consortium, with a much larger shipment commitment, chooses between Reserve Slot and Spot Booking for wool scouring capacity. A small regional scouring mill chooses between Dedicated Run and Flexible Capacity as it schedules that capacity.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A quarry operator chooses between an Early blast and a Late blast for a major extraction season. A rail contractor chooses between keeping the freight route open with Open corridor or reserving it with Hold corridor while the quarry schedules its blasting window.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: A tidal-energy cooperative schedules servicing for one of its turbines, choosing between Routine Service and Deep Service. A marine maintenance contractor chooses whether to take the job in the Early Slot or the Late Slot.

s.name: Blockbuster Launch
s.description: A major film studio and a global distributor are setting the timing and rollout sequence for a blockbuster release. The studio chooses Summer Release or Winter Release, while the distributor chooses Theatrical First or Streaming First.

s.name: Garden Wall Repair
s.description: A local mason and a homeowner are arranging a small repair to a garden stone wall. The mason chooses between Light Tuckpoint and Deep Tuckpoint, while the homeowner chooses between Morning Access and Flexible Access for coordinating the work.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Accord
s.description: A national herbarium and an overseas biodiversity archive are negotiating a loan of irreplaceable type specimens whose handling could affect major research collections. The national herbarium chooses between Release Specimens and Retain Specimens, while the archive chooses between Accept Terms and Reject Terms.

s.name: Planetarium Show Slots
s.description: Northstar Planetarium and Meridian Planetarium are each scheduling a flagship show for a globally important celestial event. Each institution must choose between the Prime slot and the Late slot in the coordinated planetarium schedule.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A regional bat-conservation authority chooses between Full Coverage and Rapid Survey for its night-monitoring program. A wind-farm developer chooses between Delay Launch and Proceed Launch while the survey decision is pending.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A restoration mason is preparing a bid for a season-defining stone wall repair and must choose between Full Rebuild and Patch Repair. The property owner must choose between inviting an Open Tender and making a Direct Award.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A regional bat-conservation agency chooses between Full survey and Rapid survey for several crucial survey nights. A land trust chooses between Open access and Limited access to the roost sites during those same nights, with the survey's stakes affecting the future of the protected bat habitat.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Labour
s.description: A saffron grower chooses between Staggered Picking and Peak-Day Picking for the harvest season. A labour coordinator chooses between Local Crew and Agency Crew to supply the pickers.

s.name: Satellite Downlink Windows
s.description: A small Earth-observation satellite operator and a partner ground-station scheduler are coordinating a routine satellite downlink window. The satellite operator chooses between Standard Pass and Backup Pass, while the scheduler chooses between Early Window and Late Window.

s.name: Thatching Crew Rotas
s.description: Two thatching crews are coordinating work across a busy roofing season, with each crew manager setting a rota for their own team. Crew A chooses between a Steady Rota and a Compressed Rota, while Crew B chooses between an Early Start and a Late Start.

s.name: Hedge Laying Contracts
s.description: A land trust and a specialist hedge-laying contractor are negotiating a major countryside restoration contract. The land trust chooses between Full laying and Selective laying, while the contractor chooses between Fixed schedule and Flexible schedule.

s.name: Triage Staffing
s.description: A regional hospital’s emergency department is preparing its staffing plan for a demanding season. The chief medical officer chooses between Standard staffing and Surge staffing, while the nursing director chooses between Routine triage and Priority triage.

s.name: Mountain Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain-hut authority is deciding between Urgent Resupply and Deferred Resupply for a remote hut facing a major seasonal supply decision. Its logistics contractor is choosing between Airlift Cargo and Pack Train to deliver the provisions.

s.name: Shared Osier Bed
s.description: Two neighboring osier growers are arranging one day's cutting in a shared osier bed. Grower A chooses between cutting only marked stems and clearing a chosen patch, while Grower B chooses whether to do the cutting before lunch or after lunch.

s.name: Mirror Recoating
s.description: An observatory director and a telescope-mirror recoating contractor are planning work on a research telescope before the observing season. The director chooses Full Recoat or Spot Recoat, while the contractor chooses Rush Schedule or Standard Schedule.

s.name: Antique Restoration Bids
s.description: Two antique-restoration ateliers submit sealed bids for the same high-profile commission. Each atelier chooses between a Cautious Bid and an Ambitious Bid, with the contract carrying consequences for its workshop budget and reputation.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A glacier-survey pilot and a mapping coordinator are preparing a small flight. The pilot chooses between Close Transect and Wide Transect, while the coordinator chooses between Early Pass and Late Pass for the flight plan.

s.name: Stadium Concession Pricing
s.description: A stadium food concessionaire chooses between Regular Pricing, keeping menu prices steady, and Event Pricing, adjusting prices for the marquee match. A beverage concessionaire makes the same choice for drinks as the stadium prepares for a match whose concession budget matters to the season.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Season
s.description: A university herbarium curator requesting a season-critical specimen loan chooses between an Expedited Request and a Routine Request. The lending herbarium’s collections manager chooses between Approve Loan and Decline Loan while managing the institution’s budget and reputation.

s.name: Port Dredging Windows
s.description: A port authority and a ferry cooperative are coordinating a routine dredging project. The port authority chooses between an Early Window and a Late Window for dredging, while the ferry cooperative chooses between a Morning Slot and an Afternoon Slot for its busiest sailings.

s.name: Peat Bog Adjustment
s.description: A volunteer coordinator and a land steward are making a small peat-bog restoration adjustment together. The coordinator chooses between Light Sluice Tuning and Firm Sluice Tuning, while the steward chooses between Sparse Moss Planting and Dense Moss Planting.

s.name: Greenhouse Heat Sharing
s.description: Two neighboring commercial greenhouses must choose how to handle a shared geothermal heating line during a severe growing season. Greenhouse A chooses between Heat Export and Heat Retain, while Greenhouse B chooses between Heat Accept and Heat Divert.

s.name: Rooftop Hive Siting
s.description: A city pollinator office and a rooftop cooperative are coordinating an urban beehive project. The office chooses between Dense Cluster and Scattered Hives, while the cooperative chooses between Central Roof and Edge Roof for the hives.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Northbank Dairy and Meadow Vale are two large farms whose harvest plans depend on a shared silage clamp. Each farm chooses between “Reserve Slot” and “Yield Slot” for the harvest window.

s.name: Rope Ferry Staffing
s.description: At a small rope ferry, the ferry operator and the dock coordinator each choose how to staff the next crossing period. The operator chooses either “Full Crew” or “Lean Crew,” while the coordinator chooses either “Early Hand-off” or “Late Hand-off.”

s.name: Cheese Cave Contract
s.description: A heritage cheesemaker chooses whether to keep a valuable batch in the cheese cave for deep ripening or prepare it for early release. A major affineur chooses whether to commit to a reserve purchase or buy the cheese on the spot market.

s.name: Orchard Pollination Contract
s.description: A large orchard cooperative and a commercial beekeeping company are signing a high-stakes pollination contract for the coming bloom. The cooperative chooses between Full Access and Limited Access to its orchards, while the beekeeper chooses between Premium Coverage and Basic Coverage for the contracted hives.

s.name: Seasonal Route Bidding
s.description: Two regional courier firms, A and B, are bidding for a season-long delivery route whose contract matters to their operating plans and reputations. Each firm chooses between a Lean Quote, an aggressive tender for the route, and a Premium Quote, a higher-priced tender with more room per delivery.

s.name: Shared Bat Survey
s.description: A local bat-survey coordinator chooses between the Creek Route and the Meadow Route for a volunteer survey night. A neighboring coordinator chooses whether to begin at Dusk Start or Dark Start while planning the same evening’s survey.

s.name: Mushroom Substrate Supply
s.description: A major mushroom grower and a substrate producer are making linked decisions for a high-stakes cultivation season. The grower chooses between Contract Supply and Spot Supply, while the producer chooses between Reserve Capacity and Flexible Capacity.

s.name: Radio Telescope Scheduling
s.description: A community radio observatory and a nearby university astronomy group are arranging one night's telescope time. The observatory chooses an early or late observing slot, while the university group chooses a shared-band or quiet-band setup for its session.

s.name: Scouring Capacity Pact
s.description: A major wool-scouring mill and a large wool cooperative are making linked decisions for the coming processing season. The mill chooses between Expand Capacity and Hold Capacity, while the cooperative chooses between Book Scouring and Seek Alternatives for its wool.

s.name: Seed Archive Exchange
s.description: A national seed bank responsible for a country's staple-crop archive is arranging an exchange with a small regional seed cooperative. The seed bank chooses between Rapid release and Careful screening, while the cooperative chooses between Broad sharing and Limited sharing.

s.name: Planetarium Scheduling
s.description: A planetarium manager and a visiting science-club coordinator are arranging a public show. The manager chooses Prime Slot or Off-Peak Slot, while the coordinator chooses Early Session or Late Session for the club’s booking.

s.name: Sawmill Kiln Booking
s.description: A small sawmill and a local kiln operator are coordinating a booking for a batch of boards. The sawmill chooses Standard Slot or Flexible Slot, while the kiln operator chooses Hold Date or Shift Date.

s.name: Salt Pan Harvesting
s.description: Two large salt-pan operators share a brine system whose seasonal condition affects both businesses. Operator A chooses between Early Harvest and Late Harvest, while Operator B chooses between Open Channels and Closed Channels.

s.name: Clocktower Maintenance
s.description: A clocktower caretaker chooses between Routine Service and Full Overhaul for the tower's maintenance visit. A town events coordinator chooses between Keep Schedule and Shift Schedule for the nearby daily chimes while the work is arranged.

s.name: Emergency Triage Coverage
s.description: Two neighboring hospitals, Northside and Southside, must set their emergency-department triage staffing for a period of heavy regional demand. Northside chooses between Surge Roster and Standard Roster, while Southside chooses between Surge Roster and Standard Roster.

s.name: Triage Shift Coordination
s.description: A community hospital's emergency department and inpatient ward are coordinating staffing for an ordinary busy shift. The emergency department chooses between Float Nurses and Fixed Teams, while the inpatient ward chooses between Early Coverage and Late Coverage.

s.name: Small Letterpress Run
s.description: A neighborhood letterpress printer and an independent bookseller are arranging a modest print run. The printer chooses between Rush Plates and Standard Plates, while the bookseller chooses between Early Pickup and Flexible Pickup.

s.name: Small Letterpress Run
s.description: A small letterpress shop and a nearby zine editor are preparing a short run of handbills. The shop chooses between “Loose pressure” and “Firm pressure,” while the editor chooses between “Light inking” and “Rich inking” for the run.

s.name: Small Shelf Refresh
s.description: The acquisitions librarian at one neighborhood library is choosing between a Paperback Set and a Hardback Set for a small shelf refresh. A librarian at a nearby branch is choosing between Local Titles and General Titles for its own modest order.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: A millpond keeper chooses whether to open the sluice early or late. A nearby miller chooses whether to run the mill early or late.

s.name: Canal Lock Scheduling
s.description: A regional grain cooperative and a downstream hydroelectric utility coordinate the schedule for a major canal lock system. The cooperative chooses between sending barges through as a Priority Convoy or as Staggered Batches, while the utility chooses between Peak Release and Steady Release of water through the locks.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: Two neighboring mountain-rescue agencies are arranging avalanche patrol rosters for a dangerous week in which their coordination affects major rescue and access decisions. Agency A chooses between Full Roster and Split Roster, while Agency B chooses between Early Patrol and Late Patrol.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: The patrol chiefs of two neighboring ski areas are coordinating rosters for a shared avalanche-prone traverse. North Ridge chooses between Full Roster and Split Roster, while Cedar Pass chooses between Early Patrol and Flexible Patrol for the coming season.

s.name: Milk Supply Season
s.description: A regional dairy co-op and a supermarket chain are negotiating a season-defining milk supply arrangement. The co-op chooses between Premium Contract, a price-focused agreement, and Volume Contract, a volume-focused agreement; the supermarket chooses between Stable Shelf, a steady retail-pricing plan, and Discount Push, a promotional retail-pricing plan.

s.name: Archive Digitisation
s.description: A national archive is commissioning a contractor to digitise a season’s worth of fragile records, with the project carrying a meaningful budget and reputation stake. The archive chooses between Complete Capture and Selective Capture, while the contractor chooses between Fast Processing and Quality Review.

s.name: Small Truffle Permit
s.description: Two neighboring truffle foragers are arranging a small permit for one woodland patch. Ada chooses between Light route and Careful route, while Benoit chooses between Morning slot and Afternoon slot.

s.name: Canal Lock Slots
s.description: A grain-shipping cooperative is planning its seasonal passage through a busy canal lock and must choose between an Early Convoy and a Staggered Convoy. The canal authority is scheduling the lock and must choose between a Peak Slot and an Off-Peak Slot.

s.name: Routine Downlink
s.description: A small satellite operator chooses between an early or late downlink window for a routine data pass. A ground-station scheduler chooses between fine-tuning the receiver or using a broader tuning setting.

s.name: Ringing Station Slots
s.description: At a small bird-ringing station, Team A and Team B are arranging routine volunteer slots. Team A chooses Early setup or Late setup, while Team B chooses Quiet period or Busy period.

s.name: Seasonal Vinyl Release
s.description: A record label is planning a major seasonal release with a vinyl pressing plant. The label chooses between Early Master and Late Master for delivering its final audio master, while the plant chooses between Priority Slot and Flexible Slot for scheduling the pressing queue.

s.name: Shared Vine Rows
s.description: Two neighboring vineyard managers share a small irrigation line for adjoining vine rows. Each chooses between a steady flow and a brief pulse for the next watering cycle.

s.name: Seasonal Hedge Contract
s.description: A landowner and a hedge-laying contractor are setting terms for a season-long boundary-maintenance contract. The landowner chooses either Detailed brief or Basic brief, while the contractor chooses either Dedicated crew or Shared crew.

s.name: Dairy Co-op Pricing
s.description: A regional dairy co-op and a neighborhood grocer are coordinating a milk supply arrangement. The co-op chooses between Stable Price and Flexible Price, while the grocer chooses between Regular Order and Seasonal Order.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A masonry contractor is submitting a bid for a season of stone wall repairs, choosing between Full Rebuild and Selective Patch. A heritage property trust is commissioning the work and choosing between Fixed Scope and Open Scope.

s.name: Telescope Mirror Recoating
s.description: A major observatory and its mirror-recoating contractor must coordinate a high-stakes restoration of the telescope’s primary mirror. The observatory chooses between Full Recoat and Spot Recoat, while the contractor chooses between Fast Cure and Slow Cure.

s.name: Marsh Grazing Schedule
s.description: Two neighboring salt-marsh graziers, one on the north bank and one on the south bank, are arranging when to use their grazing rights. Each chooses between Spring grazing and Autumn grazing for their herd.

s.name: Small Quota Meeting
s.description: Two neighboring fishing cooperatives are discussing a fine adjustment to their shared seasonal quota. The North Cove cooperative chooses between “Keep Quota” and “Shift Quota,” while the South Inlet cooperative chooses between the same two options.

s.name: Orchard Pollination
s.description: A local beekeeper and an orchard grower are arranging a pollination contract for the grower’s fruit trees. The beekeeper chooses between Standard Hives and Extra Hives, while the grower chooses between Early Booking and Late Booking.

s.name: Routine Satellite Downlink
s.description: A small weather-data lab and a community satellite relay coordinate a routine satellite downlink window. The lab chooses First Window or Second Window for its transmission, while the relay chooses Brief Handoff or Extended Handoff for its receiving schedule.

s.name: Canal Shift Coverage
s.description: Two canal authorities must arrange coverage for the same lock-keeper shift during a high-stakes shipping window. The first authority chooses “Keep Shift” or “Swap Shift,” while the second chooses “Cover Shift” or “Keep Assignment.”

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: A small orchard manager and a neighboring volunteer arrange an overnight frost watch. The manager chooses whether to begin with a Canopy Check or a Ground Check, while the volunteer chooses between a Lantern Round and a Quiet Post.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: The city traffic office and the marathon organizing committee are coordinating road closures for a neighborhood race. The traffic office chooses between Early closure and Late closure, while the committee chooses between Full reroute and Partial reroute.

s.name: Turbine Fine-Tuning
s.description: At a small wind farm, a field technician chooses between Fine Tune, making a careful adjustment to one turbine, and Routine Check, leaving the adjustment to the usual checklist. A control-room operator chooses between Steady Setting, holding the turbine controls at a measured setting, and Quick Setting, making a brisk control adjustment.

s.name: Puppet Tour Timing
s.description: A small puppet troupe is arranging one touring stop with a neighborhood hall coordinator. The troupe chooses between bringing its Full Set or its Light Set, while the coordinator chooses an Early Slot or a Late Slot for the performance.

s.name: Bog Recovery Plan
s.description: A peatland restoration agency and a neighboring farmers’ cooperative are coordinating a season-long bog recovery project. The agency chooses between Staged Rewetting and Rapid Rewetting, while the cooperative chooses between Field Cooperation and Drainage Push.

s.name: Salt Pan Harvest
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan harvesters are planning work around a shared evaporation basin. Each chooses Early harvest, collecting salt at the start of the cycle, or Late harvest, collecting it later in the cycle.

s.name: Seasonal Rope Ferry
s.description: A rope-ferry cooperative chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew for the coming season. A municipal transport office chooses between Early Subsidy and Late Subsidy to schedule staffing support for the crossing.

s.name: Turbine Maintenance Window
s.description: A wind-farm operator chooses between Routine Servicing and Deferred Servicing for a turbine maintenance window. A maintenance contractor chooses between Full Crew and Small Crew for that same window.

s.name: Emergency Thatch Rotas
s.description: Two thatching crews are coordinating rotas for a high-stakes restoration of a row of historic cottages before severe weather arrives. Crew A chooses between a Master-heavy and an Apprentice-heavy rota, while Crew B chooses between an Early-shift and a Late-shift rota.

s.name: Rooftop Hive Plan
s.description: A neighborhood beekeeping cooperative and the city planning office are deciding how to place urban hives for the coming season. The cooperative chooses Rooftop Cluster or Scattered Roofs, while the planning office chooses Strict Zoning or Flexible Zoning; the decision matters for the season's harvest, municipal resources, and public reputation.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: A neighborhood beekeeper and a community-garden coordinator are arranging where an apiary will sit for the winter. The beekeeper chooses between Orchard Edge and Shed Side, while the coordinator chooses between North Plot and South Plot.

s.name: Rope Ferry Staffing
s.description: A rope-ferry operator chooses between running the crossing with a Solo Crossing crew or adding a Relief Deckhand. A riverside community coordinator chooses between arranging a Peak Roster or a Lean Roster for the ferry service.

s.name: Estate Hedge Contract
s.description: A conservation estate and a specialist hedge-laying firm are setting terms for a high-stakes hedge-laying contract. The estate chooses between Full Restoration and Phased Restoration, while the firm chooses between Early Handover and Flexible Handover.

s.name: Courier Route Bidding
s.description: Two neighborhood courier firms are bidding for an everyday delivery route. Each firm chooses between a Lean Quote, a tightly priced bid, and a Buffered Quote, a bid with more room for routine route costs.

s.name: Shared Greenhouse Heat
s.description: Two neighboring commercial greenhouse operators, North Ridge Growers (A) and Valley Bloom (B), must set their draw from a shared geothermal heat loop for an important growing season. Each chooses between “Full draw” and “Reduced draw,” determining how aggressively that greenhouse requests heat from the shared system.

s.name: Kiln Firing Coordination
s.description: A small pottery studio and a nearby clay supplier are coordinating a kiln firing. The studio chooses a Slow firing or Quick firing schedule, while the supplier chooses Standard delivery or Flexible delivery timing.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: A tidal-grid operator and a marine maintenance contractor are arranging service for a high-value tidal turbine. The operator chooses between Early servicing and Deferred servicing, while the contractor chooses between Crew commitment and Spot response.

s.name: Kelp Harvest Timing
s.description: Two neighboring kelp-farm operators, A and B, are planning their harvest for the coming season. Each chooses between Early Harvest and Full Growth for their own kelp beds.

s.name: Emergency Surge Staffing
s.description: Northside Hospital and Riverside Hospital are coordinating staffing for a predicted mass-casualty surge. Northside chooses between “Full Triage” and “Lean Triage,” while Riverside chooses between “Surge Team” and “Core Team” for its emergency department.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: A commercial orchard cooperative and a neighboring grower face an overnight frost watch. The cooperative chooses between Run sprinklers and Deploy heaters, while the grower chooses between Send crews and Hold crews.

s.name: Seasonal Dairy Pricing
s.description: A regional dairy co-op is negotiating seasonal wholesale pricing with a grocery chain. The co-op chooses between a Premium quote and a Discount quote, while the chain chooses between a Shelf feature and a Standard shelf arrangement.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspections
s.description: A regional river authority and a major hydropower operator are deciding how to manage an eel passage during a critical migration season. The authority chooses between Routine Checks and Full Audit, while the operator chooses between Open Gates and Restrict Flow.

s.name: Seasonal Bean Order
s.description: A neighborhood coffee roastery and a local coffee wholesaler are arranging a seasonal bean order. The roastery chooses Direct Contract or Spot Market, while the wholesaler chooses Fresh Lot or Stored Lot for the transaction.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: A mountain rescue authority and a major ski area are setting avalanche patrol rosters before a dangerous storm. The authority chooses between Full Patrol and Lean Patrol, while the ski area chooses between Early Closure and Open Routes.

s.name: Tundra Migration Routes
s.description: Two neighboring reindeer-herding cooperatives are planning a crucial seasonal migration across the tundra. Each cooperative must choose one of its two designated routes: Cooperative A chooses between Inland Route and Coastal Route, while Cooperative B chooses between Valley Route and Plateau Route.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations
s.description: Two harbour pilot cooperatives are negotiating how to cover a demanding seasonal rotation of vessel assignments. Cooperative A chooses either “Tide Roster,” rotating pilots with the tide windows, or “Fixed Roster,” keeping crews on set turns, while Cooperative B chooses either “Staggered Calls,” spreading assignments across the rotation, or “Bunched Calls,” grouping assignments into concentrated runs.

s.name: Celestial Broadcast Slots
s.description: Two major planetariums are coordinating a once-in-a-generation celestial broadcast whose scheduling has major consequences for both institutions. Planetarium A chooses between the Prime Slot and the Overnight Slot, while Planetarium B chooses between the Opening Slot and the Closing Slot.

s.name: Ski-Lift Grooming
s.description: A trail crew lead chooses between Light Grooming and Deep Grooming for a small lift-accessed slope. The lift supervisor chooses between an Early Pass and a Late Pass for the grooming window.

s.name: Shared Dune Fence
s.description: A coastal municipality and a neighboring resort authority must coordinate placement of a major dune fence along their shared shoreline. The municipality chooses between Inland Fence and Seaward Fence, while the resort authority chooses between Inland Fence and Seaward Fence.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: Two large commercial beekeeping firms are arranging winter apiaries in the same region. Each firm must choose between Valley Shelter and Windward Ridge for its colonies.

s.name: Foundry Commission
s.description: A bell foundry is casting a major commission for a commissioning council. The foundry chooses between Rapid Pour and Measured Pour, while the council chooses between Open Tuning and Exact Tuning for the bells.

s.name: Dairy Co-op Pricing
s.description: Two neighboring dairy co-ops are making a small weekly pricing adjustment for a shared local delivery route. Co-op A chooses between “Steady Quote” and “Small Trim,” while Co-op B chooses between “Steady Quote” and “Small Trim.”

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: Two caretakers of neighboring small orchards are arranging an overnight frost watch. Caretaker A chooses between Porch Check and Row Check, while Caretaker B chooses between Early Walk and Dawn Walk for monitoring the trees.

s.name: Floodplain Rope Ferry
s.description: A rope-ferry operator chooses Full Crew or Lean Crew for a vital crossing used after a major flood. A river authority chooses Landing Team or Remote Control for managing its side of the ferry operation.

s.name: Port Rotation Window
s.description: A harbour pilot cooperative is choosing between Rapid Rotation and Staggered Rotation for a critical vessel movement. A terminal operator is choosing between Priority Berthing and Balanced Berthing for the same harbour window.

s.name: Kiln Booking
s.description: A small sawmill and a nearby cabinet shop are coordinating a routine booking at a shared lumber-drying kiln. The sawmill chooses between Early slot and Late slot, while the cabinet shop chooses between Full load and Partial load.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: Two small glacier survey teams plan flights over the same stretch of ice: a mapping team and a weather-monitoring team. The mapping team chooses Low pass or High pass, while the weather-monitoring team chooses Early pass or Late pass.

s.name: Dune Fence Placement
s.description: Two neighboring dune stewards are adjusting a short fence along the same sandy footpath. Each chooses whether to place their section at the crest setback or the path setback, with the two sections needing to line up.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring smallholders share a silage clamp for a modest batch of feed. Smallholder A chooses between Trim edges and Leave edges when finishing their side, while Smallholder B chooses between Tight cover and Loose cover when settling the shared sheet.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A marathon organizer and a city traffic authority must coordinate road access for a high-stakes race. The organizer chooses between Full Closure and Partial Closure, while the authority chooses between Early Detour and Late Detour.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A city traffic department and a marathon organizer are coordinating road closures for a major race. The traffic department chooses between Full Closure and Rolling Closure, while the organizer chooses between Early Start and Late Start.

s.name: Triage Shift Coverage
s.description: At a community hospital, the triage coordinator chooses between Full Triage and Lean Triage for an ordinary busy shift. The staffing coordinator chooses between Early Float and Late Float for when supplemental staff join the triage area.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief
s.description: Two lighthouse keepers are arranging an ordinary relief shift at a coastal lighthouse. Keeper A chooses between Early relief and Regular relief, while Keeper B chooses between Radio handoff and Log handoff.

s.name: Scouring Schedule
s.description: For one ordinary delivery day, a small wool-scouring mill chooses whether to keep some washing capacity in reserve or open it fully. A local wool-collection cooperative chooses whether to send fleeces at a steady pace or in a rush.

s.name: Cranberry Bog Flooding
s.description: Two cranberry growers sharing a bog district must each choose how to manage seasonal flooding. The first grower chooses between Early Flooding and Delayed Flooding, while the second chooses between Canal Release and Gate Holding.

s.name: Seasonal Freight Timetable
s.description: A regional freight carrier and a major rail terminal are coordinating a timetable for a high-value seasonal shipping program. The carrier chooses between Early Dispatch and Late Dispatch, while the terminal chooses between Priority Window and Flexible Window.

s.name: Planetarium Premiere
s.description: A national space agency and an international planetarium network are making a high-stakes decision about a flagship deep-space show. The agency chooses between Prime Slot and Late Slot, while the network chooses between Shared Premiere and Exclusive Premiere.

s.name: Substrate Supply Contract
s.description: A large commercial mushroom grower chooses between Reserved Contract and Spot Purchase for its substrate supply. The substrate producer chooses between Priority Allocation and Open Allocation for this grower, shaping a major supply arrangement.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contract
s.description: A small orchard cooperative and a local cider maker are arranging a seasonal apple-harvest contract. The cooperative chooses between Early Delivery and Late Delivery, while the cider maker chooses between Firm Price and Flexible Price.

s.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
s.description: Two ferry operators are bidding for scarce timetable slots on a vital island route, where the decision affects their long-term operations. North Channel Ferries chooses between the Dawn Slot and Midday Slot, while Seaway Ferries chooses between the Dawn Slot and Evening Slot.

s.name: Cider Press Bookings
s.description: Orchard North and Valley Gold are arranging bookings at a major cider press whose harvest capacity affects their large supply contracts. Each producer must choose between Guaranteed Slot, which commits press capacity early, and Flexible Slot, which leaves the booking open until later.

s.name: Hedge Renewal Contract
s.description: A landowner and a hedge-laying contractor are negotiating a contract important to the coming farming season. The landowner chooses between Full Rebuild and Targeted Repair, while the contractor chooses between Winter Start and Spring Start.

s.name: Café Bean Sourcing
s.description: A neighborhood café manager chooses between sourcing a House Blend or a Single Origin for the café's menu. A nearby coffee roastery chooses whether to provide a Standard Roast or a Custom Roast for that order.

s.name: Routine Port Dredging
s.description: A port authority and a shipping cooperative are coordinating a routine dredging project. The authority chooses an Early Window or Late Window for the work, while the cooperative chooses Standard Routing or Rerouted Traffic for its vessels.

s.name: Seasonal Courier Bids
s.description: Two courier firms, Metro Parcel and Northline Express, are bidding to serve a retailer’s seasonal delivery corridor. Metro Parcel chooses between a Premium Route bid and a Lean Route bid, while Northline Express chooses between a Flexible Route bid and a Committed Route bid for the same contract.

s.name: Vineyard Watering
s.description: A vineyard manager and a neighboring grower coordinate a small shared irrigation channel. The manager chooses between Earlier watering and Later watering, while the grower chooses between Steady flow and Brief pause.

s.name: Seasonal Flour Orders
s.description: A regional bakery chain is arranging flour supplies for a high-demand baking season and chooses between Early Order, committing its seasonal request in advance, and Spot Order, placing it near production time. A flour cooperative chooses between Reserve Flour, setting aside capacity for the bakery chain, and Flexible Supply, keeping its capacity open for other bakery orders.

s.name: Small Library Order
s.description: A neighborhood library is deciding whether to order a new title now or defer the order. Its local bookseller is choosing between holding the usual price and offering a small account credit for this acquisition.

s.name: Orchard Falconry Rounds
s.description: A small orchard owner and a neighboring market gardener coordinate routine falconry pest control. The orchard owner chooses Morning Release or Late Release, while the gardener chooses Open Field or Hedgerow Route for the hawk's working area.

s.name: Rooftop Hive Siting
s.description: A neighborhood beekeeper and a city rooftop coordinator are planning urban beehive locations for the coming growing season. The beekeeper chooses Courtyard Hives or Rooftop Hives, while the coordinator chooses Park Buffer or Street Terrace.

s.name: Cider Press Bookings
s.description: A small orchardist is booking time at a local cider press, while the press coordinator sets the day's preparation style. The orchardist chooses an Early slot or Late slot, and the coordinator chooses a Flexible setup or Fixed setup.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A regional masonry firm chooses between submitting a Detailed Bid or a Lean Bid for a season's stone wall repairs. A heritage council chooses between an Immediate Award and a Revision Request as it considers the firm's proposal.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: A tidal-farm operator and a servicing contractor are arranging a routine turbine visit. The operator chooses between a brief or extended outage, while the contractor chooses between sending a local crew or a specialist crew.

s.name: Offshore Wind Maintenance
s.description: A national offshore wind operator must choose between Planned overhaul and Emergency patches for a major wind farm. A small specialist maintenance contractor chooses between Reserve crew and Stretch crew while supporting that decision.

s.name: Dune Fence Placement
s.description: A coastal resort consortium and a neighboring municipality are deciding how to place and configure a dune fence system. The consortium chooses between Seaward Fence and Landward Fence, while the municipality chooses between Open Gaps and Continuous Fence.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: A commercial beekeeper is choosing where to place a large apiary for the winter: in a sheltered valley or on an exposed ridge. A neighboring land trust is deciding whether to lease the valley ground for the apiary or reserve it for other winter uses.

s.name: Routine Quarry Window
s.description: A small quarry's foreperson chooses between the Early Window and Late Window for a routine blast. The nearby haul-route coordinator chooses between the Short Buffer and Long Buffer for keeping the route clear around that window.

s.name: Ringing Station Allocation
s.description: A national bird-monitoring agency and a migratory-bird research consortium must allocate access to a scarce bird ringing station during a season with major conservation stakes. The agency chooses between “Reserve Dawn” and “Open Dawn,” while the consortium chooses between “Claim Peak” and “Use Overflow.”

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: An upstream mill operator must choose between Early release and Late release for the millpond sluice during the growing season. A downstream farming cooperative must choose between Early draw and Late draw for its irrigation schedule, with the timing important to both organizations’ seasonal plans.

s.name: Dyeing Season Coordination
s.description: A large textile mill and its principal apparel buyer must coordinate a high-stakes dyeing season. The mill chooses between Early Shift and Late Shift for its dyeing crews, while the buyer chooses between Fixed Batches and Flexible Batches for releasing color orders.

s.name: Quiet-Sky Scheduling
s.description: A small university radio team and a neighboring research group are sharing a radio telescope for a routine observation. The university team chooses an earlier or later observing window, while the neighboring group chooses a narrow or wide frequency band for its session.

s.name: Mushroom Substrate Order
s.description: A small mushroom grower chooses between a Standard Batch and a Rush Batch for a routine crop order. A local substrate supplier chooses between a Fresh Mix and a Budget Mix for that same order.

s.name: Seasonal Beer Rollout
s.description: A microbrewery chooses between “Limited Batch” and “Wide Release” for a season-defining beer. Its regional distributor chooses between “Premium Push” and “Routine Listing” for the beer’s retail rollout. Both choices are part of a substantial seasonal distribution agreement.

s.name: Ringing Station Slots
s.description: At a small bird-ringing station, Coordinator A chooses whether their team uses the Dawn slot or the Later slot. Coordinator B chooses whether their team uses the North nets or the South nets.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: At a small lighthouse, the outgoing keeper chooses between a Brief Handover and a Detailed Handover for the relief shift. The incoming keeper chooses between Early Arrival and On-Time Arrival for taking over the station.

s.name: Dairy Co-op Pricing
s.description: Northfield Dairy Co-op and Meadow Dairy Co-op serve the same local grocery market. Each co-op chooses between keeping a Steady Price and running a Promo Price for its packaged milk.

s.name: Dye-Bath Adjustments
s.description: A shift supervisor at a small textile dyeing workshop chooses between a Short Rinse and a Full Rinse for the day's fabric batch. The dye technician chooses between a Cool Bath and a Warm Bath for the same batch.

s.name: Seasonal Vinyl Queue
s.description: Two record labels, A and B, must schedule major album pressings at the same vinyl plant ahead of an important release season. Each label chooses either Reserve Capacity or Flexible Queue for its pressing slot.

s.name: Orchard Pollination Contract
s.description: A seed company and a commercial beekeeper are setting a high-stakes pollination contract for the company's flowering crop. The seed company chooses Full-Season Access or Peak-Week Access, while the beekeeper chooses Dedicated Hives or Shared Hives.

s.name: Triage Desk Staffing
s.description: A charge nurse and an emergency physician coordinate staffing for a small triage desk during an ordinary shift. The nurse chooses either "Steady roster" or "Flex coverage" for nurse assignment, and the physician chooses either "Routine intake" or "Rapid intake" for the intake tempo.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease
s.description: A regional oyster cooperative and a marine-farming company are negotiating an oyster-bed lease with major business consequences. The cooperative chooses between Long Lease and Short Lease, while the company chooses between Premium Terms and Basic Terms.

s.name: Shared Kiln Schedule
s.description: A pottery teacher and a studio technician are coordinating a shared kiln for the day's batch. The teacher chooses Slow Firing or Fast Firing, while the technician chooses Early Loading or Late Loading.

s.name: Corner Delivery Bids
s.description: Two neighborhood couriers are bidding on a small local delivery route. Courier A chooses between an Early bid and a Late bid, while Courier B chooses between a Tight quote and a Flexible quote for the same route.

s.name: Canal Shift Swap
s.description: Two lock-keepers responsible for a major canal each choose whether to swap an upcoming shift or keep the assigned shift. Their choices determine how the lock-keeping schedule is arranged.

s.name: Clocktower Upkeep
s.description: The town clockkeeper is scheduling when to service the clocktower, choosing between Early Service and Late Service. The square’s maintenance coordinator is choosing between Morning Chime and Evening Chime for the tower’s regular daily test.

s.name: Offshore Wind Maintenance
s.description: At a major offshore wind farm, the operator chooses between Rapid Overhaul of aging turbines and Deferred Overhaul while planning the maintenance program. The regional grid authority chooses between Priority Dispatch for the farm and Standard Dispatch for the grid.

s.name: Puppet Tour Stop
s.description: A traveling puppet theatre company is arranging a modest tour stop with a local venue. The company chooses between Full Troupe and Small Troupe, while the venue chooses between Prime Slot and Late Slot.

s.name: River Equipment Crossing
s.description: At a high-stakes cable-ferry crossing, the Northbank emergency agency and Southbank emergency agency are coordinating the movement of critical equipment. Northbank chooses between Early Loading and Late Loading, while Southbank chooses between Priority Crossing and Shared Crossing.

s.name: Kiln Booking
s.description: A local furniture maker and a sawmill manager are arranging a kiln booking for a routine batch of lumber. The furniture maker chooses Early booking or Flexible booking, while the manager chooses Reserved slot or Open slot.

s.name: Kiln Booking
s.description: A small sawmill and a nearby furniture maker are arranging one kiln booking for a batch of boards. The sawmill chooses an Early slot or Late slot, while the furniture maker chooses a Standard load or Flexible load.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Tour
s.description: A puppet theatre company and an international festival are making decisions about a major touring production. The company chooses between Full Tour and Short Tour, while the festival chooses between Prime Slot and Late Slot.

s.name: Dairy Co-op Pricing
s.description: A dairy cooperative and a local grocery store are setting terms for the next milk order. The co-op chooses between Stable Price and Promotional Price, while the grocery store chooses between Regular Shelf and Featured Shelf.

s.name: Small Library Order
s.description: A small library's acquisitions librarian chooses between a Targeted List and a Broad List for a modest book order. A local bookseller chooses between Flexible Delivery and Fixed Delivery for fulfilling that order.

s.name: Port Dredging Windows
s.description: A small port’s operations coordinator chooses between an Early Window and a Late Window for routine channel dredging. The dredging contractor chooses whether to schedule the work in a Short Window or a Long Window.

s.name: Record Pressing Queue
s.description: An independent record label is arranging a vinyl pressing queue with a local pressing plant. The label chooses between Batch Together and Split Batches, while the plant chooses between Day Slot and Night Slot.

s.name: Vinyl Queue Timing
s.description: Two small record labels are coordinating a modest vinyl pressing queue. Label A chooses between an Early Handoff and a Late Handoff for its lacquer, while Label B chooses between an Early Slot and a Late Slot for its place in the queue.

s.name: The Charter Edition
s.description: A major publisher and a letterpress printer are preparing a nationally important commemorative edition. The publisher must choose between Rush Release and Full Proofing, while the printer chooses between Premium Stock and Standard Stock for the run.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A city marathon director chooses between Full Closure and Rolling Closure for the race route. The regional transit authority chooses between Early Detour and Late Detour for managing traffic during the event.

s.name: Seed Bank Exchange
s.description: A local seed bank and a nearby seed bank are arranging a small exchange of seed samples. The local bank chooses between Routine Sort and Extra Sort, while the nearby bank chooses between Standard Pack and Custom Pack for preparing its shipment.

s.name: Dairy Co-op Pricing
s.description: Two large dairy cooperatives are setting prices for milk contracts in the same regional market. Each cooperative must choose between Premium Pricing and Volume Pricing for the coming contract period.

s.name: Lock-Keeper Shift Swaps
s.description: Two neighboring lock-keepers are arranging a small shift swap for one ordinary day. The first chooses Keep Shift or Offer Swap, while the second chooses Keep Shift or Offer Swap.

s.name: Neighboring Bog Floods
s.description: Two neighboring cranberry growers are planning a routine flood for their adjacent bogs. One chooses Early Flood or Late Flood for the timing, while the other chooses Shared Ditch or Separate Ditch for managing the connecting water channel.

s.name: Osier Bed Cutting
s.description: Two neighboring osier growers are preparing beds for the coming harvest season. Each must choose between Early cutting and Late cutting for their own osier bed, with the timing decisions made independently.

s.name: Peatland Recovery Pact
s.description: A conservation trust managing a major peat bog must choose between Block Drains and Stage Rewetting. A downstream water utility must choose between Fund Early and Fund Later for the restoration plan.

s.name: Shared Kiln Scheduling
s.description: A neighborhood pottery studio and a nearby ceramics workshop share access to the same community kiln. The studio chooses between Gentle firing and Fast firing, while the workshop chooses between Morning firing and Evening firing.

s.name: Weekly Bean Arrangement
s.description: A small coffee roastery and a neighborhood café are coordinating a modest weekly bean arrangement. The roastery chooses between Direct Trade and Spot Market, while the café chooses between Standing Order and Flexible Order.

s.name: Osier Bed Cutting
s.description: A small osier grower is arranging a bed-cutting job with a local basket maker, whose involvement is a modest side contract. The grower chooses Early cutting or Mature cutting, while the basket maker chooses Prompt pickup or Delayed pickup.

s.name: Dyeing Shift Coordination
s.description: A small apparel mill and its contracted dye house coordinate their textile dyeing shifts. The mill chooses between Early shift and Late shift, while the dye house chooses between Standard bath and Quick bath.

s.name: Small Route Bids
s.description: Two local courier services are deciding how to bid for a small neighborhood delivery route. Each service chooses between a Tight Bid that closely fits the route and a Flexible Bid that leaves more room for adjustment.

s.name: Dome-Time Handoff
s.description: The observatory’s imaging team and a small student observing team are arranging one shared dome-time handoff. Each team chooses either an Early slot or a Late slot for its fine-adjustment session.

s.name: Shared Kiln Season
s.description: A ceramic-arts cooperative and a prominent independent studio share a kiln during a high-stakes production season. The cooperative chooses between Slow firing and Fast firing, while the independent studio chooses between Early loading and Late loading for its kiln schedule.

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queue
s.description: A small record label chooses Early booking, reserving a pressing slot ahead of time, or Late booking, sending its masters closer to release. The pressing plant chooses Priority queue, placing the run ahead in its queue, or Batch queue, grouping it with similar jobs.

s.name: Coppice Renewal Contract
s.description: A regional woodland cooperative and a biomass utility are negotiating the management of a valuable coppice tract. The cooperative chooses Early cutting or Late cutting, and the utility chooses Steady demand or Surge demand.

s.name: The National Press Run
s.description: A major publisher is choosing how to commit its letterpress title: “Full Run” means producing the complete planned edition, while “Test Run” means starting with a limited edition. Its distributor chooses between “National Push,” placing the title across the country, and “Regional Push,” concentrating its release in selected markets.

s.name: Shared Weir Timing
s.description: An upstream irrigation district and a downstream farm cooperative are coordinating seasonal maintenance at a shared weir. The district chooses Spring Window or Autumn Window, while the cooperative chooses Spring Window or Autumn Window for its own work.

s.name: Flagship Mirror Recoat
s.description: A national observatory and a specialized mirror-coating contractor are arranging the recoating of a flagship telescope mirror. The observatory chooses Emergency Recoat or Scheduled Recoat, while the contractor chooses Dedicated Crew or Shared Crew.

s.name: Co-op Milk Pricing
s.description: A small dairy co-op and a neighborhood grocer are coordinating a routine milk order. The co-op chooses between Steady price and Small discount, while the grocer chooses between Steady order and Flexible order.

s.name: Orbital Downlink Scheduling
s.description: A national Earth-observation agency and a commercial satellite operator are coordinating a season of satellite downlink windows. The agency chooses between Priority Window and Flexible Window, while the operator chooses between Reserved Slot and Shared Slot.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring farmers share a silage clamp for storing their silage. Each chooses whether to load the shared clamp first or second in the schedule.

s.name: Seasonal Hedge Contract
s.description: A regional estate manager and a hedge-laying contractor are negotiating a substantial seasonal hedge-laying contract.
