The estate manager chooses either a detailed specification or a flexible specification, while the contractor chooses either an early-season crew or a late-season crew.

s.name: Shared Vineyard Irrigation
s.description: A vineyard manager and a neighboring grower share a small irrigation canal. Each chooses between Early watering and Late watering for that day's routine water draw.

s.name: Mirror Recoating
s.description: An observatory and a mirror-coating contractor are coordinating a major telescope mirror recoating before the observing season. The observatory chooses Full Recoat or Spot Recoat, while the contractor chooses Rush Schedule or Careful Schedule for carrying out the work.

s.name: Canal Lock Slots
s.description: An upstream barge cooperative and a downstream barge cooperative are scheduling regular passages through the same canal lock. Each cooperative chooses either First Window or Second Window for its scheduled passage.

s.name: Wool Mill Scheduling
s.description: Two neighboring wool cooperatives are arranging access to a local wool-scouring mill. Each cooperative chooses between making a firm reservation for scouring capacity and using flexible booking instead.

s.name: Dome Scheduling
s.description: Two astronomy teams are coordinating modest observing time in a shared observatory dome. Team A chooses an Early session or a Late session, while Team B chooses a Narrow-field setup or a Wide-field setup for its work.

s.name: Tournament Ice Renewal
s.description: The arena manager must choose between Full Resurface and Quick Patch for the rink before a season-defining tournament. The tournament organizer must choose between Peak Slot and Off-Peak Slot for when the resurfacing work is scheduled.

s.name: Local Film Release
s.description: A neighborhood cinema and an independent film distributor are coordinating the release of an upcoming film. The cinema chooses between Early Screening and Later Screening, while the distributor chooses between Wide Opening and Staggered Opening.

s.name: Canal Shift Exchange
s.description: Two lock-keepers at neighboring canal locks must settle coverage for a demanding navigation season. Each chooses between Keep Roster, retaining assigned shifts, and Swap Shifts, trading coverage with the other keeper before the schedule is finalized.

s.name: Shared Osier Bed
s.description: Two neighboring basket makers share a small osier bed and are making a routine cutting choice. The first chooses Light cut or Close cut for the stems, while the second chooses Early cut or Late cut for the same bed.

s.name: Marathon Detour
s.description: A city traffic coordinator and a marathon organizer are coordinating a small neighborhood race. The coordinator chooses between “Early Closure” and “Late Closure,” while the organizer chooses between “Short Detour” and “Long Detour” for the affected route.

s.name: Marsh Grazing Schedule
s.description: Two neighboring smallholders share seasonal salt-marsh grazing rights. Each chooses whether to schedule their herd for the marsh's early or late grazing turn.

s.name: National Archive Digitisation
s.description: A national archive and a digitisation contractor are coordinating a major project involving historically important collections. The archive chooses between Full Scan and Selective Scan, while the contractor chooses between Open Release and Restricted Release for the resulting digital archive.

s.name: Co-op Milk Pricing
s.description: A dairy co-op chooses between Stable price and Flexible price for its weekly milk offer, while a neighborhood grocer chooses between Regular order and Adjusted order. They make these routine pricing and ordering choices for the same week's delivery.

s.name: Canal Shift Swap
s.description: Two senior lock-keepers must staff adjoining locks on a major canal serving farms and cities during a critical operating window. Each lock-keeper chooses between keeping the assigned shift and arranging a shift swap.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Shift
s.description: Two small saffron growers are coordinating a modest harvest-day labor exchange. Grower A chooses either “Early Picking” or “Late Picking,” while Grower B chooses either “Shared Basket” or “Separate Basket.”

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: A small beekeeper and a neighboring farm manager are arranging where the apiary will sit through winter. The beekeeper chooses Field Margin or Barn Shelter, while the farm manager chooses North Access or South Access for the service route.

s.name: Small Letterpress Run
s.description: A neighborhood printmaker and a local bookseller are coordinating a small letterpress run. The printmaker chooses Light Inking or Firm Inking, while the bookseller chooses Early Proof or Final Proof.

s.name: Flour Supply Contract
s.description: A national bakery chain and a flour mill are arranging a high-stakes supply order for the bakery’s production season. The bakery chooses between “Spot purchase” and “Annual contract,” while the mill chooses between “Rush shipment” and “Scheduled shipment.”

s.name: Dune Fence Placement
s.description: A coastal municipality and a resort operator each decide where to place a protective fence along their adjoining dune sections. Each chooses between a Seaward Fence and a Landward Fence for its section.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations
s.description: For the coming shipping season, a harbour authority and a pilot cooperative are setting the harbour's rotation policy. The authority chooses between Fixed Rotation and Flexible Rotation, while the cooperative chooses between Seniority Roster and Balanced Roster.

s.name: Small Port Dredging
s.description: The local port office chooses whether to schedule a small dredging job for the Early Window or Late Window. The dredging crew chooses between a Steady Pace and a Brief Pause pattern during that window.

s.name: Canal Shift Swap
s.description: Two lock-keepers at a small canal lock are arranging their ordinary shifts. The first chooses whether to keep the assigned shift or request a swap, while the second chooses whether to accept the swap or keep the existing roster.

s.name: Orchard Falconry
s.description: Two neighboring orchard stewards are arranging falconry for routine pest control. Each steward chooses whether to Release Falcon over the shared orchard area or Hold Falcon for the day.

s.name: Harvest Press Schedule
s.description: A regional cider maker and a cooperative press operator are arranging bookings for the coming harvest season. The cider maker chooses Early Booking or Flexible Booking, while the press operator chooses Reserved Slot or Open Slot.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A heritage property manager is deciding whether the season's stone wall repair should be commissioned as Full restoration or Patch repair. A masonry contractor is preparing either a Firm bid or a Flexible bid for that work.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A masonry contractor is preparing a bid to repair a substantial stone wall before the next building season. The property manager must choose between Quick Award and Careful Review, while the contractor chooses between Lean Bid and Full Bid.

s.name: Stadium Concession Pricing
s.description: A stadium's primary concession operator and a licensed pop-up vendor are setting pricing for a high-attendance season. The operator chooses Premium Pricing or Value Pricing, while the pop-up vendor chooses Premium Pricing or Value Pricing.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A regional bat-monitoring team and a cave-reserve manager are planning a season-important survey night. The team chooses between Night Transect and Acoustic Stations, while the manager chooses between Guided Access and Quiet Closure for organizing the night’s monitoring and site access.

s.name: Seasonal Cable Ferry Plan
s.description: A cable-ferry operator and a regional transport authority are planning service for a demanding crossing season. The operator chooses between Steady Crossing and Rapid Crossing, while the authority chooses between Peak Dispatch and Staggered Dispatch for arranging vehicles at the ferry.

s.name: Harvest Sourcing Terms
s.description: A regional coffee roastery and its origin-supply partner are setting terms for the coming harvest. The roastery chooses between Premium Lot and Spot Lot, while the partner chooses between Full Contract and Flexible Contract.

s.name: Wind-Farm Maintenance
s.description: A wind-farm operator chooses Early overhaul or Deferred overhaul for a major turbine cluster. The specialist maintenance contractor chooses Crew reserve or Crew release for the season’s service plan.

s.name: Dairy Contract Pricing
s.description: A regional dairy cooperative and a major milk processor are making a high-stakes decision about the cooperative’s next major milk contract. The cooperative chooses between Hold Price and Cut Price, while the processor chooses between Sign Contract and Walk Away.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A marathon race director chooses between Early Closure and Late Closure for the course roads. The city traffic agency chooses between Full Detour and Partial Detour while coordinating the event’s road-closure plan.

s.name: Orchard Pollination Contract
s.description: An orchard owner and a local beekeeper are arranging a pollination contract for a small orchard. The orchard owner chooses between a full hive service and a shared-hive plan, while the beekeeper chooses between an early-season visit and a midseason visit.

s.name: Shared Kiln Timing
s.description: Two neighboring pottery studios share a small test kiln for a routine batch of glazed cups. Each studio chooses between a Gentle Ramp and a Quick Ramp firing schedule for its own work.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring farmers share a small silage clamp for an ordinary feed batch. Farmer A chooses between Early covering and Late covering, while Farmer B chooses between Light packing and Firm packing as their respective ways to fine-tune the shared clamp.

s.name: Hut Resupply Timing
s.description: A mountain hut caretaker and a local resupply volunteer are coordinating a small restocking run. The caretaker chooses between Trim Order and Extra Item, while the volunteer chooses between Morning Drop and Afternoon Drop.

s.name: Wool Scouring Schedule
s.description: A small wool cooperative chooses whether to send its next fleece lot in an Early Batch or Late Batch. The nearby shared scouring workshop chooses whether to tune its capacity for an Early Wash or Late Wash.

s.name: Archive Digitisation Partnership
s.description: A regional archive is planning a major digitisation season with a university publishing partner. The archive chooses between Batch Scanning and Curated Scanning, while the partner chooses between Open Metadata and Restricted Metadata for the digitised collection.

s.name: Roastery Sourcing
s.description: Two small coffee roasters are adjusting their weekly sourcing plans. Each chooses between a House Blend and a Single Origin for the next roast.

s.name: Migration Ringing Schedule
s.description: Two bird-ringing teams, North Fen Research Group and River Marsh Trust, must each choose a station slot for a high-stakes migration season. Each team can request the Prime Slot or the Backup Slot, coordinating their fieldwork around the station’s limited schedule and their seasonal commitments.

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queues
s.description: Two independent record labels are planning important vinyl releases during the same pressing season. Label A chooses between Regular Queue and Priority Queue for its pressing run, while Label B chooses between Early Booking and Flexible Booking for its own run.

s.name: Peatland Fine-Tuning
s.description: Two neighboring peat-bog caretakers are making a small restoration adjustment on adjoining plots. Caretaker A chooses between Light raking, a modest surface clearing, and No raking; Caretaker B chooses between Low bund, a slight water-holding ridge, and Open trickle, a narrow drainage path.

s.name: Substrate Season Contract
s.description: A commercial mushroom grower chooses between a Spot Order and a Season Contract for its substrate supply. The substrate producer chooses between Flexible Batching and Reserved Capacity for arranging that season's supply. The choices concern how the grower's substrate allocation is arranged.

s.name: Vineyard Falconry
s.description: Two neighboring vineyard managers are coordinating season-long falconry pest control. Manager A chooses between Perimeter Flights and Interior Flights for the falcon team, while Manager B chooses between Dawn Releases and Dusk Releases for its team.

s.name: Cheese Cave Ripening
s.description: Two cheesemakers, Mira and Jules, share a small cheese cave while ripening a batch. Mira chooses between Gentle turning and Firm turning of the wheels, while Jules chooses between a Narrow vent and a Wide vent for the cave.

s.name: Telescope Mirror Recoating
s.description: A major observatory is arranging the recoating of its flagship telescope mirror with a specialized optical-coatings firm. The observatory chooses between Full Recoat and Spot Recoat, while the firm chooses between Deep Cure and Rapid Cure.

s.name: Salt Pan Sale
s.description: A family-run salt-pan owner, whose seasonal sales are central to the household income, chooses between Early Harvest and Full Cure for the salt. A local grocer, for whom salt is only one of several product lines, chooses between Spot Pickup and Storage Order.

s.name: Seasonal Flour Contract
s.description: A regional bakery chain is arranging a substantial seasonal flour order with its mill supplier. The bakery chooses between Bulk Order and Flexible Order, while the supplier chooses between Priority Allocation and Standard Allocation for handling the contract.

s.name: Thatching Crew Rotas
s.description: Two thatching crews are planning their rotas for a demanding season of heritage-roof contracts. Each crew must choose between an Early Rota, with its main work scheduled sooner, and a Late Rota, with its main work scheduled later.

s.name: Antique Cabinet Bid
s.description: A neighborhood antiques shop and a freelance restoration studio are preparing a bid for a modest cabinet restoration. The shop chooses between a Basic Bid and a Full Bid, while the studio chooses between a Quick Turnaround and a Careful Turnaround.

s.name: Mountain Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain hut manager and a local porter coordinator are arranging a routine resupply. The manager chooses between Full Restock and Lean Restock, while the coordinator chooses between Direct Carry and Relay Carry.

s.name: Mirror Recoating
s.description: An observatory technician is deciding whether to give a small telescope mirror a fine polish or leave the surface as it is. A coating specialist is choosing between applying a fresh coat and making a touch-up to the existing coating.

s.name: Orchard Falcon Pass
s.description: A falconer and a small orchard keeper are arranging a routine falconry pass to deter a few pests. The falconer chooses between Close Pass and Wide Pass, while the orchard keeper chooses between Early Release and Late Release as a fine adjustment to the release timing.

s.name: Coppice Rotation Pact
s.description: Two neighboring forestry cooperatives jointly manage a large coppice woodland and must each choose a cutting cycle. For each cooperative, Early Rotation means harvesting its coppice sooner, while Late Rotation means leaving it growing for a longer cycle. Their decisions concern the future management of the woodland and the cooperatives’ livelihoods.

s.name: Handbell Batch
s.description: A small bell foundry is planning an ordinary batch of handbells, while a local bell retailer coordinates the order. The foundry chooses between “Quick Pour” and “Measured Pour,” and the retailer chooses between “Flexible Order” and “Firm Order.”

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: Two neighboring beekeepers, Lena and Omar, are choosing where to place their apiaries for the winter. Lena chooses between Sheltered Grove and Orchard Edge, while Omar makes the same choice for the apiary on his side of the neighboring land.

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queue
s.description: An independent record label and a local pressing plant are coordinating a vinyl pressing queue for a small release. The label chooses Standard Queue or Rush Queue, while the plant chooses Reserve Slot or Fill Queue for its available production capacity.

s.name: Small Bell Casting
s.description: A bell founder and a tuning lead are preparing one small bell. The founder chooses between a Narrow gate and a Wide gate for the pour, while the tuning lead chooses between a Gentle cool and a Firm cool for the mold.

s.name: Bakery Supply Orders
s.description: A neighborhood bakery and its local flour supplier are arranging a small weekly supply order. The bakery chooses a morning or afternoon ordering window, while the supplier chooses standard or flexible packing for the shipment.

s.name: Local Taproom Delivery
s.description: A small microbrewery and a neighborhood bottle shop are arranging a modest weekly delivery. The brewery chooses between Standard Delivery and Flexible Delivery, while the shop chooses between Regular Display and Featured Display.

s.name: Planetarium Show Slots
s.description: A planetarium director chooses between an Early show and a Late show for an evening booking. A visiting astronomy presenter chooses between a Short program and a Full program for the same booking.

s.name: Shared Cider Press
s.description: A small orchard cooperative and a nearby independent grower are booking time at the same cider press. The cooperative chooses Early booking or Late booking, while the grower chooses Flexible slot or Fixed slot.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: Two small glacier-survey flight teams are coordinating brief mapping passes over nearby ice fields. The first team chooses between a Close transect and a Wide transect, while the second chooses between an Early pass and a Late pass.

s.name: Cheese Cave Ripening
s.description: A cheese cooperative and a specialty distributor are arranging a high-stakes ripening run in a shared cheese cave. The cooperative chooses between Rapid Ripening and Slow Ripening, while the distributor chooses between Early Release and Extended Aging.

s.name: Riverside Cable Ferry
s.description: A cable-ferry operator and a delivery driver arriving at a rural landing must each choose how to handle the next crossing. The operator chooses between Normal Pull and Delay Crossing, while the driver chooses between Board Now and Wait Ashore.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease
s.description: A major coastal oyster company is negotiating access to a commercially vital oyster bed with a state marine agency. The company chooses between Larger Lease and Current Lease, while the agency chooses between Open Auction and Direct Renewal.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotation
s.description: Two harbour pilot coordinators are fine-tuning a small routine rotation. Coordinator A chooses between “Tide Handoff” and “Pier Handoff,” while Coordinator B chooses whether to assign its pilot to the “First Rotation” or the “Second Rotation.”

s.name: Puppet Tour Scheduling
s.description: A touring puppet troupe and a neighborhood arts center are arranging a modest local run. The troupe chooses between an early or late load-in, while the arts center chooses whether to schedule the shows on weekdays or weekends.

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queue
s.description: A major record label and a vinyl pressing plant are setting terms for a high-stakes release. The label chooses between Rush Pressing and Hold Slot, while the plant chooses between Reserve Capacity and Release Capacity.

s.name: City Hive Siting
s.description: A neighborhood beekeeper and a city parks planner are deciding how an urban hive project will be sited. The beekeeper chooses between Rooftop Apiary and Courtyard Apiary, while the planner chooses between Street Buffer and Park Partnership.

s.name: Alpine Hut Resupply
s.description: A remote mountain-hut cooperative and a helicopter operator are coordinating a high-stakes resupply before severe weather closes the route. The cooperative chooses between Early Stocking and Late Stocking, while the operator chooses between Heavy Lift and Light Lift.

s.name: Dyeing Shift Coordination
s.description: A small garment workshop and its dye-material supplier are coordinating textile dyeing shifts. The workshop chooses Day Shift or Evening Shift, while the supplier chooses Morning Delivery or Evening Delivery for the dye batches.

s.name: Seasonal Card Run
s.description: A small letterpress studio and a local stationery shop are arranging a print run of seasonal cards. The studio chooses Short run or Extended run, while the shop chooses Early pickup or Flexible pickup for receiving them.

s.name: Emergency Rope Ferry
s.description: A rope-ferry operator and a county emergency coordinator must set the crossing's operating plan during a high-water evacuation period. The operator chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew, while the coordinator chooses between Open Route and Hold Route.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: The north-slope and south-slope avalanche patrol coordinators are arranging their routine rosters. Each coordinator chooses between assigning their patrol to the dawn shift or the midday shift.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flight
s.description: A glacier-survey pilot and a field mapper are arranging one routine flight over a short section of ice. The pilot chooses Low Pass or High Pass, and the mapper chooses Early Turn or Late Turn for the flight plan.

s.name: Salt Pan Harvest
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan operators, A and B, are planning how to harvest their adjoining pans during the day. Each chooses between Early Skimming and Late Skimming for their own pan.

s.name: Seasonal Seaweed Racks
s.description: A coastal seaweed cooperative and a neighboring seaweed processor are coordinating use of shared drying racks during the peak harvest season. The cooperative chooses between “Early loading” and “Late loading,” while the processor chooses between “Open vents” and “Closed vents.”

s.name: Canal Lock Schedule
s.description: A regional canal authority and a major freight operator must coordinate a high-stakes lock schedule before a season-critical convoy. The authority chooses Release Surge or Hold Water, while the operator chooses Rush Freight or Stage Freight.

s.name: Cheese Cave Schedule
s.description: A small cheesemaker and a shared cheese-cave steward are coordinating the ripening of a batch. The cheesemaker chooses between Early Release and Full Ripening, while the steward chooses between Cool Airflow and Steady Airflow.

s.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
s.description: Two neighboring ferry operators are coordinating departures on a shared everyday route. Operator A chooses either the Morning Slot or the Afternoon Slot, while Operator B chooses either the Morning Slot or the Afternoon Slot for its service.

s.name: Rope Ferry Routine
s.description: A rope-ferry operator and a crossing assistant are adjusting the routine for a short, ordinary crossing. The operator chooses between “Fine Tune” and “Keep Pace,” while the assistant chooses between “Steady Pull” and “Easy Pull.”

s.name: The Osier Bed Contract
s.description: A regional basketworks cooperative and a landowner must decide how to manage a commercially vital osier bed for the coming harvest. The cooperative chooses between Early cutting and Delayed cutting, while the landowner chooses between Light cutting and Heavy cutting.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: Two local bat survey coordinators are planning a small survey night. The first chooses between Quiet Setup and Active Setup for the recording area, while the second chooses between Early Start and Late Start for the survey schedule.

s.name: Dyeing Shift Coordination
s.description: A large textile mill and its dye supplier are coordinating a high-stakes dyeing shift for a major production run. The mill chooses between Rush Shift and Standard Shift, while the supplier chooses between Premium Dye and Economy Dye.

s.name: Orchard Frost Watch
s.description: An orchard manager and a nearby beekeeper coordinate an overnight frost watch for the orchard. The manager chooses between Sensor Sweep and Quiet Watch, while the beekeeper chooses between Early Call and No Call.

s.name: Turbine Tune-Up
s.description: A wind-farm technician chooses between Light Tuning and Full Tuning for a routine turbine adjustment. The site's maintenance coordinator chooses between an Early Window and a Late Window for scheduling that adjustment.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Windows
s.description: An upstream water authority and a downstream flood-control agency must each choose a maintenance window for a jointly operated weir. Each is choosing between an Early Window and a Late Window, with the timing affecting a major shared water-management operation.

s.name: Marathon Traffic Plan
s.description: A city marathon organizer chooses between Full Closure and Rolling Closure for the race route. A regional transit authority chooses between Early Detour and Late Detour for rerouting traffic while the marathon passes.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A small glacier research team and a local flight operator are planning a survey flight. The research team chooses Morning Launch or Afternoon Launch, while the operator chooses Flexible Routing or Fixed Routing.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Crisis
s.description: A national herbarium is considering a loan request for specimens needed by an international research consortium. The herbarium chooses between Full Loan and Limited Loan, while the consortium chooses between Urgent Project and Staged Project.

s.name: Canal Shift Swap
s.description: Two neighboring lock-keepers are arranging a small shift swap for an ordinary canal lock. Each chooses whether to keep the assigned shift or swap shifts with the other lock-keeper.

s.name: Mountain Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain-hut cooperative and an alpine logistics firm are coordinating a high-stakes resupply for a remote hut. The cooperative chooses between Emergency Stock and Routine Stock, while the logistics firm chooses between Direct Flight and Staged Flight.

s.name: Canal Lock Scheduling
s.description: A canal authority chooses between reserving a Priority Slot or arranging Staggered Slots for a major freight movement. A shipping consortium chooses between sending a Rush Convoy or using a Spread Convoy through the lock system.

s.name: Canal Shift Swap
s.description: Mira and Jon are lock-keepers at two nearby canal locks arranging a small roster adjustment. Mira chooses either “Keep Shift,” leaving her assigned shift unchanged, or “Swap Shift,” offering it for a one-shift exchange; Jon makes the same choice for his assignment.

s.name: Brewery Distribution
s.description: A small microbrewery is deciding whether to handle a local delivery route itself or use a distributor deal. The distributor is deciding whether to give the brewery a feature tap placement or a routine listing in its accounts.

s.name: Greenhouse Heat Sharing
s.description: Two neighboring greenhouse growers coordinate their overnight heating. The first grower chooses between Release Heat and Retain Heat, while the second chooses between Take Shared Heat and Run Heaters.

s.name: Eel Pass Check
s.description: A stream steward is arranging a routine inspection of a small eel pass and chooses between Quick Check and Careful Check. A nearby mill operator chooses between Clear Debris and Leave It before the inspection.

s.name: Seaweed Rack Scheduling
s.description: A coastal seaweed grower and a local processor coordinate use of a set of seaweed drying racks. The grower chooses either Open racks or Covered racks, while the processor chooses either Morning collection or Evening collection.

s.name: Stone Wall Repair Bids
s.description: A homeowner is seeking a bid for a modest stone wall repair and chooses whether to provide a full scope or a brief scope of the work. A local mason chooses whether to prepare a detailed bid or a lean bid.

s.name: Library Acquisitions
s.description: A university library is planning a major seasonal acquisitions package and chooses between Core Collection and Selective Bundle. An academic press coordinating with the library chooses between Early Release and Standard Release for the package's licensing schedule.

s.name: Substrate Commitments
s.description: A commercial mushroom grower is arranging substrate for the coming production season and must choose between Lock Contract and Spot Buy. The substrate supplier must choose between Reserve Batch and Open Allocation for handling the grower's order.

s.name: Tundra Migration
s.description: Two reindeer-herding cooperatives must coordinate their seasonal migration plans across the same vulnerable tundra corridor. The first cooperative chooses Northern Route or Southern Route, while the second chooses Early Crossing or Late Crossing.

s.name: Avalanche Roster
s.description: A municipal avalanche-patrol coordinator is scheduling the team's short route check either before opening or near closing: Early Sweep or Late Sweep. A trail volunteer with a limited reporting role chooses which short section to note, Ridge Check or Valley Check.

s.name: Planetarium Scheduling
s.description: A planetarium manager and an astronomy club coordinator are arranging an evening show. The planetarium manager chooses the Prime Slot or Late Slot, while the astronomy club coordinator chooses a Long Feature or Short Feature.

s.name: Shared Telescope Tuning
s.description: Two small astronomy teams are arranging short observations on the same radio telescope. Team A chooses between Quick calibration and Careful calibration, while Team B chooses between Quiet band and Busy band for its observing setup.

s.name: Small Wool Scour
s.description: Two nearby wool scouring mills are coordinating their ordinary weekly processing plans. Mill A chooses between Steady washing and Extra capacity, while Mill B makes the same choice for its own scouring schedule.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: Two neighboring quarry operators coordinate their daily blasting windows to keep shared local work schedules orderly. Each operator chooses either a Morning Blast or an Afternoon Blast window.

s.name: Small Coffee Order
s.description: A small coffee roastery is arranging a modest bean order and chooses between Local Farm and Usual Co-op sourcing. A nearby café chooses between Whole Beans and Grind Adjustment for how it receives the order.

s.name: Wind-Farm Maintenance
s.description: A wind-farm operator and its maintenance contractor are coordinating a major seasonal service plan. The operator chooses between Early overhaul and Routine service, while the contractor chooses between Reserve crew and Standard crew.

s.name: Seasonal Milk Pricing
s.description: A dairy co-op and a supermarket chain are negotiating the pricing structure for the co-op’s seasonal milk supply. The co-op chooses Stable price or Premium price, while the supermarket chooses Shelf contract or Spot contract for the season.

s.name: Marsh Grazing Season
s.description: A coastal cattle cooperative chooses either Early Grazing or Late Grazing for its herd's use of contested salt-marsh grazing rights. A conservation trust chooses either Grant Permit or Withhold Permit for the season's access terms, with the decision affecting an important grazing season and marsh-management budget.

s.name: Shared Osier Bed
s.description: Two neighboring osier growers share an osier bed and decide when to harvest their portions. Grower A chooses Early cutting or Late cutting, while Grower B makes the same choice for the adjacent portion.

s.name: Seasonal Coffee Sourcing
s.description: A coffee roastery and a coffee-growing cooperative are negotiating a seasonal sourcing arrangement. The roastery chooses Spot Purchase or Forward Contract, while the cooperative chooses Standard Lot or Reserve Lot.

s.name: Saffron Picking Contract
s.description: A saffron-growing cooperative chooses between organizing Peak Crews or Lean Crews for the brief stigma-picking season. A regional labor contractor chooses between an Early Contract and a Flexible Contract for supplying pickers. The arrangement covers the cooperative’s harvest labor and the contractor’s seasonal service.

s.name: Lift Grooming Schedule
s.description: A ski resort's grooming supervisor chooses between Early Grooming and Late Grooming for a lift. A ski school coordinator chooses between Morning Lessons and Afternoon Lessons when scheduling classes for that lift.

s.name: Quarterly Library Buying
s.description: A county library acquisitions director chooses whether the library’s quarterly order emphasizes Core Titles or Experimental Titles. A small local publisher chooses whether to present its catalog with a Standard Pitch or a Premium Pitch.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring dairy farms share one silage clamp for storing their winter feed. Farm A chooses Early Loading or Late Loading, and Farm B independently chooses Early Loading or Late Loading.

s.name: Orchard Contract Tune-Up
s.description: Two neighboring orchard growers are fine-tuning a small harvest contract. Grower A chooses either Early pickup or Flexible pickup, while Grower B chooses either Shared crates or Separate crates.

s.name: Eel Pass Review
s.description: A regional fisheries office is reviewing eel passes at a major river dam and chooses between Routine Inspection and Full Inspection. The dam operator chooses between Open Records and Limited Records for the inspection period.

s.name: Seasonal Raptor Control
s.description: An orchard cooperative and a licensed falconer are coordinating seasonal falconry pest control for an important harvest. The cooperative chooses between Broad Release and Targeted Release for deploying hawks, while the falconer chooses between Day Patrols and Dusk Patrols.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Terms
s.description: A regional herbarium and a university botanical institute are arranging a season-critical loan of valuable plant specimens. The herbarium chooses between Priority Loan and Standard Loan, while the institute chooses between Accept Terms and Request Revisions.

s.name: Cave Season
s.description: A cheesemaker managing a valuable seasonal batch chooses between Early Release and Deep Ripening. The cheese-cave operator chooses between Shared Cave and Private Cave for the batch.

s.name: Shared Alpine Corridor
s.description: North Peak Ski Area and South Peak Ski Area share a high-alpine lift corridor central to their winter operations. Each resort chooses between Overnight Grooming and Minimal Grooming for the corridor under its control.

s.name: Shared Bog Restoration
s.description: A local peatland trust and a neighboring small farm are coordinating restoration of a shared peat bog. The trust chooses between “Block Ditches” and “Leave Ditches,” while the farm chooses between “Raise Weirs” and “Keep Flow.”

s.name: Critical Route Contract
s.description: Two major courier companies are bidding for a strategically important delivery contract whose award could substantially change both firms’ futures. Northstar chooses between Premium bid and Lean bid, while Meridian chooses between Premium bid and Lean bid.

s.name: Clocktower Chimes
s.description: A clockkeeper and a town events coordinator are preparing the small town clocktower for its regular chimes. The clockkeeper chooses between Fine Tune and Routine Check, while the coordinator chooses between Short Chime and Long Chime.

s.name: Seed Bank Exchange
s.description: A community seed bank and a regional seed bank are arranging an exchange of heritage seeds for the coming planting season. The community bank chooses between Standard packet and Diverse packet, while the regional bank chooses between Flexible terms and Fixed terms.

s.name: Morning Lift Prep
s.description: A ski area's grooming supervisor and lift-operations supervisor each choose a plan for preparing the ski-lift runs before opening. The grooming supervisor chooses Early Grooming or Late Grooming, while the lift-operations supervisor chooses Full Prep or Selective Prep.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease
s.description: A coastal oyster cooperative and a large seafood processor are negotiating control and purchasing arrangements for a major oyster bed lease. The cooperative chooses between Exclusive Lease and Shared Lease, while the processor chooses between Supply Commitment and Flexible Buying.

s.name: Ringing Station Slots
s.description: At a small bird-ringing station, the coordinator chooses between the Early Slot and the Late Slot for the session. A visiting volunteer chooses between the Short Setup and the Full Setup for preparing the station.

s.name: Canal Lock Scheduling
s.description: An upstream agricultural consortium and a downstream freight operator must schedule access to a strategically vital canal lock. The consortium chooses between Early Release and Late Release for its water shipments, while the freight operator chooses between Day Convoy and Night Convoy for its cargo fleet.

s.name: Estate Hedge Contract
s.description: A landowner and a specialist hedge-laying contractor are negotiating a major contract for an estate boundary. The landowner chooses Full restoration or Minimal restoration, while the contractor chooses Fixed schedule or Flexible schedule.

s.name: Championship Ice Resurfacing
s.description: A rink operator is preparing the ice for a major championship and must choose between Full Resurface and Quick Resurface. The championship organizer must choose between an Early Program and a Late Program for the event.

s.name: Observatory Dome Time
s.description: A university observatory's research astronomer and outreach coordinator are arranging one evening of dome time. The astronomer chooses either Short run or Long run, while the coordinator chooses either Public viewing or Team booking.

s.name: Harvest Lock Scheduling
s.description: A regional canal operator and a grain cooperative are coordinating a heavily booked canal lock for the coming harvest season. The operator chooses either Early Slot or Late Slot for the lock schedule, while the cooperative chooses either Consolidate Barges or Split Barges for its shipments.

s.name: The Archive Conversion Pact
s.description: A national archive is choosing between Full Scan and Selective Scan for a vast collection whose digitisation will shape access to important historical records. A rights consortium is choosing between Open Release and Licensed Release for the resulting digital archive.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: A tidal-energy operator and a marine service contractor coordinate servicing for a heavily used tidal turbine before a demanding operating season. The operator chooses between Early Overhaul and Deferred Overhaul, while the contractor chooses between Reserve Crew and Reassign Crew.

s.name: Clocktower Fine-Tuning
s.description: A town caretaker chooses whether to leave the clocktower escapement alone or tune it slightly. A visiting horologist chooses whether to adjust the chime timing or keep the chimes as they are.

s.name: Kiln Slot Timing
s.description: Two nearby small sawmills, Alder Creek and Millstone, are booking the shared kiln for a routine batch of boards. Alder Creek chooses an earlier or later slot, while Millstone chooses a morning or afternoon booking.

s.name: Mushroom Substrate Contracts
s.description: A commercial mushroom farm and its substrate supplier are setting terms for a substantial growing season. The farm chooses between Early Ordering and Spot Ordering, while the supplier chooses between Reserved Batch and Flexible Batch.

s.name: Truffle Permit Season
s.description: A regional truffle cooperative is choosing how its crew will operate under a seasonal foraging permit: Limited Harvest or Intensive Harvest. The woodland authority is choosing whether to Issue Permit or Withhold Permit for the season.

s.name: Salt Marsh Grazing
s.description: A small cattle cooperative and a neighboring family farm share seasonal salt-marsh grazing rights. The cooperative chooses Early Grazing or Late Grazing, while the family farm chooses Shared Gate or Separate Gate for moving animals through the marsh.

s.name: Roastery Sourcing
s.description: A small coffee roastery manager chooses between Standard Beans and Adjusted Beans for a fine-tuning change in a weekly blend. A nearby café buyer chooses between a Regular Order and a Trial Order for that blend.

s.name: Estate Hedge Contract
s.description: A large estate owner and a specialist contractor are negotiating a high-stakes hedge-laying contract. The owner chooses Dense hedge or Light hedge, while the contractor chooses Full crew or Lean crew.

s.name: Radio Telescope Scheduling
s.description: Two astronomy teams are planning observations on a heavily booked radio telescope for an important observing season. Team A chooses between Deep Survey and Rapid Follow-up, while Team B chooses between Early Window and Late Window for its program.

s.name: Kiln Booking
s.description: A small sawmill manager and a nearby furniture maker are arranging a kiln booking for a batch of boards. The sawmill chooses between an early slot and a late slot, while the furniture maker chooses between a full load and a partial load.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A small glacier survey team is choosing whether to fly its drone along a low or high transect. A second survey team planning the same day's nearby flight is choosing between an early pass and a late pass.

s.name: Shared Vineyard Watering
s.description: Two neighboring vineyard growers share a small irrigation canal. Each chooses between Morning watering and Evening watering for a routine watering round.

s.name: Valley Vineyard Water Plan
s.description: A vineyard consortium chooses between Deep Irrigation and Lean Irrigation for its vines, while a regional reservoir cooperative chooses between Early Release and Late Release of the shared irrigation water. They are setting the season’s water plan for a high-stakes harvest.

s.name: Canal Lock Scheduling
s.description: A canal authority is scheduling a high-stakes lock window for a major freight consortium. The authority chooses Dawn Release or Night Release, while the consortium chooses Bulk Convoy or Staggered Passage for moving its cargo through the lock.

s.name: Flagship Observatory Window
s.description: A lead space-observation team and a partner consortium are seeking time on the same rare, high-stakes observatory dome window. Each chooses whether to schedule its observing campaign early or late in the available window.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A glacier survey team is choosing between Dawn Departure and Midday Departure for its flight. A small charter operator is choosing between Direct Route and Staggered Route for arranging the survey flights.

s.name: Small Rope Ferry
s.description: A ferryperson and a dock assistant are staffing a small rope ferry. The ferryperson chooses between Steady Pull and Brief Pull, while the assistant chooses between Early Signal and Late Signal for coordinating a crossing.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations
s.description: The East Basin harbour pilot team and the West Basin harbour pilot team are arranging their daily pilot rotations. Each team chooses between its two rotation plans: East Basin selects Steady Rotation or Flexible Rotation, while West Basin selects Early Handoff or Late Handoff.

s.name: Falconry Pest Control
s.description: A large grain estate and a neighboring conservation trust must decide how to address a severe pest threat through falconry, with major consequences for both parties. The estate chooses between Release Falcons and Shelter Falcons, while the trust chooses between Open Corridors and Close Corridors for access across the adjoining land.

s.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
s.description: Two neighboring ferry operators, Northbank Ferries and Southbay Ferries, are setting their daily timetable slots. Northbank chooses between Morning Slot and Midday Slot, while Southbay chooses between Morning Slot and Midday Slot.

s.name: Salt Pan Harvesting
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan harvesters are deciding when to rake their small pans during the day. Each chooses either Early raking or Late raking for that day's harvest.

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queue
s.description: A small record label and a local vinyl pressing plant are deciding how to handle an upcoming album run. The label chooses between Rush pressing and Standard queue, while the plant chooses between Priority slot and Regular slot.

s.name: Cider Press Bookings
s.description: Two orchard cooperatives are arranging access to the same cider press for their harvest. Each cooperative chooses between a Firm Booking and a Flexible Booking.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Windows
s.description: The upstream weir operator and a downstream canal cooperative each schedule routine maintenance for their shared weir system. The upstream operator chooses either Early Window or Late Window, while the downstream cooperative chooses either Early Window or Late Window.

s.name: Coppice Cycle Planning
s.description: Two neighboring coppice owners are planning the cutting cycle for their adjoining woodland plots. Each chooses between a Short Rotation and a Long Rotation for the coming management period.

s.name: Scouring Reservations
s.description: A small wool cooperative and a neighboring wool processor are arranging access to a local wool-scouring plant. The cooperative chooses between Early Booking and Late Booking, while the processor chooses between Firm Reservation and Flexible Reservation.

s.name: Scholarly Collection Deal
s.description: A university library is deciding whether to acquire a scholarly series or a backfile archive for its collection. An academic press is choosing between offering a flexible license and a premium license for the acquisition.

s.name: Cave Batch Adjustment
s.description: A cheesemaker and a cave caretaker are making a small ripening adjustment for one batch in a cheese cave. The cheesemaker chooses between “Turn wheels” and “Leave wheels,” while the caretaker chooses between “Open vent” and “Keep vent.”

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A marathon organizer is planning a major city race and must choose between Full Closure, keeping the course roads closed throughout the event, and Rolling Closure, reopening each road after runners pass. The city's traffic agency must choose between Early Detours, diverting traffic before race morning, and Late Detours, beginning diversions as the race unfolds.

s.name: Rare Archive Acquisition
s.description: A national library and a university library are deciding how to pursue the acquisition of a unique archive with major scholarly value. The national library chooses between Direct Offer and Consortium Bid, while the university library makes the same choice.

s.name: Mirror Recoating Contract
s.description: A major observatory and a precision-optics contractor are coordinating the recoating of a valuable telescope mirror. The observatory chooses Full Recoat or Patch Recoat, while the contractor chooses Rush Slot or Standard Slot for the work.

s.name: Vineyard Irrigation
s.description: A small vineyard manager chooses between Morning drip and Evening drip for a section of vines. A neighboring water steward chooses between Steady flow and Brief pulse for the shared irrigation line.

s.name: Woodland Permit Choices
s.description: Two neighboring weekend truffle foragers, Mira and Jo, are arranging permits for a small woodland. Mira chooses between the Dawn slot and the Later slot, while Jo chooses between the Creek patch and the Oak patch.

s.name: Routine Kiln Booking
s.description: A small sawmill and a nearby cabinet maker are coordinating a routine kiln booking for a modest batch of boards. The sawmill chooses Early Slot or Late Slot, while the cabinet maker chooses Flexible Pickup or Fixed Pickup.

s.name: Cider Press Bookings
s.description: Two large cider producers are arranging access to a regional cider press, with their harvest contracts tied to the booking. Orchard North chooses between Early Booking and Flexible Booking, while Orchard South chooses between Peak Slot and Off-Peak Slot.

s.name: Substrate Arrangement
s.description: A small mushroom grower chooses between a Standing Order and a Spot Order for substrate. A nearby substrate supplier chooses between preparing a Fresh Mix and using a Reserve Mix for the arrangement.

s.name: Vineyard Water Planning
s.description: A vineyard manager chooses between Early watering and Delayed watering for the growing season. A neighboring grower chooses between Reserved allocation and Spot allocation for irrigation water.

s.name: Coppice Cycle Planning
s.description: A woodland manager is planning the cutting cycle for a coppice stand. The manager chooses between Short Cycle and Long Cycle, while a nearby biomass cooperative chooses between Early Pickup and Late Pickup for arranging its collection schedule.

s.name: Osier Bed Timing
s.description: Two neighboring osier growers are deciding how to time their small osier-bed cutting. Grower A chooses “Early cut” or “Late cut,” while Grower B chooses “Early cut” or “Late cut” for the adjacent bed.

s.name: Observatory Dome Time
s.description: A university observatory coordinator handles the evening program and chooses between Open Dome and Hold Dome. A visiting astronomy-club volunteer joins the program and chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot for the same evening’s dome time.

s.name: Milk Contract Pricing
s.description: A regional dairy cooperative is setting the price for a major milk-supply contract, choosing between Hold Price and Cut Price. A large dairy processor must simultaneously choose between Honor Contract and Demand Discount.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: Two commercial beekeepers, North Ridge Apiary and Valley Bloom Apiary, are choosing winter locations for their hives in the same agricultural region. North Ridge Apiary chooses between Orchard Shelter and Upland Yard, while Valley Bloom Apiary chooses between Orchard Shelter and Upland Yard.

s.name: Oyster Bed Boundaries
s.description: Two neighboring oyster growers are renewing adjacent small oyster-bed leases. Each chooses whether to leave a tight buffer or a wide buffer along the shared boundary.

s.name: Mirror Recoating Contract
s.description: A major observatory and its telescope-mirror recoating contractor must coordinate a high-stakes restoration. The observatory chooses between Full Recoat, replacing the mirror coating across the entire surface, and Spot Recoat, treating only selected areas; the contractor chooses between Deep Cure, using a longer curing process, and Fast Cure, using an accelerated process.

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring dairy farms are arranging their seasonal use of a shared silage clamp. Farm A chooses Early Loading or Delayed Loading, while Farm B chooses Priority Booking or Flexible Booking.

s.name: Stadium Concessions
s.description: Two concession operators are setting prices for competing stands at the same stadium over the coming season. Each operator chooses between Value Pricing and Premium Pricing for its stand.

s.name: Osier Bed Timing
s.description: Two neighboring osier growers are tending sections of the same small osier bed. Each chooses whether to do their cutting early or late in the season.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Tuning
s.description: A small tidal-turbine operator chooses between a Routine check and Fine tuning for a minor servicing task. The servicing crew chooses between an Early visit and a Deferred visit.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: Two major quarry operators work on adjoining faces of the same mountain and must schedule a blasting window for their next extraction round. Operator A chooses between Early Blast and Late Blast, while Operator B chooses between Early Blast and Late Blast.

s.name: Cave-Ripening Contract
s.description: A regional cheese cooperative and a cave owner must coordinate a high-stakes cheese-ripening contract. The cooperative chooses between Early Release and Extended Ripening, while the cave owner chooses between Open Venting and Seal Cave.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A city transportation department and a marathon organizer are coordinating road access for a marquee race. The department chooses between Full Closure and Rolling Closure, while the organizer chooses between Early Start and Late Start.

s.name: Substrate Blend Order
s.description: A small mushroom grower chooses between Gentle Mix and Firm Mix for a routine substrate order. A nearby substrate supplier chooses between Quick Delivery and Held Delivery for that same order.

s.name: Shared Greenhouse Heat
s.description: Two neighboring hobby greenhouse growers, Mira and Leo, are fine-tuning heat exchange on a cool evening. Mira chooses whether to Open vent or Close vent, while Leo chooses whether to Share warmth with the neighboring greenhouse or Hold warmth inside his own.

s.name: Coppice Cycle Planning
s.description: A small coppice plot is managed jointly by a woodland steward and a nearby firewood cooperative. The steward chooses between Early cutting and Later cutting, while the cooperative chooses between Early cutting and Later cutting for its own work cycle.

s.name: Harvest Sourcing
s.description: A coffee roastery and a green-bean cooperative are planning their sourcing for the next harvest season. The roastery chooses between Long Contract and Spot Buying, while the cooperative chooses between Premium Lot and Standard Lot.

s.name: Salt-Marsh Grazing
s.description: A small salt-marsh grazier chooses between Early grazing and Late grazing for a routine allotment. A neighboring grazier chooses between Shared track and Separate track for moving animals through the marsh.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease Plans
s.description: Two oyster companies are making seasonal plans for adjacent oyster-bed leases. Company A chooses either “Renew Early” or “Wait to Renew,” while Company B chooses either “Share Access” or “Reserve Access” for the same beds. The companies make these choices as part of arranging their seasonal lease plans.

s.name: Critical Lift Grooming
s.description: A major ski resort's operations director chooses between Overnight Grooming and Minimal Grooming for a critical lift network. The regional mountain-safety coordinator chooses between Open Lifts and Hold Lifts for that same network.

s.name: Shared Vineyard Canal
s.description: A vineyard manager with a large block chooses between Deep watering and Light watering for the vines. A neighboring small-vineyard grower who helps coordinate their shared canal chooses between Release now and Release later.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A glacier survey pilot chooses between a Centered Pass and a Slight Offset for the flight line. An onboard camera operator chooses between Standard Capture and Shifted Capture for when to take the close-up set.

s.name: Cider Press Bookings
s.description: For the coming harvest, two cider producers are arranging access to the same commercial cider press, with the booking choice affecting a season’s budget and reputation. Producer A chooses either Early Booking or Late Booking, while Producer B independently chooses either Early Booking or Late Booking.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: A commercial beekeeper chooses between placing the hives in a Sheltered Grove or an Open Pasture for winter. A neighboring orchard manager chooses between arranging a Shared Shelter or maintaining a Separate Yard for the nearby apiary.

s.name: Relief Shift Tuning
s.description: At a small lighthouse, Keeper A chooses between a quick handoff and a careful handoff for the routine relief shift. Keeper B chooses whether to make the lamp check early or late during that same shift.

s.name: Frame Restoration Bid
s.description: A small antiques shop owner and a local restorer are discussing a modest bid to fine-tune an old picture frame. The shop owner chooses Minimal Retouch or Careful Retouch for the requested work, while the restorer chooses Quick Quote or Detailed Quote for presenting the bid.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Crews
s.description: A saffron estate chooses between Early Hiring and Late Hiring for its seasonal harvest labor. A labor cooperative chooses between Reserve Crews for that estate and Flexible Crews available across growers.

s.name: Orchard Pollination Contract
s.description: A large orchard cooperative and a regional beekeeper consortium are negotiating a high-stakes pollination contract for the coming bloom. The cooperative chooses Full Orchard or Targeted Blocks, while the consortium chooses Early Arrival or Flexible Arrival.

s.name: Small Sawmill Kiln Booking
s.description: A small sawmill manager and a nearby kiln operator are arranging one ordinary batch of boards. The sawmill manager chooses between Early booking and Flexible booking, while the kiln operator chooses between Hold slot and Release slot.

s.name: Continental Rail Corridor
s.description: A freight railway and a port authority must set the operating plan for a major rail corridor. The railway chooses between Night Dispatch and Day Dispatch, while the port authority chooses between Priority Berths and Flexible Berths.

s.name: Port Dredging Windows
s.description: A regional port authority and a major shipping consortium must coordinate a high-stakes dredging project. The authority chooses Early Dredging or Late Dredging, while the consortium chooses Fixed Bookings or Flexible Bookings for the port's navigation windows.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Timing
s.description: A saffron grower chooses Early picking or Late picking for a small plot. A seasonal worker chooses Gentle handling or Quick handling for the same harvest.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: Two neighboring mill operators are coordinating water use at a shared millpond ahead of an important milling season. The upstream operator chooses between “Early Release” and “Late Release,” while the downstream operator chooses between “Open Sluice” and “Hold Sluice.”

s.name: Osier Bed Timing
s.description: A basket maker and a small osier grower are planning work on one modest osier bed. The basket maker chooses Light cutting or Full cutting, while the grower chooses Early cutting or Late cutting.

s.name: Seasonal Wool Scouring
s.description: A regional wool mill and a large wool-buying cooperative are planning their arrangements for the coming shearing season. The mill chooses between Standard Scouring and Expanded Scouring capacity, while the cooperative chooses between Early Booking and Flexible Booking for its wool lots.

s.name: Flagship Beer Rollout
s.description: A regional microbrewery and a major distributor are negotiating a high-stakes rollout for the brewery’s flagship beer. The microbrewery chooses Limited Release or Wide Release, while the distributor chooses Premium Push or Mass Placement for its retail distribution plan.

s.name: Cranberry Bog Flooding
s.description: A cranberry cooperative and a watershed manager coordinate plans for a shared cranberry bog during flood season. The cooperative chooses between Open Levees and Seal Levees, while the manager chooses between Release Water and Hold Water.

s.name: Bell Casting Commission
s.description: A bell foundry is preparing a major commission with a restoration committee overseeing the project. The foundry chooses between Thick Crown and Lean Crown for the bell's casting design, while the committee chooses between Early Pour and Late Pour for the approved casting schedule.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: The outgoing lighthouse keeper chooses between an Early handoff and a Late handoff for a routine relief shift. The incoming keeper chooses between Trim lantern and Leave trim as a small adjustment during the changeover.

s.name: Marathon Detour
s.description: A city traffic coordinator chooses between Early Closure and Late Closure for roads along a marathon course. The marathon organizer chooses between Short Route and Full Route for the race plan.

s.name: Regional Triage Capacity

A neighboring hospital network chooses between Open Overflow and Standard Intake as it coordinates its own triage staffing, with the decisions affecting the season's budget and reputation.

s.name: Orchard Falconry Plan
s.description: An orchard cooperative and a licensed falconry contractor are planning a season-long falconry program to control crop-eating pests. The cooperative chooses between Broad Release and Targeted Release, while the contractor chooses between Dawn Flights and Evening Flights.

s.name: Osier Bed Timing
s.description: Two neighboring osier growers are preparing willow rods for their routine basket orders. Each chooses between Early Cutting, harvesting the osier bed in the first window, and Delayed Cutting, leaving the bed for the later window.

s.name: Planetarium Scheduling
s.description: A small planetarium is adjusting the timing of an evening show, and its curator chooses between an Earlier Slot and a Later Slot. The visiting presenter chooses between a Short Setup and a Long Setup for arranging the equipment before the show.

s.name: Shared Drying Racks
s.description: Two seaweed growers share a set of drying racks during the harvest season. Each chooses whether to bring a batch for early loading or late loading, coordinating their rack-use timing independently.

s.name: Eel Pass Check
s.description: Two neighboring stream stewards oversee a small eel pass. The upstream steward chooses between Quick check and Fine adjustment, while the downstream steward chooses between Quick check and Fine adjustment.

s.name: Coppice Harvest Timing
s.description: A small woodland owner chooses between Short cycle and Long cycle for managing a coppice stand. A nearby firewood cooperative chooses between Early pickup and Deferred pickup for arranging collection from that stand.

s.name: Ringing Station Slots

s.name: Shared Silage Clamp
s.description: Two neighboring dairy farms are coordinating use of one shared silage clamp before the winter feed season. Farm A chooses either “Early Filling” or “Late Filling,” while Farm B chooses either “Shared Access” or “Reserved Access” for its clamp arrangements.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotations
s.description: Two harbour pilots are arranging a small routine rotation for a quiet berth. Each chooses between an Early Rotation and a Late Rotation for taking the handoff.

s.name: Eel Pass Inspection

s.name: Milk Pricing
s.description: A dairy co-op chooses either Member Rate or Market Rate for the wholesale price of a routine milk shipment. A neighborhood grocer chooses either Regular Shelf or Sale Shelf for the retail price.

s.name: Ringing Station Slots

s.name: Dune Fence Placement

s.name: Seasonal Truffle Permit

s.name: Vinyl Queue Stakes

s.description: A disaster-response satellite operator and a commercial ground-station network are coordinating access to a critical satellite downlink window. s.description: Two neighboring seaweed growers use adjacent drying racks and coordinate their daily work. The first grower chooses between Open Rack and Covered Rack, while the second chooses between Early Loading and Late Loading.

s.name: Turbine Service Scheduling
s.description: A wind-farm operator and a maintenance contractor coordinate a routine service visit for a turbine. The operator chooses Routine visit or Deferred visit, while the contractor chooses Early slot or Late slot.

s.name: Salt Pan Adjustment
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan keepers are making a fine adjustment to one small evaporation pan. Keeper A chooses between Shallow Rake and Deep Rake, while Keeper B chooses between Early Gather and Late Gather.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: A lighthouse keeper and a relief coordinator are arranging a small relief shift. The keeper chooses between Trim Lantern and Check Bearings, while the coordinator chooses between Early Relief and Late Relief.

s.description: A national ice-mapping agency and a private polar-data firm are coordinating a season of glacier survey flights. s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: A lighthouse authority and a relief contractor are planning a seasonal lighthouse handover. The authority chooses between Early Relief and Late Relief, while the contractor chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew for the relief shift.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A county bat ecologist is planning the season’s bat survey nights and must choose Early Survey or Late Survey. A woodland landowner decides whether to offer Full Access or Limited Access for those nights, shaping the season’s monitoring arrangement and conservation report.

s.name: Regional Triage Staffing

s.name: Osier Bed Trim
s.description: Two neighboring osier growers are deciding how to trim a small shared osier bed after the season. Each chooses either Low cut or High cut for their side.

s.name: Migration Survey Slots
s.description: A national bird-monitoring agency and an international conservation consortium are assigning field teams at a bird-ringing station during a critical migration window. Each chooses between the Dawn Slot and the Dusk Slot, with the resulting survey schedule feeding a major habitat-protection decision.

s.name: Library Acquisitions Priorities
s.description: A university acquisitions librarian and a faculty department are coordinating the department’s next library purchase request. The librarian chooses between Core Titles and Broad Sampling, while the department chooses between Course List and Research List.

The contractor chooses between Broad Sweep, covering wider orchard areas, and Targeted Sweep, focusing flights on identified pest zones; the cooperative chooses between Dawn Flights and Dusk Flights for the operating schedule.

s.name: Overflow Route Bids
s.description: Two neighborhood courier teams are bidding to cover a small overflow route between nearby shops. Team A chooses either “Base Bid,” keeping its usual route quote, or “Fine-Tuned Bid,” making a small adjustment; Team B chooses between the same two bidding approaches for its own quote.

s.name: Seasonal Coffee Sourcing
s.description: A regional coffee roastery and a highland coffee cooperative are arranging a substantial seasonal sourcing deal. The roastery chooses between Traceable Lot, reserving a specifically documented coffee, and Blended Lot, combining coffees across approved farms; the cooperative chooses between Priority Contract, reserving production for the roastery, and Flexible Contract, keeping allocation open during the season.

s.description: A dyehouse supervisor and a finishing coordinator are planning a textile dyeing shift. The supervisor chooses between Early Batch and Late Batch, while the coordinator chooses between Standard Rinse and Extended Rinse.

s.description: Two university astronomy teams share time on a radio telescope and are arranging a routine observing schedule. Team A chooses between Morning Block and Evening Block, while Team B chooses between Short Session and Long Session.

s.name: Critical Triage Shift
s.description: A hospital emergency department is choosing between Surge Staffing and Standard Staffing for a critical triage shift. A regional ambulance service is choosing between Direct Routing and Distributed Routing for incoming patients. Together, these choices shape how the organizations handle a high-stakes period of emergency care.

s.name: Archive Acquisition
s.description: A national library and a university consortium are negotiating to acquire a rare archive of major scholarly importance. The national library chooses between Early Bid and Measured Bid, while the consortium chooses between Exclusive Rights and Shared Rights.

s.name: Sawmill Kiln Booking

s.name: Stone Wall Bids
s.description: Two local masons, A and B, are preparing separate bids for a small stone wall repair. Each chooses between a Lean Bid, with a narrow adjustment, and a Careful Bid, with more room for fine-tuning the estimate.

s.name: Tidal Rack Planning
s.description: North Cove Seaweed Cooperative and South Cove Seaweed Cooperative share a set of drying racks for the coming harvest. North Cove chooses between Early Loading and Staggered Loading, while South Cove chooses between Open Canopies and Wind Shields.

s.name: Antique Restoration Bids
s.description: A museum foundation and a private collector are bidding for control of the restoration contract for an exceptionally valuable antique portrait. s.name: Seasonal Library Acquisitions
s.description: A university library is planning a major seasonal acquisition program with a scholarly publisher. The library chooses between Established Works and Emerging Works, while the publisher chooses between Bundled Offer and Selective Offer.

s.description: At a small lighthouse, the outgoing keeper and incoming keeper are arranging a routine relief shift. The outgoing keeper chooses Early Relief or Late Relief, while the incoming keeper chooses Short Handoff or Long Handoff.

s.name: Tundra Route Choice
s.description: Two nearby reindeer herders are making a small route adjustment for an ordinary day's movement. Herder A chooses between Open Slope and Creek Bend, while Herder B chooses between Ridge Track and Birch Loop.
