s.name: Type-Specimen Loan
s.description: A national herbarium and a university consortium are handling a request to borrow irreplaceable type specimens for a high-stakes taxonomic revision. The herbarium chooses between Approve Loan and Retain Specimens, while the consortium chooses between Expedited Protocol and Standard Protocol.

s.name: Planetarium Scheduling
s.description: A neighborhood planetarium and a visiting astronomy club are coordinating one evening planetarium show. The planetarium chooses an early or late slot, while the club chooses whether to request a public show or a club show.

s.name: Small Bell Casting
s.description: A small bell foundry's caster chooses between Fine Pour and Steady Pour for a routine casting. The workshop tuner chooses between Early Trim and Late Trim for adjusting the bell's rim.

s.name: Rooftop Hive Siting
s.description: A city apiary office is choosing whether to place a major urban beehive cluster on a civic roof or above a market. A rooftop cooperative is choosing between maintaining green access around the site or restricting access around it.

s.name: Hut Resupply Tweak
s.description: A mountain hut caretaker chooses between making a Small Adjustment or making No Adjustment to the next resupply plan. A volunteer carrier chooses between an Early Shift and a Late Shift for that same small delivery adjustment.

s.name: Small-Batch Coffee Pickup
s.description: A local coffee roastery prepares a small batch for a nearby café and chooses between Standard Roast and Fine-Tuned Roast. The café chooses between Early Pickup and Later Pickup for collecting the batch.

s.name: Cider Press Bookings
s.description: Two neighboring orchard owners, A and B, are arranging use of a shared cider press for their apple harvest. Each chooses between a Morning Slot and an Afternoon Slot for the booking.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: The North Ridge Avalanche Office and the Alpine Pass Authority are coordinating patrol rosters for a heavily traveled mountain corridor where a bad deployment could endanger travelers and disrupt the region. North Ridge chooses between Full Patrol and Lean Patrol, while Alpine Pass chooses between Day Rotation and Night Rotation.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A small quarry manager chooses between an Early Window and a Late Window for a routine blast. A nearby road coordinator chooses between a Short Buffer and a Long Buffer for the temporary road-clearance schedule.

s.name: Shared Kiln Booking
s.description: A neighborhood potter and a local ceramics shop are arranging a modest shared kiln firing. The potter chooses Early Firing or Late Firing, while the shop chooses Short Cycle or Long Cycle for its batch.

s.name: Ski-Lift Grooming
s.description: A ski resort manager and a lift-operations contractor are coordinating grooming for a regularly used lift area. The manager chooses Dawn Grooming or Late Grooming, while the contractor chooses Full Grooming or Light Grooming.

s.name: Restoration Commission
s.description: A regional museum is commissioning the restoration of a valuable antique, and a specialist restoration studio is submitting a bid. The museum chooses between a Fixed-scope Brief, which specifies the conservation work in advance, and an Exploratory Brief, which leaves room for assessment; the studio chooses between a Firm Bid and a Contingent Bid.

s.name: Winter Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain-hut authority and a helicopter cooperative must arrange a high-stakes resupply before winter storms. The authority chooses Ridge staging, pre-positioning cargo near the hut, or Valley staging, keeping cargo at a lower depot; the cooperative chooses Dedicated lift, assigning an aircraft to the hut, or Shared lift, combining the mission with another mountain route.

s.name: Mirror Recoating
s.description: A telescope technician is preparing a small mirror for routine recoating and chooses between Fine Adjustment and Quick Adjustment. The recoating specialist chooses between Thin Recoat and Standard Recoat for the same mirror.

s.name: Shared Pressing Queue
s.description: Two small record labels share a vinyl pressing queue for their next modest run. Label A chooses an Earlier Slot or a Later Slot, while Label B chooses a Short Batch or a Long Batch.

s.name: Cheese Cave Ripening
s.description: A cheesemaker and a major distributor are deciding how to handle a high-stakes cave-ripening batch. The cheesemaker chooses between Early Release and Deep Ripening, while the distributor chooses between Premium Launch and Bulk Contract.

s.name: Osier Harvest Contract
s.description: An osier-bed grower and a basketmaker are planning the season's harvest. The grower chooses between Early Cutting and Late Cutting, while the basketmaker chooses between Firm Contract and Flexible Contract.

s.name: Seed Lot Exchange
s.description: A community seed bank coordinator and a neighboring farm cooperative are arranging an exchange of seasonal seed lots. The coordinator chooses between Early Dispatch and Delayed Dispatch, while the cooperative chooses between Standard Lot and Diverse Lot.

s.name: Shared Kiln Schedule
s.description: Two neighboring charcoal makers share access to a small kiln for their next batches. Each chooses between a Daytime burn and an Overnight burn.

s.name: Salt Pan Harvest
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan operators are planning a routine harvest from connected pans. Operator A chooses Morning Rake or Afternoon Rake, while Operator B chooses Open Gate or Hold Gate for the brine channel.

s.name: Wind-Farm Maintenance
s.description: A wind-farm operator is choosing between Full Overhaul and Routine Service for a major turbine-maintenance program. A specialist maintenance contractor is choosing between Priority Crew and Standard Crew for the same program.

s.name: Creek Ferry Shift
s.description: A ferry operator and a landing attendant are arranging staffing for a small rope ferry's next crossing. The operator chooses Extra Watch or Usual Watch for the boat side, while the attendant chooses Extra Watch or Usual Watch for the landing side.

s.name: Winter Apiary Siting
s.description: A commercial beekeeper and a land trust are arranging winter siting for the beekeeper’s hives before the coming season. The beekeeper chooses between Ridge Yard and Creek Yard, while the land trust chooses between Windbreak Parcel and Open Parcel for the available apiary arrangement.

s.name: Puppet Tour Stop
s.description: A one-person touring puppeteer chooses whether to bring the full puppet rig or a trimmed rig for a small neighborhood stop. A volunteer theatre coordinator chooses whether to schedule the show in an early slot or a late slot.

s.name: Puppet Tour Booking
s.description: A touring puppet company and a regional arts festival are arranging a high-profile season engagement. The company chooses between Full Production and Compact Production, while the festival chooses between Prime Slot and Shared Slot.

s.name: Town Bell Casting
s.description: A small bell foundry manager chooses between Standard Casting and Custom Casting for a town bell. The town clock committee chooses between Early Pickup and Flexible Pickup for receiving the cast bell.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Fine-Tuning
s.description: A small tidal-turbine operator chooses between Brief Tune and Deep Tune for its next maintenance visit. The servicing crew chooses between Early Service and Later Service for scheduling that visit.

s.name: Falconry Pest Control
s.description: A grain cooperative is choosing between Broad Patrols and Focused Patrols for a falconry pest-control campaign protecting its harvest. A licensed raptor team is choosing between Full Deployment and Held Reserve for the same campaign.

s.name: Eel Pass Review
s.description: A river authority chooses how to inspect a major dam’s eel pass: Full Inspection or Rapid Inspection. The dam operator simultaneously chooses Open Bypass or Maintain Flow during the eel migration season, making this a high-stakes passage review.

s.name: Bog Patch Tuning
s.description: A peatland volunteer and a neighboring smallholder are tending one small bog patch together. The volunteer chooses between Trim edges and Leave edges, while the smallholder chooses between Place plugs and Skip plugs.

s.name: Release Window
s.description: Two film studios, A and B, are preparing major releases for the same season. Each chooses either Holiday Window, opening during the year-end period, or Spring Window, opening later in the release calendar.

s.name: Dune Fence Placement
s.description: A coastal municipality and a neighboring resort consortium must coordinate dune-fence placement before a major storm season. The municipality chooses between a Seaward Fence and a Landward Fence, while the consortium makes the same choice for its own fence.

s.name: Mass-Casualty Triage
s.description: During a mass-casualty night, two neighboring hospitals must decide how to staff their emergency departments. Hospital A chooses between Full Triage and Lean Triage, while Hospital B chooses between Open Surge and Normal Intake.

s.name: Dune Fence Placement
s.description: A coastal restoration manager chooses between Seaward Fence and Setback Fence for a seasonal dune-fence installation. A beachfront property consortium chooses between Open Gaps and Dense Line for its installation plan.

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queues
s.description: Two record labels are seeking pressing slots at a vinyl plant for major releases whose timing matters greatly. Each label must choose either Priority Queue or Regular Queue for its pressing order.

s.name: Triage Coverage Plans
s.description: A regional hospital's emergency department and its affiliated urgent-care network are planning triage coverage for a demanding season. The emergency department chooses between Surge Staffing and Core Staffing, while the urgent-care network chooses between a Shared Roster and a Separate Roster.

s.name: Bean Seed Exchange
s.description: Two neighboring seed banks are arranging a small exchange of bean seeds. The first bank chooses between sending a Routine packet or an Adjusted packet, while the second chooses between including Shared notes or Brief notes with its seeds.

s.name: Oyster Bed Leases
s.description: A coastal restoration company and a regional oyster cooperative are negotiating leases for a highly valuable oyster bed. The company chooses between Intensive Cultivation and Reserve Lease, while the cooperative chooses between Shared Access and Exclusive Claim.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: A millpond keeper chooses between Early sluice and Late sluice for a routine adjustment. A downstream miller chooses between Morning draw and Afternoon draw for the same small water-use schedule.

s.name: Coppice Cycle Planning
s.description: A woodland cooperative and a nearby biomass buyer are coordinating coppice cutting cycles for the coming season. The cooperative chooses Short rotation or Long rotation, while the buyer chooses Short rotation or Long rotation for its purchasing schedule.

s.name: Small Letterpress Run
s.description: A neighborhood letterpress operator chooses between Light pressure and Firm pressure for a short print run. A local poet arranging the run chooses between Smooth stock and Textured stock.

s.name: Harbour Pilot Rotation
s.description: Two harbour pilots are arranging the next small harbour rotation. Each chooses between a Steady Handoff and a Quick Handoff for their assigned changeover.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A marathon coordinator chooses between Early closure and Late closure for roads along the race route. A local transit manager chooses between Reroute buses and Keep routes during the closure period.

s.name: Cranberry Bog Flooding
s.description: Two neighboring cranberry growers, A and B, share a flood-control system during a high-stakes growing season. Each must choose between Flood Now and Hold Back for managing water in their bog.

s.name: Kiln Booking
s.description: A sawmill manager and a kiln operator are arranging kiln bookings for the sawmill’s seasonal production. The manager chooses Early Booking or Spot Booking, while the operator chooses Reserve Capacity or Release Capacity.

s.name: Concession Pricing
s.description: Two neighboring stadium concession stands, Stand A and Stand B, serve fans during a game. Each stand chooses between keeping a regular price and offering a small discount on its snacks.

s.name: Seasonal Scouring Slots
s.description: A regional wool-scouring cooperative is deciding whether to expand capacity for the coming season or hold its existing capacity. A major wool buyer is choosing whether to book scouring slots early or book them late.

s.name: Kiln Season Timing
s.description: Two charcoal cooperatives supplying the same seasonal market must schedule their kiln runs. Each cooperative chooses between an Early Burn and a Late Burn, with the timing affecting its production plan and market coordination.

s.name: Critical Bat Survey Night
s.description: A regional bat-conservation authority must choose between Full Survey and Rapid Survey for a critical bat survey night. The cave landholder must choose between Close Site and Permit Access for that same night.

s.name: Wind-Farm Maintenance
s.description: A wind-farm operator chooses between Planned Overhaul and Deferred Service for a major turbine group. Its maintenance contractor chooses between Rapid Crew and Staged Crew for carrying out the season's work.

s.name: Garden Wall Repair
s.description: A homeowner arranging a small stone wall repair chooses between a Detailed Scope and a Loose Scope for the work. A local mason chooses between a Firm Bid and a Flexible Bid for that scope.

s.name: Quiet Film Launches
s.description: Two small independent film distributors are arranging modest local releases for their films. Each distributor chooses either an Early release or a Late release for a small timing adjustment.

s.name: Heritage Rota
s.description: A major thatching contractor and a heritage estate are coordinating a rota for restoring a chain of nationally important roofs. The contractor chooses between Front-load crews, concentrating its teams early, and Spread crews, distributing them across the schedule; the estate chooses between Clear access and Protect grounds for the work periods.

s.name: Cabinet Touch-Up Bids
s.description: Two independent antique restorers are bidding for a small cabinet touch-up commissioned by a local collector. Restorer A chooses between a Minimal Bid and a Detailed Bid, while Restorer B makes the same choice; each option specifies the scope of adjustment and labor included in the quote.

s.name: Oyster Bed Leases
s.description: Two neighboring oyster companies, Baycrest Oysters and Tidehaven Shellfish, are arranging seasonal leases for adjacent oyster beds. Baycrest chooses between Joint Lease, covering a jointly managed boundary, and Independent Lease, covering only its own parcel. Tidehaven chooses between Early Filing and Late Filing for its lease application.

s.name: Salt Pan Pickup
s.description: A full-time salt-pan farmer is preparing an ordinary harvest and chooses between Early rake and Late rake. A nearby market buyer handling a small purchase chooses between Firm pickup and Flexible pickup.

s.name: Truffle Season Permits
s.description: A truffle-foraging cooperative is planning its seasonal permit application with a regional woodland authority. The cooperative chooses between Early Foraging and Late Foraging, while the authority chooses between Open Permits and Limited Permits.

s.name: Estate Hedge Contract
s.description: A large estate owner is awarding a high-stakes hedge-laying contract to a specialist firm. The owner chooses between Full Rebuild and Patch Repair, while the firm chooses between an Early Start and a Late Start.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A neighborhood marathon coordinator chooses between an early or late road closure. A municipal traffic desk chooses whether to route vehicles along the main detour or the side detour.

s.name: Floodplain Rope Ferry
s.description: During a major flood, a rope ferry is the only crossing serving several isolated communities. The ferry operator chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew, while the regional emergency office chooses between Add Deckhand and Hold Roster for the ferry.

s.name: Migration Station Slots
s.description: A university migration team and a national conservation agency are choosing which scarce bird ringing station slot to request during a season-critical migration window. Each must choose between the Dawn Slot and the Dusk Slot, and the allocation can substantially affect the season's monitoring work.

s.name: Small Flour Restock
s.description: A neighborhood bakery manager chooses between Standard Order and Flexible Order for a small flour restock. A nearby mill coordinator chooses between Morning Dispatch and Afternoon Dispatch.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Windows
s.description: The upstream weir crew chooses whether to schedule a small maintenance adjustment in the Morning window or the Afternoon window. The downstream weir crew makes the same choice for its own nearby weir.

s.name: Salt Pan Harvest
s.description: A coastal salt cooperative and a major salt processor are coordinating work at a high-value salt pan. The cooperative chooses between Early Harvest and Late Harvest, while the processor chooses between Open Channels and Seal Channels for managing brine flow during the harvest season.

s.name: Salt Pan Harvest Timing
s.description: Two neighboring salt-pan operators, Asha and Bimal, are planning their next harvest. Each chooses between Early Harvest and Late Harvest for collecting salt from their own pan.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease
s.description: A small oyster grower and a neighboring seafood cooperative are deciding how to arrange access to an oyster bed lease for the coming season. The grower chooses Keep Lease or Trade Lease, while the cooperative chooses Joint Lease or Separate Lease.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A wind-farm developer chooses between Night Shutdown and Night Operations during a critical bat-survey season. A bat-conservation authority chooses between Full Access and Limited Access for the survey sites.

s.name: Shared Dune Fence
s.description: A beach manager and a neighboring dune steward are coordinating fence placement along adjoining stretches of the same beach. Each chooses between Front Dune, placing the fence nearer the seaward edge, and Back Dune, placing it farther inland on the dune.

s.name: Mountain Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain hut warden and a local packer are arranging a routine resupply. The warden chooses between Early Request and Late Request, while the packer chooses between Full Load and Light Load for the trip.

s.name: Mountain Hut Resupply
s.description: A remote mountain-hut coordinator and a contracted logistics team must arrange a high-stakes winter resupply. The coordinator chooses between Early Delivery and Late Delivery, while the logistics team chooses between Airlift Cargo and Pack Train.

s.name: Thatching Crew Rotas
s.description: A heritage-roofing cooperative is deciding whether its thatching crew will work as a full crew or a split crew on a major restoration. The building owner is choosing between an early rota and a late rota for coordinating access and site work.

s.name: Chapbook Print Run
s.description: A neighborhood letterpress printer and an independent bookstore are coordinating an everyday print run for a new chapbook. The printer chooses between Short run and Long run, while the bookstore chooses between Firm order and Cautious order.

s.name: Tentpole Release
s.description: A major film studio chooses between Summer Launch and Holiday Launch for a tentpole movie. Its streaming distributor chooses between Immediate Release and Delayed Release for the film’s platform debut.

s.name: Seed-Lot Exchange
s.description: Two neighboring seed-bank curators are arranging a small exchange of seed lots. The first curator chooses between Fine Sort and Quick Sort for preparing the lot, while the second chooses between Early Dispatch and Routine Dispatch for sending its matching packet.

s.name: Winter Triage Coverage
s.description: A hospital emergency department and a regional ambulance service are coordinating coverage for a demanding winter season. The hospital chooses between Full Triage and Lean Triage, while the ambulance service chooses between Staggered Arrivals and Batch Arrivals.

s.name: Garden Wall Bids
s.description: Two local masons, A and B, are preparing bids for a small garden-stone wall repair. Each chooses between a Lean Bid covering only the loose stones and a Careful Bid allowing extra fitting and adjustment work.

s.name: Seed Exchange Terms
s.description: Two local seed banks are arranging an exchange for the coming planting season. Seed Bank A chooses between sending a Small Batch or a Full Batch, while Seed Bank B chooses between Early Dispatch and Flexible Dispatch.

s.name: Seasonal Quota Talks
s.description: The Northbank Cooperative and the Southbay Cooperative are negotiating allocations for a valuable fishing season. Northbank chooses either High Quota or Low Quota for its fleet, while Southbay chooses either High Quota or Low Quota for its fleet.

s.name: Charcoal Burn Timing
s.description: Two neighboring charcoal makers, Mira and Sol, are planning burns for small batches of charcoal. Mira chooses between Dawn Burn and Dusk Burn for her kiln, while Sol chooses between Dawn Burn and Dusk Burn for his kiln.

s.name: Bat Survey Nights
s.description: A local bat-monitoring coordinator and a volunteer are planning one small survey night. The coordinator chooses an Early Route or Late Route, while the volunteer chooses a Quiet Pass or Extra Pass along the transect.

s.name: Turbine Tune-Up
s.description: At a small wind farm, the field technician chooses between Light Adjustment and Full Check for a routine turbine visit. The maintenance coordinator chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot for that same visit.

s.name: Seasonal Flour Contract
s.description: A neighborhood bakery and its flour supplier are finalizing a substantial seasonal supply order. The bakery chooses between Reserve Flour and Spot Order, while the supplier chooses between Priority Milling and Flexible Milling.

s.name: Inlet Quota Adjustment
s.description: Two small-boat fishers are discussing a minor adjustment to their shared inlet quota for the next outing. Fisher A chooses between Keep Share and Shift Share, while Fisher B chooses between Keep Share and Shift Share.

s.name: Observatory Dome Time
s.description: A university astronomer and a local astronomy club coordinator are arranging one evening of observatory dome time. The astronomer chooses between “Early Slot” and “Late Slot,” while the coordinator chooses between “Long Session” and “Short Session” for the club’s booking.

s.name: Ice Rink Resurfacing
s.description: A neighborhood ice rink manager is choosing between Quick Resurface and Full Resurface for the rink. A community skating club is choosing between Morning Session and Evening Session for its regular ice time.

s.name: Quota Negotiation
s.description: A small fishing cooperative and a local seafood buyer are negotiating the cooperative’s quota arrangement for the coming week. The cooperative chooses between Standard Quota and Flexible Quota, while the buyer chooses between Early Booking and Spot Booking.

s.name: Planetarium Show Slots
s.description: A small neighborhood planetarium coordinator is arranging one ordinary evening show with a guest presenter. The coordinator chooses between an Earlier Slot and a Later Slot, while the presenter chooses between a Star Talk and a Moon Talk.

s.name: Seasonal Specimen Loan
s.description: A regional herbarium and a university research team are arranging a season-critical loan of rare specimens. The herbarium chooses Full Loan or Restricted Loan, while the team chooses Rush Return or Extended Study.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: A millpond keeper and a downstream gardener are making a small sluice-timing decision. The keeper chooses between “Open Early” and “Open Late,” while the gardener chooses between “Water Early” and “Water Late.”

s.name: Bat Survey Timing
s.description: Two volunteers are planning a small bat survey night in neighboring parts of the same park. The first volunteer chooses between an early or late setup, while the second chooses between a quiet route and an open route for checking the area.

s.name: Truffle Permit Timing
s.description: Two neighboring hobby truffle foragers are arranging permits for a shared patch. Each chooses between an Early Permit and a Late Permit for a minor adjustment to their usual foraging schedule.

s.name: Quiet Release Weekend
s.description: Two small film distributors are coordinating the release timing of their films at a local cinema. Each distributor chooses either Thursday Release or Friday Release for a minor adjustment to the schedule.

s.name: Fenland Osier Agreement
s.description: A large osier grower and a floodplain land trust are deciding a high-stakes osier bed cutting agreement. The grower chooses Early Cutting or Delayed Cutting, while the trust chooses Full Release of the beds or Bed Reserve for restricted cutting.

s.name: Shared Salt Pan
s.description: Two large salt cooperatives share a coastal salt pan during a crucial harvest season. Cooperative A chooses either Early Harvest, removing its crystallized salt promptly, or Hold Brine, leaving the brine longer; Cooperative B makes the same choice for its operation.

s.name: Reindeer Route Choice
s.description: Two neighboring reindeer herders are planning a small seasonal move across the same grazing area. Each herder chooses whether to guide their herd along the Ridge Route or the Valley Route.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contract
s.description: An orchard cooperative and a juice processor are setting a harvest contract for the coming season. The cooperative chooses Early Delivery or Late Delivery, while the processor chooses Firm Purchase or Flexible Purchase.

s.name: Bay Quota Tweak
s.description: Two neighboring small-boat fishing cooperatives are making a fine adjustment to their shared weekly quota. The first cooperative chooses Hold Quota or Trim Quota, while the second chooses Hold Quota or Trim Quota.

s.name: Small Letterpress Run
s.description: A typesetter and a zine editor are coordinating a small letterpress print run. The typesetter chooses either Tight spacing or Loose spacing for the forme, while the editor chooses either Short run or Repeat run for the order.

s.name: Downlink Scheduling
s.description: An Earth-observation satellite operator and a ground-station network coordinator must schedule the satellite’s next downlink window. The operator chooses between an Early Window and a Late Window, while the coordinator chooses between a Priority Slot and a Shared Slot.

s.name: Tournament Ice Turnaround
s.description: A rink operations director and a tournament organizer are coordinating resurfacing for a high-profile tournament. The director chooses between Deep Resurface and Quick Resurface, while the organizer chooses between Short Breaks and Long Breaks in the competition schedule.

s.name: Mountain Hut Resupply
s.description: A hut warden and a local porter coordinate a routine resupply of a mountain hut. The warden chooses Early restock or Late restock for the handoff, while the porter chooses Pack light or Pack spare for the load.

s.name: Orbital Downlink Scheduling
s.description: A satellite operator and a ground-station consortium are coordinating a valuable seasonal satellite downlink schedule. The operator chooses between Early release and Held release, while the consortium chooses between Priority window and Shared window.

s.name: Herbarium Loan Requests
s.description: A university herbarium and a regional herbarium are arranging a short-term loan of dried plant specimens. The university herbarium chooses Standard Packing or Rapid Dispatch, while the regional herbarium chooses Routine Review or Priority Review.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Windows
s.description: An upstream weir operator is scheduling routine maintenance and chooses either an Early window or a Late window. A downstream farmers' cooperative coordinates its irrigation schedule by choosing either Weekday notice or Weekend notice.

s.name: Weir Adjustment
s.description: A canal keeper and a downstream allotment steward are arranging a small routine adjustment at a shared weir. The canal keeper chooses an Early window or a Late window, while the steward chooses an Early window or a Late window for coordinating access.

s.name: Kelp Plot Timing
s.description: Two neighboring kelp farmers are deciding how to time a small shared plot's harvest. Farmer A chooses between “Early Harvest” and “Later Harvest,” while Farmer B chooses between the same two options.

s.name: Dune Fence Placement
s.description: Two neighboring dune-lot stewards, A and B, are deciding where to place their separate protective fences. Each chooses between Seaward fence and Landward fence for their own lot.

s.name: Osier Bed Contract
s.description: A large osier-bed owner and a processing cooperative are deciding how to handle a harvest whose outcome matters greatly to both organizations. The owner chooses Early Cutting or Late Cutting, while the cooperative chooses Guaranteed Purchase or Spot Purchase.

s.name: Shared Weir Maintenance
s.description: The upstream canal cooperative and downstream canal cooperative coordinate maintenance at a shared weir. Each chooses either a Morning Window or an Afternoon Window for its crew's work.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease
s.description: A large oyster cooperative is negotiating access to a commercially vital oyster-bed lease with the coastal authority. The cooperative chooses between Expand Harvest and Limit Harvest, while the authority chooses between Open Auction and Private Renewal.

s.name: Vineyard Watering
s.description: Two neighboring vineyard stewards share a small irrigation channel during a mild dry spell. Each chooses between Early trickle and Late trickle for the timing of the vines’ routine watering.

s.name: Triage Roster
s.description: An emergency-department charge nurse and an urgent-care charge nurse coordinate an everyday hospital triage roster. The emergency charge nurse chooses Shared Float or Unit Staff, meaning whether to assign a nurse to the shared triage pool or keep staffing within the department; the urgent-care charge nurse chooses Early Shift or Late Shift, meaning when to place its extra triage coverage.

s.name: Critical Ferry Crossing
s.description: The North Terminal Authority and South Terminal Authority each choose a departure window for a cable ferry carrying a critical convoy across a flood-swollen river. North chooses between Day Crossing and Night Crossing, while South chooses between Day Crossing and Night Crossing.

s.name: Planetarium Show Slots
s.description: A city planetarium and a visiting astronomy club are coordinating featured programs for the same weekend. The planetarium chooses Prime Slot or Late Slot, while the club chooses Prime Slot or Late Slot for its own show.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief Shifts
s.description: Two lighthouse keepers are coordinating a routine relief shift, and each chooses whether to arrange an early or late changeover. One keeper chooses between Early handoff and Late handoff, while the other chooses between Early arrival and Late arrival.

s.name: Kiln Batch Timing
s.description: A small charcoal maker and a nearby pottery studio are coordinating one ordinary kiln batch. The maker chooses between Short burn and Long burn, while the studio chooses between Early pickup and Late pickup for collecting it.

s.name: Orchard Harvest Contract
s.description: An orchard grower and a local cider cooperative are arranging a modest harvest contract. The grower chooses between Early Harvest and Late Harvest, while the cooperative chooses between Firm Pickup and Flexible Pickup.

s.name: Dune Fence Placement
s.description: A coastal municipality and a resort consortium are coordinating a major dune-fence project. The municipality chooses between High-Dune Fence and Beach-Edge Fence, while the resort consortium chooses between High-Dune Fence and Beach-Edge Fence.

s.name: Storm Lighthouse Relief
s.description: The North Beacon Authority and the South Beacon Authority coordinate relief shifts during a severe storm season when keeping both lighthouses staffed is critical. North Beacon chooses between Dawn Relief and Dusk Relief, while South Beacon independently chooses between Dawn Relief and Dusk Relief.

s.name: Handbell Tuning
s.description: A small bell foundry is preparing a newly cast handbell for a nearby music shop. The foundry tuner chooses between Fine Adjustment and Leave Rim, while the shop buyer chooses between Soft Test and Firm Test.

s.name: Film Release Timing
s.description: A small film distributor and a neighborhood cinema are coordinating the release timing for an upcoming film. The distributor chooses between Opening Weekend and Quiet Week, while the cinema chooses between Opening Weekend and Quiet Week.

s.name: Lighthouse Relief
s.description: Two keepers at nearby lighthouses are coordinating their routine relief shifts. Keeper A chooses an Early handoff or a Late handoff, and Keeper B chooses an Early handoff or a Late handoff.

s.name: Bat Survey Night
s.description: For a routine bat survey night, a volunteer coordinator chooses between Early Setup and Late Setup for placing acoustic recorders. A nearby landowner chooses between Gate Access and Trail Access for how the survey team reaches the site.

s.name: Hut Resupply Plans
s.description: A mountain-hut caretaker chooses between preparing an Early Load or a Late Load for the next resupply. A local supplier chooses between sending a Direct Pack or a Split Pack up the mountain.

s.name: Town Bell Casting
s.description: A small bell foundry chooses between Rush casting and Careful casting for a town bell. The town clock committee chooses between Fixed pickup and Flexible pickup for receiving the finished bell.

s.name: Shared Fishing Grounds
s.description: Two fishing cooperatives are negotiating access to a shared, highly valuable fishing ground. The North Shelf Cooperative chooses between Firm Cap, proposing a tightly limited quota, and Flexible Cap, proposing a less restrictive quota; the South Shelf Cooperative makes the same choice for its fleet.

s.name: Seasonal Film Releases
s.description: Two film studios are scheduling releases for major films during a high-stakes season. Studio A chooses Festival Launch or Holiday Launch, while Studio B chooses Summer Launch or Awards Launch.

s.name: Cable Ferry Crossing
s.description: A small cable-ferry operator and a commuter share responsibility for one crossing. The operator chooses between “Steady Pull” and “Quick Pull,” while the commuter chooses between “Board Early” and “Wait Ashore”.

s.name: Evacuation Ferry Staffing
s.description: A regional rope-ferry operator chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew for a major evacuation crossing. A contracted emergency-services agency chooses between Reserve Crew and No Reserve for the same ferry operation.

s.name: Seed Bank Exchange
s.description: A regional seed bank coordinator handles a shipment central to an upcoming distribution and chooses between Standard Exchange and Urgent Exchange. A small community seed bank handling a routine exchange chooses between Catalog Confirm and Catalog Revise.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: A glacier research consortium is planning its survey flights for the season and must choose between a Broad Survey and a Targeted Survey. An aviation contractor must assign the flights to an Early Window or a Late Window.

s.name: Seasonal Downlink Coordination
s.description: A satellite-imaging mission team and a ground-station network are coordinating a downlink window for a season of data deliveries. The mission team chooses Early Window or Late Window, while the network chooses Priority Slot or Flexible Slot.

s.name: Weir Maintenance Windows
s.description: The upstream and downstream water cooperatives coordinate maintenance on a shared weir. The upstream cooperative chooses the Early Window or Late Window, while the downstream cooperative assigns its crew to the First Shift or Second Shift.

s.name: Turbine Tune-Up
s.description: A wind-farm maintenance coordinator chooses between Blade Tweak and Leave Settings for a small turbine adjustment. A nearby maintenance technician chooses between Check Bearings and Skip Check during the same routine visit.

s.name: Orchard Press Calendar
s.description: Two orchard cooperatives, Northbank and Redvale, are arranging access to a regional cider press for an important harvest season. Northbank chooses either Early Booking, reserving press time in advance, or Flexible Booking, while Redvale chooses either Priority Slot or Shared Slot for its press arrangement.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: A quarry operator and an aggregate hauler coordinate a day's quarry schedule. The quarry operator chooses between Early blast and Late blast, while the hauler chooses between Early pickup and Late pickup.

s.name: Shared Telescope Scheduling
s.description: Two small astronomy teams share time on a radio telescope. Team A chooses between Deep Scan and Quick Scan, while Team B chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot.

s.name: Seed Bank Exchange
s.description: A regional seed bank and a neighborhood seed bank are arranging a modest exchange of garden seeds. The regional bank chooses between sending a Curated Bundle or a Basic Bundle, while the neighborhood bank chooses between an Early Pickup or a Later Pickup.

s.name: Avalanche Patrol Rosters
s.description: Two neighboring avalanche-patrol coordinators are arranging rosters for a shared weekend route. Each coordinator chooses between concentrating coverage at dawn or splitting coverage across the morning and afternoon.

s.name: Peatland Rewetting
s.description: A national peatland agency and a neighboring land consortium are coordinating restoration of a major peat bog. The agency chooses between Full Rewetting, restoring water levels across the bog, and Limited Rewetting, restoring only its core. The consortium chooses between Block Drains, closing the bog's drainage channels, and Open Drains, leaving those channels operating.

s.name: Coppice Cycle Pact
s.description: Two neighboring woodland cooperatives manage coppice stands whose harvest schedules affect a major shared timber contract. Each cooperative must choose either a Short Cycle or a Long Cycle for its stand.

s.name: Island Ferry Scheduling
s.description: A small island ferry company, dependent on its main crossing, chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot for its daily service. A regional water-taxi cooperative with several other routes chooses between Morning Slot and Afternoon Slot for a connecting service.

s.name: Marathon Road Closures
s.description: A city transportation agency chooses between Early Closure and Staged Closure for roads along a major marathon route. The marathon organizer chooses between Full Route and Short Route for the race course, with both plans shaping the event and the city's road access.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: A tidal-energy utility and an independent maintenance contractor are coordinating service for a tidal turbine array before the next production season. The utility chooses Routine overhaul, servicing all scheduled turbine components, or Targeted repair, servicing only flagged components; the contractor chooses Full crew, assigning a large service team, or Lean crew, assigning a smaller service team.

s.name: Planetarium Scheduling
s.description: The planetarium scheduler chooses whether a routine show uses an Early slot or a Late slot. The local astronomy club coordinator chooses whether to request a Weeknight or Weekend showing.

s.name: Cranberry Bog Flooding
s.description: A small cranberry grower and a neighboring bog manager are making fine adjustments to water levels in adjoining cranberry bogs. The grower chooses between Steady Flood and Quick Drain, while the manager chooses between Gentle Flood and Brief Flood.

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queues
s.description: A local record label and a neighborhood pressing plant are arranging a small vinyl run. The label chooses Standard Queue or Rush Queue, while the plant chooses Day Slot or Evening Slot.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Tour
s.description: A puppet theatre company is planning a seasonal tour, choosing between Full Tour and Limited Tour. A regional arts festival is deciding whether to offer Prime Slot or Off-Peak Slot for the engagement.

s.name: Imperial Cabinet Restoration
s.description: Two nationally known antique-restoration firms are bidding for the contract to restore a priceless imperial cabinet. Firm A chooses between a Premium bid and a Lean bid, while Firm B makes the same choice for its own proposal.

s.name: Cider Press Contracts
s.description: North Orchard Cooperative and South Orchard Cooperative are relying on the same industrial cider press for contract harvests. North chooses between “Peak booking” and “Off-peak booking,” while South independently chooses between “Peak booking” and “Off-peak booking.”

s.name: Vinyl Pressing Queues
s.description: A record label and a vinyl pressing plant are coordinating a high-stakes album release. The label chooses between Rush pressing and Standard queue, while the plant chooses between Priority slot and Regular slot.

s.name: Clocktower Fine-Tuning
s.description: A volunteer clockkeeper decides whether to make a minute adjustment to the clock mechanism or leave it alone. A nearby caretaker decides whether to check the bell alignment or skip the check.

s.name: Hedge Laying Contract
s.description: A national land trust is negotiating a large hedge-laying contract with a specialist contractor. The land trust chooses between Full restoration and Phased restoration, while the contractor chooses between Dedicated crew and Shared crew for delivering the work.

s.name: Rooftop Hive Siting
s.description: Two neighboring urban gardeners are choosing where to place a small beehive within their respective plots. The first gardener chooses between North Parapet and South Parapet, while the second chooses between North Courtyard and South Courtyard.

s.name: Dune Fence Alignment
s.description: Two neighboring dune stewards are aligning short sand-fence sections during routine maintenance. Each chooses between Seaward Offset, placing their section a little toward the beach, and Inland Offset, placing it a little toward the dunes.

s.name: Seasonal Ferry Coordination
s.description: A county cable-ferry operator and a seasonal produce cooperative must coordinate busy crossings during the harvest season, when delays affect the ferry budget and the cooperative's delivery reputation. The operator chooses Queue Crossing or Dispatch Crossing, while the cooperative chooses Consolidate Loads or Split Loads.

s.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
s.description: Two small ferry operators each need to adjust one sailing in a shared local timetable. Operator A chooses either Early Slot or Later Slot, while Operator B independently chooses either Early Slot or Later Slot for its sailing.

s.name: Telescope Scheduling
s.description: A national observatory and a university consortium are planning their radio-telescope observing programs for the coming season. The observatory chooses between Deep Survey and Rapid Survey, while the consortium chooses between Early Window and Late Window for its proposed observing schedule.

s.name: Migration Slot Planning
s.description: A bird-ringing station coordinator and a visiting ornithology team are planning access during a high-demand migration season. The coordinator chooses Standard Rotation or Extended Rotation, while the team chooses Early Visit or Late Visit for its station slot.

s.name: Charcoal Burn Timing
s.description: Two charcoal producers are planning a high-demand season in the same woodland supply area. Each must choose either Early Burn or Late Burn for the main kiln schedule, arranging production around shared deliveries and market timing.

s.name: Quiet-Sky Calibration
s.description: Two radio-astronomy teams share a small calibration run on one radio telescope. Team A chooses between Early Tuning and Late Tuning, while Team B chooses between Narrow Band and Wide Band.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Tour
s.description: A touring puppet company, facing a high-stakes season, chooses between Grand Tour and Regional Tour for its production plan. A national network of puppet-theatre venues chooses between Festival Circuit and Civic Circuit for the company's bookings.
actorB: A national network of puppet-theatre venues

s.name: Urban Beehive Siting
s.description: A municipal pollinator-program director, accountable for the city's seasonal urban-apiary plan, chooses between Central Plot and Rooftop Cluster. A commercial rooftop manager, with one building under consideration, chooses between Host Hives and Decline Hives.

s.name: Mountain Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain hut manager is arranging the next supply delivery and chooses between an early order and a late order. The regional supplier chooses between sending the goods along a pack route and arranging a roadhead handoff.

s.name: Shared Dune Fences
s.description: Two neighboring beachfront property managers are deciding where to place their low dune fences. Each can place a fence nearer the beach or farther inland while coordinating around the shared stretch of dunes.

s.name: Seasonal Kiln Booking
s.description: A regional sawmill and a timber cooperative are arranging a kiln booking for a substantial seasonal lumber contract. The sawmill chooses either Reserve kiln or Spot kiln, while the cooperative chooses either Early delivery or Late delivery.

s.name: Side-Table Restoration Bid
s.description: A small antiques dealer and a freelance restorer are arranging a bid for a fine adjustment to an old side table. The dealer chooses between Quick bid and Fine bid, while the restorer chooses between Loose estimate and Exact estimate.

s.name: Small Hedge Contract
s.description: A smallholder and a local hedge layer are agreeing on a modest hedge-laying contract. The smallholder chooses between a tight or flexible brief, while the hedge layer chooses between an early or careful finish.

s.name: Cave Ripening Tweak
s.description: A cheesemaker and a cellar attendant are making a small adjustment in a cheese cave while a batch of wheels ripens. The cheesemaker chooses Gentle Turn or Firm Turn for the wheels, and the attendant chooses Dry Air or Humid Air for the cave.

s.name: Ringing Station Slots
s.description: Two local bird-ringing teams share a ringing station and must choose when to schedule their session. Team A chooses between Dawn Slot and Late Slot, while Team B chooses between Early Visit and Later Visit.

s.name: Observatory Dome Time
s.description: At a shared observatory, the resident astronomy team and a visiting astronomy team must each choose how to use an evening's dome time. The resident team chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot, while the visiting team chooses between Narrow Field and Wide Field.

s.name: Rooftop Hive Planning
s.description: A neighborhood gardening club and a nearby apartment association are planning where to place their urban beehives. The gardening club chooses between Garden Plot and Library Roof, while the apartment association chooses between Courtyard Roof and Market Roof.

s.name: Alpine Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain-hut resupply operator chooses between Early Dispatch and Deferred Dispatch for the season's next supply run. The hut committee chooses between Full Stock and Lean Stock as its provisioning plan.

s.name: Dome Scheduling
s.description: A university astronomer and a visiting astronomer are arranging observatory dome time for their next routine observing session. The first chooses between the Prime Window and the Backup Window, while the second chooses between a Shared Booking and a Solo Booking.

s.name: Millpond Sluice Timing
s.description: At a millpond, an upstream mill operator and a downstream farming cooperative each set a sluice-timing decision for a seasonally important water window. The mill operator chooses between Early release and Late release; the cooperative chooses between Early request and Late request.

s.name: Dome Time Allocation
s.description: A university observatory and a partner astronomy institute are arranging a valuable observing season in the same dome. The observatory chooses between Deep Survey and Rapid Survey, while the institute chooses between Early Block and Late Block for its requested dome time.

s.name: Antique Restoration Bids
s.description: An antique restoration workshop and an antique dealer are arranging a bid for work on a modest piece. The workshop chooses between Full restoration and Light restoration, while the dealer chooses between Firm bid and Flexible bid.

s.name: Dome Time Allocation
s.description: A national observatory director and a consortium of research universities are allocating a high-stakes observing night in the observatory dome. The director chooses between Full-Night Run and Split-Night Run, while the consortium chooses between Prime-Time Claim and Late-Time Claim.

s.name: Kelp Harvest Coordination
s.description: A small kelp farm and a nearby processor are coordinating a routine harvest. The farm chooses Early harvest or Delayed harvest, while the processor chooses Prompt pickup or Later pickup.

s.name: Osier Bed Trimming
s.description: Two neighboring osier growers are making a fine adjustment to their small beds after a routine harvest. The first grower chooses how lightly or closely to cut the stems, while the second chooses whether to trim early or late in the ordinary cutting period.

s.name: Shared Cranberry Canal
s.description: The North Bog Cooperative and South Bog Cooperative are neighboring cranberry growers whose shared flood-control canal is crucial during a high-stakes harvest. North chooses between “Early Flooding” and “Hold Water,” while South chooses between “Release Water” and “Retain Water.”

s.name: The Masterwork Restoration Bid
s.description: A renowned restoration atelier and a royal collection are deciding how to handle a high-stakes antique restoration commission. The atelier chooses between a Minimal Bid and a Comprehensive Bid, while the collection chooses between a Public Tender and a Direct Award.

s.name: Cheese Cave Ripening
s.description: A cheesemaker and a cave attendant are making a small adjustment to how a batch of cheese is ripened. The cheesemaker chooses between Gentle Turning and Frequent Turning, while the attendant chooses between Narrow Venting and Open Venting.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: A tidal-energy operator must choose between Full Overhaul and Patch Repair for a critical underwater turbine. Its servicing contractor must choose between Crew Dispatch and Remote Guidance for carrying out or supporting the work.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Servicing
s.description: A turbine technician and a small tidal-farm operator are coordinating a routine servicing visit. The technician chooses between Fine-tune blades and Leave settings, while the operator chooses between Brief slowdown and Keep rotation.

s.name: Puppet Tour Planning
s.description: A puppet theatre troupe is arranging a modest tour with a local arts coordinator. The troupe chooses between Full Cast and Small Cast, while the coordinator chooses between Prime Slot and Weekday Slot for the performances.

s.name: Marsh Grazing Schedule
s.description: Two neighboring smallholders share salt marsh grazing rights for the season. Each chooses whether to use the marsh early or late, coordinating their livestock schedules around the shared pasture.

s.name: Heritage Thatch Rotas
s.description: A national heritage trust and a regional housing authority are coordinating thatching crew rotas across a season of major roof-renewal work. The trust chooses between an Early Rota and a Late Rota, while the authority chooses between a Peak Rota and a Steady Rota.

s.name: Hut Resupply
s.description: A mountain-hut cooperative is choosing between Early Convoy and Staged Loads for its seasonal resupply. The helicopter operator is choosing between Fixed Schedule and Flexible Schedule for that mountain-hut resupply operation.

s.name: Tidal Turbine Service
s.description: A small tidal-turbine operator, whose output depends on the maintenance visit, is choosing between Thorough Service and Routine Service. An independent maintenance crew is choosing between a Prime Slot and a Late Slot for carrying out the visit.

s.name: Cranberry Bog Adjustment
s.description: Two neighboring cranberry growers are planning a routine water-level adjustment in their adjoining bogs. Grower A chooses between Light flood and Deep flood, while Grower B chooses between Early flood and Late flood.

s.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
s.description: Two small quarry crews sharing a worksite each choose a window for a routine blast. Crew A selects Morning window or Afternoon window, while Crew B makes the same choice for its own blast.

s.name: Quarry Blast Timing
s.description: A major quarry and a neighboring freight rail operator must choose how to handle a high-stakes blasting window. The quarry chooses Early Blast or Late Blast, while the rail operator chooses Hold Freight or Run Freight during that window.

s.name: Kelp Harvest Timing
s.description: North Cove Kelp Farm and South Inlet Kelp Farm are deciding when to harvest their seasonal kelp crops. Each farm must choose between Early Harvest and Delayed Harvest as it plans the season's operations.

s.name: Seasonal Reindeer Routes
s.description: Two neighboring reindeer herding cooperatives, North Tundra and South Tundra, are planning routes for a season-long grazing agreement. North Tundra chooses either Ridge Circuit or Valley Circuit, while South Tundra chooses either Open Plateau or Forest Edge for its herd.

s.name: Oyster Bed Lease Adjustments
s.description: Two neighboring oyster growers are making small adjustments to their oyster-bed leases in the same tidal inlet. Grower A chooses between Tight spacing and Loose spacing for the beds, while Grower B chooses between Short renewal and Long renewal for the lease term.

s.name: Winter Heat Compact
s.description: Two neighboring commercial greenhouse operators, Northglass (A) and Southglass (B), must set their controls during a severe cold snap while sharing a limited thermal-storage loop. Northglass chooses Draw heat or Conserve heat, while Southglass chooses Send heat or Hold heat.

s.name: Glacier Survey Flights
s.description: Two independent glacier survey teams are planning flights over the same glacier. Team A chooses between Morning Flight and Afternoon Flight, while Team B chooses between Ridge Route and Valley Route.

s.name: Mirror Recoating Adjustment
s.description: A telescope technician and an observatory manager are coordinating a small mirror-recoating job. The technician chooses between Standard polish and Extra polish, while the manager chooses between Early check and Late check.

s.name: Rope Ferry Continuity
s.description: A rope-ferry operator chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew for a vital river crossing. A regional transport authority chooses between Open Crossing and Hold Service while setting the ferry’s operating plan for an emergency supply route.

s.name: Puppet Booth Setup
s.description: A small puppet troupe touring locally chooses between Early Load-in and Late Load-in for setting up its show. The venue's stage manager chooses between Wide Spacing and Tight Spacing when arranging the puppet booth.

s.name: Small Weir Window
s.description: The canal keeper and a downstream meadow steward are arranging a small weir maintenance window. The canal keeper chooses Early repair or Late repair, while the meadow steward chooses Morning access or Afternoon access.

s.name: Puppet Theatre Touring
s.description: Lantern Puppet Theatre and Willow Marionettes are planning high-stakes touring seasons across the same national arts market. Lantern chooses between School Circuit and Festival Circuit, while Willow chooses between City Circuit and Rural Circuit.

s.name: Ice-Shelf Survey Coordination
s.description: Two glacier-survey agencies are coordinating flights over a rapidly changing ice shelf whose maps will guide a major evacuation route. Agency A chooses between Early Overflight and Late Overflight, while Agency B chooses between Valley Transect and Ridge Transect.

s.name: Hedge Restoration Contract
s.description: A landowner chooses between Early Laying, scheduling the hedge work early in the season, and Late Laying, scheduling it later. A hedge-laying contractor chooses between Firm Price, a fixed contract charge, and Flexible Price, a charge adjusted under agreed conditions, for the season's restoration work.

s.name: Truffle Plot Permits
s.description: Two neighboring truffle foragers are arranging permits for walks in a small woodland patch. Each chooses between a Usual Permit for the customary marked area and an Adjusted Permit for a slightly revised area.

s.name: Saffron Harvest Contract
s.description: A saffron cooperative chooses between Hand Harvest and Contract Crews for its fields. A major spice buyer chooses between Premium Contract and Spot Contract for purchasing the crop. Their decisions concern the entire season's saffron harvest and its commercial future.

s.name: Canal Lock Scheduling
s.description: A freight consortium and a regional water authority are coordinating use of a heavily booked canal lock for the coming shipping season. The consortium chooses between Peak Convoy and Off-Peak Convoy, while the authority chooses between Reserve Lock and Share Lock.

s.name: Boundary Hedge Contracts
s.description: Northmere Estate and Southbank Estate are negotiating high-stakes hedge-laying contracts for a shared boundary restoration. Northmere chooses either Full Scope or Phased Scope, while Southbank chooses either Fixed Deadline or Flexible Deadline.

s.name: Shared Kiln Firing
s.description: A ceramics studio manager and a neighboring pottery instructor are coordinating a shared kiln firing. The manager chooses between Slow Ramp and Fast Ramp, while the instructor chooses between Early Load and Late Load for the day's pieces.

s.name: Library Acquisition Cycle
s.description: A university library and a neighboring public library are making choices during a high-stakes annual acquisition cycle. The university library chooses between Core Titles and Emerging Titles, while the public library chooses between Shared Purchase and Solo Purchase.

s.name: Substrate Season Contract
s.description: A commercial mushroom farm and its substrate supplier are setting terms for the coming growing season. The farm chooses between a Long Contract and a Flexible Order, while the supplier chooses between Reserve Stock and Spot Release.
